title: Stagiair(e) Marketing - Growth e/o Content
description: Volg jij een opleiding in marketing, AI, communicatie, (creative) business of een vergelijkbare studie? Zoek je een afstudeerstage en heb je interesse in een focus op content of growth marketing? We hebben jouw creativiteit en vernieuwende ideeën nodig! Wij zijn namelijk op zoek naar een creatieve student die ons helpt met het maken van marketingcampagnes in woord én beeld. Dit betekent een focus op content creatie en/of growth marketing. Wat ga je doen? Dat bepaal je voornamelijk zelf! Afhankelijk van je opleiding en interesses stellen we een takenpakket samen dat aansluit bij de uitdagingen, doelstellingen en projecten die spelen binnen ons team. Is AI je beste vriend? Mooi, daar kunnen we nog veel in ontwikkelingen. Interesse in de Socials? Fijn, we kunnen je creativiteit goed gebruiken. Vlotte pen? Ook prima! Jouw teksten krijgen bij ons het podium dat ze verdienen. Kortom, afhankelijk van jouw input, ideeën en talenten kijken we samen wat je gaat doen, zoals: Vormgeving; Webinarproducties; Website-optimalisatie en -onderhoud; E-mail marketing; Social media; Deep dive in de analytics; Meedenken in plannen rondom AI. Vanaf dag één nemen we je bij de hand en laten je zien hoe de praktijk werkt. Maar na verloop van tijd kun jij het (bijna) helemaal zelf en vertel je ons hoe het beter kan. Met wie werk je samen? Natuurlijk sta je er niet alleen voor. Wij zijn onlangs gegroeid tot een team van zeven enthousiaste marketeers met ieder een eigen specialisme. Genoeg mogelijkheden dus om samen te groeien en van elkaar te leren. Maud over haar stage bij 12Build: “12Build is voor mij een plek waar ik mezelf kan en mag ontwikkelen. Ik voel me vanaf het eerste moment welkom in een super leuk team. Er is fijne begeleiding, ruimte om vragen te stellen en feedback te geven/ontvangen. De kernwaarden Happiness, Openness en Drive voel je als je hier binnen stapt.” Wie is 12Build? 12Build in het kort: Met een flinke portie Drive, Happiness en Openness bouwen wij aan een transparante bouwbranche. Wij zijn een SaaS platform dat bouwbedrijven verbindt en zo de samenwerking bevordert. We bestaan al bijna twintig jaar en groeien nog steeds. Inmiddels zijn we met meer dan 90 collega’s, verdeeld over 2 kantoren (Nijverdal en Zwolle). Een groot deel van de bouwwereld in de Benelux, Duitsland en Denemarken werkt al op ons platform en gebruikt onze software op dagelijkse basis. En we hebben de ambitie om heel Europa te veroveren. Wat verwachten we van jou? Je volgt HBO of WO-opleiding in marketing, communicatie of aanverwant (zoals creative business, bedrijfskunde, commerciële economie, artificial intelligence, business analytics of marketing analytics); Je zoekt een afstudeerstage en bent beschikbaar per februari 2027, voor een periode van ca. 1/2 jaar. 3e jaars student en op zoek naar een stage voor dezelfde duur en periode? ook jij bent welkom om te reageren! Je beheerst de Nederlandse taal foutloos, zowel mondeling als schriftelijk; And English would be great, since about 1/3rd of our colleagues has an international background; Auch Deutsch wäre schön; Daarnaast ontvang je bonuspunten voor je pingpong, pool of FIFA skills. Wat bieden we jou? Een stagevergoeding; Een moderne werkplek waar je alle middelen en tools krijgt om je werk als een pro uit te voeren; De mogelijkheid om zowel thuis als op kantoor te werken; Een toffe relaxruimte met o.a. pooltafel, tafeltennis en FIFA; Een werkomgeving waar openness, drive en happiness centraal staan. Geregeld leuke uitjes, teamdagen, sprekers en workshops; Geen torenhoge hiërarchische lagen. Gewoon een platte organisatie. Je hebt de moeite genomen deze tekst helemaal te lezen. Dat zegt genoeg, toch? Solliciteer dus snel! Heb je toch nog vragen of twijfel je nog een beetje? Geen probleem! Stuur gerust een mailtje naar Niels (Recruiter), via of neem alvast een kijkje achter de schermen op Instagram of TikTok Find more English Speaking Jobs in Netherlands on Arbeitnow

title: Bioengineer, Display & Library Engineering
description: Adaptyv is building an automated lab that lets AI agents run biology experiments. We're entering the era of agentic science where AI models can now design novel proteins, propose hypotheses, and iterate on experimental results. But they can't run the experiments themselves - that's still a manual, months-long process. We're building the infrastructure that gives AI agents access to the physical world. We are one of the fastest growing biotech companies, trusted by leading biopharmas, frontier AI labs, and the techbio companies pushing the field forward. This is a rare chance to help advance some of the most important work happening in biotech today. Our automated lab is powered by a deep software + hardware stack: lab instruments worth millions of USD reverse-engineered into API-controllable hardware, dozens of devices orchestrated through complex workflows, full observability on everything that happens in the lab, processing pipelines for messy physical-world data, and AI systems that troubleshoot production results and accelerate assay development. We’re growing rapidly and are hiring for talented people to scale and support the massive demand for AI-driven wet lab experimentation. About the Role You are here to scale up data generation. Design teams can hand us 10⁶ sequences, and our automated infrastructure measures on the order of 10³ of them individually. Library construction and display is what closes that gap. We want someone who has set these systems up before and can do it again here, with their own hands. Phage, ribosome, mRNA, yeast, cell-free: which one fits depends on the library and the target, and part of the job is making that call and then building it rather than writing a recommendation. This is a build role, not a service role. For your first months you are making libraries, running selections, working out why a round collapsed, and turning what works into something the automation team can run without you. What You'll Do Build the libraries. Oligo pools, combinatorial assembly, barcoding. More campaigns fail here than at selection. Run selections end to end , including the call on whether a round enriched real binders or just fast growers. Pick the platform per campaign and stand it up. Based on the library and the target, not on what you happened to use last. Own the sequencing analysis. You don't need to be a bioinformatician, but you can't be waiting on one. Hand off to automation. A protocol that only works when you personally run it isn't finished. Close the loop. Selected designs get expressed and measured on BLI and SPR by the team next door. That tells you whether the selection worked. What We're Looking For MSc / PhD in molecular biology, protein engineering, or a relevant field, plus 3+ years running display and selection yourself. You have set up a display platform, not just used one. This is the core requirement. Built the library, got the selection working, and produced binders that held up in an independent assay. Managing outsourced CRO campaigns is not the same thing. Depth in at least one display format and working literacy across the rest. We are not fixed on which one. High-diversity cloning , and an understanding of where bias enters a pool and what it costs you later. NGS as a routine tool , and FACS if you have it. Enough Python or R to analyze your own data without joining a queue. You use AI tools seriously. It's 2026 and we run on Claude Code across the company. You also need the judgment to check what comes back. A self-starter. Nobody is going to hand you a prioritized queue. You decide what to build, build it, and tell us what you learned. Startup speed, not academic pace. Campaigns run against customer deadlines. A working platform with known limits beats an elegant one next year. You want your protocols automated rather than manual forever. If your instinct is that a campaign is finished once you have ten good clones, we will frustrate each other. We want data, not a hit list. Details Location: Lausanne, Switzerland (on-site) Type: Full time Start date: ASAP Application deadline We are reviewing applicants on a rolling basis. title: Performance Marketing Manager
description: Why we do what we do The mind is our window to the world. It can paint everything outside in grey or in bright colors. Whoever finds access to that window can change their perspective every day, and psychological hurdles can become chances to grow. Happiness spreads from one person to the next and across a whole society, like a quiet revolution, one mind at a time. Who we are Our mission inspires us and challenges us. Our skills, thoughts and ideas go into a product that reaches thousands of people, and that brings responsibility with it. The work asks for passion, integrity and the courage to try things no one has tried before. A team full of people who are crazy enough to think they can change the world they live in. Yes, we are a hardworking team, but not for us alone, not for money or personal fame, but for the people we serve at the center of our efforts: Our team, clients, psychologists on our platform and supporters across the country. Why this role exists Aepsy serves three audiences, each with its own timeline. Clients need support now. Psychologists are building their practice. Employers are deciding whether to unlock access for their whole team. This role leads performance marketing for all three: how people find Aepsy, what actually works, and what the numbers suggest we do next. Marketing at Aepsy is a small, focused team, and every role has a clear place in it. The Creative Marketing Lead owns copy and shapes the campaigns. The Art Director builds the visual language. The Growth Performance Architect owns the measurement architecture. You work closely with all three, bringing campaigns to the right people through the right channels, finding out what worked, and helping the team decide what to keep, change or stop. Performance with principles Our values shape how we advertise. Privacy is non-negotiable. Anyone visiting a mental health platform deserves the highest level of privacy and data security. That means no urgency or fear in our messages, no before-and-after claims, and no targeting or retargeting based on health data or other sensitive personal information. Sometimes this makes a number harder to reach. It also builds trust that lasts, and that trust is why people choose Aepsy. If strong performance combined with strong principles sounds like the challenge you’ve been looking for, we’d love to hear from you. What you’ll do Own performance across all funnels. Clients may decide within days. Employers take longer and involve several people. Together with the colleagues closest to each audience, you define what success means for each one. Run paid media end to end on Meta, Google, TikTok and LinkedIn. That covers structure, bidding, audiences, creative rotation, and both awareness and conversion, plus the judgement to know which of the two you’re working on. Read the numbers and get more out of them. The Growth Performance Architect builds the measurement setup with you. You turn it into insights the team can act on. Turn patterns into decisions. Why do people who considered Aepsy drop off before deciding? Does the response to a creative suggest it should run weekly rather than monthly? Answering questions like these is the core of the role. Shape how people find support. Search is changing fast, and new ways of discovering things are emerging. You’ll help decide how people find Aepsy when they need it most. Help build the team’s marketing rhythm. You’ll set up the flow for campaigns, newsletters and more, from first idea to delivery, so the whole team can rely on it. What you bring Three to four years in performance marketing, including campaigns you’ve run end to end and at least one that didn’t go as planned and taught you something. A data-driven mindset with a real feel for brand and content. Confidence running Meta and Google on your own, and experience with TikTok or LinkedIn for reaching HR leads and psychologists. Bring the channels you’ve found work best. Judgement that weighs data together with values. The field is sensitive, Switzerland is a small multilingual market, and the mission matters. Fluent (Swiss) German and English. Aepsy works in four languages, German is the largest market, and most partners and HR leads communicate in German. A habit of noticing a step that repeats and improving it, using AI in your daily work. Strongly preferred SEO and GEO basics, and curiosity about how AI search engines choose which sources to cite. Lifecycle marketing experience: segmentation, triggers and deliverability. Experience at an organisation with strong convictions, and enjoyment of doing great work within clear principles. What we offer Work that matters. Every campaign you improve helps someone find support a little sooner. Your skills serve something bigger than a conversion rate. A team that has your back. The Creative Marketing Lead, Art Director, Growth Performance Architect and Head of Marketing are each strong in their field. You’ll never have to face a number alone. A strong foundation. You’ll build on a product people trust, a network of qualified psychologists, partnerships with employers and insurers, and values clear enough to make hard decisions easier. Room to shape things. There are three audiences, several funnels, a content area being rebuilt, and a search landscape that AI is changing. Your ideas will have impact, and you’ll see it. A short line to decisions. You’ll report directly to the Head of Marketing and have access to leadership strategy. Modern tools , including AI, and the freedom to use them well. Time to recharge : five weeks of holiday and a mental health benefit (of course). Together with us We’re a young, ambitious team with diverse backgrounds and beliefs. We love conversations about the big picture and about the small details. We believe in what we do and work hard for a slightly better world. We’re also friends, parents, partners, stand-up comedians, yoga beginners and Zen monks who enjoy life. Sleep on it. Read it again. Then take a deep breath and send us: Your CV and a personal cover letter . We read every letter carefully, so tell us what motivates you, why this mission matters to you, and why this role, right now. Whatever shows your thinking best . A short note is enough. One campaign you can explain well is worth more than a full portfolio. In our conversation we’ll be curious about two things: a number that proved you wrong, and something you decided to stop doing. PS: Please skip the generic, AI-generated cover letter. A few honest lines in your own words mean much more to us. The time you save is better spent in the sun, on a walk in the forest or with a friend. Life is too beautiful for impersonal cover letters :) Find Jobs in Switzerland on Arbeitnow

description: About the role At Agile Robots, we build powerful software frameworks to orchestrate complex robotic systems and solve challenging tasks. The solutions are sold to various international customers to enable them to control their robotic work cells. Smooth integration and scalable deployment are key goals. AgileCore is meant to be a scalable platform that supports multiple projects in parallel. That only works if the platform underneath scales with it - if it stays fast, thread-safe, and diagnosable as projects, devices, and operating conditions multiply. We are looking for a Senior C++ Performance Engineer to join our AgileCore Runtime core team. On the specialization side, you will drive the performance of the Runtime core - the Blackboard, the Behavior Engine and the execution paths beneath them - make the system provably thread-safe under load, and make failures in the field fast to diagnose. You own the practice: the methodology, the tooling, the benchmarks, the audits and the education. You work hand in hand with the platform architect, who owns the performance budgets and hot-path interface contracts at the architecture level - you turn those budgets into measured, enforced reality and shape them with your findings. You set the standard for performance, concurrency and troubleshooting, and raise the team's ability to meet it without slowing feature development down. This is a shipping role, not a research role: success is measured in merged improvements, closed field escalations and green regression gates - not in microbenchmark leaderboards. We optimize to the budget the product needs, not to zero. where third-party plugins meet 1 kHz vendor control loops A small senior core team with real ownership: your work becomes the standard the whole platform builds on Your Responsibilities: Own the latency, throughput, and jitter of the Runtime core components - benchmark suites, per-subsystem budgets, and regression gates in CI instead of surprises at a customer site Be the hands-on authority on thread safety: ownership models, lock hierarchies, memory-order reasoning, and eliminating whole classes of races through sanitizers, stress and soak testing Ensure the product holds across the complete operational domain it is used in - You will work on a portfolio which includes approximately ±175 clients primarily in the Mid-Market segment (1,000 to 5,000 employees), who spend on average around 8.5k € ARR with us, though actual deal sizes vary, with some larger accounts (25k € +) included. This portfolio includes some well-known brands, as well as more locally known organizations. These clients are based around the world in different industries. What these clients have in common is that they are all developing their HR teams with us. You are tasked with evangelizing our latest product offerings and services, including our AI programs that help HR teams build AI skills. And by doing so, you will drive your pipeline growth. With 175 accounts, you can't give every client the same amount of time. That's why you use AI tools to research accounts, prepare for meetings, and spot expansion signals across your portfolio, so more of your time goes to conversations with clients. In this role you will be working together closely with our Learning Consulting (Customer Success) team. About our Market Reports state that the global e-learning market was worth USD 215 billion in 2021. Moreover, it is estimated to reach an expected value of USD 645 billion by 2030 at a CAGR of 13% during the forecast period (2022–2030). We’ve grown from €0 to €10M in revenue in 6 years, bootstrapped. And 80% of our sales team hit their targets. AIHR is currently trailblazing the path in HR-specific e-learning. You can be a part of that. On a typical day You arrive at our 20th-floor HQ in Rotterdam, just across from Central Station, in the morning. After a brief chat with your colleagues, you grab a cup of coffee, start your computer, check your calendar for any last-minute changes, and prepare the day around the calls you have planned with your customers, and internal meetings with colleagues. For each client call, you ask your custom GPT for a quick account brief based on HubSpot/Gong data, platform usage, and notes from past calls. Then, you review a report that Silvia from the product team has shared with you. A few weeks ago, you got the idea that clients who download resources to assess their AI-maturity and who have larger HR teams might be interested in our new AI Boot Camp offering. You used AI to cross-reference those downloads with HR team size in HubSpot and build a target list. You outlined this hypothesis in a short business case you pitched to Emilie, your manager, who agreed. We’ve been running a campaign on this topic with our marketing team. Now some clients want to talk! You discuss the campaign results with your peers Jessica, Max and Filip. Rik, our in-house chef, serves lunch, and you enjoy it with the wider sales team. Next, you have a few 30-minute client meetings in a row, followed by admin. You open HubSpot (our CRM) and go through your daily tasks. Next, you work on a proposal for a client you spoke with the day before. You use AI to draft a first version tailored to the goals they shared on the call, then sharpen it yourself. You also prepare another client presentation. You use our tool Gong to review parts of the call you had earlier because you applied some tactics you learned in training on SPICED last month. Gong's AI summary points you straight to the moments that matter. You share relevant parts of the call with Emilie as part of your development plan (everyone at AIHR has one, as hunger to grow is one of our core values). Before you know it, it’s the end of the day. Luckily, it’s the last Friday of the month, a social gathering! This is when the whole team comes together to celebrate our successes (we have many!), eat something, drink, and get to know each other outside of work. Who you are We’re looking for someone positive, resilient, and curious, a true relationship builder with excellent communication skills, and someone who is not afraid to fail. The ideal candidate has the following: Minimum 3+ years experience in a closing role; Experience with successfully owning at least 1,5 million € portfolio and/or closing 25 k € deals at mid-market companies; Experience renewing and growing clients; Experience using generative AI tools (e.g., ChatGPT, Gemini) for tasks like account research, meeting prep, proposal writing, and workflow automation is essential; The ability to talk credibly with HR leaders about how AI is changing their function; A relentless drive to win, with the courage to hold clients accountable; Commercially assertive - never a pushover, always pushing for the close; A shark’s instinct for the deal: sensing opportunities and going for them without hesitation; Excellent written and verbal English skills; A talent for hypothesis-based thinking; Track record of continuously overachieved targets; An exceptional sense of responsibility; Experience working for a fast-growing organization; A sixth sense for commercial opportunities; Knowledge of WinningByDesign is a plus; Affinity with E-Learning and/or HR is a plus. We offer A key role in shaping the education of tens of thousands of Human Resource professionals from all over the world through our courses; Benchmarked compensation; The opportunity to shape your day-to-day work; A personal development plan with a structured path toward your next promotion; Flexible working hours & working from home arrangements after your onboarding; A high degree of autonomy in a vibrant, result-driven, inclusive, and international team; A key role in a fast-growing scale-up company; A beautiful office right across Rotterdam Central Station (Millennium Tower) and a brand new office in Amsterdam; 26 paid holidays per year + 1 extra day for every year you work here + you can exchange any 2 public holiday days for 2 other days of your choice; Pension plan; 5 Mental health days per year; Access to OpenUp mental health platform; Personal development budget, training, and we pay for the books you read! All public transport expenses covered (NS Business Card); MacBook + all other equipment you need to do your work; Daily lunch prepared by a chef, weekly drinks, and fun team activities; Free access to the office gym. title: Lead Analytics Engineer
description: Do you love turning messy business questions into data people can trust? Can you connect the customer journey from the first marketing touch through sales conversion, revenue, retention, and product usage and explain the numbers equally clearly to an engineer, a CMO, and a CFO? AIHR is looking for a Lead Agentic Analytics Engineer to become the hands-on functional lead of our two-person Data & Analytics team. You will own the translation of cross-functional business questions into trusted metrics, governed semantic models, and decision-ready agentic analytics; set the analytical direction; and build the most critical models yourself. You are transforming raw data into governed products that drive decision-making for our business partners. About AIHR Founded in 2016 with the mission to future-proof HR, the Academy to Innovate HR (AIHR) has become the global market leader in online training for HR professionals. We support customers in more than 140 countries, including organizations such as Unilever, Reckitt, Goldman Sachs, Philips, Deloitte, Nike, Heineken, and UBS. Our goal is to continuously upskill and empower one million HR professionals. Today, we are an international team of more than 100 people representing over 30 nationalities. We are driven by excellence, innovation, and a hunger to grow, while staying friendly, enthusiastic, and committed to helping each other succeed. Working at AIHR means taking real responsibility, improving how we operate, and getting the freedom to develop in new areas and shape your role as the company grows. Role and Responsibilities AIHR's Data & Analytics team is part of Business Operations. You will work alongside Vahid, our Senior Data Engineer, and report to Leo, our VP of Business Operations. Our ingestion and warehouse foundation is largely established: data from systems such as HubSpot and our own LMS moves through ETL pipelines into Snowflake. Through special Projects, we are building governed semantic layers on top so the business can self-serve trusted analytics through Power BI, Metabase, and AI tools. Your role owns the step that matters most: translating a business question into a clear definition, a well-designed model, and conversational/agentic analytics that your leadership trusts. You will set the analytical architecture, dbt standards, and roadmap, while Vahid focuses on ingestion, warehouse reliability, and engineering implementation. You will both build: you will personally deliver the most critical business models, review implementations, and ensure the outputs are usable by the business. This role has no direct reports. Your colleague, Vahid, remains managed by the VP of Business Operations, while you have clear functional decision rights over metric definitions, semantic-model design, analytical quality, dbt standards, and technical priorities. It is designed for someone who wants to lead through expertise while remaining close to the work. What You'll Own Own and execute a rolling one-year Data & Analytics roadmap, balancing urgent business needs with foundational work. Guide Vahid through clear priorities, design reviews, code review, and reusable modeling patterns. Lead discovery across Marketing, Sales, Customer Success, Product, and Finance to uncover the decision behind a request and translate it into agreed metric definitions, governed semantic layers, and data models that connect the full customer lifecycle. Set the analytical architecture and dbt standards; design, build, test, and document the most critical governed models yourself using SQL and dbt. Own the full-funnel measurement framework—from marketing reach, demand generation, attribution, and customer acquisition cost through lead and pipeline conversion, sales cycle, bookings, and revenue to onboarding, product adoption, expansion, renewal, churn, and customer lifetime value. Keep core recurring-revenue definitions finance-grade and reconciled while showing how upstream activity drives downstream customer outcomes. Own the logic and quality behind executive dashboards and self-service analytics across Power BI, Metabase, and AI-enabled interfaces. Present the results to senior leaders, explain every assumption, and respond constructively to challenge. Partner closely with Vahid on warehouse and pipeline requirements, resolve conflicting numbers at the source, and raise the technical quality of the team. Apply AI where it improves development speed or data access, while using sound judgment around privacy, governance, validation, and trust. A Typical Week This is a hands-on lead role. The exact balance will shift with business priorities, but you should expect roughly half your time to remain close to the data—building, reviewing, and investigating—and the rest to be split across discovery, functional leadership, and decision support. Design or improve a dbt model that connects data across HubSpot, our LMS, billing, or other source systems; write the SQL, tests, documentation, and metric logic needed to put it into production. Run discovery sessions with leaders in Marketing, Sales, Customer Success, Product, or Finance to clarify the decision they need to make, challenge the requested metric, and agree on the definition. Work side by side with Vahid on source-data requirements, architecture choices, and implementation; review code and unblock delivery without handing off all of the technical work. Investigate a commercial or customer-lifecycle question, improve an executive or functional dashboard, and present the conclusion—including assumptions and limitations—to the relevant leadership team. Reprioritize the Data & Analytics roadmap, resolve competing requests, and invest in the semantic layer, governance, and reusable modeling foundations that reduce future ad hoc work. What Success Looks Like Within your first three months, you have established a clear operating model with Vahid, mapped ownership of the most important metrics, agreed the Data & Analytics roadmap, and resolved at least one material conflicting-number problem. Within six months, AIHR has a governed customer-lifecycle domain in dbt and an executive view connecting acquisition and pipeline to revenue, retention, and product usage, and has launched the first MVP of our agentic analytics platform to drive self-serve adoption. The underlying definitions are documented, reconciled where relevant, and trusted across Marketing, Sales, Customer Success, Product, and Finance. Within twelve months, two or three priority business domains are governed end to end, leadership can trace performance from acquisition through lifetime value using consistent numbers, self-service adoption is growing, and Vahid can independently implement the modeling patterns and quality standards you established. Throughout, you remain hands-on in SQL, dbt, Snowflake, and analytics while setting direction, coaching through the work, and earning leadership's trust in both the numbers and the roadmap. We offer A high-impact role as the functional lead of a small Data & Analytics team, with end-to-end ownership of the semantic layer behind company-wide decisions. Competitive, benchmarked compensation. Substantial autonomy to shape your day-to-day work, with regular growth conversations and support for your career goals. Flexible working hours and work-from-home arrangements after onboarding. 26 paid holidays per year, plus one extra day for each of your first five years at AIHR. The option to exchange any two public holidays for two days of your choice. A work-from-anywhere policy that lets you work abroad for up to 20 days per calendar year. A pension plan, four Trust Days for ad hoc recovery, and access to the OpenUp mental health platform. A personal development budget, training opportunities, and the books you need to keep learning. All public-transport expenses covered through an NS Business Card, plus a MacBook and the equipment you need. A beautiful office opposite Rotterdam Central S

title: Senior Partnership Manager
description: Do you look at a partner program that works and immediately see what it could become at three times the size? Are you the kind of person who owns your number and a running book of business, while designing the channels that will carry the next phase of growth? Do you want a mandate that is yours: rethink how we work with resellers, open up consultancies and universities, and work out where tech partnerships fit? And do you like variety, where growing an existing commercial partner one day and presenting a new partner model to leadership the next is just part of the job? AIHR is looking for a Senior Partnership Manager to grow our commercial partner book and build the partner programs that take us into the next phase of growth within our Sales Department. This is not a marketing position. About AIHR Founded in 2016 with the mission to future-proof HR, the Academy to Innovate HR (AIHR) has become the world’s market leader in online training for human resources (HR) professionals. We have a global customer base spanning 140+ countries, including companies such as Unilever, Reckitt, Goldman Sachs, Philips, Deloitte, Nike, Heineken, and UBS. It is our goal to continuously upskill and empower 1,000,000 HR Professionals. We are an international team of 100+ people, driven by excellence, innovation, and a hunger to grow in everything we do. As such, we strive to provide the world’s best courses and excellent support to our customers while continuously optimizing every aspect of our work. With over 30 nationalities, our team is diverse, yet we all share a few traits: we're friendly, enthusiastic, and great team players. Being a fast-growing company, working at AIHR means taking on a lot of responsibility. For a senior hire, that means real ownership: the room to shape a commercial channel, direct access to leadership, and the potential to craft your own role as the program grows. Role and Responsibilities As Senior Partnership Manager, you come in with the ambition to triple the AIHR partnership program. Today that program is a global portfolio of 130+ commercial partners driving primarily single-seat e-commerce sales, plus a reseller channel that brings in B2B business. Both work, and both have far more potential than we currently capture. Your job is to optimize what we have, evolve it into a set of structured commercial partner programs, and work out which new channels deserve investment. This is a quota-carrying role with a build mandate. You manage a running book of business with our existing commercial partners and stay their main point of contact. On top of that, you design and launch larger partner programs with resellers, HR consultancies, system integrators, and universities. We have a strong belief that these partners, HR implementation consultants in particular, are well placed to position our courses with their clients, and that this can become a major revenue stream for AIHR. Your work is built from three connected workstreams: Grow the existing partner channel: run the existing book, grow partner revenue, and identify the commercial opportunities that drive meaningful additional business. Build the extended partner programs: restructure the reseller program so it generates more predictable, repeatable B2B revenue, and extend it to consultancies, system integrators, and universities. Define the tech partnership go-to-market: research which commercial models fit AIHR, propose the strategy, then test, validate, and build out what works. You’ll report to the Team Lead for Channel & Strategic Partnerships, work closely with Marketing, Sales, and Product to get your partners what they need, and act as the partnership network’s advocate across the wider commercial team. You will regularly present proposals and results to AIHR leadership. On a typical day On a typical Monday morning, you start with your pipeline. Your existing partner book is quick to review: a few conversations need a nudge, two QBRs are coming up. The larger partnerships take more thought. Other companies in our industry have built significant revenue through resellers, consultancies, and universities, but these deals have a longer sales cycle, so you always keep several opportunities moving at the same time. Today that means a value-added reseller in the middle of a negotiation, a prospective university that wants to add AIHR’s courses to its 2027 academic year, and a consultancy that signed last month and now needs to get moving. After lunch you speak with the managing partner of a German niche consultancy that does a lot of HR implementation work. Her clients keep running into the same problem: the new system goes live, and the HR team lacks the skills to get the most out of it. You talk through how capability building could become part of her offering, with AIHR as the partner behind it. She is interested, and you agree to work out a commercial proposal together. Next you work on an enablement session for consultants, covering what they need to know about our courses, how they bring AIHR into a client conversation, what a first joint win could look like, and you brief Marketing on the materials their consultants will need. The next morning is for outreach. You build a sourcing list of potential partners in a segment you want to open up, and you contact them yourself. AIHR has a very good name in the HR industry, and that usually helps open doors. Later that week you run a QBR with one of your strongest commercial partners. You review their numbers together, agree on two concrete actions, and set a date to check back in. You identify where there is room to grow the relationship and push for more where performance has stalled. You also notice that a large part of their customer base works in corporate HR teams, so you bring in a colleague from Sales to explore a B2B opportunity through the same relationship. On Thursday you are back with the value-added reseller. They want to bundle our courses with their own services. It is a model we haven’t proven yet. There is no standard agreement to pull off the shelf, so you work with our Sales Engineer to design the deal while you negotiate it: what they sell, how they are rewarded, how revenue is generated, and what would tell you both it is working. You treat it as a pilot and agree on a first version you can learn from. Some of these experiments will not work out. The ones that do become the programs you build the channel on, and you will be the person who figured them out. You close out the week updating your forecast and walking your manager through where the existing book, pipeline, and new programs stand. Friday afternoon wraps with a quick team catch-up and, if you're in the Rotterdam office, our regular Friday drinks. Your Target This is a quota-carrying role. Your number is built from the revenue of the partner book you run and the new partner programs you launch. In your first year, that means growing revenue across the existing partner portfolio, a restructured reseller program, the first signed partners among consultancies, system integrators, and universities, and a tech partnership go-to-market strategy that has been proposed, tested, and started generating commercial opportunities. We offer Competitive, benchmarked compensation, including a commission plan tied to your target A high degree of autonomy in a vibrant, result-driven, inclusive, and international team A beautiful office right across Rotterdam Central Station (Millenniumtoren), with a satellite office in Amsterdam 26 paid holidays per year Exchange any 2 public holiday days for 2 other days of your choice Work-from-anywhere policy: up to 20 days a year working abroad Pension plan Access to the OpenUp mental health platform Personal development budget, training, and we pay for the books you read All public transport expenses covered (NS Business Card) MacBook + all other equipment you need to do your work Daily lunch prepared by a chef, weekly drinks, and fun tea

title: Senior Sales Operations (SalesOps) Manager
description: Do you like making it easier for a Sales team to do its best work? Do you enjoy owning the details that keep deals moving, while also spotting where the process could work better? And do you get satisfaction from turning repetitive work into a simpler, smarter way of working? AIHR is looking for a Senior Sales Operations Manager to join our Revenue Operations team. You’ll help support more than €10 million in annual deal value , working closely with Sales leadership while owning the operational processes that move deals from opportunity to collected revenue. About AIHR Founded in 2016 with the mission to future-proof HR, the Academy to Innovate HR (AIHR) has become the world’s market leader in online training for human resources (HR) professionals. We have a global customer base spread across 140+ countries, amongst which companies like Unilever, Reckitt, Goldman Sachs, Philips, Deloitte, Nike, Heineken, and UBS. It is our goal to continuously upskill and empower 1,000,000 HR Professionals. We are an international team of 90+ people, driven by excellence, innovation, and a hunger to grow in everything we do. As such, we strive to provide the world’s best courses and excellent support to our customers while continuously optimizing every aspect of our work. With over 30 nationalities, our team is diverse, yet we all share a few traits: we're friendly, enthusiastic, and great team players. Being a fast-growing company, working at AIHR means taking on a lot of responsibility and getting countless opportunities to develop yourself in new areas and potential to craft your own role. Role and Responsibilities As our Senior Sales Operations Manager, your job is to make it easier for Sales to do great work. This is a hands-on role with a broad view of the commercial journey. You’ll work on how Sales operates, support leadership with better insight, and own processes such as the Deal Desk, vendor registration, invoicing, collections, and order-to-cash. We see those responsibilities as connected. Being close to the day-to-day work gives you the context to see where time is being lost, where a process no longer works, and where the same problem keeps coming back. We want someone who is comfortable doing the work themselves, but who does not simply accept unnecessary manual work because “that’s how we do it.” This role is a combination of keeping things moving today and making sure they work better tomorrow. Your responsibilities include: Improving how Sales works. You use data, feedback, and your understanding of the day-to-day work to identify where things can be better. That could mean redesigning a workflow, improving reporting, clarifying ownership, creating a better operating rhythm, or removing manual steps that no longer add value. Helping Sales leadership improve performance. You look beyond individual requests and help spot patterns across the Sales organization. Where are deals slowing down? What does the data tell us about why? Are we missing information in HubSpot that would help Sales, Marketing, or leadership make better decisions? You turn those observations into practical recommendations and are comfortable challenging existing ways of working when the data points somewhere else. Owning and improving the Deal Desk. When a deal needs something outside the standard process, you help move it forward. This can include approvals, documentation, commercial questions, vendor or supplier registration, procurement portals, questionnaires, and coordination across internal and external stakeholders. You take care of the immediate need, while also looking for patterns that could make the next request simpler. Owning order-to-cash and collections. You take responsibility for turning booked revenue into collected cash. Collections is a meaningful and hands-on part of the role: monitoring outstanding invoices, following up with customers, picking up the phone when that is the best way to resolve an issue, and working with Sales, Finance, procurement teams, and other stakeholders to clear payment blockers. You also look at the process behind the work — reducing overdue balances, improving follow-up, and finding ways to make order-to-cash more effective over time. Working AI-first. You actively use AI and automation where they can make the work more efficient or improve the quality of the outcome. That might mean analyzing patterns in Sales data, speeding up vendor registration, improving a recurring workflow, or removing repetitive administrative work. As part of RevOps, you are expected to try new approaches, keep what works, and share useful ways of working with the wider team. Connecting the dots across teams. Many commercial processes cross Sales, Finance, Customer Experience, Marketing, Operations, and other parts of the business. You help create clarity around ownership, bring the right people together, and make sure decisions turn into action. You’ll work with tools including HubSpot, Gong, Atlassian, QuotaPath, Zapier, Google Workspace , and a growing set of AI tools and internal AI workflows. We do not expect you to arrive as an expert in every system. We do expect you to be comfortable learning how they fit together and questioning whether we are using them in the best way. Success in this role is not simply an empty queue or a dashboard that looks good. It is reliable day-to-day execution combined with steady improvement in how Sales operates. On a typical day On Monday morning, you start by getting a view of the commercial week ahead. You check active deals in HubSpot, outstanding operational requests, the payments inbox, and anything else that needs attention. During the RevOps stand-up with the RevOps team, you talk through priorities. An Account Executive is working on an enterprise opportunity where the customer's procurement team needs AIHR registered as a vendor. Several invoices need follow-up. You have also noticed a group of deals spending longer than expected in one stage of the pipeline. The vendor registration comes first. You use one of our existing AI workflows to help complete the documentation, gather any missing information internally, and get the process moving. While doing that, you notice that part of the information the workflow relies on is out of date. Rather than working around it, you fix the source and make sure the next registration is easier. Later, you turn to the stalled opportunities. You dig into the data, speak with the Sales team, and find that Account Executives are not consistently recording meeting outcomes. That makes it difficult to understand why certain MQLs progress while others do not. The answer may not be “Sales needs to update HubSpot more.” You look at why the information is not being captured in the first place and whether the workflow can be made easier for reps while still giving Marketing and leadership the information they need. You believe it’s easier to change a process than to change human behaviors. After lunch with colleagues in the office, you spend time on collections. Some invoices need a straightforward reminder. Others need more persistence. You follow up with customers, get on the phone where needed, and work through issues involving purchase orders, invoicing details, procurement processes, or internal ownership. This work is part of the role, not something sitting outside it. And because you are doing it yourself, you see first-hand which issues are one-offs and which ones point to something we should fix. On another day, you sit down with Sales leadership to look at commercial performance. You are not there simply to report what happened. You help interpret what is behind the numbers and what we might do differently. You also regularly connect with Neal, Head of CX & Operations , and colleagues across Business Operations. Some weeks you will spend more time on live operational work; other weeks give you more room to improve reporting, build an automation in Zapier, clean up a process

title: Senior .NET Developer
description: Bouw mee aan de toekomst van kassasoftware Retail staat nooit stil. Voor ons Customer Experience team zoeken we een senior .NET developer die niet alleen sterke software bouwt, maar ook helpt onze bestaande codebase fundamenteel verder te brengen. Een belangrijk deel van je werk is een gerichte refactoring: naar een architectuur die beter onderhoudbaar en testbaar is, waarin testautomatisering vanzelfsprekender wordt en waarin teams effectief en verantwoord met AI kunnen ontwikkelen. Je komt terecht in een rol met inhoudelijke diepgang én zichtbare impact op een product dat dagelijks door retailers wordt gebruikt. Hoe ziet jouw dag er precies uit? Je werkt in het Customer Experience team aan onze Windows-kassaclient en aan de technische basis daaromheen. Samen met collega’s uit development en product vertaal je klant- en gebruikersbehoeften naar robuuste software. Je houdt je onder andere bezig met: Het ontwerpen en realiseren van nieuwe functionaliteit voor onze kassasoftware. Het stapsgewijs refactoren en moderniseren van bestaande .NET-code, zonder de continuïteit voor onze klanten uit het oog te verliezen. Het verbeteren van architectuur, modulariteit, afhankelijkheden en codekwaliteit. Het creëren van een codebase die beter testbaar is en waarin geautomatiseerde tests eenvoudiger en betrouwbaarder kunnen worden toegevoegd en onderhouden. Het opzetten en verbeteren van unit-, integratie- en waar relevant end-to-end testautomatisering. Het toepassen en verder ontwikkelen van een AI-native SDLC: van analyse en ontwerp tot implementatie, testen, code review en documentatie. Het kritisch beoordelen, testen en verbeteren van door AI gegenereerde voorstellen en code. Het delen van kennis en het helpen van collega’s om AI-first development effectief, veilig en met behoud van vakmanschap toe te passen. Het samenwerken met product, UX en andere developmentteams om technische keuzes te verbinden met klantwaarde. Wat bieden we jou? Een inhoudelijk uitdagende seniorrol met directe invloed op de toekomst van onze kassasoftware. De ruimte om een belangrijke refactoring en moderniseringsslag daadwerkelijk vorm te geven Een omgeving waarin AI-first development serieus wordt genomen en waarin je actief kunt bijdragen aan de verdere professionalisering daarvan. Samenwerking met betrokken collega’s in een informele organisatie met korte lijnen. Veel vrijheid, verantwoordelijkheid en ruimte voor eigen initiatief. Hybride werken, met Breda als kantoorlocatie. Marktconform salaris en aantrekkelijke secundaire arbeidsvoorwaarden. Ruimte voor persoonlijke en technische ontwikkeling. Wat zoeken wij? Je technische skills Je bent een ervaren software engineer die eigenaarschap neemt en technische vraagstukken graag tot de kern doorgrondt. Je combineert pragmatisme met hoge kwaliteitsstandaarden: je weet wanneer een snelle verbetering passend is, maar ook wanneer een structurele oplossing nodig is. Zeer ruime, aantoonbare ervaring met C# en het .NET-ecosysteem. Ervaring met het ontwikkelen en onderhouden van bedrijfskritische applicaties met een langere technische historie. Goede kennis van objectgericht ontwerp, SOLID-principes, dependency injection, async/await en gangbare design patterns Ervaring met refactoring van complexe codebases en het stapsgewijs verbeteren van architectuur en maintainability. Sterke ervaring met geautomatiseerd testen, bijvoorbeeld met unit tests, integratietests, mocking en testbare architectuur. Ervaring met WPF en .NET Framework; ervaring met .NET MAUI is een plus. Ervaring met bijvoorbeeld Entity Framework, NuGet, CI/CD en Git-gebaseerde ontwikkelprocessen. Een kritische blik op requirements, technische keuzes en kwaliteit. Goede communicatieve vaardigheden in het Nederlands en Engels. AI-first development is voor jou de standaard Voor deze rol zoeken we nadrukkelijk geen kandidaat die AI slechts af en toe als hulpmiddel inzet. Jij hebt AI-first development volledig omarmd en weet hoe je dit vertaalt naar een professionele softwareontwikkelpraktijk. Dat betekent dat je ervaring hebt met het inzetten van AI in meerdere fasen van de SDLC, bijvoorbeeld voor analyse, ontwerp, implementatie, testautomatisering, refactoring, documentatie en code review. Je begrijpt tegelijk dat AI geen vervanging is voor engineering judgement: je kunt output valideren, risico’s herkennen, kwaliteit bewaken en de juiste technische beslissingen blijven nemen. Je hebt een duidelijke visie op hoe AI helpt om sneller en beter te leveren, zonder concessies te doen aan betrouwbaarheid, security, testbaarheid en onderhoudbaarheid. Je soft skills Je neemt verantwoordelijkheid voor wat je bouwt én voor de kwaliteit van de technische omgeving waarin je werkt. Je bent analytisch sterk en kunt complexe legacy- of architectuurvraagstukken overzichtelijk maken Je bent nieuwsgierig, blijft jezelf ontwikkelen en deelt graag kennis met anderen Je werkt graag samen, maar kunt ook zelfstandig richting geven aan technische verbeteringen. Je durft bestaande aannames en oplossingen ter discussie te stellen als dat leidt tot een beter resultaat. Je hebt oog voor de gebruiker én voor de lange termijn van het product. title: Director, European Strategic Communications
description: Anduril Industries is a defense technology company with a mission to transform U.S. and allied military capabilities with advanced technology. By bringing the expertise, technology, and business model of the 21st century’s most innovative companies to the defense industry, Anduril is changing how military systems are designed, built and sold. Anduril’s family of systems is powered by Lattice OS, an AI-powered operating system that turns thousands of data streams into a realtime, 3D command and control center. As the world enters an era of strategic competition, Anduril is committed to bringing cutting-edge autonomy, AI, computer vision, sensor fusion, and networking technology to the military in months, not years. ABOUT THE TEAM Anduril's global communications team is responsible for shaping how the world understands modern defense technology—and why it matters. We're seeking a Director of Communications, Europe, to build and lead Anduril's external communications presence across the continent. This is a senior individual contributor role based in Amsterdam, reporting to the VP of Global Communications, with a dotted line to Anduril's European General Manager. You will be Anduril's first dedicated communications hire in Europe, responsible for standing up a regional program from scratch, building relationships with media and institutions, and developing the narratives that will define Anduril's reputation across the world's most consequential defense markets. This is a builder role. You'll set strategy and execute it yourself, establish agency and contractor networks as the business grows, and work shoulder-to-shoulder with business development, policy, and senior leadership to earn Anduril a place in Europe's defense conversation. The ideal candidate has deep roots across multiple European markets, understands how defense, technology, and industrial policy intersect at the national level, and knows how to build presence and credibility in environments where trust is earned slowly and reputation matters enormously. WHAT YOU'LL DO Build Anduril's European communications program from the ground up, developing strategy, establishing infrastructure, and executing across markets with varying levels of maturity and priority. Drive media relations across defense, technology, business, and policy outlets in priority European markets, building the relationships and pipelines that will sustain long-term coverage. Develop and execute market-specific narrative strategies that connect Anduril's mission and capabilities to each country's defense priorities, industrial ambitions, and security context. Work closely with Anduril's European General Manager and business development teams to support market entry, customer engagement, partnerships, and key events. Build and manage a network of regional agencies and contractors as European operations expand. Partner with global communications, policy, and marketing teams to adapt core messaging for European audiences without losing coherence or accuracy. Engage think tanks, research institutions, and policy communities to build credibility and shape the broader discourse around defense innovation and allied cooperation. Own metrics and reporting frameworks to track progress and demonstrate impact across markets. QUALIFICATIONS 10+ years of experience in communications, public affairs, or media relations. Fluency in the European defense and political landscape across multiple countries, how decisions get made, who shapes opinion, and where the conversation is heading. A track record of building communications programs in new markets, not just inheriting them. Experience managing agencies, contractors, and regional communications networks across borders. Exceptional writing and strategic thinking, with the ability to develop narratives that land across cultures and audiences. Comfortable working autonomously in an early-stage market environment, with the judgment to make calls without a lot of process around you. You'll excel in this role if you: Have built something before, a market presence, a regional program, a communications function, and know what that actually requires. Can hold complexity: different countries, different threat perceptions, different industrial interests, all requiring distinct approaches under a coherent strategy. Know Europe's defense ecosystem personally, the journalists, the institutions, the officials who shape how these conversations evolve. Are energized by the moment Europe is in, and want to help shape how one of the most important defense technology companies in the world shows up in it. title: Medical Doctor with SNOMED Coding Experience (UK)
description: We are seeking qualified medical doctors to annotate and code clinical documents with SNOMED CT, with a focus on accuracy and consistency against detailed coding guidelines. You will work asynchronously on a dedicated annotation platform, coding de-identified clinical notes and documentation including discharge summaries, lab results and progress notes against SNOMED CT concepts to support the development of clinical AI platforms. Technical proficiency: Comfortable using structured annotation tools and digital platforms. Language: Native or near-native written English. Legal Status You will have the right to work in your country of residence. You will work as an independent contractor. Why Join Us? Competitive Compensation: Hourly rate, paid weekly Professional Development: Hands-on experience in clinical AI development and terminology work, shaping how AI systems interpret clinical records and assign medical codes. description: Installation, formation et support des solutions d’encaissement Vous aimez le contact client, les nouvelles technologies et les solutions concrètes ? SAS ARCHIMAX est spécialisée dans l’installation et la maintenance de systèmes de caisse, d’équipements digitaux et de réseaux, notamment autour du logiciel RESTOMAX. Nous aidons les professionnels de la restauration et du commerce à simplifier leur quotidien et à digitaliser leur activité. Installer et configurer les solutions Installer et paramétrer les systèmes de caisse et les outils digitaux. Mettre en service les caisses tactiles, imprimantes tickets, tablettes, écrans cuisine et terminaux de paiement. Configurer les connexions et les réseaux : WiFi, routeurs et IP. title: Associate Director- Sustainability & Impact (Lyon, France)
description: Location : Lyon, France About ARCHIMED: With offices in Europe, North America and Asia, ARCHIMED is a leading investment firm focused exclusively on healthcare industries. Its mix of operational, medical, scientific and financial expertise allows ARCHIMED to serve as both a strategic and financial partner to healthcare businesses. Prioritized areas of focus include Biopharma Products, Consumer Health, Healthcare IT, In Vitro Diagnostics, Life Science Tools & Biologic Services, MedTech, and Pharma Services. ARCHIMED helps partners internationalize, acquire, innovate and expand their products and services. ARCHIMED manages €8 billion across its various funds, including the largest healthcare-only private equity fund raised by a European-based General Partner. Since inception, ARCHIMED has been a committed Impact investor, both directly and through its EURÊKA Foundation. The Team • An international team (with more than 30 nationalities) with complementary education and experience in the investment, medical, scientific, strategic and operational sectors • Composed of alumni from: INSEAD, Berkeley, Georgetown, Bocconi, HEC Paris, Ponts et Chaussées, ESSEC, Imperial College, Dartmouth, etc. • Professional backgrounds: Private Equity (3i, Siparex, USS Ltd, Barings, capiton), Consulting (A.T. Kearney, Bain, McKinsey), M&A (Lazard, EY, KPMG, PwC), Industry (Biotronik, Cerba, Pharmacy, Veterinary) Your Role Portfolio engagement and value creation Lead portfolio engagement on Sustainability and Impact (S&I), providing hands-on support to portfolio companies and tracking S&I progress across ARCHIMED’s portfolios through dashboards, KPIs, and supporting processes. Lead select portfolio value creation projects, collaborating with deal teams as well as guiding and project managing S&I interns where required. Develop and oversee the execution of actionable S&I roadmaps for each portfolio company, with targets and milestones based on the company’s materiality analysis and aligned with ARCHIMED’s S&I strategy, partnering with third-party technical experts when necessary. Influence portfolio company management to advance their roadmaps through technical guidance and sharing of best practices. Investment process Act as the bridge between deal teams and external providers during due diligence, critically assessing findings to confirm that each target is consistent with ARCHIMED’s S&I strategy and fund obligations. Work with all ARCHIMED functions to review and improve how S&I is integrated into investment decision making. Data, reporting, and compliance Establish the tools and framework to collect, monitor, and coordinate S&I data across funds, enabling timely, accurate, and consistent reporting, and select third-party technical experts when necessary. Analyze and interpret S&I data and substantially contribute to the production of ARCHIMED’s annual S&I report in line with industry standards and frameworks, turning data into clear narratives. Contribute substantially to regular reporting to investors and to mandatory disclosures on fund S&I performance, ensuring credibility and transparency. Monitor regulatory developments in ARCHIMED’s locations and sectors of focus, and help ensure compliance with sustainability-related requirements. Center of excellence and capability building Establish an S&I center of excellence across funds and portfolio companies, with tools, reports, and training materials that share guidance and best practices. Provide expert guidance and S&I training to management, investment, and investor relations teams to deepen integration across the business. Requirements At least 10 years’ experience building and executing sustainability strategies, preferably in private equity. Proven hands-on leadership, initiative, and project management skills, with strong problem-solving ability. Robust knowledge of S&I frameworks and disclosures, including SFDR, SASB, CSRD, EDCI, PMDR, and the UN SDGs. Strong command of impact measurement methodologies, including developing and reporting on impact metrics. Strong attention to detail, with the ability to build coherent sustainability narratives and proofread content. Excellent interpersonal, communication, and presentation skills, with the adaptability to engage C-suite executives internationally. Proven team player, able to build working partnerships and promote collaboration with a wide range of stakeholders. Ability to coach junior team members, sharing knowledge and giving regular feedback. title: Senior datamanagement specialist
description: Als senior datamanagement specialist werk je aan een belangrijke ambitie: data binnen de AFM naar een niveau brengen waarop risico’s beheerst worden én data optimaal kan worden ingezet voor toezicht. Dit team ondersteunt toezichtsafdelingen en ondersteunende afdelingen met specialistische kennis op het gebied van onder andere data governance, datamodellering, masterdatamanagement, datakwaliteit en metadatamanagement. Let op: Deze functie is aangemerkt als een kwetsbare functie. Voor interne medewerkers geldt dat bij een overstap naar deze functie een herscreening kan plaatsvinden. Voorbeeld uit de praktijk "Je werkt vanuit datamanagement aan de ontwikkeling van een nieuwe centrale capability: de Self Service Analyse Omgeving (SSA). Deze omgeving moet toezichthouders in staat stellen om zelfstandig analyses uit te voeren op beschikbare data. Hoe pak je dit aan?" Je werkt samen met Data Analisten aan het opzetten van deze capability. Vanuit datamanagement ben jij verantwoordelijk voor het definiëren van de randvoorwaarden waarbinnen data veilig, verantwoord en effectief gebruikt kan worden. Daarbij richten jullie je op drie belangrijke onderdelen: Datatoegang: samen bepalen jullie welke datasets beschikbaar worden gesteld aan toezichtteams en hoe deze toegankelijk worden gemaakt. Governance en compliance: jij zorgt ervoor dat datagebruik voldoet aan wet- en regelgeving, waarbij herkomst, eigenaarschap, toegangsrechten en doelbinding van data duidelijk zijn vastgelegd. Standaardisatie: samen ontwikkelen jullie een centrale en uniforme werkwijze, zodat gebruikers data op een consistente manier kunnen raadplegen en analyseren. Uiteindelijk leveren jullie een veilige en gestandaardiseerde Self Service Analyse Omgeving op. Hierdoor kunnen toezichthouders zelfstandig inzichten verkrijgen uit data, terwijl de kwaliteit, veiligheid en governance van de data gewaarborgd blijven. description: About Us Basecamp Research is building frontier AI for therapeutic design. We believe the future of medicine lies in reprogramming the body to repair itself, and we design the models and the medicines to teach it how. Our EDEN models are trained on BaseData, the world's largest proprietary genomic dataset, with over 10B genes collected through partnerships in more than 30 countries across all seven continents. Our pipeline of EDEN-designed therapeutics, beginning with in vivo cell therapy, is advancing towards clinical development. title: Gestionnaire Ressources Humaines
description: L’humain au cœur de la Maison, contribuez à faire vivre l’expérience Beau-Rivage de l’intérieur. Niché au cœur de Genève, notre palace emblématique incarne l’élégance, le raffinement et l’excellence du service hôtelier de luxe. Engagé dans un ambitieux projet de rénovation visant à sublimer son héritage tout en redéfinissant les standards contemporains du luxe, l’établissement ouvre un nouveau chapitre de son histoire. Pour accompagner cette transformation et soutenir nos équipes au quotidien, nous recherchons notre futur(e) Gestionnaire Ressources Humaines H/F . Votre mission : Rattaché(e) à la Directrice des Ressources Humaines, vous assurez la gestion RH quotidienne et accompagnez les collaborateurs tout au long de leur parcours au sein de la Maison. Véritable interlocuteur(trice) de proximité, vous intervenez sur l’ensemble des sujets liés à l’administration du personnel, à la paie, au recrutement et à l’expérience collaborateur. Polyvalent(e), autonome et organisé(e), vous évoluez au sein d’une équipe RH à taille humaine et contribuez activement à garantir une gestion fiable et rigoureuse, tout en maintenant une relation de proximité avec les collaborateurs et les équipes opérationnelles. Vos responsabilités principales : Administration du personnel : Assurer la gestion administrative des collaborateurs, de leur entrée à leur sortie : contrats, avenants, attestations, certificats de travail, permis de travail et autres documents RH. Suivi des collaborateurs : Garantir la bonne tenue des dossiers collaborateurs, la fiabilité des données administratives et leur mise à jour régulière. Gestion des absences : Assurer le suivi des absences, vacances, congés et certificats médicaux. Accompagnement RH : Être un point de contact privilégié pour les collaborateurs et répondre à leurs questions relatives aux différents sujets RH. Onboarding & Offboarding : Coordonner les différentes étapes d’intégration et de départ des collaborateurs, en collaboration avec la Direction des Ressources Humaines et les départements concernés. Paie & Gestion des temps : Assurer le processus mensuel des salaires, le suivi des temps de travail et des éléments variables de paie jusqu’à la clôture. Recrutement : Participer à l’ensemble du processus de recrutement selon les besoins : publication des annonces, suivi des candidatures, entretiens et accompagnement jusqu’à l’engagement définitif. Relations Écoles : Contribuer au développement et au suivi des partenariats avec les écoles hôtelières afin de renforcer notre attractivité auprès des futurs talents. Communication & Événements internes : Participer à la communication RH ainsi qu’à l’organisation des événements destinés aux collaborateurs. Projets RH & Expérience Collaborateur : Contribuer aux différents projets RH et proposer des initiatives visant à améliorer continuellement l’expérience collaborateur. Profil : Formation : Vous êtes diplômé(e) d’une école hôtelière (Bachelor ou équivalent) et avez complété votre parcours par une formation en Ressources Humaines . Expérience : Vous disposez d’une expérience d’au minimum 3 ans dans une fonction RH similaire , obligatoirement acquise dans le secteur de l’hôtellerie-restauration . Paie : Vous maîtrisez les processus de paie, le suivi des temps de travail et la gestion des éléments variables de salaire. Connaissances RH : Vous disposez idéalement de bonnes connaissances du droit du travail suisse et des assurances sociales . Outils : Vous êtes à l’aise avec les outils informatiques et les systèmes d’information RH. Organisation : Rigoureux(se) et organisé(e), vous savez gérer plusieurs priorités simultanément et assurer un suivi précis de vos dossiers. Relationnel : Vous appréciez le contact humain et savez instaurer une relation de confiance avec vos interlocuteurs, tout en respectant la stricte confidentialité inhérente à la fonction RH. Posture : Autonome, dynamique et polyvalent(e), vous appréciez de travailler au sein d’une petite équipe où l’entraide, la réactivité et l’autonomie sont essentielles. Langues : Vous maîtrisez parfaitement le français, à l’oral comme à l’écrit . La maîtrise de l’anglais constitue un réel atout. Personnalité : Vous êtes force de proposition, orienté(e) solutions et aimez contribuer à une ambiance de travail positive. Pourquoi rejoindre la Maison Beau-Rivage ? Une fonction RH polyvalente et proche du terrain , au cœur de la vie de la Maison. L’opportunité d’accompagner les collaborateurs à chaque étape de leur parcours. Une participation active à la transformation d’un établissement emblématique en pleine rénovation. Des missions variées associant administration RH, paie, recrutement, relations écoles et expérience collaborateur . Un environnement de travail stimulant et exigeant au cœur de Genève. La possibilité de contribuer concrètement aux projets RH qui accompagneront le nouveau chapitre de Beau-Rivage. Rejoignez Beau-Rivage et contribuez à faire vivre une expérience collaborateur à la hauteur de l’excellence de notre Maison. Nos offres d’emploi s’adressent autant aux femmes qu’aux hommes. title: Software Engineer (Data)
description: Our Mission We’re not your average benefits platform – we’re the driving force that uplifts people’s lives. Our technology connects the entire benefits ecosystem, creating better outcomes for employers, employees, brokers, and providers. Our mission is clear: to build a world where everything works at its best, ensuring every employee gets the support they need to thrive—both at work and beyond. Your Mission As our Software Engineer (Data) , you’ll build and run the pipelines, orchestration, and infrastructure that move data across Ben: in from our product and the tools we use, in from our customers, and back out to them again. It’s the plumbing the whole company and our customers depend on, and it has to stay reliable. We serve global enterprise customers with strict security and reliability requirements. You’ll own real work from day one. You’ll have a strong team of cross functional engineers alongside you, room to grow into harder problems, and the freedom to do the job your way. What you’ll be working on Own everything that flows into Ben: build and maintain the ingestion pipelines that bring data into our warehouse, with Fivetran for managed sources and custom pipelines where we need them. Keep everything running on time: own the orchestration that keeps data moving on schedule and recovers cleanly when something breaks. Scale and manage our data infrastructure: build and manage our data infrastructure as code with Terraform, using mainly AWS services. Connect Ben to every system our customers run: build enterprise-grade pipelines and connectors for our customers, bringing their data in, for example from HR and payroll systems, and getting accurate data back out to them, reliably and securely, even at the volumes large customers bring. Build the data layer our agents act on: help connect our data to the AI agents and services we're building, including through MCP connectors, so they get the right context at the right time. Shape what we build: work with product and other stakeholders to scope problems and agree on simple but scalable solutions. Build it to enterprise standard: build to current security practice, for example the OWASP Top 10 and the AWS Well-Architected Framework. Behind the scenes Ben runs on Python 3, Django, PostgreSQL, and React, on AWS. Our data platform today is built around Fivetran, AWS DMS or custom pipelines for ingestion, dbt for transformation, PostgreSQL on AWS RDS as the warehouse, and n8n or AWS Lambda for automation between systems. We manage our infrastructure as code with Terraform and use different AWS services depending on requirements. We have adopted frontier level agentic development practices and continue to push the envelope of what’s possible with current technologies. Your skills and experience Strong experience with Python and SQL . A few years building and running production data pipelines that other people relied on. Comfortable with infrastructure as code , ideally Terraform, and hands-on with AWS, for example Lambda, ECS, Glue, S3, RDS. A good grasp of ETL/ELT and orchestration . Experience building or running data integrations and connectors , especially ones that other companies or customers depend on, is a real plus. Solid software engineering fundamentals : clean code, sensible design, and tests you can rely on. You keep security in mind when you build applications and configure infrastructure, and you know what enterprise customers expect of their data. Nice to have, not essential : Experience working on customer-facing data integrations such as HRIS or payroll feeds via SFTP and in EDI format Experience with MCP server development , or different ways of preparing data for AI agents such as ontology modelling, context, knowledge graphs, and semantic layers. We don't expect all of it. We do expect curiosity about it. Why join us? Ben's customers are large enterprise employers, and the hundreds of thousands of people who work for them rely on us to get their benefits right, every time. That depends on data moving accurately between their systems and ours, every cycle. You get to work on the data infrastructure that makes this run like clockwork. At the same time, Ben is an AI-native organisation. Agents are already doing a lot of impactful work here, and they can only do it on data they can trust. That raises questions a dashboard never had to answer. How fresh does this need to be for an agent to act on it? How do you match the same entity across tools? How do you control what an agent is allowed to see? Very few engineers have answered those in production. You'd be one of them. You'll take ownership of large, complex problem spaces, help design how they scale, and build an agentic layer few engineers have built anywhere yet, and you'll see the impact of it: Ben supports hundreds of thousands of people across 30+ countries. Our Compensation & Benefits It's important to us to practise what we preach when it comes to benefits. We know what good looks like and we want to provide the best for our team, with a comprehensive and inclusive benefits package. You'll have a choice over the things that are most important to you. You can see a selection below, with the full offering here . 💰 Competitive base salary + equity, so you own what you build ⭐ Bonus scheme designed to reward and recognise high performance 💳 £100 monthly personal Ben Balance: for whatever works for you, whether that's Netflix, Spotify, or a really expensive cup of coffee! This allowance will increase by £50 for each year of service until you reach £250 🍔 Weekly lunch provided in office so you can spend quality time with the team over some tasty food! 🏖 28 days of holidays a year plus bank holidays, and an option to buy or sell 5 days per year. Your holiday entitlement increases to 30 days at your 3rd year of service! 🌴 Work-from-abroad scheme, so you can support your travels, enjoy an extended holiday, or visit loved ones. 🍼 Enhanced parental leave and workplace nursery scheme to support with the cost of childcare in a nursery setting ❤️ Comprehensive Private Medical Insurance 💌 Funded Life Assurance cover with the option to voluntarily increase. This also includes an annual health check 🧠 Comprehensive mental health support and professional coaching through a leading provider Diversity and Culture at Ben We are organically growing a brilliantly diverse, inclusive and respectful bunch of people we are extremely proud of. This should go without saying, but all applications are very much welcome.
