title: Director, Sales & Key Accounts, EMEA
description: Core skills: business development, new logo acquisition, strategic account management, cross-sell, video infrastructure, executive engagement, pipeline generation, enterprise closing. Bitmovin is an award-winning video streaming technology to world-renowned brands and managed service providers. Our solution suite consists of Live and VOD Encoding, a Multi-Platform Player, and Analytics platform; enabling content owners to redefine the viewer experience through API-based workflow optimization, fast turnaround, and scalability. We have seen great success and created great momentum in the market. This is down to our products, ecosystem, but ultimately our people who love video streaming and helping customers. “We’re building the future of video streaming across EMEA - combining high-impact hunting with strategic account growth to deliver unmatched commercial results. If you’re ready to help shape the industry and make a real impact, join us.” Barney Withers Green, SVP, Sales & Business Development, EMEA & APAC At Bitmovin we value cognitive diversity and the huge part this plays in not only creating a global culture second to none, but in how this underpins our ability to create truly representative, Emmy award winning products. Diversity in all its forms is encouraged and celebrated at Bitmovin; everyone has a role to play in helping us shape the future of video. Why us? Bitmovin is rapidly growing with significant market opportunity, and we are looking for talented and self driven individuals to take Bitmovin to the next level. Following an exciting evolution of our commercial structure, we are seeking an exceptional, commercially driven Sales Director to accelerate revenue growth, develop strategic opportunities, and strengthen our presence across key EMEA markets. This role uniquely combines high-impact new business development with strategic ownership of key customer relationships. Supported by designated Account Managers and Customer Success resources for day-to-day management, you will be empowered to focus on winning new logos, driving strategic cross-sell, and engaging executives across the region. With our full support and coaching, you will pave your own path, collaborating with our global teams to shape the future of media and streaming. This is an opportunity that offers: Opportunity to shape the streaming and video technology strategies of leading EMEA Media & Entertainment companies A hybrid role balancing high-velocity new business acquisition with strategic key account ownership Selling market-leading products (Live Encoding, VOD Encoding, Player, Observability) alongside top Cloud Partners and System Integrators Autonomy, international collaboration, flexible working, and regional travel (~50%). Your Impact As Director, Sales & Key Accounts, you will be at the forefront of powering the next generation of digital video across EMEA. Your mission is to fuel Bitmovin’s expansion by acquiring game-changing new logos and driving high-value strategic growth across priority markets, including the UK, DACH, and selected CEE & MENA regions. Operating within the global GTM and partner strategy to define and execute local initiatives in media, streaming, and OTT markets. Driving direct enterprise sales with full sales cycle ownership, including multi-year SaaS agreements and platform licensing deals. Enabling customers to adopt Bitmovin solutions in the way that best fits their business — direct, partner-led, or cloud/video platform routes. Identifying, onboarding, and enabling local partners to drive net-new revenue and new customer wins. Collaborating with local and global teams (solutions engineering, customer success, partner teams) to support adoption and partner success. Providing market insights, competitor intelligence, and recommendations on product, pricing, and GTM strategy. Tracking pipeline, revenue, and partner acquisition KPIs to measure impact and improve conversion rates across channels. What competencies can you bring Industry Expertise: Proven success selling software/technology into broadcasters, OTT platforms, or video infrastructure (CDN, adtech, broadcast tech) Drive & Accountability: Track record of originating, closing complex enterprise sales, and consistently exceeding revenue goals Relationship Building: Established network of technical and commercial decision-makers across EMEA media and streaming ecosystems Technical Acumen: Solid grasp of streaming workflows, technical ecosystems, and enterprise buying processes Proactive Ownership: Self-driven, highly autonomous pipeline builder focused on results and execution Strategic Influence: Confident navigating high-value negotiations and engaging senior executive stakeholders Collaboration & Adaptability: Open to feedback and skilled at partnering across cross-functional teams to drive collective success What Success Looks Like First 6 Months: Establish strong relationships with priority customers, prospects, and internal stakeholders Build a clear territory plan and strategic business development roadmaps for target regions Develop a healthy, self-generated pipeline of qualified opportunities Identify and progress strategic cross-sell opportunities within assigned key accounts First 12 Months: Deliver against agreed net-new ARR and strategic cross-sell targets Demonstrate consistent pipeline generation and enterprise deal progression Establish meaningful new customer relationships across priority EMEA markets Maintain strong executive engagement and strategic oversight of assigned key accounts Operate independently with rigorous forecasting discipline and commercial accountability You don’t have experience with all the points above? Don’t worry, we will support you with learning, training, and coaching on the job. Life at Bitmovin Find out more about us on our Careers Page See what fellow Bitmovers are saying on LinkedIn Check the employee reviews on Glassdoor For all of our roles, we are willing to discuss flexible working arrangements to support everyone’s unique circumstances. title: Lead Business Development Manager (m/w/d)
description: Über unseren Kunden Wahrscheinlich hast du heute schon ein Produkt unseres Kunden benutzt, ohne es zu merken. Das Unternehmen ist einer der weltweit führenden Anbieter intelligenter Zugangslösungen: Tor- und Türautomation, die Gebäude, Grundstücke und Garagen sicher und smart macht. Das Europa-Geschäft mit Zentrale in Deutschland wächst und verändert sich gerade. Ziel ist es, Marktanteile zu gewinnen und den Vertrieb noch professioneller aufzustellen. Dafür sucht das Unternehmen eine Person, der nicht nur selbst Neukunden gewinnt, sondern das BDM-Team mitzieht. Deine Aufgaben: Neukunden gewinnen: Du betreust dein eigenes Gebiet in Nordwestdeutschland mit vielen wichtigen Großkunden und konzentrierst dich auf große OEMs. Abschlüsse in ganz Europa unterstützen: Mit den BDMs in Benelux und Nordeuropa besuchst du Kunden gemeinsam und hilfst, neue Accounts zu gewinnen. Vorbild und Coach sein: Auch ohne disziplinarische Führung prägst du, wie das Team (ca. 5 BDMs) Neukunden anspricht, Kundentermine gestaltet, das CRM nutzt und die Pipeline steuert. Vertrieb steuern und Forecasts verantworten: Du berichtest KPIs in HubSpot, verantwortest deine Forecast-Zahlen und legst Maßnahmen fest, wenn erwartete Aufträge ausbleiben. Dein Profil Du hast mindestens 8 Jahre Erfahrung im operativen B2B-Vertrieb oder Business Development und kannst nachweisen, dass du Neukunden gewinnst. Du hast große Accounts, idealerweise OEMs, in mehreren europäischen Märkten gewonnen und weiterentwickelt. Du arbeitest diszipliniert: Ein CRM (z. B. HubSpot), sauberes Pipeline-Tracking, KPI-Reporting und verlässliche Forecasts gehören für dich zum Alltag. Du lieferst Ergebnisse, statt nur darüber zu reden. Du gehst proaktiv auf Kunden zu, setzt dich durch, denkst in Zahlen und hältst ein, was du zusagst. Du betreust gern eigene Kunden und unterstützt dabei deine Kolleg:innen. Profitabilität behältst du im Blick, neue Ideen bringst du aktiv ein. Du wohnst in Deutschland und bist bereit, etwa 50 % zu reisen (v.a. Nordwestdeutschland, Benelux, Europa). Du sprichst fließend Deutsch und Englisch . Ein Plus ist, wenn du: Erfahrung mit Tür-, Tor-, Zutritts- oder Sicherheitslösungen mitbringst oder aus einer verwandten Branche kommst, etwa Bau, Gebäudetechnik oder Elektro. description: About ActAI There are over 5 billion users using basic applications today such email, notes, tasks, calendar and they're not AI-native. Our mission is to build proactive applications for anyone in the world, who are not used to complex prompting. We aim to bring intelligence to conversations, errands, organising and workflows, with minimal to no prompting. Our product focuses on achieving high reliability for long-running workflows, persistent context, and real-world task completion. We believe products will greatly reduce hallucinations. Our objective is to organise anyone's life, allowing us all to spend time on valuable and meaningful things. CDDS specializes in developing low-collateral kinetic interceptors designed to neutralize malicious drones (Mavics, FPV racers and fast fixed wings). Our solutions are built for precision and safety, minimizing risk to surroundings while effectively countering unauthorized or threatening unmanned aerial systems. We work at the cutting edge of counter-drone technology, delivering reliable protection for critical assets and environments. Tasks Your Mission We are looking for an exceptional Control & Flight Test Engineer to drive the control, vision, hardware and operational stack of our interceptor drone platform to the next level. You will test, tune and develop state-estimation, control and vision algorithms that directly determine successful target interception. You will act as the eyes and ears of the R&D team on customer demos and field tests abroad. You will work closely with all teams, meaning control, vison, software and hardware experts — ensuring your and the teams algorithms translate directly into field performance. title: Account Executive - Public Sector Germany - Defense (Bundeswehr)
description: Celonis is the trusted platform to industrialize Enterprise AI. At our core is the Celonis Context Model — which combines process data, business knowledge, and intelligence into a living digital twin of the enterprise that AI can actually understand, turning AI's operational blind spots into operational clarity. World's leading companies trust Celonis and its global ecosystem of partners to make their AI agents, people, systems, and processes work together, achieving transformational outcomes. We believe there's a massive opportunity to unlock global productivity and sustainability by giving AI the context to understand how every business process really works. Join our mission to make processes work for people, companies, and the planet. The Team: Celonis grew up with the private sector: Deutsche Telekom, Mercedes-Benz, Uniper and three quarters of the DAX companies rely on Celonis Process Intelligence. Now we are taking the next big step in Germany: scaling our business with the public sector. To make this happen, Celonis is investing heavily through 2029 in its German public sector business. Over the past year, we have built our Public Sector team from the ground up. Today, a strong go-to-market core team of Account Executives and Value Engineers is in place, working with federal and state-level institutions. The Bundeswehr is one of our primary target organizations in the public sector. With our Celonis for Defense & Security initiative, presented at the Munich Security Conference 2026, we offer a sovereign and trusted platform that integrates data across systems and optimizes military processes along the entire value chain. This means higher operational readiness through optimized logistics and faster maintenance, repair and overhaul (MRO) cycles, greater resilience through end-to-end supply chain transparency, and faster IT modernization by connecting existing systems with modern AI applications. Building on our data analysis solution Metropolis , we also help connect information from a wide range of sources into a comprehensive situational picture , enabling faster and better-informed decisions during the actual mission . To drive this forward, we are now complementing our existing Public Sector team with a highly specialized Account Executive who brings first-hand experience from inside the organization we serve: the Bundeswehr . The Role: This is not a typical Account Executive role. You bring the perspective of someone who knows the Bundeswehr from the inside: how its structures work, how processes in logistics, maintenance or procurement really run, and how decisions are made and budgets are approved. You will use this credibility to build trusted relationships across the Bundeswehr and the defense ecosystem, and to position Celonis as a long-term partner for its digital transformation. Working closely with our Public Sector AEs, Value Engineers and product experts, you will translate the operational reality of the armed forces into compelling use cases, contribute to the creation of solution blueprints, drive opportunities from first conversation to signed contract, and help shape how Celonis enters and grows in this market. The Work you'll do: Build and own relationships across the Bundeswehr – Army (Heer), Navy (Marine), Air Force (Luftwaffe) and Cyber and Information Domain Service (CIR) – and its ecosystem, e.g. the Federal Ministry of Defence (BMVg), the Federal Office of Bundeswehr Equipment, Information Technology and In-Service Support (BAAINBw) and BWI GmbH. Engage with decision-makers from leadership, logistics, procurement, IT and digitalization. Translate operational challenges into concrete, AI-enabled use cases with measurable impact, e.g. in logistics and supply, MRO and materiel readiness, supply chain resilience, procurement and IT modernization. Bring the voice of the Bundeswehr into Celonis: share insights with our product, marketing and value engineering teams to sharpen our offering. Own an individual revenue target and drive complex, long sales cycles to a successful close. Navigate defense procurement and tender processes (e.g. VSVgV, framework agreements) together with our partners and internal experts. Work closely with partners such as consulting firms, system integrators and defense IT providers. Represent Celonis at public sector and defense events and conferences. The Qualifications you need: Several years of professional experience within the Bundeswehr , e.g. as an officer or civilian employee, ideally in a leadership role and/or in logistics, procurement, IT, digitalization, planning or organizational development. title: wo-stage criminologie/sociologie: zicht op ondermijning
description: wo- afstudeerstage, vanaf februari 2027 Ben jij die enthousiaste en analytisch sterke student criminologie of sociologie? Het dashboard Zicht op Ondermijning toont cijfers en inzichten over onder andere drugs- en financiële delicten, vastgoedfraude en verdachte transacties. Ook werken we in het dashboard Zicht op Online Criminaliteit aan analyses die inzicht geven in zowel slachtoffers als daders van online criminaliteit. Wij bieden jong talent graag een kans om bij het CBS stage te lopen. Je kunt je afstudeeronderzoek doen naar de gevolgen van het ruimen van een drugslab of hennepkwekerij voor de betrokkenen. Ook kun je zelf een suggestie doen voor een afstudeeronderzoek op het gebied van ondermijning of online criminaliteit. Dat kan een al uitgewerkte onderzoeksvraag zijn met een bijbehorende methode, of een onderwerp waar jouw interesse ligt. Belangrijk is dat het in ieder geval een kwantitatieve component bevat. Naast het doen van onderzoek, doe je, door mee te werken binnen ons team, waardevolle werkervaring op met: het schrijven en controleren van programmatuur in R; het uitvoeren van kwaliteitschecks op data; het presenteren van jouw resultaten in een teambijeenkomst. Dit is jouw stageplek bij CBS Den Haag Afdeling Beleidsstatistiek bestaat uit 70 collega’s verdeeld over Den Haag en Heerlen. Er werken onderzoekers en projectleiders met veel verschillende studieachtergronden bij onze afdeling. Wij stellen cijfers samen die gebruikt worden voor het ontwikkelen, monitoren en verbeteren van beleid, vaak met een thema-overstijgend karakter. We zijn samenwerkingspartner op het gebied van data-gedreven werken bij overheden. Hieronder enkele voorbeelden van output van de afdeling: Zicht op Ondermijnende criminaliteit Barometer Culturele Diversiteit Dashboard problematische schulden Diverse onderzoeken van de CBS urban datacenters Dit breng jij mee Je bent bijna klaar met jouw universitaire opleiding criminologie, sociologie of aanverwante afstudeerrichting en zoekt een afstudeerstage om je opleiding succesvol af te ronden. Daarnaast: heb je (enige) ervaring met programmeren in R; kun je zelfstandig onderzoek uitvoeren en uitkomsten analyseren; weet je hoe je met verschillende methoden en technieken onderzoek doet. Kernwoorden die jou omschrijven zijn enthousiast, proactief en analytisch. title: wo-stage economie: Nowcasting Model voor BBP
description: wo- praktijkstage, start in overleg Krijg jij energie van het bouwen van slimme datamodellen die economische groei voorspellen nog voordat alle cijfers binnen zijn? Duik jij graag in data, ontdek je nieuwe databronnen en wil je met jouw analyses échte impact maken op officiële bbp-ramingen? Dan is deze stage in nowcasting en econometrie precies wat je zoekt. Dit is jouw uitdaging Bij het ramen van de kwartaalcijfers van het bbp (economische groei) gebruiken we voor een aantal bedrijfstakken momenteel een relatief eenvoudige methode: de ontwikkeling van het aantal banen dient als benadering voor de economische activiteit. Dit gebeurt omdat directe en tijdige broninformatie ontbreekt. Een belangrijk gevolg hiervan is dat we de eerste ramingen later vaak moeten bijstellen wanneer er meer volledige data beschikbaar komt bij de definitieve raming (ongeveer anderhalf jaar later). Het is aan jou om deze methodiek te verbeteren. Je gaat een geavanceerder model ontwikkelen waarmee we de economische activiteit van deze bedrijfstakken kort na afloop van de verslagperiode nauwkeuriger kunnen inschatten. Dit wordt ook wel “nowcasting” genoemd. Het doel is om dichter bij de uiteindelijke realisatie te zitten en daarmee het aantal en de omvang van latere bijstellingen te verkleinen. Een belangrijk onderdeel van jouw opdracht is om te onderzoeken welke databronnen tijdig beschikbaar zijn en we kunnen gebruiken als input voor dit model. Vervolgens ga je met behulp van historische data eerdere verslagperiodes simuleren. Zo kun je analyseren of jouw voorgestelde methode daadwerkelijk beter presteert dan de huidige aanpak, bijvoorbeeld door te kijken naar kleinere bijstellingen. Tot slot ontwikkel je een werkende productiestraat in R, zodat de nieuwe methode praktisch toepasbaar wordt binnen het ramingproces. Dit is jouw stageplek, bij CBS Den Haag We verwelkomen je binnen de sector Nationale Rekeningen, bij het team Aanbod- en gebruiktabellen, dat bestaat uit ruim 25 mensen. Het team maakt de kwartaal- en jaarramingen van het bruto binnenlands product (bbp), en de economische groei. We zijn gedreven onderzoekers en producenten van cruciale informatie, waaronder de economische groei, en continu op zoek naar verbeteringen. De nationale rekeningen vormen de officiële overzichtsstatistiek van de nationale economie. Het nationaal inkomen, de economische groei, het overheidstekort en het beschikbaar inkomen van huishoudens zijn enkele belangrijke macro-economische indicatoren die aan de hand van de nationale rekeningen worden vastgesteld. Je bent analytisch sterk en weet complexe vraagstukken te doorgronden en data kritisch te interpreteren. Je denkt proactief mee over het verbeteren van bestaande methoden en staat open voor het verkennen van nieuwe ideeën en technieken. title: wo-stage statistiek: data-analyse en weegmethoden
description: wo- afstudeerstage, start in overleg Op zoek naar een statistiekstage? Analyseer bij het CBS weegmethoden en non-respons met R en draag bij aan betere statistieken voor Nederland. Dit is jouw uitdaging Het CBS trekt steekproeven onder de Nederlandse bevolking om diverse statistieken te maken. Hierbij is sprake van selectieve non-respons. Om voor deze non-respons te corrigeren, voeren we een zogenaamde weging uit, waarbij personen een gewicht krijgen op basis van hun onder- of oververtegenwoordiging in de respons. Personen met achtergrondkenmerken die ondervertegenwoordigd zijn in de respons, krijgen dan een groter gewicht dan personen met achtergrondkenmerken die oververtegenwoordigd zijn. Zie bijvoorbeeld [1] voor algemene informatie over wegen. Bij het uitvoeren van een weging zijn er diverse zaken om rekening mee te houden. Zo kan niet voor alle achtergrondkenmerken worden gecorrigeerd voor scheefheid, omdat de gewichten dan te extreem zouden worden. Daarnaast is het vaak verstandig om überhaupt niet voor te veel achtergrondkenmerken te corrigeren, omdat dit een negatieve invloed heeft op de marges van de schattingen voor de doelvariabelen van een onderzoek. Ook is er een relatie met de doelvariabelen in het onderzoek: op het moment dat er een samenhang is tussen een achtergrondkenmerk en de doelvariabelen van een onderzoek, is het wenselijk om wél voor dat achtergrondkenmerk te corrigeren als dat kenmerk scheef in de respons zit. Het is daarom vaak verstandig om toch zo veel mogelijk te corrigeren voor scheefheid in achtergrondkenmerken. Het CBS heeft een reguliere werkwijze voor het opstellen en uitvoeren van wegingen voor reguliere onderzoeken. Een optie die nog niet wordt gebruikt, maar wel interessant lijkt, is het uitvoeren van een zogenaamde voorweging. Hierbij wordt de weging min of meer in twee stappen uitgevoerd, waardoor er mogelijk voor meer en/of andere achtergrondkenmerken gecorrigeerd kan worden. Wellicht is het mogelijk om eerst een correctie uit te voeren voor non-respons en vervolgens een verdere weging uit te voeren die meer focust op de doelvariabelen van het onderzoek en de achtergrondkenmerken die daarmee correleren. Dit soort vragen speelt zowel bij de reguliere steekproeven die bij het CBS worden uitgevoerd als bij potentiële nieuwe toepassingen. In deze stage ga je aan de slag om verschillende opties voor de weging te analyseren, te kijken naar de verschillen tussen deze opties en te bepalen welke keuze de voorkeur heeft. Afhankelijk van de resultaten zouden weegmethoden aangepast kunnen worden, met directe impact op de statistieken van het CBS. Hiermee staan we aan de kern van het waarneemproces en komen er allerlei statistieken langs bij het team. Daarnaast zijn we betrokken bij het maken van schattingen: hoe kunnen we de respondenten op zo’n manier mee laten tellen dat er zinnige resultaten uit onze onderzoeken komen die ook daadwerkelijk iets zeggen over de gehele populatie? We zijn een team met hoogopgeleide professionals die hoge kwaliteit nastreven. Als onze methoden verbeterd of uitgebreid kunnen worden, zodat we beter uit de voeten kunnen met de data die het CBS verzamelt, dan worden wij daar heel blij van. Afhankelijk van de resultaten zullen we bestaande methoden opnieuw bekijken en kunnen onze methoden misschien worden toegepast op datasets waar dat nu (nog) niet mogelijk is. Je hebt kennis van en wellicht ervaring met: data-analyse; diverse onderzoeksmethoden en -technieken; programmeren in R; het rapporteren van bevindingen in een heldere en gestructureerde vorm. Kernwoorden die jou omschrijven zijn proactief, analytisch, communicatief sterk en kritisch. Dit kun je van ons verwachten Een fijne leeromgeving waarin je: jouw vakkennis vergroot en werkervaring opdoet met het doen van onderzoek en het analyseren van data; jouw communicatievaardigheden verder ontwikkelt en leert om onderzoeksresultaten helder te presenteren; uitdagingen aangaat en op zoek gaat naar oplossingen. title: Mid Market Account Executive
description: Since we opened our doors in 2009, the world of commerce has evolved immensely, and so has Square. After enabling anyone to take payments and never miss a sale, we saw sellers stymied by disparate, outmoded products and tools that wouldn't work together. So we expanded into software and started building integrated, omnichannel solutions – to help sellers sell online, manage inventory, offer buy now, pay later functionality, book appointments, engage loyal buyers, and hire and pay staff. Across it all, we've embedded financial services tools at the point of sale, so merchants can access a business loan and manage their cash flow in one place. Afterpay furthers our goal to provide omnichannel tools that unlock meaningful value and growth, enabling sellers to capture the next generation shopper, increase order sizes, and compete at a larger scale. Today, we are a partner to sellers of all sizes – large, enterprise-scale businesses with complex operations, sellers just starting, as well as merchants who began selling with Square and have grown larger over time. As our sellers grow, so do our solutions. There is a massive opportunity in front of us. We're building a significant, meaningful, and lasting business, and we are helping sellers worldwide do the same. The Role At Square, we’re re-imagining how small and midsize businesses grow. As a Mid Market Account Executive on our Outbound Team, you’ll bring Square’s ecosystem to new sellers across diverse industries by building, shaping, and closing your own pipeline. You’ll run sophisticated, multi-product deals from the first touch to final close — blending hunter instincts, consultative depth, and strategic execution. If you’re an experienced closer who thrives in outbound environments, loves solving meaningful business challenges, and consistently delivers against ambitious targets — this is your role. You Will Own the full outbound sales cycle — from prospecting to negotiation to close — with SMB and mid-market merchants. Build and manage a high-quality pipeline through cold outreach, social selling, targeted campaigns, and creative outbound strategies. Develop multi-product solutions across Square’s ecosystem and tailor them to each merchant’s unique needs. Partner with Business Development on lead flow while independently driving net-new logo acquisition. Conduct high-impact discovery, demos, and negotiations with decisiveness across multi-stakeholder deals. Act as a consultant and trusted advisor — seamlessly flexing across BDR, AE, and AM responsibilities when needed. Collaborate cross-functionally with Product, Marketing, Implementation, and Operations to deliver cohesive solutions. Maintain disciplined pipeline management and forecasting accuracy in Salesforce. Consistently hit and exceed revenue goals — monthly and quarterly. You Have 4+ years of full-cycle B2B sales experience with consistent quota achievement. Proven success in outbound prospecting and net-new business creation (SaaS or fintech preferred). Experience closing complex, multi-threaded deals with longer sales cycles. Ability to build pipeline from scratch using targeted, strategic outreach. Exceptional communication, presentation, and negotiation skills across phone, video, and written channels. Strong consultative selling skills — diagnose business challenges and map tailored solutions. A hunter’s mindset — resilient, creative, and driven to win. title: Praktikant/in, Life Sciences Strategieberatung/Life Sciences Intern (2027 Start) - m/f/d
description: NOTE: English translation appears below Über Charles River Associates Charles River Associates ist eine führende globale Beratungsfirma, die wirtschaftliche, finanzielle und betriebswirtschaftliche Expertise für große Anwaltskanzleien, Unternehmen und Regierungen weltweit bietet. CRA berät Kunden in wirtschaftlichen und finanziellen Angelegenheiten im Zusammenhang mit Rechtsstreitigkeiten und behördlichen Verfahren und unterstützt Unternehmen bei kritischen Geschäftsstrategien und leistungsbezogenen Fragen. Seit 1965 engagieren Kunden CRA aufgrund der Kombination aus Branchenerfahrung und rigoroser, faktenbasierter Analyse, die klare, umsetzbare Lösungen für komplexe Geschäftsprobleme bietet. Stellenübersicht Die Life Sciences Practice von CRA hilft Pharma-, Biotechnologie-, Medtech- und Digital-Health-Unternehmen, optimale Leistungen in wichtigen Geschäftsbereichen wie kommerzielle Strategie, Preisgestaltung und Zugang, Innovation, Organisationsstruktur, Politikanalyse, medizinische Angelegenheiten, Stakeholder-Management und Marketing zu erzielen – alles zum langfristigen Nutzen von Patienten, Ärzten, Mitarbeitern und Aktionären. Wir arbeiten direkt mit Life-Sciences-Unternehmen sowie mit deren Rechtsberatern, Industrieverbänden, Regierungsorganisationen und Interessengruppen zusammen. Unsere spezialisierte Life Sciences Practice bringt Klarheit und Lösungen für komplexe Herausforderungen. Kunden wenden sich an uns, wenn sie die richtige Entscheidung treffen, sie richtig umsetzen und die Zustimmung der wichtigsten Interessengruppen sichern müssen. Ihr Vertrauen in uns beruht auf unserem emphatischen Fokus auf die Kunden und insbesondere auf unserer praktischen Erfahrung in den Life Sciences, unserem tiefgehenden Industriewissen von der Forschung und Entwicklung bis zum Markteintritt und darüber hinaus sowie unseren starken akademischen Qualifikationen in den Bereichen Wissenschaft, Wirtschaft und Betriebswirtschaft. Das Life Sciences Team von CRA arbeitet von Büros in den USA und Europa aus, um Einblicke in globale Themen und lokale Marktchancen zu bieten und unseren Kunden einen einfachen Zugang zu ermöglichen. Der Einstieg in die Life Sciences Practice bei CRA bietet Ihnen eine einzigartige Gelegenheit, Ihr Wissen über das Gesundheitswesen weltweit zu erweitern. Unser Praktikumsprogramm soll die Analystenerfahrung widerspiegeln und Ihnen ein besseres Verständnis für unser Geschäft und die Art der Arbeit bei Charles River Associates vermitteln. Aufgaben Praktikanten sind neugierige und analytische Denker, die kreative Ansätze für nicht standardisierte Probleme mitbringen. Sie werden Teil eines integrierten Teams sein, das eine Vielzahl von Beratungsprojekten durchführt und liefert. Typische Aufgaben sind: Enge Zusammenarbeit mit erfahrenen Kollegen zur Durchführung von Strategie- und/oder Politik- und Wirtschaftsberatungsprojekten, die spezifische Kundenbedürfnisse adressieren; Unterstützung bei unabhängigen Recherchen zur Identifizierung, Sammlung, Verwaltung und Analyse qualitativer Erkenntnisse und quantitativer Daten; Beitrag zu internen Diskussionen, die Erkenntnisse aus dem Analyseprozess aufbauen und Ergebnisse in breitere Projektlieferungen integrieren; Teilnahme an Telefon- oder persönlichen Interviews mit Kunden oder externen Interessengruppen; Erstellung von Abschnitten von Kundenberichten, Präsentationen und anderen Kundenlieferungen (z.B. Excel-Arbeitsmappen) unter der Aufsicht von erfahrenen Teammitgliedern; Proaktive Entwicklung von Wissen über die Life-Sciences-Branche sowie Beratungsmethoden; Teilnahme an praxisbezogenen Aktivitäten (Schulungen, Wissensaustausch usw.). Gewünschte Qualifikationen Bachelor-, Master- oder PhD-Studenten mit starker akademischer Leistung von einer erstklassigen Institution mit Schwerpunkt auf Biowissenschaften, Wirtschaft (oder verwandten Fächern wie Betriebswirtschaft, Gesundheitsökonomie und -politik, öffentliche Politik), Naturwissenschaften, Mathematik, Statistik, Ingenieurwesen oder einer anderen quantitativen Disziplin; Kenntnisse in der Microsoft Office Suite (Word, PowerPoint, Outlook und Excel) sowie Verständnis für Internetrecherchen Erfahrung in oder starkes Interesse an der Life-Sciences-Branche und dem Gesundheitswesen; Verständnis wirtschaftlicher Konzepte und Geschäftsprozesse sowie Vertrautheit mit wesentlichen Beratungsmethoden, -werkzeugen und -techniken ist sehr hilfreich; Effektive schriftliche und mündliche Kommunikationsfähigkeiten auf Englisch (weitere Sprachen sind von Vorteil); Starke Selbstmanagementfähigkeiten (Detailorientierung, effektives Zeitmanagement, Fähigkeit zur Priorisierung); Nachgewiesenes hohes Maß an Initiative und Führung; Hervorragende Teamarbeit und Kollaboration; Klares und nachgewiesenes Interesse an Beratung durch Kursarbeit, Arbeitserfahrung, Aktivitäten oder Teilnahme an CRA-Rekrutierungsveranstaltungen; Bewerbung Bewerbungen werden fortlaufend geprüft. Die Dauer des Praktikums beträgt in der Regel vier bis sechs Monate, mit flexiblen Startterminen über das Jahr verteilt. Das Praktikum ist bezahlt, und wir freuen uns über Bewerber, die ab Mai 2027 starten können. Um für diese Position berücksichtigt zu werden, reichen Sie bitte die folgenden Unterlagen ein: Lebenslauf – maximal 1 Seite; Anschreiben – Bitte beschreiben Sie Ihr Interesse an CRA und wie diese Rolle zu Ihren Zielen passt. Ihr Anschreiben sollte nicht länger als eine Seite sein und klar sowie professionell präsentiert werden (Mindestschriftgröße 12). Bitte stellen Sie sicher, dass Ihr Anschreiben die folgenden Fragen beantwortet: Warum Life-Sciences-Consulting und warum CRA? Bitte beschreiben Sie ein Beispiel einer datenbasierte Entscheidung die Sie getroffen haben Welche Erfahrung aus Ihrem Lebenslauf/CV macht Sie am meisten stolz und warum? Praktikumsbeginn und – dauer – bitte geben Sie ihr bevorzugtes Anfangsdatum (in 2027) und ihre bevorzugte Praktikumsdauer (4-6 Monate) an Berufliche Entwicklung Die robusten Entwicklungsprogramme und Wellness-Programme von CRA ermöglichen es Ihnene, sowohl als Individuum als auch als Teammitglied zu wachsen. Wir bieten Praktikanten eine Vielzahl von technischen Schulungen, Präsentationsfähigkeiten, internen Seminaren und Leistungscoaching. Flexibilität am Arbeitsplatz CRA schafft ein Arbeitsumfeld, das es unseren Kollegen ermöglicht, von der Zusammenarbeit im Büro zu profitieren, um unser Versprechen von beruflichem Wachstum, Mentoring und Inklusivität bestmöglich zu erfüllen. Gleichzeitig erkennen wir an, dass Einzelpersonen eine Reihe von Vorteilen genießen, wenn sie periodisch von zu Hause aus arbeiten. Derzeit bitten wir Mitarbeiter, im Durchschnitt 3 bis 4 Tage die Woche im Büro zu arbeiten (was Reisen zu einem anderen CRA-Büro oder zum Standort eines Kunden einschließen kann). Des weiteren bitten wir Praktikanten 5 Tage die Woche im Büro zu arbeiten. Zu bestimmten Zeiten des Jahres (z.B. Feiertagsperioden) werden zusätzliche Remote-Arbeitsoptionen für diejenigen angeboten, deren Arbeitsverpflichtungen dies zulassen, obwohl unsere Büros für diejenigen, die dort sein möchten oder müssen, geöffnet bleiben. Unser Engagement für Vielfalt Charles River Associates ist ein Arbeitgeber, der Chancengleichheit bietet (Equality Act 2010). Im Rahmen unseres Fokus auf Gerechtigkeit und Inklusion arbeiten wir daran, einen fairen und konsistenten Einstellungsprozess sicherzustellen. Wir feiern Vielfalt und sind für ein inklusives Arbeitsumfeld engagiert. Die in dieser Stellenbeschreibung enthaltenen Aussagen sollen die allgemeine Natur und das Niveau der von den Personen in dieser Position ausgeführten Arbeiten beschreiben. Sie sind nicht als vollständige Liste aller Verantwortlichkeiten, Pflichten und Fähigkeiten gedacht, die für das Personal in dieser Position erforderlich sind. title: Sales Evergreen
description: Powering Great Work We started as the place to find a trusted trade. Now, as we shape the future of home improvement, we're building the tech to transform that landscape for everyone - better products, smarter data, AI where it actually helps - so trades can spend less time on admin and consumers can find someone they trust, first time. That's Powering Great Work, and it's why every team here exists: 🔧 Trades spend less time on admin and more on winning work and growing their business 🏠 Homeowners get a trusted trade, first time, every time 🚀 We get to build products that change homes and lives across the country Fancy a career in sales at Checkatrade? Let's talk before the role even exists. Our sales team turns conversations into confidence, and confidence into growth, for tradespeople and homeowners across the UK, and we're always looking for great salespeople. This isn't a live vacancy. It's a way to get on our radar, so we can come to you the moment there's a great fit. The job, unfiltered: Have real conversations, not scripted ones: read the room and sell in the way that gets results, not the way that ticks a box. Close deals that mean something, helping a tradesperson grow their business or a homeowner find someone they can trust. Own a pipeline from first outreach to long-term account growth, and see the impact of your work end to end. Chase targets that matter, and keep going when a deal falls through, learning from it as you do. Back your team and be backed in return, with no faff and people who want to see everyone succeed. The fit: Wherever you are in your sales career, from SDR through to sales leadership, we want to hear from you if you bring: A track record of hitting (or exceeding) targets, whatever stage of your career that's been at. The knack for building relationships that last, from a cold first call to a long-term account. A consultative streak: you listen first, then sell the solution that actually fits. title: Revenue Enablement Manager

Scalable Operations: The Academy scales seamlessly across global regions without losing quality or accountability. Proactive Leadership: Collaborative yet assertive approach—able to operate independently, take full ownership, and advocate for high standards. Preferred (Nice-to-Have) Experience in payments, fintech, SaaS, or complex B2B technology sectors. Familiarity with Salesforce, Learning Management Systems (LMS), and sales engagement tools. title: Stagiair Finance
description: Finance leer je pas echt als je ziet wat er achter de cijfers gebeurt. Ben jij bezig met een opleiding richting Finance, Bedrijfsadministratie, Accountancy of Finance & Control en wil je tijdens je stage ervaren hoe een financiële administratie er in de praktijk uitziet? Dan hebben we binnen het Finance-team van Claus Group een mooie stageplek voor je. Bij ons kijk je niet alleen mee. Je gaat vooral zelf aan de slag. Je leert hoe facturen worden verwerkt, hoe betalingen en bankmutaties worden gecontroleerd, hoe we omgaan met debiteuren en crediteuren en hoe financiële gegevens uiteindelijk samenkomen in een betrouwbare administratie. En die administratie is bij Claus behoorlijk veelzijdig. Binnen onze organisatie komen horeca, events en leisure samen. Een groot bedrijfsevent heeft financieel een heel andere dynamiek dan een avond BARRACA of een druk weekend bij Claus Bowling. Juist daardoor krijg je tijdens je stage te maken met verschillende soorten omzet, kosten, leveranciers en administratieve processen. Je wordt begeleid door onze Finance-collega's en krijgt gedurende je stage steeds meer ruimte om werkzaamheden zelfstandig op te pakken. Natuurlijk houden we daarbij rekening met jouw opleiding, leerdoelen en wat je vanuit school moet aantonen. Dit is Claus Group Claus Group is een veelzijdige horecagroep waar gastvrijheid, kwaliteit en beleving centraal staan. Vanuit onze locaties in Hoofddorp en Amsterdam creëren wij elke dag opnieuw bijzondere ervaringen voor onze gasten. Claus Group bestaat uit verschillende unieke hospitalitymerken. Bij Claus Events organiseren wij jaarlijks honderden congressen, vergaderingen, bedrijfsfeesten en andere zakelijke evenementen. Met 20 moderne bowlingbanen en het sfeervolle American 50’s Diner restaurant biedt Claus Bowling gasten een gezellige middag of avond uit. Bij Braziliaans restaurant BARRACA Rodizio Grill & Bar brengen we de warme Zuid-Amerikaanse gastvrijheid naar onze gasten met het unieke rodizio-concept. Elk merk heeft zijn eigen karakter, maar samen vormen we met ruim 150 collega’s één familie. We staan voor elkaar klaar en doen er alles aan om de verwachtingen van onze gasten te overtreffen. Dat doen we met passie, vakmanschap en plezier. We geloven in korte lijnen, samenwerken, ruimte voor initiatief en persoonlijke aandacht. Of je nu werkt in de bediening, keuken, techniek, evenementen of op kantoor: iedere collega draagt bij aan de beleving van onze gasten. Jouw bijdrage maakt het verschil! Bij Claus Group werk je niet zomaar in de horeca. Je werkt in een organisatie waar iedere dag iets anders gebeurt, waar collega's voor elkaar klaarstaan en waar je de ruimte krijgt om jezelf te ontwikkelen. Wat ga je doen? Tijdens je stage draai je mee met de dagelijkse werkzaamheden van onze Finance-afdeling. We beginnen natuurlijk met een goede uitleg en begeleiding. Naarmate je meer leert, kun je steeds meer werkzaamheden zelfstandig uitvoeren. Je gaat onder andere: · Inkoopfacturen verwerken en controleren; · Meewerken aan de crediteurenadministratie; · Bankmutaties verwerken en controleren; · Ondersteunen bij de debiteurenadministratie; · Openstaande posten controleren en opvolgen; · Betalingen en financiële gegevens controleren; · Verschillen en afwijkingen helpen uitzoeken; · Financiële documenten verwerken en archiveren; · Contact hebben met collega's over ontbrekende of onduidelijke informatie; · Ondersteunen bij periodieke controles en afsluitingen; · Werken met Excel en onze financiële systemen; · Gegevens verzamelen en controleren voor financiële overzichten; · Meedenken over hoe administratieve processen slimmer of efficiënter kunnen; · Ondersteunen bij andere financiële werkzaamheden die binnen het team voorbij komen. Welke werkzaamheden je precies oppakt, hangt ook af van jouw opleiding, ervaring en ontwikkeling tijdens de stage. Wat ga je bij ons leren? Een stage is er om te leren. We vinden het daarom belangrijk dat je niet alleen taken uitvoert, maar ook begrijpt waarom je iets doet. Tijdens je stage leer je bijvoorbeeld hoe een financiële administratie binnen een organisatie wordt opgebouwd en bijgehouden, hoe verschillende geldstromen worden verwerkt en waarom een correcte administratie zo belangrijk is voor de rest van de organisatie. Je leert afwijkingen herkennen, verbanden leggen en steeds kritischer naar cijfers kijken. Want als een bedrag niet klopt, is het uiteindelijk veel interessanter om te ontdekken waarom het niet klopt dan het alleen te corrigeren. Daarnaast krijg je een goed beeld van de samenwerking tussen Finance en andere afdelingen binnen een organisatie. Dit breng je mee Je hoeft natuurlijk nog geen ervaren financieel medewerker te zijn – daarvoor loop je juist stage. We vinden het vooral belangrijk dat je nieuwsgierig bent en graag wilt leren. Je: volgt een relevante mbo- of hbo-opleiding, bijvoorbeeld Finance & Control, Bedrijfsadministratie, Accountancy, Business Administration of een vergelijkbare opleiding; vindt het leuk om met cijfers te werken; werkt nauwkeurig en gestructureerd; bent nieuwsgierig en wilt begrijpen waarom iets wel of niet klopt; durft vragen te stellen als je iets niet begrijpt; neemt initiatief en wacht niet altijd af tot iemand je een opdracht geeft; kunt zelfstandig werken, maar vindt samenwerken net zo belangrijk; gaat zorgvuldig om met vertrouwelijke informatie; hebt enige kennis van Excel of wilt hier graag beter in worden; communiceert prettig met collega's; beheerst de Nederlandse taal goed en kunt je ook in het Engels redden. Ervaring met financiële software of Exact is mooi meegenomen, maar zeker geen vereiste. Wat bieden wij jou? Een stage waarin je echt onderdeel bent van het Marketingteam en verschillende kanten van het vak kunt ontdekken. Je krijgt onder andere: Een veelzijdige marketingstage binnen hospitality, leisure en events; Een stagevergoeding van €500 op basis van 40 uur per week; Veel ruimte voor eigen ideeën en initiatief; De mogelijkheid om mee te werken aan echte campagnes en projecten; Ervaring met verschillende merken, doelgroepen en marketingkanalen; Ruimte om aan jouw schoolopdrachten en persoonlijke leerdoelen te werken; 20% personeelskorting binnen alle merken van Claus Group Een gratis personeelsmaaltijd tijdens je werkdag; Een gezellige en informele werkomgeving waar hard werken en plezier hand in hand gaan. En misschien wel het belangrijkste: je komt terecht in een organisatie waar collega's elkaar kennen, helpen en samen successen vieren. Find more English Speaking Jobs in Netherlands on Arbeitnow

title: Account Lead - Client Success
description: Let’s transform banking forever ClearBank is built on the belief that banking infrastructure shouldn’t slow down progress. Quite the opposite. That spirit and ‘can-do’ attitude is why our clients – from FinTech's and crypto platforms, to banks and credit unions – choose to use our API to power their banking infrastructure. But it’s our people who are the stars here. They power that innovation, push harder to break boundaries. They make coming to work (or working from home) fun. What you can expect: ClearBank is a place where you can do things differently and challenge the status quo. We will give you a high level of autonomy and transparency, and we trust you to make the right decisions for the bank. Your mission: As an Account Lead in our Mid-Market Client Management team focused on Client Success, you’ll be responsible for building and maintaining strong, trusted relationships with a portfolio of existing and new clients. You’ll develop a deep understanding of our clients’ businesses, priorities and evolving needs, helping them get the most from their relationship with ClearBank while ensuring we continue to deliver positive client outcomes. You’ll identify opportunities to deepen and grow those relationships through appropriate cross-sell and upsell opportunities, working collaboratively across ClearBank to connect clients with the products and solutions that meet their needs. Key Responsibilities · Own and develop strong, trusted relationships with existing Mid-Market clients, acting as a key point of contact and developing a detailed understanding of their businesses, priorities and evolving needs. · Develop and execute client account plans that support successful, long-term relationships and identify opportunities to deepen client engagement. · Proactively engage clients through regular relationship and account reviews, maintaining an understanding of their performance, priorities, challenges and future plans. · Identify and progress cross-sell and upsell opportunities within existing accounts, connecting client needs with relevant ClearBank products and capabilities to support sustainable account growth. · Build relationships across client organisations, developing effective connections with relevant decision makers and stakeholders and ensuring relationships are not dependent on a single point of contact. · Act as an advocate for clients internally, bringing together the appropriate teams to address needs, resolve issues and support strong client outcomes. · Collaborate across Product, Solutions, Operations, Risk, Compliance and other relevant teams to support clients effectively and ensure commitments and issues are progressed appropriately. · Maintain a strong understanding of the payments landscape and ClearBank’s proposition, using this knowledge to have credible, commercially relevant conversations with clients and identify opportunities that meet their needs. · Monitor the health and development of client relationships, proactively identifying risks, emerging needs and opportunities for further engagement. · Support retention and sustainable growth across the existing client portfolio by combining excellent relationship management with appropriate commercial development. Skills & Experience (must-have) · Strong knowledge and practical experience of the payments industry is essential, with the credibility to discuss payments propositions, client requirements and relevant industry developments with senior client stakeholders. · Proven experience managing and developing existing B2B client relationships, ideally within payments, banking or financial services. · Demonstrable experience of building trusted, long-term relationships with clients, understanding their objectives and using that insight to improve client outcomes. · A track record of identifying and successfully progressing upsell and cross-sell opportunities within existing client relationships. · Strong commercial skills, with the ability to balance client success, relationship retention and account growth. · Experience conducting structured client and account reviews and translating client needs into clear actions and opportunities. · Proven stakeholder management skills, with the ability to build credibility with decision makers and senior stakeholders within client organisations. · Great communication, questioning and presentation skills, including the ability to make complex payments and banking topics clear and relevant for different audiences. · Problem-solving and judgement, with the ability to coordinate stakeholders and maintain client confidence when navigating issues or competing priorities. · Ability to work collaboratively across multiple internal teams to deliver positive outcomes for clients. Nice-to-have · Broader knowledge of banking infrastructure and embedded banking. · Experience working with fintech, financial services or other regulated organisations. · Experience managing complex client relationships involving multiple products and stakeholder groups. What success looks like in the role · Clients experience a proactive, trusted and value-adding relationship with ClearBank, supported by a strong understanding of their business and priorities. · Client relationships are maintained and developed effectively, with risks, issues and changing client needs identified and addressed proactively. · Appropriate cross-sell and upsell opportunities are identified and progressed based on genuine client needs and commercial value. · Account plans and client information remain current, providing a clear view of relationship health, priorities, opportunities and agreed actions. · Strong collaboration across ClearBank supports positive client outcomes and sustainable long-term relationships. A little bit more about us! ClearBank is Where You Can belong: At ClearBank we think about Diversity, Equity and Inclusion (DE&I) a lot. Not because we think we should. But because we know we should – how else can we build a happy workforce and be successful as a business. We’re committed to making sure our teams reflect society. Collaborating across Product, Solutions, Risk, Compliance, Legal and other relevant teams to assess opportunities, shape viable proposals and progress new business efficiently. A strong track record of building, qualifying and converting sales pipelines in a complex B2B environment. Experience managing the full new business development cycle, from market mapping and initial outreach through discovery, proposal development, negotiation and close. Ability to develop clear target-client and account plans, prioritising activity according to strategic fit, client need and commercial potential. Strong discovery and consultative selling skills, with the ability to uncover client challenges and translate them into relevant commercial propositions. Experience building relationships with senior decision makers and navigating multiple stakeholders within prospective client organisations. Strong commercial judgement, including the ability to qualify opportunities, focus effort effectively and balance growth objectives with risk considerations. Clear communication, presentation and negotiation skills, with the ability to explain complex banking or payments propositions in an accessible and compelling way. Ability to collaborate effectively with Product, Solutions, Risk, Compliance, Legal and operational stakeholders throughout the sales process. Relevant knowledge of banking, payments, fintech or financial services would be advantageous. Priority prospects are engaged through consistent, targeted and insight-led business development activity. We all do it every day; navigating new, unexpected and sometimes even daunting challenges. But we believe in ourselves and trust we can do it. Want to innovate? Go for it. Push for a better way? You Can. If you think you have it in you, this is Where You Can. Role Purpose As Senior Finance Business Partner, you’ll play a key strategic and operational leadership role within our UK Finance team, reporting to the UK CFO. You’ll provide independent financial oversight and insight across the UK Bank, deputise for the UK CFO when required and connect UK Finance with Group Finance teams. The role combines financial control, regulatory oversight, planning and commercial finance to support effective decision-making and sustainable performance. This is a visible senior role requiring strong technical expertise, commercial judgement and the confidence to influence and constructively challenge senior stakeholders. Key Responsibilities Deputise for the UK CFO, including supporting interactions with the Board and Executive Committee. Lead the relationship between UK Finance and Group Finance, ensuring services meet UK regulatory and operational requirements. Maintain independent oversight of the UK Bank’s financial position, constructively challenging and validating Group Finance outputs. Lead UK financial planning and analysis, including budgeting, forecasting and performance reporting. Partner with the UK leadership team on business cases, profitability and strategic decision-making. Support the review of regulatory submissions and the preparation of Board and Executive Committee papers. Monitor compliance with UK regulatory and prudential requirements, escalating risks and control weaknesses appropriately. Improve financial processes and reporting to strengthen clarity, accuracy and timeliness. Act as a trusted adviser to the UK CFO and senior stakeholders, providing clear financial insight and challenge. Contribute financial leadership to strategic initiatives, including growth planning and operational resilience. Skills & Experience A recognised accountancy qualification, such as ACA, ACCA, CIMA or an equivalent, with significant post-qualification experience in financial services. Broad finance experience covering financial control, reporting, planning and commercial finance. Strong knowledge of UK GAAP and IFRS. Experience of regulatory and prudential requirements, including PRA and FCA frameworks, ICAAP, ILAAP, and recovery and resolution planning. Experience working within a regulated UK banking environment. Strong budgeting, forecasting, performance analysis and business-case development skills. Experience working effectively across a matrix organisation. Strong stakeholder management and influencing skills, with the confidence to engage and constructively challenge at Board and Executive level. Excellent analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to simplify complexity and focus on material issues. Sound professional judgement, independence and professional scepticism. A collaborative, outcome-focused approach, with the ability to take ownership, identify risks early and support shared goals. Our platform powers hotels across 150 countries, processing billions in bookings annually. From boutique properties to large hotel groups, we help hoteliers transform operations and uplevel their commercial strategy through a unified platform that integrates with hundreds of partners. And we do it with a completely remote team. Imagine working alongside global innovators to build AI-powered solutions that solve hoteliers' biggest challenges. Since our founding in 2012, we've continually been recognized for excellence, most recently earning top honors at the 2026 HotelTechAwards for Best Hotel Management Software and landing on Deloitte's Technology Fast 500 again, but we're just getting started. How You'll Make an Impact: As Global Director, Mid-Market Onboarding, you will own and scale the onboarding function for Cloudbeds' fastest-growing and most complex customer segment. You'll lead the team responsible for guiding mid-market customers from contract signature through go-live, adoption, and a clean transition to Account Management. You'll build the frameworks, standards, metrics, and team capability that make that experience world-class and repeatable at scale. You'll inherit a team of dedicated ICs and leads that have been experimenting with new ways to support these customers and improve their experience. Your charter is to get leadership in place and be maniacal about customer experience while building the project-management rigor that complex mid-market deployments demand. You'll be measured on onboarding velocity, deployment quality, customer satisfaction, and the long-term retention impact of a strong start. Our Onboarding Team: Our team is passionate about delivering exceptional customer experiences and helping hoteliers succeed with Cloudbeds from day one. We build together with a test-and-learn mindset that encourages innovation, collaboration, and continuous improvement. title: Team Lead Customer Success - Southern Europe
description: About You You're a jack-of-all-trades with a passion for cool technology and interacting with people and making them happy. You're a self-starter who's good at triaging problems and working on the most important one. You've worked directly with customers for a long time and are comfortable being the face of the company to them. One of the things that pleases you most in life is customers successfully using your product, being thrilled with its value, and telling you they're happy they partnered with you. Further, you're a curious person, and you'd love the opportunity to work with a technology team that includes data scientists, algorithm experts, back-end and front-end engineers to expand your knowledge. About Us Constructor.io powers product search and discovery for some of the largest retailers in the world. We serve billions of requests every week, and you've probably seen our results somewhere and used our product without knowing it. We differentiate ourselves by focusing on metrics over features, and reinventing search and discovery from the ground up as a machine learning challenge with the specific goal of improving metrics like revenue. We're approximately doubling year over year despite the market slow down and have customers in every eCommerce vertical. We're a passionate team of technologists who love solving problems and want to make our customers' and coworkers' lives better. We value empathy, openness, curiosity, continuous improvement, and are excited by metrics that matter. We believe that empowering everyone in a company to do what they think is best can lead to great things. About The Position As a Team Lead Customer Success Southern Europe, you'll be joining a rapidly growing team that helps our customers increase their revenue by improving the search and product discovery experiences of their websites and mobile apps through integrating with our services. Your responsibilities will include: Leading, coaching, and developing a team of Customer Success Managers across Southern Europe, with a focus on the main markets of France and Spain (and other Southern European countries) Ensuring customers successfully go live and continue to see measurable value from Constructor's product. Building and enabling your team to build trusted relationships across complex enterprise organizations: from engineers, data, and product teams to Heads and Directors of Ecommerce, Digital, Product, and Technology, up to VP and C-level executives. Translating technical concepts, product capabilities, and performance data into clear business value connecting Constructor's work to outcomes like conversion, revenue, customer experience, and operational efficiency. Implementing and iterating on scalable processes and best practices to support team growth. Acting as an escalation point for complex customer challenges and leading from the front when hands-on engagement is required. Requirements French is a must for this role; and additional languages are welcome bonuses. Based in EMEA, ideally in Southern Europe. At least three years leading teams, with a minimum of three direct reports. At least five years managing enterprise customer relationships in Customer Success, Account Management, Solutions Consulting, or a similar customer-facing role. Experience building trusted relationships with stakeholders ranging from technical teams and product leaders to Ecommerce Directors, VPs, and C-level executives. Strong executive presence and the confidence to lead strategic customer conversations, including QBRs and EBRs. Strong influencing and stakeholder-management skills, including the ability to create momentum without direct authority. Strong problem-solving skills, intellectual curiosity, and the ability to learn quickly in a fast-moving, technically sophisticated environment. Experience in ecommerce, digital commerce, search, product discovery, or a related field is highly valued. Benefits A competitive compensation package including stock options Fully remote team - choose where you live Work from home stipend! We want you to have the resources you need to set up your home office Apple laptops provided for new employees Training and development budget for every employee, refreshed each year Parental leave for qualified employees Work with smart people who will help you grow and make a meaningful impact Diversity, Equity, and Inclusion at Constructor At Constructor.io we are committed to cultivating a work environment that is diverse, equitable, and inclusive. title: Technical Project Manager (AMER)
description: About Us Constructor is the next-generation platform for search and discovery in ecommerce, built to explicitly optimize for metrics like revenue, conversion rate, and profit. Our search engine is entirely invented in-house utilizing transformers and generative LLMs, and we use its core and personalization capabilities to power everything from search itself to recommendations to shopping agents. Engineering is by far our largest department, and we’ve built our proprietary engine to be the best on the market, having never lost an A/B test to a competitive technology. We’re passionate about maintaining this and work on the bleeding edge of AI to do so. Out of necessity, our engine is built for extreme scale and powers over 1 billion queries every day across 150 languages and roughly 100 countries. It is used by some of the biggest ecommerce companies in the world like Sephora, Under Armour, and Petco. We’re a passionate team who love solving problems and want to make our customers’ and coworkers’ lives better. We value empathy, openness, curiosity, continuous improvement, and are excited by metrics that matter. We believe that empowering everyone in a company to do what they do best can lead to great things. Constructor is a U.S. based company that has been in the market since 2019. It was founded by Eli Finkelshteyn and Dan McCormick who still lead the company today. About the Position We're looking for a proactive and highly organized Technical Project Manager to lead customer implementations across Constructor's product suite. You will lead onboardings for new customers as well as implementations of additional products for existing customers, owning each engagement from kickoff through activation. You will own the plan, the timeline, and the outcome, and you drive the people delivering it through a matrixed reporting structure. As we build toward an automation-first operating model, you will help standardize how implementations are run and increasingly act as a portfolio strategist, managing exceptions while repeatable, AI-assisted processes carry the routine work. You will: • Lead multiple implementations end to end, both new-customer onboardings and additional-product rollouts for existing customers, from kickoff through integration, testing, and activation. • Take accountability for the outcome of every implementation, coordinating Constructor resources, customer resources, and partners, against a single shared plan. • Run kickoffs, set milestones, track dependencies, and maintain a clear, shared view of status for internal stakeholders and the customer. • Serve as the customer's primary point of contact through activation, setting expectations and communicating progress, risks, and changes in scope. • Identify risks and blockers early, escalate effectively, and keep implementations moving toward on-time, predictable delivery. • Ensure clean handoffs into implementation from Sales and out of implementation to Customer Success and Support. • Maintain implementation plans and reporting in our systems of record so schedule, duration, and status roll up cleanly across your portfolio. • Help build the repeatable processes, templates, and standards that let the function scale, and partner on the automation-first model as it matures. Role Responsibilities: Technical Project Management • Own the Outcome: Be accountable for the success of each implementation from kickoff to activation, whether the work is delivered by Constructor, the customer, or a partner, standing behind on-time, predictable go-live for both new customers and existing-customer product rollouts. • Drive Every Contributor: Coordinate Constructor technical resources, customer resources, and partners against one plan, holding each accountable to their commitments through influence rather than authority. • Lead the Customer Experience: Serve as the primary point of contact through activation, running a clear communication rhythm and building customer confidence from kickoff to handoff. • Manage Handoffs & Risk: Ensure accurate handoffs from Sales into implementation and from implementation into Customer Success and Support, surfacing risk early and keeping delivery on track wherever the risk sits. • Build Scalable Process: Standardize how implementations are run at Constructor, maintain accurate tracking and reporting, and help advance the automation-first operating model as the function grows. Requirements You Have • At least 3 years of technical project management or onboarding project management experience, ideally in a SaaS environment. • A track record of owning delivery outcomes end to end and holding cross-functional contributors accountable through influence rather than direct authority. • Excellent organizational and communication skills, with the ability to run multiple implementations in parallel without losing the thread. • Customer-facing confidence: you can lead a kickoff, manage expectations, and keep stakeholders aligned through go-live. • Proven ability to prioritize effectively, manage competing demands, and maintain clarity under ambiguity. Nice to Have • Technical fluency sufficient to direct integration specialists and translate between technical and business stakeholders. • Exposure to ecommerce, product discovery, LLMs and familiarity with concepts like catalog data feeds, integrations and APIs. • Experience coordinating implementations that span internal teams, customer resources, and third-party partners. Benefits 🏝️ Unlimited vacation time - we strongly encourage all of our employees take at least 3 weeks per year 💰 A competitive compensation package including stock options 🌎 Fully remote team - choose where you live 🛋️ Work from home stipend! We want you to have the resources you need to set up your home office 💻 Apple laptops provided for new employees 🧑‍🎓 Training and development budget for every employee, refreshed each year 👪 Maternity & Paternity leave for qualified employees 🧠 Work with smart people who will help you grow and make a meaningful impact 🏥 Company sponsored US health coverage (100% paid for employee) Diversity, Equity, and Inclusion at Constructor At Constructor.io we are committed to cultivating a work environment that is diverse, equitable, and inclusive. As an equal opportunity employer, we welcome individuals of all backgrounds and provide equal opportunities to all applicants regardless of their education, diversity of opinion, race, color, religion, gender, gender expression, sexual orientation, national origin, genetics, disability, age, veteran status or affiliation in any other protected group. By submitting this application, you acknowledge that Constructor will collect and process the personal data you provide for the purpose of evaluating your candidacy for this role. If you are not selected, we will retain your data for a limited period as described in our Recruitment Privacy Notice . After that period your data will be deleted or anonymized. title: Senior AR Analyst, Credit Control
description: Convene Hospitality Group (CHG) operates a global portfolio of lifestyle brands focused on creating places and experiences that bring people together. The company designs, develops, and operates hospitality-driven destinations to host gatherings of all kinds, ranging from small corporate meetings to immersive brand activations and beyond. We love bringing people together in person, and that passion for great experiences extends to our employees as well. If you're interested in creating inspiring moments of connection, consider joining our team. Senior AR Analyst, Credit Control | London Please note: candidate must currently reside in the UK and be able to work in the UK without sponsorship. About Convene Hospitality Group Convene Hospitality Group designs and operates experiential event venues, bringing premium meeting and event experiences to some of the world’s leading organisations. Through a growing portfolio of brands including Convene, etc.venues and NeueHouse, we operate a network of nearly 40 venues and are the largest single provider of dedicated meeting and event spaces across the US and UK. The UK is central to that story. From our Convene venues across the City of London to etc.venues in London and Manchester, and with our new West End destination, Convene Rathbone, our UK footprint continues to grow, and so does the pace of the events we deliver. Every conference, board meeting and live event our clients host relies on a finance team that keeps things moving behind the scenes. About the Role We are seeking an experienced Senior Accounts Receivable (AR) Analyst, Credit Control to join our UK Finance team and help lead AR operations across our UK venue portfolio. Reporting to the AR Manager, you’ll take ownership of billing, credit control and cash allocation, turning client contracts and booking data into accurate, timely invoices, following up on outstanding balances, allocating customer receipts and keeping customer accounts clean and reconciled in our financial systems. This is a role with real visibility. You’ll work closely with Sales, Event Operations and client procurement teams, acting as a trusted partner who keeps cash flowing while protecting the strong client relationships our business is built on. For someone who brings both rigour and a commercial mindset, it’s an opportunity to make a direct impact on the financial health of a growing UK business. What You’ll Do Daily Operations & Cash Management: Prepare multi-bank reconciliation spreadsheets (Santander, JPM, Online Credit Cards) and resolve unapplied cash exceptions Process incoming payments (ACH, credit cards, wires, cheques) and apply them accurately to customer accounts in NetSuite Issue final invoices for standard customer accounts and review/process credit memos and billing adjustments with proper approvals Manage customer record updates in NetSuite Credit Control & Collections: Take direct ownership of chasing overdue accounts via calls, emails, and structured collection cycles Review the AR Aging report weekly to track overdue accounts, identify delinquent trends, and prioritise high-value collection efforts Escalate severely overdue or high-risk accounts to Finance/Sales Management and Legal/Collections where necessary Assess and assign credit limits for new and existing accounts based on payment history and financial reviews Experience Required 5+ years of dedicated Accounts Receivable or Finance experience Strong proficiency in NetSuite (or comparable ERPs) and intermediate to advanced Excel Experience managing key enterprise client accounts, including submitting and tracking invoices via customer supplier portals (e.g. Coupa, SAP Ariba, Tungsten Network), purchase order-led invoicing and resolving rejected or queried invoices, is a strong advantage Solid understanding of month-end AR reconciliations Excellent problem-solving skills and cross-functional communication We’re Here For You: At Convene Hospitality Group, we want you to feel supported in every part of your life. Here’s what you can expect: Health & Wellness: Private medical insurance, subsidised fitness and eye care, plus well-being and personal support programs. Because your well-being matters, inside and outside of work. Time Off & Balance: 25 days annual leave, bank holidays, and company sick pay. Financial Benefits: Bonus scheme, interest-free loans for rail travel or further education, and a Cycle to Work program. We invest in you so you can grow personally and professionally.
