title: Solution Implementation Consultant (French Speaking)
description: About CoreView CoreView is the global leader in Microsoft 365 (M365) tenant resilience, serving over 23 million users worldwide. We empower the world’s leading organizations to master the complexity of Microsoft M365. Through robust security and precise governance, we help ensure that our client’s environments stay cyber-resilient and productive, no matter how complex they are. Our unified, cloud-native platform delivers powerful automation, rapid value, and end-to-end visibility across the entire M365 ecosystem. Backed by world-class support and a collaborative, innovative culture, CoreView is a place where your ideas matter, and your work truly impacts global enterprises. Please submit your CV in English You must have eligibility to work in France without the need for sponsorship Job Summary As a Solution Implementation Consultant, you will be a key advisor and delivery expert for our clients, guiding them through the deployment, configuration, and ongoing evolution of the CoreView platform and associated Microsoft 365 environments. Your mission: ensure clients quickly achieve success and value realization, both through structured implementation projects and dynamic professional services requests. In this role, you’ll blend strong technical skills on M365 and cloud administration with client-facing consulting excellence. You’ll lead customers through onboarding, tailored solution design, automation initiatives, and proactive optimization. You will act as the technical voice of the customer internally—focusing on removing friction, accelerating outcomes, and building trusted partnerships. You will also be expected to progressively become a Subject Matter Expert (SME) on CoreView solutions and Microsoft 365, providing deep insights and thought leadership both internally and with clients. Job Requirements Technical Skillset : Strong knowledge of Microsoft 365 (including Entra ID, Exchange Online, Teams, SharePoint Online, OneDrive), SaaS/cloud operations, automation/orchestration tools, and security best practices. Implementation Experience : Demonstrated experience delivering technical projects or professional services in a SaaS or IT consulting role. Experience with M365 tenant migrations, hybrid/cloud adoption, or large-scale IT transformations is highly valued. Consultative Approach : Proven ability to capture business requirements, translate them into technical solutions, and educate customers at multiple levels—from IT admins to executives. Project & Task Management : Aptitude for running multiple projects, prioritizing concurrent client demands, and maintaining detailed project documentation (SOWs, delivery plans, runbooks, reports, etc.). Problem Solving : Strong analysis skills; able to diagnose issues, identify technical gaps, and design effective workarounds in fast-paced environments. Teamwork : Comfortable collaborating across internal teams—working closely with product, support, engineering, and account management. Willing to share knowledge and continuously improve. Communication : Excellent written and spoken English/French . Ability to explain technical concepts clearly and constructively to non-technical users. Experience delivering on-demand or packaged professional services (such as tenant assessments, security posture reviews, policy automation, etc.), administering Microsoft 365 hybrid environments or complex customer deployments. Extra Credit Certifications: Microsoft certifications (e.g., MS-100/101, AZ-104, MS-500, etc.) or experience with ISO/SOC-compliant environments a plus. Education & Experience: Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, IT or proven equivalent experience. Knowledge of automation, orchestration, disaster recovery, and business continuity strategies. Knowledge of scripting (PowerShell, KQL, etc.), workflow automation, custom reporting/dashboarding and proficiency with APIs in M365 contexts. Familiarity with large-scale migration, change management, or digital transformation projects. Job Responsibilities Implementation Project Delivery: Lead clients through the onboarding, configuration, and rollout of CoreView (and satellite M365 environments). Own project execution (remotely and/or onsite), ensuring clear milestones, documentation, and mutual accountability. Professional Services Execution: Deliver ad hoc and packaged professional services (e.g., policy setup, governance automation, reporting customization, security reviews, delegations, and optimization workshops) as scoped by client needs or internal recommendations. Solution Design: Translate complex business requirements into robust technical solutions leveraging the CoreView platform and best practices for Microsoft 365. Guide clients on technical architecture, integrations, and preferred operating models. Training & Enablement: Provide hands-on training, classroom webinar, documentation, and best-practice know-how to empower clients’ IT teams and administrators. Project & Task Management: Develop and maintain detailed Statements of Work (SOWs), implementation plans, and delivery documentation. Track client requests, work deliverables, and completion timelines in our delivery and CRM systems. Customer Engagement: Establish a trusted advisor relationship with client technical stakeholders. Proactively communicate updates, listen for feedback, and adapt project plans for evolving needs. Issue Resolution & Escalation: Take primary responsibility for diagnosing and resolving technical blockers; escalate issues to product/support engineering as needed, ensuring a seamless client experience. Continuous Improvement: Gather feedback from the field (clients and partners) and relay actionable insights for service/product improvement. Share learnings across the team to enhance playbooks and delivery standards. #LI-CW1 Coreview Values Ownership Mindset : Take ownership. Drive outcomes. One Team : One team, one goal, embracing diversity - to achieve more together. Velocity: Decide fast. Deliver fast. Repeat. Continuous Improvement : Curiosity drives us. We challenge the status quo. Customer First: Listen deeply. Solve boldly. Resilience: Steady under pressure. CoreView is an organisation which values the strength that diversity brings to the workplace. As an employer, we seek to promote equal opportunity through affirmative action. All qualified applicants will therefore receive consideration for employment and will not be discriminated against based on gender/sex, race/ethnicity, disability, age or any other protected group status (such as protected veteran status) or characteristic that is protected by local legislation. title: Senior Technical Program Manager, International Security & Privacy Compliance
description: CoreWeave is The Essential Cloud for AI™. Built for pioneers by pioneers, CoreWeave delivers a platform of technology, tools, and teams that enables innovators to build and scale AI with confidence. Trusted by leading AI labs, startups, and global enterprises, CoreWeave combines superior infrastructure performance with deep technical expertise to accelerate breakthroughs and turn compute into capability. Founded in 2017, CoreWeave became a publicly traded company (Nasdaq: CRWV) in March 2025. Learn more at www.coreweave.com . We're proud to be a Living Wage accredited Employer. CoreWeave is The Essential Cloud for AI™. Built for pioneers by pioneers, CoreWeave delivers a platform of technology, tools, and teams that enables innovators to build and scale AI with confidence. Trusted by leading AI labs, startups, and global enterprises, CoreWeave combines superior infrastructure performance with deep technical expertise to accelerate breakthroughs and turn compute into capability. Founded in 2017, CoreWeave became a publicly traded company (Nasdaq: CRWV) in March 2025. Learn more at www.coreweave.com . About the Role CoreWeave is taking its AI cloud and data center services to new countries. Each new market brings its own data protection, cybersecurity, and data residency requirements, and we have to meet them before we launch. As the Technical Program Manager for International Security & Privacy Compliance, you will own the program that gets CoreWeave compliant in each new market. You will turn local legal and regulatory requirements into controls, timelines, and owners. Then you will lead Legal, Privacy, Security, Data Center Operations, Product, and Go-to-Market through to a compliant launch. The problem is defined; the solution is not. You will build the playbook as you go and make it repeatable for each market that follows. The role is based in London so you can work during business hours with US teams and with teams in the Middle East and Asia-Pacific. What You'll Do Own the end-to-end compliance program for new-country launches, from early regulatory assessment through go-live and ongoing upkeep. Work with Legal and Privacy counsel to turn local laws into concrete technical and operational requirements. These cover data protection and privacy, cybersecurity, data localization and residency, cross-border data transfer, incident reporting, and registration or licensing. Legal owns the interpretation; you own turning it into delivery. Map country requirements to CoreWeave's existing control framework (SOC 2, ISO/IEC 27001, and related certifications). Find gaps and drive the work to close them with control owners in Security, Engineering, and Data Center Operations. Build and maintain source-of-truth program plans, a requirements register, and a dependency map for each market. Use them to drive high-quality execution against timelines leadership can rely on. Build country-specific incident and breach notification obligations into CoreWeave's incident response process before go-live. Find risks and blockers early, such as data residency limits on architecture, local vendor or partner obligations, and regulator timelines. Drive them to resolution across teams, or escalate them with clear options and tradeoffs. Coordinate privacy reviews and data protection impact assessments for in-country services, working with Privacy and Product. Bring compliance requirements into product and data center launch plans early, so customer-facing commitments, contracts, and Trust Center content reflect what we can actually deliver. Report program status, risk, and decisions needed to Security, Legal, and business leadership. Make the work repeatable. Turn each market's lessons into a scalable country-entry playbook, templates, and workflows in Jira and our GRC tooling. Who You Are [5+] years of relevant experience in international security and privacy compliance program management, GRC, or related technical program management, preferably at a cloud, data center, or infrastructure provider. A track record of managing end-to-end, large-scale, cross-functional programs with significant organizational impact under little or no supervision. You are comfortable with work that has a defined problem but no defined solution. Strong execution skills. You get things done to high quality on timelines people can trust. You identify risks and blockers early and drive them to resolution. A solid grounding in industry best practices and frameworks such as ISO/IEC 27001, ISO/IEC 27701, SOC 2, NIST CSF, and GDPR-style data protection regimes. You can make well-reasoned decisions and tradeoffs that fit CoreWeave's context. You quickly learn and keep up with the requirements of unfamiliar jurisdictions, well enough to take an active part in decisions with Legal, Security, and Engineering. You use feedback to shape priorities, and you make sure compliance solutions don't degrade the customer experience. You influence cross-functional decisions with a structured approach, data, and technical insight, to achieve the intended outcome. You also contribute to the wider CoreWeave community, for example by mentoring others. You win buy-in from critical stakeholders on your recommendations, define clear communication strategies tailored to the audience, from engineers to executives, and seek out feedback to improve how you work. Preferred Experience running compliance programs across several countries, especially in Asia-Pacific or the Middle East. Experience with data residency, sovereign cloud, or in-country hosting requirements for cloud or data center services. Certifications such as CIPP/E, CIPM, CISSP, CISM, CISA, or PMP. Experience with GRC platforms and with Jira-based program tracking. Wondering if you're a good fit? We believe in investing in our people and value candidates who bring unique backgrounds, even if you don't check every box. Here are a few qualities we've found make someone successful on our team. If some of this describes you, we'd love to talk. You're comfortable balancing compliance rigor with practical, scalable solutions. You take ownership, bring structure to ambiguity, and follow issues through to resolution. You communicate clearly with technical and non-technical stakeholders and build strong cross-functional partnerships. You're energized by building processes and systems that improve how teams work. To fulfill our obligation to protect client data, successful applicants offered employment with CoreWeave will be required to complete a basic criminal record check, conducted in compliance with GDPR. Employment offers are conditional upon receiving satisfactory check results. title: Chief of Staff
description: Über uns: Die Baubranche ist einer der größten Wirtschaftszweige der Welt – und einer der am wenigsten digitalisierten. Wir bei Cosuno ändern das. Als eines der am schnellsten wachsenden ConTech-Scale-ups Europas revolutionieren wir den Einkauf und die Nachunternehmervergabe. Wir haben ein starkes Produkt, exzellente Metriken und ambitionierte Wachstumsziele. Um unsere kommerzielle Skalierung auf das nächste Level zu heben, suchen wir eine herausragende Persönlichkeit, die direkt mit unserem Gründerteam und dem CRO zusammenarbeitet. Deine Mission: Als Chief of Staff (Commercial Focus) bist du kein reiner Berater, sondern ein "Builder". Du fungierst als rechte Hand des C-Levels, löst unsere komplexesten Wachstumsherausforderungen und treibst strategische Initiativen von der ersten Hypothese bis zur erfolgreichen Implementierung voran. Strategic Execution: Du übernimmst die Ownership für geschäftskritische Go-to-Market-Projekte über die Bereiche Enterprise Sales, Revenue Operations und Customer Success hinweg. Commercial Excellence: Du identifizierst Ineffizienzen in unseren Funnels, entwickelst datengetriebene Lösungsansätze und skalierst unseren Umsatzmotor (Pricing-Strategien, neue Marktsegmente, Sales-Zyklen-Optimierung). Cross-functional Leadership: Du agierst als Bindeglied zwischen den Commercial-Teams und Product/Tech, brichst Silos auf und sorgst dafür, dass alle an einem Strang ziehen, um unsere OKRs zu übertreffen. Executive Leverage: Du entlastest das Gründerteam und den CRO im operativen Tagesgeschäft, bereitest Board-Meetings vor und triffst eigenständig Vorabentscheidungen auf C-Level-Niveau. Dein Profil: Wir suchen einen analytischen Vordenker mit einer absoluten "Get-shit-done"-Mentalität. Du kannst auf Flughöhe strategisch diskutieren, scheust dich aber nicht davor, tief in die Daten oder operativen Prozesse abzutauchen. Top-Tier Erfahrung: Du bringst 2-3+ Jahre Berufserfahrung aus einer führenden Strategieberatung mit. Alternativ hast du bereits in einer ähnlich exponierten, strategischen Rolle in einem High-Growth B2B-SaaS-Umfeld massiven Impact bewiesen. Commercial Acumen: Du hast eine starke Affinität zu B2B-Software-Metriken (ARR, CAC, LTV, Churn) und idealerweise bereits Projekte in den Bereichen GTM-Strategie, Sales Excellence oder Pricing begleitet. Analytische Exzellenz: Du triffst Entscheidungen nicht aus dem Bauch heraus, sondern basierend auf Daten. Du beherrschst Financial/Commercial Modeling und kannst komplexe Sachverhalte in klare Handlungsempfehlungen übersetzen. Kommunikationsstärke: Du kommunizierst präzise, auf den Punkt und kannst auf C-Level sowie im Board-Kontext souverän agieren. Sprachen: Verhandlungssichere Deutsch- (Muttersprachenniveau) und exzellente Englischkenntnisse. Warum Cosuno? Massiver Impact & Sichtbarkeit: Deine Arbeit hat direkten, messbaren Einfluss auf den Erfolg und die Bewertung unseres Unternehmens. Fast-Track Karriere: Die CoS-Rolle ist als Sprungbrett konzipiert. Beweist du dich hier, stehen dir langfristig Türen für Senior-Leadership-Rollen (z.B. VP, Head of) innerhalb von Cosuno offen. Flexibilität & Kultur: Arbeite aus unserem modernen Office in Berlin-Friedrichshain oder nutze unser hybrides Modell. Wir pflegen eine Kultur der absoluten Transparenz, wenig Politik und schnellen Entscheidungen. Das Setup: Ein unbefristeter Vertrag, State-of-the-art Equipment, regelmäßige Team-Events und ein extrem motiviertes, internationales Team, das gemeinsam gewinnen will. title: Master Data & Analytics Specialist
description: Wij zijn Cotap, de Vloerfanaten. We hebben al meer dan 85 jaar een enorme passie voor vloeren, waarbij alles wat we doen gericht is op het ontwikkelen van kennis, kwaliteit en service. Cotap is een groothandel en Retail partner in een markt die razendsnel digitaliseert. We hebben de ambitie om digitaal leider te zijn en we weten dat dat méér vraagt dan technologie. De échte verandering zit in hoe mensen werken, samenwerken en beslissen. Data is daarbij een sturende factor. Daarom zoeken we een Master Data & Analytics Specialist die een bijdrage kan leveren in het kwalitatieve beheer en onderhoud van masterdata en het opzetten en onderhouden van een dataplatform welke voor BI en AI-toepassingen gebruikt kan worden. En kan meedenken in het verder automatiseren en integreren van databronnen binnen de organisatie. Ben jij analytisch sterk, zie jij kansen in data en krijg je energie van het bouwen aan een datagedreven organisatie? Dan maken we graag kennis met je! Wat is jouw rol? Als Master Data & Analytics Specialist ben jij dé specialist op het gebied van data binnen Cotap. Je zorgt ervoor dat onze data betrouwbaar, toegankelijk en toekomstbestendig is. Daarmee creëer je de basis voor betere bedrijfsprocessen, managementinformatie, Business Intelligence en toekomstige AI-toepassingen. Je werkt op het snijvlak van operatie, processen, technologie en innovatie. In eerste instantie leer je onze bestaande datastromen, systemen en processen grondig kennen. Vervolgens krijg je een belangrijke rol in de verdere professionalisering van databeheer, data eigenaarschap en analytics binnen de organisatie. Bij Cotap zien we data als een van de belangrijkste bouwstenen voor de toekomst. Daarom bieden we een ontwikkeltraject waarin je stap voor stap groeit van operationeel specialist naar strategisch adviseur en regisseur van data binnen de organisatie Wat zijn jouw verantwoordelijkheden? Beheren, verbeteren en bewaken van de kwaliteit van onze masterdata; Opzetten en verder ontwikkelen van data eigenaarschap en beheer binnen Cotap; Ontwikkelen en beheren van ons centrale dataplatform voor BI- en AI-toepassingen; Analyseren van datakwaliteit en het initiëren van verbetertrajecten; Ontwikkelen van dashboards, rapportages en managementinformatie; Adviseren van collega's en projectteams over datastructuren en data-inrichting; Signaleren van kansen voor procesverbetering, automatisering en integraties; Begeleiden van databeheerders en bijdragen aan verdere professionalisering van databeheer; Ondersteunen van data gedreven besluitvorming binnen de organisatie; Onderzoeken en toepassen van innovatieve mogelijkheden op het gebied van data, AI en analytics. Hoe ziet het team eruit? Je maakt onderdeel uit van de afdeling Data & ICT en rapporteert aan de Manager ICT. Daarnaast werk je intensief samen met collega's uit vrijwel alle afdelingen binnen Cotap. Denk aan commercie, logistiek, voorraadbeheer en finance. Wat maakt jou de ideale kandidaat? HBO werk- en denkniveau; Een opleiding in bijvoorbeeld Informatiemanagement, Bedrijfskunde of Data & Analytics; Minimaal 3 jaar ervaring binnen data, analytics of informatiemanagement; Ervaring met ERP-systemen, BI-tools en datamodellering; Affiniteit met AI, automatisering en innovatieve technologieën; Sterke analytische vaardigheden en een gestructureerde werkwijze; Goede communicatieve vaardigheden waardoor je gemakkelijk schakelt tussen techniek en business; Een initiatiefrijke en resultaatgerichte instelling; Het vermogen om mensen mee te nemen in veranderingen en verbeteringen Wat mag je van ons verwachten: Jaarcontract met zicht op een vast contract bij wederzijds enthousiasme; Salaris tussen de € 3600,- en €4880 bruto per maand o.b.v. fulltime; Inspirerende werkomgeving met ruimte voor persoonlijke groei en ontwikkeling; Reiskostenvergoeding van 25 cent per kilometer (vanaf 10 km enkele reis); Jaarlijkse collectieve- en individuele salarisverhoging; 25 vakantiedagen (o.b.v. fulltime) Een aantrekkelijke pensioenregeling met bijdrage van de werkgever; Fruit op je werk en organiseren we jaarlijks diverse vitaliteitsmomenten Jaarlijkse personeelsbijeenkomsten, teamuitjes en een spectaculaire kerstmarkt; Bovendien vergeten we jouw (werk)jubileum, verjaardag en die van je partner niet; Mocht je een nieuwe vloer nodig hebben, dan zorgen wij voor een interessante korting; Werken bij een financieel gezond en groeiend familiebedrijf met een duidelijke duurzaamheidsambitie Interesse in een kennismaking of meer informatie? title: AI Product Owner

title: Application Scientist
description: About CuspAI CuspAI is the frontier AI company on a mission to solve the breakthrough materials needed to power human progress. While nature took billions of years to perfect molecules, we are harnessing AI to unlock trillion-dollar materials breakthroughs in months, not millennia. Our founding team is the most cited in the world, comprised of world-class researchers in AI, chemistry and engineering. We are working on some of the hardest and most important challenges including energy, clean water, the future of compute, and carbon capture, and this is just the start of what our 'search engine' for next-generation materials will unlock. We invite you to be part of a diverse, innovative team at the intersection of AI and materials science, working to create impactful partnerships that drive innovation, scalability, and industry collaboration. This work matters. Your work matters. We’re on the cusp of the on-demand materials era. Join us. The Role We hire across a spectrum of backgrounds. What they share is the ability to turn a partner’s problem into a plan, deliver it, and translate fluently between experimental, computational, and machine learning teams. We operate a matrix structure. You will have a home team, but may contribute to projects in another pillar as demand and your expertise evolve. Your Impact You will own the scientific delivery of partner projects, from scoping to results. Working with our technical programme managers, ML researchers, platform engineers, and lab integration team, you will make sure our platform answers the questions that matter to partners, and that what is learned on each project feeds back into tools and workflows used across the company. Alongside delivery, you will help build the cross-cutting capabilities that future projects depend on, such as validated workflows, harmonised data pipelines and agentic design campaigns. Application Areas We are particularly interested in candidates with expertise in one or more of the areas below. You do not need to cover a whole pillar. Environment : Porous and soft materials, interfaces, and separations Cross-cutting : Materials informatics, automated experimentation and optimisation. Design and steer discovery campaigns, including agentic and closed-loop campaigns with partner labs. Assess when models, simulations, and data can be trusted, and contribute to validating them against experiments. Bridging experimental and computational teams Translate platform recommendations into clear, executable experimental plans, and translate lab realities back into requirements for internal teams. Make sure data from partners and our own workflows are clean, structured, and consistent. Work closely with partner labs, including on-site visits at key stages of a project. Capability and product development Build and automate workflows that run reliably at scale within our platform. Relay partner feedback to TPMs, ML researchers, and platform engineers to improve tools and workflows. Stay informed about advances in your field and contribute to the scientific direction of your team. Must Have Skills and Qualifications A PhD in chemistry, materials science, physics, chemical engineering, or a related field, or equivalent industry experience. Deep, hands-on expertise in at least one of: atomistic simulation (including machine-learned force fields); experimental materials or chemistry, ideally with automation or high-throughput methods; materials or cheminformatics with machine learning and optimisation. A track record in one or more of the application areas above. Python skills for data handling, analysis, automation or modelling, and familiarity with version control (Git). Exceptional ability to communicate with both experimental and computational scientists, and to translate between them. A personal passion for CuspAI's mission and the potential of AI to unlock breakthroughs in materials science. Bonus Points (But Not Critical) Industry experience, particularly in the semiconductor, electronics, energy, or chemical sectors. Experience leading projects or collaborations with external partners, including writing technical scopes or proposals. Experience with multiscale modelling, from atomistic to mesoscale, continuum or device level. Practical synthesis or processing experience, with an understanding of what makes a route feasible and reproducible. Professional software engineering practice, such as code review, testing and deployment. Prior experience in a start-up or fast-growth technology company. Additional Considerations These roles can be based in our London, Cambridge, Amsterdam, or Berlin offices, with the expectation of being in the office at least three days per week. There may be regular travel to partner sites and other CuspAI offices for collaboration and project work. title: Account Executive
description: We're looking for an Account Executive to close new-logo business for Cytix in a market where most of the people you're calling haven't heard of us yet. You'll be selling a product, not a service, into CISOs, security engineers and AppSec leads, which means the pitch has to work on its own merits rather than on brand recognition. This is a full-cycle closing role: you'll run discovery, demo and negotiation yourself, with support from the CRO on the harder deals while you build that muscle. You'll carry mid-market opportunities to start, working alongside SDR-sourced pipeline as well as your own prospecting, with a clear path to Senior Account Executive as your quota, deal complexity and independence grow. What you'll do Run full-cycle new-logo opportunities from qualified meeting through discovery, demo and close, sourced by SDR, Marketing and your own prospecting. Generate some of your own pipeline alongside SDR support, prospecting into a clearly defined ideal customer profile. Run structured discovery calls solo, identifying pain and priorities for your primary buyer. Close mid-market deals with negotiation support from the CRO as you build experience with more complex procurement. Maintain your own weekly pipeline and forecast, developing commit accuracy over time. Work SDR and Customer Success handoffs as directed, keeping CRM records clean and up to date. What you'll bring 3–5 years' full-cycle closing experience in B2B SaaS, or a strong track record in an adjacent commercial role (for example SDR) ready to step up. A track record at or near 100% of quota (around £500k–£750k) in at least one of the last two years. Real consultative selling instinct: you'd rather understand a prospect's problem than run a script at them. Comfortable prospecting and selling into accounts with little existing awareness of Cytix, energised by the challenge of a cold or lightly-worked start. Visible drive and competitiveness, and a willingness to take on unfamiliar deal types or buyer personas when asked. Genuinely bright and inquisitive : good follow-up questions come naturally to you, and you're genuinely curious about the product and the security market, including how software gets built and secured. Drawn to a business where new challenges show up daily; you want to take ownership of them and lean in, rather than needing everything mapped out in advance. Comfortable taking yourself out of your comfort zone when a deal or a buyer is unfamiliar territory. What you'll get Time off that works for you: Unlimited holiday policy, including a guaranteed 33 days plus your birthday off Flexible hybrid working: Work in a way that helps you do your best work, while staying connected with the team. A stake in what we’re building: Eligible employees can participate in our EMI share option scheme. Healthcare that goes further: After one year’s service, access private healthcare through Vitality, including dental, optical, hearing and therapy cover. More ways to get around: Access our company car salary-sacrifice scheme. Support for growing families: Enhanced maternity and paternity leave. About Cytix Software never stops changing. Teams ship new code every day, through tickets, pull requests, releases, and increasingly with AI in the mix, but the way security keeps up with all that change hasn't really moved on. That's the problem we're solving. Cytix helps organisations understand which software changes actually matter, what should happen next, and how to prove the right call was made. Security understood, in other words. We're a small team with big plans, so every person we hire genuinely shapes what Cytix becomes. That's why we're upfront about our five values: we interview for all of them, and they matter to us more than a perfect CV. They're things you do, not things you are, so have a read and see if they sound like you. Make the first move . When the goal is clear but the path isn't, you get moving rather than waiting for perfect instructions. If you're blocked, you make a sensible call, say what you're assuming, and explain how you'd course-correct. We'd rather you act and be slightly wrong than sit still. Find the smarter path. You ask why before how. You dig into what the real problem is instead of just building what the spec says, and you're happy to question 'that's how it's always been done' when the reason behind it has gone stale. See it through. When something's yours, it lands. No loose ends, no surprises for whoever picks it up next. You keep people posted when things change, and if something falls between roles, you catch it. Raise the bar. You do the best job possible in the time you've got, whether that's a day or a month. Sometimes that means deep craft; sometimes the smartest move is quick and scrappy. It's about good judgement, and we hold each other to it without blame or politics. Play to win. You care about the mission but don't take yourself too seriously. You say 'I' when things go wrong and 'we' when they go right, trust teammates to do things their own way, and bring a bit of humour when the pressure's on. title: Engineering Manager, Billing & Monetization

The hardest AI problems aren't about getting an answer fast. They're about getting one people can trust. We believe trust is essential to how society works. Every day, we rely on information that's been independently verified, from financial statements to the products we buy, to the sustainability claims companies make. Behind that trust are audit and finance professionals who examine evidence, verify information and hold organizations accountable. At DataSnipper, we build AI solutions that empowers those professionals. By making evidence easier to trace and verify, we help them focus on the judgment and expertise that make their work so important. For our product and engineering team, this is where things get exciting. In audit, a plausible answer isn't good enough. Every output must be explainable and traceable back to its source. We've just launched a brand-new agentic platform, Alwin by DataSnipper. AI agents running in the cloud across hundreds of documents at once, reasoning across PDF, Word and Excel, with a full audit trail behind every step. There are lots of greenfield problems ahead, and real room to shape what we build and how we build it. And we build at scale. More than 600,000 professionals across 3,000+ organizations in 175 countries rely on DataSnipper, including Fortune 500 companies, government agencies and all Big Four audit firms. In 2025 alone, the DataSnipper platform delivered more than $1.4 billion in productivity savings to is customers. Backed by a $100 million Series B led by Index Ventures, at a $1 billion valuation, and as proud members of 1% for the Planet, we care about how we grow, not just how fast. If you want to build AI that professionals trust with work that really matters, this is your chance to help shape the future of audit and finance and do the best work of your career along the way. The Scope Onboarding & offboarding : sign-up, trials, tenant and workspace provisioning, and the first-run experience. Getting a new firm from contract to value, fast. Licensing & entitlements : seats, plans, feature access and limits across the Excel add-in and Alwin, for self-serve users and global enterprise contracts alike. Metering & billing : real-time usage and credit consumption for our agentic products, through to invoicing, payments and revenue reporting. What You Will Do Lead through outcomes, not tasks. Set clear goals and trust the team to find the how. Make the team measurably better. Raise the bar, grow engineers into bigger problems, and address performance directly. Own the technical direction of the full customer lifecycle platform, and stay close enough to the code to make the hard calls credibly. Build systems where correctness is non-negotiable: accurate metering, enforced entitlements, reliable billing, all observable, secure and auditable. Treat onboarding as a product. Measure activation and time-to-value, and remove friction with Product and Design. Continuously improve on the admin experience to delight and empower our internal users. Turn commercial strategy into software. Partner with Product, Finance, Sales and Customer Success to shape pricing, packaging and licensing models. Set the bar for AI-assisted engineering. Not just shipping faster, but taking on harder problems, and shaping how DataSnipper engineering uses AI. Grow the scope. Expand ownership and stand up new teams as the area grows. What You Bring 3+ years leading engineering teams, on top of 5+ years as a software engineer An empowerment style of leadership and a track record of building high-performing teams Experience building billing, licensing, entitlement or onboarding systems at scale, ideally usage- or credit-based Strong fundamentals in software architecture, distributed systems, APIs and cloud-native development Experience running production systems where financial correctness matters Strong product aptitude: you challenge framing, make roadmap trade-offs, and care about activation and conversion as much as uptime Hands-on fluency with AI coding tools and agentic harnesses, and a team that is measurably better for using them A strategic, entrepreneurial mindset: you shape direction, not just execute it Nice to Have Usage-, metered- or credit-based billing in production, including AI token metering and cost attribution Billing and payment platforms (e.g. Stripe), CRM and ERP integrations Identity and provisioning: SSO, SCIM, multi-tenant account models Product-led growth: self-serve sign-up, trials, in-product upgrades Financial correctness: idempotency, reconciliation, auditability, revenue recognition Python, Azure and observability tooling Scale-up experience, ideally in fintech or audit tech What We Offer Be part of one of the fastest-growing, profitable unicorn scale-ups in the Netherlands with a global impact. title: Product Manager, Homepage
description: Our Global Structure Deliveroo is now part of DoorDash, bringing together teams with even greater reach, scale, and ambition. Depending on your role, you may collaborate with teammates, systems, and leaders across DoorDash and Wolt. Together, we're unlocking new possibilities as one global team. Join us in shaping the experience that millions of customers land on every time they open DoorDash, Wolt, or Deliveroo. As part of our Core Consumer organisation, our Homepage team owns one of the single biggest levers we have on what customers find and one of the hardest surfaces in the app to get right. Working at the intersection of ranking, personalisation, and AI/ML, you'll help decide what each customer sees and why, across three brands and dozens of markets. You'll be building on a global stack, and your roadmap will be a mix: global platform problems that apply worldwide, global capabilities we're accelerating into EMEA, and EMEA-specific problems worth solving properly rather than working around. We're looking for a Senior Product Manager to join our Homepage team. In this role, you'll shape how customers discover restaurants, grocery and retail venues, dishes and products — and help define what discovery looks like as AI-driven and agentic experiences change the way people decide what to order. What You'll Be Doing You'll be joining a team working on one of the most-used surfaces in the app. Here's what your day-to-day might look like: Building new end-to-end features and user experiences on Homepage that shape how customers discover restaurants, grocery and retail venues, dishes, and products. Working on ranking, personalisation, and AI/ML problems in the Homepage domain, including how we decide what each customer sees and why. Exploring where AI-driven and agentic experiences change the way customers discover what to order. Making discovery work across three brands and many markets, without flattening into one-size-fits-all. What You'll Need to Thrive Our ideal candidate will bring strong product judgment and curiosity to grow into the rest: Proven experience as a Product Manager on consumer-facing products - discovery, homepage, feed, or ranking-driven experiences are especially relevant. You are a product manager more than a feature owner. Someone who finds the customer problems that matter most and makes the case for solving them. You work backwards from the customer problem, and weigh it against what the business needs most right now. You're comfortable holding several business objectives at once and making a call when they pull in different directions. You work well with a wide range of stakeholders and build trust with people whose priorities differ from your own. You think strategically and can move between long-term direction and what we should ship next. You're comfortable with ambiguity and genuinely flexible (this industry is changing fast, AI most of all). You're curious about what AI actually changes for customers, and can tell real value from hype. description: Our Global Structure Deliveroo is now part of DoorDash, bringing together teams with even greater reach, scale, and ambition. Behind the AI experiences millions of people use every day, from shopping assistants to customer support agents, sits one shared Generative AI platform. Our team builds it. You'll work with engineering and product leaders in Europe and the US, and your decisions will shape how AI gets built across every market we operate in. What You'll Be Doing Set the strategy and roadmap for core parts of our GenAI platform: model access and routing, agent infrastructure, and evaluation and observability. Build one platform for three brands. Spot the patterns across Deliveroo, Wolt and DoorDash teams and turn them into shared building blocks, so a capability built once reaches every market. Shape our model portfolio across frontier and open-weight models. Decide where we build, buy or partner in an ecosystem that changes month to month. Make agents production-ready. Give teams safe access to company knowledge, tools and systems, with the quality, latency and cost controls needed to run agents at scale. Own the evaluation strategy so teams can prove quality before launch and keep improving it after. Stay close to your customers. Work with the teams shipping AI experiences, measure adoption and time-to-production, and let real production use drive the roadmap. Lead at a senior level, presenting to senior technical leadership and influence strategy beyond your own roadmap. What You'll Need to Thrive Our ideal candidate brings deep expertise in some of these areas and curiosity to grow in others: Significant product management experience (typically 8+ years, or equivalent), including owning a technical platform, developer product, or ML or data infrastructure. Hands-on experience with LLM-based products or platforms in production, such as assistants, agents, evaluation or inference. GenAI platforms are a young field, so we care more about depth than years. A platform mindset. You notice the problem five teams keep solving and turn it into one capability everyone can use. The ability to go deep with engineers and ML researchers, then explain the trade-off in plain language to a senior leader. A track record of leading large, ambiguous areas on your own and aligning stakeholders across companies, countries and time zones. Comfort with regular overlap with US time zones, including some late-afternoon and evening calls. What Success Looks Like A team in any of our three brands can go from idea to a reliable AI product dramatically faster. That happens because the hard parts (models, inference, evaluation, tooling, observability, governance and agent infrastructure) are solved once at the platform layer and get better for everyone. Why Join Us? Real scale from day one. Your platform powers AI used by millions of consumers, merchants and couriers across three brands. Frontier work, real constraints. You'll work with the latest models and agent patterns, then make them reliable, affordable and compliant in production. Visible impact. Platform decisions here get reviewed by senior leadership and adopted across the company. title: Senior Full-Stack Developer – AI & Automation in Hamburg oder Remote (m/w/d)
description: Gestalte mit uns die Zukunft intelligenter Prozessautomatisierung Du bist ein erfahrener Softwareentwickler, denkst gerne über einzelne Features hinaus und hast Lust, mit KI, Automatisierung und modernen Technologien echte Probleme zu lösen? Du möchtest nicht nur Anforderungen umsetzen, sondern selbst technische Lösungen gestalten und deine Erfahrung in ein interdisziplinäres Team einbringen? Dann bist du bei uns genau richtig. Deine Rolle bei uns In unserem Team Elbe arbeiten Menschen mit unterschiedlichen fachlichen und technischen Hintergründen gemeinsam daran, Geschäftsprozesse intelligenter, effizienter und zunehmend automatisiert zu gestalten. Wir entwickeln Automatisierungen, verbinden bestehende Systeme, erschließen neue Einsatzmöglichkeiten für künstliche Intelligenz und schaffen Lösungen, die unseren Kolleginnen und Kollegen sowie unseren Kunden die tägliche Arbeit erleichtern. Dabei setzen wir auf einen pragmatischen Mix aus Low-Code-/No-Code-Plattformen, KI-gestützten Entwicklungswerkzeugen und klassischer Softwareentwicklung. Als erfahrener Full-Stack Developer bringst du die technische Expertise mit, um unser Team auf das nächste Level zu heben. Du entwickelst selbst, übernimmst Verantwortung für Architekturentscheidungen und unterstützt deine Teamkollegen dabei, technisch immer eigenständiger zu werden. Das erwartet dich Softwareentwicklung und Architektur: Du konzipierst und entwickelst eigenständig Anwendungen, Services, APIs und Integrationen – vom technischen Entwurf bis zum produktiven Betrieb. Intelligente Prozessautomatisierung: Du entwickelst bestehende Automatisierungen weiter und setzt neue Lösungen um, beispielsweise mit n8n, APIs und individuell entwickelten Komponenten. KI sinnvoll einsetzen: Du integrierst KI-Modelle in bestehende Prozesse, entwickelst KI-gestützte Anwendungen und experimentierst mit neuen Technologien und Werkzeugen. Systeme miteinander verbinden: Du sorgst dafür, dass unterschiedliche Plattformen und Anwendungen zuverlässig miteinander kommunizieren und Daten sicher ausgetauscht werden. Technische Verantwortung übernehmen: Du triffst fundierte Architekturentscheidungen und achtest auf Wartbarkeit, Skalierbarkeit, Sicherheit und Qualität. Wissen teilen und gemeinsam wachsen: Du unterstützt deine Kollegen bei technischen Herausforderungen, führst sie an professionelle Entwicklungspraktiken heran und etablierst gemeinsam mit ihnen nachhaltige Lösungen. Eigenständig Lösungen schaffen: Du reduzierst technische Abhängigkeiten zu anderen Entwicklungsteams, indem du notwendige Komponenten selbst entwickelst und bestehende Schnittstellen sinnvoll nutzt. Das bringst du mit Mehrjährige praktische Erfahrung in der professionellen Softwareentwicklung, idealerweise im Full-Stack-Umfeld. Fundierte Kenntnisse in der Konzeption und Entwicklung moderner Softwarearchitekturen. Erfahrung mit Backend-Technologien, APIs, Datenbanken und der Integration unterschiedlicher Systeme. Kenntnisse in modernen Frontend-Technologien und die Fähigkeit, bei Bedarf vollständige Anwendungen eigenständig umzusetzen. Erfahrung mit Softwarequalität, Testing, Versionsverwaltung, CI/CD und dem Betrieb produktiver Anwendungen. Interesse an KI-Technologien, LLMs, AI-assisted Development und Automatisierungsplattformen. Die Fähigkeit, technische Herausforderungen pragmatisch zu lösen und dabei auch langfristige Anforderungen im Blick zu behalten. Freude daran, Wissen weiterzugeben, andere zu befähigen und gemeinsam technische Lösungen zu entwickeln. Besonders wichtig ist uns deine Einstellung: Du musst nicht jedes Framework kennen. Viel wichtiger ist, dass du dich schnell in neue Technologien einarbeiten kannst, gerne Verantwortung übernimmst und Freude daran hast, in einem Team mit unterschiedlichen Kompetenzprofilen zu arbeiten. Unsere Aufgaben sind vielfältig und reichen von kleinen Automatisierungen bis zu komplexeren technischen Lösungen. Damit beschäftigst du dich beispielsweise: Automatisierung von Geschäftsprozessen und Datenverarbeitung, beispielsweise rund um Vermittler- und Vertragsdaten. Entwicklung und Erweiterung von Schnittstellen zwischen unserer Maklerplattform Professional Works und externen Anwendungen. KI-gestützte Verarbeitung und Auswertung von Gesprächstranskripten, einschließlich automatisierter Zusammenfassungen und Coaching-Ansätzen. Integration von Kommunikations-, Support- und Marketingplattformen in automatisierte Workflows. Entwicklung interner Werkzeuge für Reporting, Datenanalyse und operative Prozesse. Technische Weiterentwicklung und Stabilisierung unserer Automatisierungslandschaft.. Dabei entscheidest du gemeinsam mit dem Team, wann eine bestehende Automatisierungsplattform die beste Lösung ist und wann individuell entwickelte Software den größeren Mehrwert bietet. Warum diese Rolle besonders ist Bei uns erwartet dich kein klassisches Entwicklungsteam, in dem ausschließlich Softwareentwickler sitzen und Tickets abarbeiten. Du arbeitest mit Kollegen zusammen, die Geschäftsprozesse verstehen, Automatisierungen entwickeln, KI-Werkzeuge einsetzen und neue Ideen schnell ausprobieren. Du ergänzt dieses Team um fundierte Softwareentwicklungs- und Architekturkompetenz. Dein Erfolg zeigt sich deshalb nicht nur an dem Code, den du selbst schreibst, sondern auch daran, wie viel leistungsfähiger und eigenständiger das gesamte Team durch deine Arbeit wird. Du bekommst die Möglichkeit, Technologien mitzugestalten, neue Ansätze auszuprobieren und unmittelbar zu erleben, welchen Unterschied deine Lösungen im Unternehmen machen. title: Senior Account Director, Media
description: DEPT® is a Growth Invention company built to help the world’s most ambitious brands grow faster. Operating at the intersection of technology and marketing, our 4,000+ specialists deliver growth invention services across Brand & Media, Experience, Commerce, CRM, and Technology & Data. We’re 50|50 tech and marketing, partner-led, and first to move. Clients include Google, Lufthansa, Meta, eBay, and OpenAI. We have been certified B Corp and Climate Neutral since 2021. JOB PURPOSE This role is part of our Creative & Media services. Our team is a vibrant mix of talents, ranging from Creatives, Influencer Marketers, Brand & Content Strategists to Account Managers, Programmatic and Marketing Automation Consultants. Together, we blend imaginative storytelling and performance-driven strategies with cutting-edge technology to create engaging digital experiences that build lasting relationships with our clients. You are the commercial engine and primary sparring partner for one of our largest Tech client verticals. You’ll bridge the gap between complex Paid Media strategies and the client’s ambitious growth goals, ensuring our partnership feels less like a vendor and more like an extension of their own leadership team. Your mission is to support driving revenue into a 20% growth success story. WHAT YOU'LL DO: Client Leadership: Act as the primary business partner for the client, building trust-based relationships at the senior level. Growth Ownership: Drive a 20% YoY growth target by identifying commercial opportunities in Paid Media, Social Organic, LLM, and Influencer strategy. Matrix Orchestration: Lead the "Trio" (Account, Program, Strategy), serving as the final decision-maker to ensure delivery matches client expectations. Strategic Sparring: Challenge the client and internal teams with "Growth Invention" ideas, moving beyond execution to strategic impact. Commercial Governance: Own the P&L, SOWs, and profitability for the Business Group. title: Hoofdmonteur Warmtepompen
description: Bij DeWarmte maken we slimme en betaalbare warmtepompen waarmee we woningen van het gas af helpen. We ontwerpen onze producten zelf, assembleren ze in Utrecht en zorgen samen met onze installatiepartners dat ze bij steeds meer mensen thuis komen te staan. We groeien hard. Tot nu toe worden al onze warmtepompen geïnstalleerd door externe partners, maar daar komt verandering in. We gaan onze eigen installatieteams opbouwen en zoeken daarom een Hoofdmonteur Warmtepompen die hierin het voortouw neemt. Je bent een ervaren monteur die graag zelf de handen uit de mouwen steekt, maar ook energie krijgt van het begeleiden van anderen. Je gaat samen met je team op pad, bent verantwoordelijk voor de kwaliteit van de installaties en helpt ons om steeds meer monteurs op te leiden. Je komt dus niet in een bestaand team terecht. Je helpt het team zelf opbouwen. Wat ga je doen? Als Hoofdmonteur ben je verantwoordelijk voor de installatie van onze warmtepompen bij klanten thuis. Je begint met het leiden van ons eerste interne installatieteam en helpt ons om de komende jaren onze eigen installatiecapaciteit verder uit te bouwen. Je installeert warmtepompen en leidt je team Je gaat samen met een collega-monteur op pad om onze warmtepompen bij klanten thuis te installeren. Je bent verantwoordelijk voor de volledige installatie, van de technische uitvoering en het oplossen van onverwachte problemen tot de oplevering. Je zorgt dat installaties veilig, efficiënt en volgens onze kwaliteitsstandaarden worden uitgevoerd. Je bent het aanspreekpunt voor de klant tijdens de installatie. Je legt uit wat jullie doen, beantwoordt vragen en zorgt dat de klant met een goed gevoel achterblijft. Je stemt waar nodig af met onze werkvoorbereiders en collega's op kantoor over planning, materialen en technische uitdagingen. Je bouwt mee aan ons interne installatieteam Je begeleidt en traint nieuwe monteurs en helpt hen om zelfstandig installaties uit te kunnen voeren. Je denkt mee over het aannemen van nieuwe collega's en hoe we ons installatieteam verder kunnen uitbreiden. Je helpt onze installatiestandaarden en werkwijzen verder te ontwikkelen. Je signaleert wat er in de praktijk beter of slimmer kan en neemt initiatief om dit te verbeteren. Je deelt feedback vanuit het veld met onze engineers, werkvoorbereiders en productontwikkelaars, zodat we onze producten en installaties continu kunnen verbeteren. Wie zoeken wij? We zoeken iemand die zijn vak goed verstaat, verantwoordelijkheid neemt en het leuk vindt om anderen beter te maken. Je hoeft niet eerder een heel team te hebben opgebouwd, maar je moet wel zin hebben om die uitdaging aan te gaan. Je hebt ruime ervaring met het installeren van warmtepompen, cv-installaties of andere verwarmingssystemen. Ervaring met warmtepompen heeft een sterke voorkeur. Je hebt een goede technische basis in installatietechniek, elektrotechniek en/of werktuigbouwkunde. Je kunt zelfstandig installaties uitvoeren, technische tekeningen lezen en onverwachte problemen oplossen. Je hebt ervaring met het begeleiden van andere monteurs, of bent klaar om die verantwoordelijkheid op je te nemen. Je werkt nauwkeurig en veilig en vindt het belangrijk om goed werk af te leveren. Je communiceert makkelijk met klanten en collega's en kunt technische zaken begrijpelijk uitleggen. Je neemt initiatief, denkt in oplossingen en voelt je verantwoordelijk voor het eindresultaat. Je spreekt goed Nederlands en hebt rijbewijs B. Een relevante mbo-opleiding en certificeringen zoals VCA, NEN 3140 of CO-vakmanschap zijn mooi meegenomen. Heb je nog niet alle benodigde certificaten? Dan kijken we samen wat je nog kunt behalen. Wat bieden wij jou? Een salaris van €4.000 tot €6.000 bruto per maand op basis van 40 uur, afhankelijk van je ervaring. Een sleutelrol in ons bedrijf: je wordt de eerste Hoofdmonteur van ons interne installatieteam en helpt dit verder uit te bouwen. Veel vrijheid en verantwoordelijkheid: je krijgt de ruimte om mee te denken over hoe we installeren, samenwerken en nieuwe monteurs opleiden. Goed materiaal: een volledig uitgeruste werkbus en professioneel gereedschap. 26 vakantiedagen en 13 ADV-dagen op basis van 40 uur, met de mogelijkheid om te kiezen voor een hogere beloning in plaats van ADV. Een goede pensioenregeling volgens de cao Metaal & Techniek. Mogelijkheden om jezelf verder te ontwikkelen, zowel technisch als in het begeleiden en aansturen van een team. Een betrokken team met korte lijnen, weinig bureaucratie en regelmatig leuke activiteiten, van borrels en teamuitjes tot onze jaarlijkse wintersport. Waarom DeWarmte? Bij DeWarmte geloven we dat verduurzaming pas echt werkt als het voor iedereen bereikbaar en aantrekkelijk is. Daarom ontwikkelen we slimme, betaalbare warmtepompen die we zelf ontwerpen en assembleren. We zijn een groeiend bedrijf waar veel gebeurt en waar je echt invloed hebt op hoe we dingen aanpakken. We houden van mensen die initiatief nemen, samenwerken en niet wachten tot iemand anders een probleem oplost. Als Hoofdmonteur krijg je de kans om vanaf het begin mee te bouwen aan onze eigen installatieorganisatie. Je werkt zelf aan mooie technische installaties, leidt nieuwe monteurs op en helpt bepalen hoe we dit in de toekomst op grotere schaal gaan doen. Klaar om samen met ons iets op te bouwen? Solliciteer en kom kennismaken. We vertellen je graag meer over DeWarmte, onze warmtepompen en onze plannen voor het interne installatieteam. Compensation: €4K – €6K per month • €4K – €6K per month Find more English Speaking Jobs in Netherlands on Arbeitnow

Success in the Role Success will be measured by: Increased qualified demand, pipeline and revenue contribution from organic channels. Stronger performance across priority international markets. Successful website migration with minimal loss of SEO equity. A scalable SEO/GEO operating model and a high-performing team. Why join Diabolocom? title: Flight Test Instrumentation & Data Engineer
description: The Flight Test Instrumentation (FTI) & Data Engineer will be responsible for the end-to-end handling, quality assurance, accessibility, and long-term management of all flight data. The primary objective is to ensure that full-aircraft data, from the onboard sensors and DAQ systems to the final processing tools, is available to every engineering team through a reliable, efficient, and standardized workflow. Tasks Flight Test Instrumentation (FTI) & DAQ Pipeline Manage the data pipeline from the physical sensor and Data Acquisition (DAQ) level for the full aircraft, ensuring seamless and accurate transmission into the telemetry and storage systems. Maintain sensor configuration, calibration records, and metadata to guarantee the accurate translation of raw physical signals into usable engineering units. Collaborate with hardware, software and integration teams to define sensor requirements, DAQ architectures, scaling, and telemetry bandwidth allocations. Troubleshoot and resolve data anomalies at the DAQ and sensor level (e.g., signal noise, dropouts, faulty scaling) before they propagate into downstream databases. Data Infrastructure & Accessibility Maintain reliable extraction of flight data from InfluxDB. Develop and maintain standardized local data structures for analysis, plotting, and visualization. Optimize access to large flight datasets while minimizing CPU and memory usage. Design and maintain an efficient local storage solution for processed flight data. Support future improvements to the flight data architecture as storage requirements, sensor counts, and analysis needs continue to evolve. Data Quality & Analysis Support Maintain derived datasets to ensure common calculations and signals are shared consistently across teams. Ensure strict timing synchronization and timestamp accuracy across all recorded data, from the sensor acquisition point to the database. Monitor data quality, completeness, and integrity throughout the entire pipeline. Provide fast data previews for rapid post-flight reviews. Enable efficient access to high-frequency sensor data for detailed engineering investigations. Support custom querying of processed datasets. Requirements Education & Experience Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Aerospace Engineering, Computer Science, Data Engineering, or a related technical field. 3+ years of professional experience in test instrumentation, data acquisition (DAQ), or sensor-to-database time-series data engineering (aerospace, automotive, or racing/motorsports preferred). Hands-on experience working directly with physical aircraft/vehicle sensor installations, DAQ hardware, and telemetry pipelines. Technical & Domain Expertise 1. Hardware, Sensors & DAQ Architecture Strong understanding of physical sensors (e.g., strain gauges, accelerometers, thermocouples, pressure transducers, RTDs, LVDTs, pitot-static tubes). Demonstrated knowledge of signal conditioning, sampling rate selection, anti-aliasing filtering, scaling, and sensor calibration procedures. 2. Data Infrastructure & Software Development Proficient in Python or MATLAB for data analysis, automated data processing, and visualization library development (e.g., Pandas, NumPy, SciPy). Experience working with time-series databases, specifically InfluxDB (or similar engines), including writing efficient queries (Flux/InfluxQL) and data retrieval pipelines. Solid foundation in data structures and memory/CPU optimization when handling high-memory high-frequency continuous time-series datasets. 3. Data Integrity & Signal Processing Experience with timestamping and clock synchronization protocols across distributed DAQ hardware and storage nodes. Knowledge of basic digital signal processing (DSP) concepts (filtering, FFT, spectral analysis, decimation/resampling). Soft Skills & Work Style Cross-functional communication: Ability to bridge the gap between hardware technicians, flight physics/aerodynamics engineers, and software teams. Detail-oriented mindset: Uncompromising rigor regarding calibration metadata, unit conversions, and data accuracy. Adaptability: Drive to continuously improve data infrastructure as aircraft sensor counts, test frequencies, and analytical needs expand. Preferred / Bonus Qualifications Knowledge of standard FAA / EASA flight test instrumentation requirements or military flight test standards (e.g. IRIG 106). Familiarity with dashboarding tools (e.g., Grafana) for rapid post-flight previews and real-time telemetry display. Experience with version control systems (Git) and CI/CD pipelines for internal engineering tool distribution. Direct experience with DAQ systems and digital bus protocols (CAN bus, ARINC 429, MIL-STD-1553, Ethernet/UDP, PCM). Familiarity with binary flight data formats (e.g., IRIG 106 Chapter 10/11, MDF/MF4, HDF5, Parquet, or custom binary loggers). Experience with performing on-aircraft hardware troubleshooting (e.g., tracking down ground loops, signal noise, dropouts, or faulty scaling). title: Ingénieur en mécanique des fluides
company: ECOLE NATIONALE SUPERIEURE DE TECHNIQUES AVANCEES
description: ENSTA, établissement d’enseignement supérieur et de recherche sous tutelle du ministère des Armées, développe des activités de formation, de recherche et d’innovation dans les domaines de la défense et de la sécurité, des transports, de l'énergie, des activités maritimes, du numérique et de la santé. L’école, présente sur deux campus, à Paris-Saclay et à Brest, est membre de l’Institut Polytechnique de Paris. Classée dans le Top 10 des meilleures écoles d’ingénieurs en France, elle a pour mission : la formation d’élèves ingénieurs civils et militaires, de cadres et docteurs pour les secteurs public et privé, la recherche et l’innovation de haut niveau en relation étroite avec l’industrie des grands secteurs de souveraineté au sein de 6 unités de formation et de recherche (UFR). Le/la titulaire du poste sera affecté au sein de l’Unité de Formation et de Recherche (UFR) Mécanique. L’UFR de Mécanique a pour mission d’assurer la formation en mécanique des élèves du cursus ingénieur d’ENSTA, des élèves de masters de l’Institut Polytechnique de Paris, et la formation par la recherche d’étudiants français et étrangers au niveau master et doctorat. L’Unité développe également des activités de recherche dans le domaine de la mécanique des matériaux et des structures, de la mécanique des fluides, des vibrations et de l’acoustique. Ces activités sont réalisées grâce à un important parc expérimental de haut niveau en mécanique des solides et des fluides, tant pour l’enseignement que la recherche. Sur le campus de Brest, l’UFR de Mécanique compte une cinquantaine d’enseignants chercheurs, une cinquantaine de doctorants/post-doctorants ainsi qu’une dizaine de personnels techniques (ingénieurs, techniciens). Les activités de recherche des membres de l’UFR de Mécanique du site de Brest sont menées au sein de l’Institut de Recherche Dupuy de Lôme (IRDL, CNRS UMR 6027, www.irdl.fr ). La personne recrutée travaillera en étroite collaboration avec les enseignants-chercheurs de l’ENSTA, pôle thématique de recherche « Structure Interaction Fluide (StIF) » de l’IRDL. L’ENSTA est l’un des partenaires du projet SEARENITY, retenu dans le cadre de l'appel à projets « CORIMER Navire Bas Carbone » (financement Ademe, France 2030). Le projet vise à développer un robot autonome capable d’intervenir en continu sur les coques de navires pour les nettoyer et limiter l’apparition d’algues et coquillages afin de réduire sa consommation énergétique et ses émissions de C02. L’ENSTA intervient sur 2 aspects du projet pour lequel les verrous techniques sont nombreux et pointus : le système d’attraction magnétique : définition, simulation et tests. le volet hydrodynamique du robot : modélisation, simulation numérique et essais en veine aérodynamique La présente fiche de poste concerne les aspects hydrodynamiques. Missions / Activités principales : La personne recrutée prendra en charge l’évaluation numérique des efforts subis par le robot dans différentes configurations d’opération, et proposera des pistes d’optimisation de forme, afin d’améliorer les performances. Les modèles développés seront également confrontés à des essais de validation dans la nouvelle veine aérodynamique de l’école. Elle sera amenée à produire des rapports et présentations techniques, mettre en œuvre des outils de simulation numérique et des essais, et travailler de manière collaborative avec l’ensemble des partenaires du projet SEARENITY. Les missions détaillées sont les suivantes : Etude expérimentale en soufflerie Essais de caractérisation et de validation en veine aérodynamique, afin de valider les simulations numériques pour l’estimation des efforts, en fonction de différents paramètres (influence de la vitesse de l’écoulement, influence de l’angle d’incidence). Mise en place du protocole d’essais, conception du support et impression 3D du modèle réduit de drone, calibrage des capteurs, mise en œuvre de la veine aérodynamique. 2. Etude numérique pour le fonctionnement en zone immergée Détermination numérique des efforts moyens rencontrés par le drone en condition réelle le long de la coque. Les simulations numériques seront réalisées avec un code de calcul commercial validé, constituant l’une des références à l’heure actuelle pour la simulation d’écoulements à haut Reynolds. 3. Dimensionnement des efforts d’impact en splash-zone Détermination numérique des efforts d’impact à la traversée de la surface libre, pour différentes vitesses du navire, et différents angles d’incidence du drone. Les simulations numériques seront réalisées à l’aide d’un code de calcul développé par l’ENSTA, spécifiquement dédié aux cas d’impacts. Plusieurs trajectoires de rentrée dans l’eau seront simulées, afin de cerner les efforts maximaux subis par la structure. 4. Optimisation de forme du robot Le fonctionnement nominal du drone en zone immergée, et la phase d’entrée dans l’eau conduisent à des formes géométriques optimales très différentes. Une étude bibliographique sera menée pour orienter la recherche d’une forme extérieure la plus adaptée, au sens d’un compromis sur les efforts acceptables. Cette étude bibliographique sera éventuellement complétée par des calculs de traînée et d’impact sur des géométries académiques, afin de fournir une aide à la décision pour les concepteurs du drone. Elle est à l’origine de la création du Centre interdisciplinaire Mers & Océans , inauguré en janvier 2025. Le recrutement s’inscrit dans le projet SUBPERF-AI, qui porte sur une démarche de réduction drastique du cycle de développement de nouveaux concepts sous-marins, en s’appuyant sur les progrès récents de l’intelligence artificielle (IA), et plus particulièrement le machine learning. Au contraire de l’existant en IA basé sur des modèles ininterprétables de type boîte noire, le projet vise à construire une méthodologie de construction de modèles physiques, de complexité adaptée à la physique sous-jacente, en ayant recours à l’expertise humaine et se plaçant comme un outil de conception complémentaire dans l’écosystème existant. Les objectifs principaux du projet sont : Développer une méthodologie de détermination automatisée du modèle d’efforts hydrodynamiques de corps sous-marin, avec utilisation de l’IA (machine learning), sur la base des données de la cinématique, des trajectoires, et des paramètres de contrôle, facilement accessibles, lors des essais maquette ou réel, ou lors d’une simulation numérique. Placer l’expert humain en capacité de contrôler la construction du modèle aux différents stades : qualité des données d’entrée, qualité de la phase d’apprentissage du modèle, et outils/règles de certification a posteriori. La personne recrutée sera intégrée dans une équipe pluridisciplinaire de 3 enseignants-chercheurs, un doctorant et un second post-doctorant. Missions / Activités principales : La personne recrutée prendra en charge la construction d’un modèle d’effort hydrodynamique « expert » et la génération de données expérimentales. Le modèle hydrodynamique expert sera déterminé en suivant la méthodologie classique de l’ITTC, à l’aide d’une campagne d’essais dans la veine aérodynamique pour la caractérisation des efforts (essais en modèle captif du type PMM (Planar Motion Mechanism)). Ce modèle sera implémenté dans un simulateur temporel, dont les résultats seront confrontés sur des manœuvres standards réalisées dans le bassin à drones de l’ENSTA. La confrontation des résultats de trajectoires expérimentales aux trajectoires simulées, obtenues sur la base des essais en modèle captif, pourra amener à questionner la méthodologie standard, en particulier lors de la présence de non-linéarités importantes ou de termes croisés non négligeables. Les essais en bassin fourniront par ailleurs les données de cinématique nécessaires au travail de thèse. Les missions détaillées sont les suivantes : Tâche 1 – conception et fabrication d’un drone sous-marin Conception d’un drone générique de géométrie simplifiée, et instrumenté. Le drone recevra un capotage extérieur, afin de tester plusieurs configurations : géométrie parallélépipédique typique d’un ROV d’exploration, et géométrie cylindrique de type drone torpille. Le drone sera instrumenté pour mesurer les paramètres de contrôle, la cinématique et les trajectoires, ainsi que les efforts propulsifs (poussée, couple) et les efforts de contrôle. Tâche 2 – essais statiques et dynamiques en modèle captif Réalisation d’essais de caractérisation dans la veine aérodynamique de l’ENSTA, en similitude complète de Reynolds, pour les vitesses envisagées d’utilisation en eau du drone. Mesure des efforts en statique, sur les 6 degrés de liberté. Caractérisation des efforts de plans porteurs et du propulseur. Mesure des efforts en dynamique, en mouvement forcé à l’aide de l’hexapode : masses et inerties ajoutées, termes liés aux vitesses angulaires. Tâche 3 – Identification dérivées hydrodynamiques Identification des dérivées hydrodynamiques (ou coefficients hydrodynamiques) à partir des essais en modèle captif. Tâche 4 – Adaptation du simulateur temporel Prise en main du simulateur temporel de l’ENSTA, et de l’environnement de développement. Adaptation du code de calcul pour intégrer des lois de commande issues de mesures expérimentales. Tâche 5 – Essais libres et standardisés, en bassin Réalisation d’essais aux trajectoires prédéfinies (zigzag horizontal ou vertical, accélération horizontale, …). Réalisation d’essais pour parcourir l’espace complet des 6 degrés de libertés. Enregistrement de l’historique des contrôles (vitesse hélice, angles plans porteurs, …), des trajectoires et des efforts des organes de contrôle. Tâche 6 – Rejeu trajectoires simulateur temporel Rejeu numérique des trajectoires, afin de valider si le modèle d’efforts est suffisamment complet pour prédire correctement les trajectoires mesurées expérimentalement. Les résultats obtenus amèneront à publication scientifique. Niveau de diplôme et formations Thèse de doctorat dans le domaine de l’hydrodynamique navale. What you will do - Own the architecture of the AI Control Plane and AI Runtime and keep it aligned with the client's architecture standards, cloud substrate, API gateway, identity provider and audit services. - Define service interfaces and contracts. You will develop representative workloads, automate reproducible experiments, and investigate how Elasticsearch compares with alternative systems. Your work will identify performance strengths, gaps, and tradeoffs, guide engineering improvements, and help customers make informed technical decisions. This is a hands-on engineering role focused on building benchmarks and investigating performance, with technical publishing as a shared responsibility alongside engineering and content partners. A typical investigation might ask how Elasticsearch and an alternative system compare under concurrent ingestion and hybrid search, at comparable retrieval quality and cost, and which engineering changes would improve the outcome. Depth in at least one relevant area (search, vector retrieval, analytical databases, or observability systems) and the ability to learn unfamiliar systems. Experience designing representative datasets and workloads, including query patterns, concurrency, and ingestion behavior. Sound experimental judgment, including repeated measurements, variability analysis, warm-up and cache effects, and the distinction between meaningful changes and measurement noise. Experience building reproducible test environments and documenting configurations, procedures, and results. Clear technical writing and communication skills, with the ability to explain complex findings and their limitations. Solid collaboration skills and the ability to turn performance evidence into applicable engineering recommendations. Familiarity with cloud performance and cost analysis, including autoscaling and serverless systems. Public technical writing, open-source contributions, or published benchmark studies. Hands-on Doer Mindset: You keep your cool and stay positive when things go sideways. You are pragmatic, humble and jump into daily support queues without hesitation. Unique Event s: Events are our DNA. Mobility Support: We contribute toward your public transport pass (öV-Abo) to support convenient and sustainable commuting. Growth Potential: Thrive in a workplace with flat hierarchies, fast decision-making and an open feedback culture designed to help you continuously develop. Seit der Gründung im Jahr 2022 ist Everfield in 7 Ländern präsent – und wächst stetig weiter. Über helloTESS! Mit unserer cloudbasierten Lösung digitalisieren wir Bestell- und Bezahlprozesse, schaffen maximale Flexibilität und ermöglichen individuelle Erweiterungen, die sich an die Bedürfnisse unserer Kunden anpassen. Die TESSERO GmbH entwickelt mit helloTESS! moderne iPad- und Cloud-Lösungen für Gastronomie, Hotellerie und Gemeinschaftsverpflegung. Zur weiteren Stärkung unseres Vertriebs suchen wir für den Bereich General Business Nord einen engagierten Account Manager, der vollständig remote arbeitet, idealerweise in NRW lebt und unser Vertriebsgebiet in Norddeutschland inklusive NRW aufbaut und betreut. Deine Aufgaben Als Account Manager General Business Nord bist du verantwortlich für den aktiven Ausbau unseres Kunden- und Partnernetzwerks im Gastronomieumfeld. Du identifizierst neue Potenziale, entwickelst bestehende Accounts weiter und überzeugst Kunden mit passenden Lösungen aus dem gesamten Portfolio der TESSERO GmbH. Norddeutschland Reisebereitschaft innerhalb Norddeutschlands und NRW sowie gelegentlich zu unserem Hauptsitz in München Führerschein Klasse B Unser Angebot – deine Chance Bei uns erwartet dich eine abwechslungsreiche Vertriebsaufgabe mit viel Gestaltungsspielraum, modernen Produkten und kurzen Entscheidungswegen. Matrix POS ist seit 2024 bei Everfield. Das Team befindet sich in Hannover, Deutschland. Über die Rolle Du bist IT-Profi mit einem Faible für praxisnahe Systeme? Du willst nicht nur Technik verstehen, sondern auch Kunden dabei helfen, ihre Prozesse stabil und effizient zu betreiben? Dann bist du bei uns genau richtig! title: Ingénieur Projet Pré-FEED (H/F)
description: Ingénieur Projet Pré-FEED (H/F) Informations clés Référence : 262403S Démarrage : Janvier 2027 Durée : Mission longue durée Type de contrat : Freelance ou CDIC Zone géographique : Occitanie (81) Langue : Anglais courant indispensable Contexte de la mission Dans le cadre d'un programme de construction d'une nouvelle usine industrielle à l'international, prévu sur la période 2028-2032, nous recherchons un profil expérimenté pour intervenir en phase amont d'analyse des besoins et de pré-FEED (Front-End Engineering Design). La mission consiste à réaliser un audit approfondi de deux usines de production existantes, l'une en France et l'autre en Amérique du Nord, afin d'identifier les bonnes pratiques, les axes d'amélioration et les besoins des différents services. L'objectif est de recueillir et de formaliser l'ensemble des exigences techniques, fonctionnelles et opérationnelles dans un cahier des charges aussi complet que possible, afin de sécuriser les futures phases d'ingénierie, de conception et de construction de la nouvelle usine. Missions Réaliser un audit fonctionnel et opérationnel de deux usines de production existantes, situées en France et en Amérique du Nord. Analyser les installations, les méthodes de fonctionnement et les organisations en place afin d'identifier les bonnes pratiques, les points faibles et les axes d'amélioration. Organiser et animer des groupes de travail avec l'ensemble des services concernés, notamment : Maintenance Exploitation et production Process industriels Traitement de l'air Conduire des entretiens et des réunions de travail, notamment à distance via Teams, afin de faire émerger les besoins, contraintes et attentes de chaque service. Challenger les interlocuteurs pour identifier les besoins explicites et implicites, anticiper les problématiques et garantir l'exhaustivité des exigences. Recueillir, analyser et consolider les retours d'expérience des deux sites existants. Identifier les exigences techniques, fonctionnelles, organisationnelles et opérationnelles à intégrer dans la conception de la future usine. Définir les besoins d'industrialisation et les exigences relatives aux process de production. Élaborer et structurer un cahier des charges (CDC) complet et détaillé, intégrant les besoins de l'ensemble des parties prenantes.
