title: Senior Integrated Campaign Manager
description: At Feedzai, we're building a world of safer money. A world where financial institutions move faster than criminals. Where the payments that fund real lives through salaries, savings, and businesses are protected in real time. We use trusted AI to detect and prevent financial crime, fraud, and money laundering at scale: the world's top banks, payment networks, and acquirers trust our technology to safeguard more than one billion consumers and $9 trillion in payment volume every year. Feedzai is a Series D company and has raised $282M to date. With a valuation of $2 billion, our technology protects 1 billion consumers and 90 billion transactions each year. The Marketing Team is empowered to spark change daily with MAP - Mastery in their role, Autonomy to make decisions, and a Purpose to make the world a safer place for all consumers. Using cutting-edge tech and delivering best-in-class content, they influence the trajectory of our company. It’s this team spirit and trust in each other that let us go further together. This team has two simple goals: 1. Everyone in the world knows about the Feedzai brand 2. Making sure our sales team is busy. Join Us! We’re looking for a strategic, data‑driven Campaign Manager to architect, lead, and orchestrate Feedzai’s largest global marketing campaigns. Feedzai’s campaigns are the connective tissue between brand, product, and growth. As Campaign Manager, you’ll turn business priorities into clear campaign strategies, align cross-functional teams around the plan, and drive the programs that build awareness, generate demand and accelerate pipeline. You: You’re a strategic full-funnel marketer who knows how to turn business priorities into clear, measurable campaign strategies. You thrive in complex, fast-moving environments, bringing structure to ambiguity and momentum to cross-functional teams. You’re a natural orchestrator who can build alignment, drive accountability and confidently communicate with senior stakeholders. You stay close to performance, know how to spot what isn’t working, and bring the right teams together to fix it. Your Day to Day: Design and lead multi-channel, full-funnel campaigns tied to Feedzai’s strategic GTM motions and growth priorities. Translate business priorities into clear campaign goals, audiences, messaging, buyer journeys, routes to market and success metrics. Orchestrate teams across Product Marketing, Digital, Content, Comms, Creative, Regional Marketing, Partner Marketing, ADRs and Sales to deliver against one integrated campaign strategy. Identify critical gaps in audience, market intelligence, positioning, product readiness or sales follow-up and work with the right stakeholders to resolve them. Partner with Product Marketing to translate positioning, buyer insights and product priorities into differentiated full-funnel messaging. Stay close to campaign, lead and pipeline performance, working with Digital, ADRs and Sales to quickly identify issues and optimize messaging, targeting, channels and follow-up. Build campaign enablement that gives Sales and ADR teams the messaging, content and outreach guidance needed to convert engagement and accelerate pipeline. Lead campaign reviews, clearly communicating performance, learnings, risks, recommendations and next steps. Manage multiple complex campaigns at once, bringing structure, accountability and momentum in a fast-moving environment. You Have & You Know‑How: 8–10+ years of B2B marketing experience, with significant experience leading integrated or demand generation campaigns in SaaS, fintech or enterprise technology. Proven ability to translate business priorities into clear, measurable full-funnel campaign strategies that drive pipeline and revenue impact. Deep understanding of B2B marketing fundamentals, including audience segmentation, ICPs, positioning, buyer journeys, demand generation and pipeline acceleration. Exceptional cross-functional leadership and stakeholder management skills, with the ability to build alignment and drive execution across teams you do not directly manage. Strong project and program management skills, with the ability to juggle multiple complex initiatives, teams and deadlines. Strong executive presence and communication skills, with the confidence to clearly articulate strategy, recommendations and performance to senior leaders. A data-driven mindset, comfortable analyzing campaign and pipeline performance and translating insights into action. Strong marketing judgment, with the ability to identify missing inputs, ask the right questions and keep work moving forward. A self-starter with a bias for action who thrives in high-pressure environments where priorities can change and complete information may not always be available. Experience in B2B SaaS, fintech, fraud, financial crime, payments, banking technology or enterprise financial services strongly preferred. As a Field Marketing Manager, EMEA you'll be a key architect of how we show up in the field, owning a mix of strategy, execution of our event and field programs, while helping establish the foundational infrastructure and playbooks that will scale the team. A strong strategic instinct paired with operational excellence: you can zoom out to define a program roadmap and zoom in to manage the logistics that make the difference. Experience partnering with sales leadership and AE's to develop territory-level event strategies and account-based marketing motions. Proven ability to manage complex, multi-event portfolios simultaneously across diverse program types Strong cross-functional collaborator who works effectively with Sales, Partnerships, Creative, Communications, and executive stakeholders. Strong written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to create clear event documentation and present post-event insights to leadership. Comfortable with data and analytics, using event metrics to optimize programs and clearly demonstrate ROI. Proficiency in CRM and marketing automation software; Salesforce is required. Nice to Haves: Experience at a startup or hyper-growth company is preferred; especially within the EMEA region Experience delivering both in-person field events and larger-scale user conferences, including flagship events (500+ attendees). title: Senior AI Engineer, Agents & Applications
description: Firmus Technologies Firmus Technologies is a global leader pioneering the development and operation of efficient AI infrastructure across Asia Pacific. Founded in Australia in 2019, our mission is to create the most efficient AI infrastructure by combining cutting-edge technology with a steadfast commitment to sustainability. At Firmus, we are unique in our approach. We design, build, and operate a new class of digital infrastructure – the AI Factory. Through our model-to-grid technology approach, we have pushed the boundaries of multi-generational liquid cooling systems, energy management, AI software orchestration, and construction. For our customers, this approach allows us to make every watt count and deliver low-cost AI tokens globally. Firmus AI Cloud Our large-scale GPU cloud platform, Firmus AI Cloud, is purpose-built to deliver energy-efficient AI compute at scale to customers. It empowers developers, enterprises, educational institutions, and government users to train and deploy AI models with unmatched efficiency and cost savings. With an ever-growing suite of services and applications, we are committed to delivering a cloud experience that is market-leading, proprietary, and built to scale. Why Firmus? As an NVIDIA Cloud and Engineering partner in Asia Pacific, you will gain skills, experience, and exposure across the AI industry and be part of shaping what this industry looks like for decades to come. We are founder-led, not a big corporate. Decisions happen fast, our leaders are accessible, and there's minimum bureaucracy between you and the work. Ownership comes early. Whatever your role, you will have a direct line to outcomes, helping shape how the business grows as we scale nationally across a long-term, large-scale roadmap. Work alongside founders and experts in AI infrastructure, energy systems and next-generation compute. What we build here has impact beyond the business. Our AI Factories are designed to operate as assets to the energy grid to actively strengthen the communities and regions they operate in rather than drawing from them. Considering applying? You don't need a perfect background to join our team. If you're driven and curious, there's a path for you. We back our people to grow into new domains and take on challenges beyond their previous experience. Role Summary The Senior AI Engineer (Agents & Applications) will design, build, and operate production-grade agentic systems that coordinate, optimize, and automate decision-making across the design-build-operate lifecycle of AI factories. The role is a core contributor to the AI & Applications team’s Model-to-Grid product, connecting models, inference endpoints, benchmark intelligence, validated workload recipes, job-scheduler decisions, infrastructure telemetry, AI-factory operations, and grid-related constraints into safe, explainable, and measurable workflows. The role will build more than conversational co-pilots. It will create agentic applications that ingest and reason over time-series telemetry, logs, traces, events, scheduler state, benchmark results, configuration data, operational documentation, incident records, and multimodal sources where appropriate. These applications will help engineers, operators, and customers move from observation to diagnosis, recommendation, planning, simulation, controlled execution, verification, and continuous improvement. The engineer will define and implement the underlying agent architecture and engineering framework: orchestration, state and memory management, retrieval, tool use, specialized sub-agents, evaluation, safety controls, human approvals, observability, and deployment. The role will use fit-for-purpose self-hosted and external model endpoints, with close integration to the team’s inference platform. Key Responsibilities Design, build, and operate agentic applications supporting AI-factory planning, commissioning, validation, workload onboarding, benchmark analysis, model and recipe optimisation, scheduling, operations, maintenance, incident response, and continuous improvement. Define reference architectures for single-agent, multi-agent, workflow-based, eventdriven, and human-in-the-loop agentic systems. Build orchestration workflows using appropriate agent frameworks and libraries, such as LangGraph, LangChain, LlamaIndex, Microsoft AutoGen, Semantic Kernel, CrewAI, PydanticAI, Haystack, DSPy, or equivalent custom-built frameworks. Select the appropriate architecture for each use case rather than applying multi-agent patterns by default: Deterministic workflow and state-machine architectures for repeatable, high-confidence operational processes. Planner-executor architectures for decomposing complex investigation, planning, and remediation tasks. Supervisor-worker or manager-worker architectures for coordinating specialist domain agents. Router architectures for selecting the right model, tool, knowledge source, workflow, or specialist agent. Reflection, critic, verifier, or judge patterns for quality assurance, validation, and safety checks. Event-driven architectures for responding to telemetry anomalies, workload failures, scheduler events, benchmark regressions, and operational alerts. Human-in-the-loop architectures for high-impact recommendations, privileged actions, or changes to production environments. Build specialist agents for relevant Model-to-Grid and AI-factory domains, such as: Benchmark-analysis and performance-diagnosis agents. Workload recipe and runtime-configuration recommendation agents. Inference-endpoint selection, capacity, and optimization agents. Kubernetes and job-scheduler diagnostic agents. GPU-topology, network, RDMA, storage, and utilization-analysis agents. AI-factory health, capacity, maintenance, and operational-triage agents. Develop the intelligent coordination layer for Model-to-Grid, enabling agents to reason across model characteristics, inference and training configuration, validated recipes, GPU resources, topology, scheduling policies, network and storage performance, capacity, power, thermal conditions, health signals, and operational constraints. description: Can you help us fix the world's most broken supply chain? The fashion industry produces over 100 billion garments a year. 60% end up in landfill, not because people don't want these clothes, but because the supply chain for getting secondhand fashion from donation to resale is completely offline, manual, and broken. We're building the infrastructure powering the global secondhand clothing trade: a B2B marketplace and the AI systems digitising the supply chain behind it. Through Fleek, vintage stores, online resellers, and retail buyers source graded secondhand inventory directly from wholesalers and rag houses across multiple countries. Our key enabler is FleekSort, an AI model fine-tuned on secondhand fashion, that can grade, price, and categorise items with just a photo, turning what has historically been an opaque and manual trade into a structured, searchable, and tradable global inventory layer. We're backed by some of the world's best investors, including a16z, Y Combinator, and HV Capital, alongside world-class angels who helped build Depop, Shopify, and Postmates. Today, we serve thousands of resellers and retailers across the UK, Europe, and the US. About the Role We're looking for an Account Manager to own and grow a portfolio of Fleek's marketplace customers, driving retention, wallet share expansion, and long-term customer health. You'll manage a book of resellers, vintage stores, and enterprise buyers across the UK and US, acting as their single point of contact while building the systems and processes that enable scalable, high-quality account management. Your customers range from online resellers and brick-and-mortar vintage shops to large-scale enterprises moving significant volume through Fleek. This isn't a passive relationship management role. You'll be competing for wallet share against wholesalers from the Middle East, US, and Europe. You'll need to deeply understand your customers' businesses, proactively solve their problems, and find creative ways to grow their spend on Fleek month over month. The ideal candidate brings entrepreneurial energy, comfort with ambiguity, and an AI-first approach to scaling themselves and their portfolio. What You'll Do Own Your Portfolio: Manage a book of customers starting in the £5-15k monthly spend range, with a clear path to owning higher-value accounts as you ramp. Drive 10-20% month-on-month growth in retention and wallet share. Build Healthy Customers: Ensure customers are spending on categories that make sense for our suppliers, with minimal refunds and cancellations. A healthy customer is a retained customer. Drive Customer Engagement: Use WhatsApp, email, calls, stock lists, bundles, and handpicked supplier recommendations to keep customers active, ordering, and expanding their spend. Champion Self-Service: Act as the primary point of contact while actively encouraging and enabling customers to use the Fleek platform independently. Your goal is leverage, not dependency. You've built AI tooling, automated workflows, or implemented AI in your day-to-day work in the last 3-6 months. This isn't optional. We're scaling account management through technology, not headcount. Systems and process thinking. You don't just do the work, you improve how the work gets done. You've designed or improved workflows that made your team more effective. Strong relationship skills across multiple channels. You're equally comfortable on WhatsApp, on a call, or in person. You build trust quickly and maintain it over time. Self-motivated and entrepreneurial. You take ownership of your portfolio and your numbers. You don't wait to be told what to do. Resilience and positivity. You see problems as things to fix, not reasons to complain. You maintain energy and optimism in the face of operational complexity. title: Co-Founder & CTO (gn), Industrial Data for AI, Paris
description: About FoodLabs FoodLabs is Europe's leading early-stage VC and venture studio, backing founders who are shaping the future of the food, health, and climate value chains. We build companies from zero, putting capital, our own team, and hands-on operating time behind a founding team before there's a product or even a name. The studio's work spans wherever a market and the data or infrastructure underneath it are broken enough to justify building the fix from scratch. About The General Data Corporation General Data is the infrastructure for licensing proprietary data: The platform runs the whole deal from request to delivery, with privacy checks, rights evidence and contracts built in. The vision is to become the system of record between AI and the world’s private data, the data that has never been published but that the next generation of AI depends on. On one side are enterprises, AI labs and robotics teams that need real-world data, and on the other are companies whose operations generate it. General Data is the data infrastructure for the modern economy, connecting every party so that data can be licensed safely, transparently and at scale. Why this is a unique opportunity AI has absorbed the public internet, and its next gains will come from private, real-world data, yet today these deals still run on email, WhatsApp and brokers, with no visibility into what was checked, who holds the rights, or whether personal data was removed. Labs are already paying for this data, and regulation like GDPR and the EU Data Act makes a trusted, verifiable layer a necessity. General Data is VC-backed and looking for its technical co-founder. Together with Founder & CEO Louai Allani , you will own the product and architecture, shape the company’s direction as an equal partner and build the team from the ground up. About the role Supplier intake: Build connectors for where companies actually keep their data: Databases, document stores, ticketing systems, machine logs, and sensor and video archives. Transaction layer: Own the pipeline, rights evidence, contracts, permissions, audit trail and delivery API. ML and data quality: Build anonymisation across text, tables, images and video, plus re-identification checks, deduplication, quality scoring and tooling that turns raw records into training-ready data. Delivery and compute: Decide whether data is processed in our cloud or inside the supplier’s environment. Build secure delivery, recurring updates and our GPU infrastructure. Technical direction: Own the architecture and roadmap. Work directly with labs, suppliers and researchers to understand what the system needs to become. What you need to succeed Data infrastructure at scale: You have built pipelines for large unstructured datasets, such as video, images, sensor logs or documents, at terabyte scale or more. Physical-world data: You have worked with documents, logs, video or sensor streams, ideally in robotics, industrial or autonomous systems and know what embodied AI teams need from data and where it breaks. Sensitive data: You know how to handle personal and confidential data safely. Experience with regulated data is a plus. Technical leadership: You make architectural decisions, explain them clearly and raise the engineering bar as the team grows. Hands-on Builder: You have taken a product, platform or open-source project from 0 to 1 that others relied on, and you still write code and own the critical paths. Founder mindset: You care about the outcome, not the title. You form strong views, test them quickly and are comfortable owning technical, product and operational problems. Location: Paris preferred. English required; French is a plus. Please note: As a co-founder, you take a real stake in what we build. The compensation is a founder salary, and your upside grows with the company through your equity. Come build the infrastructure between AI and the world's data with us! title: Founding Engineer (gn) – Hardware & Bioengineering, Munich
description: About Cellsor Cameras digitized vision. Microphones digitized sound. Smell is the one major sense we still can't capture, measure or transmit reliably. Cellsor is building the sensor that changes that. We replicate the mammalian olfactory epithelium outside the body – living olfactory tissue on microelectrode arrays – and read it out with machine learning. The result is a sensor that detects chemicals the way a nose does, with the breadth and sensitivity that conventional gas sensors lack. Applications span flavor and fragrance, defense and security, medical diagnostics, food quality and industrial monitoring. We are a VC-backed Tufts University spin-out with a working proof of principle and paid industry pilots, with teams in Boston (biology) and Munich (engineering). About the role As our first engineer in Munich, you develop the instrument that keeps our living sensor tissue alive and samples the air it analyzes. You take it from today's lab setup to a field-ready prototype at a customer site within 18 months. What you will do: Define the instrument architecture, then build prototypes across mechanics, fluidics and housing Develop automated media exchange that keeps cells viable for weeks to months Build the air path: sampling, filtration and controlled delivery of odorants to the sensor Integrate sensors, pumps and controllers for monitoring and automation Test and iterate with our Boston biology team Contribute to grant applications What you need to succeed Must-have: MSc or PhD in mechanical, biomedical or bioengineering, or a related field Built a lab or medical device from concept to working prototype CAD, rapid prototyping, and electronics integration Comfortable with uncertainty: you make progress without a defined path and decide what to build next Hands-on and self-directed – you'd rather test an idea on the bench than discuss it for a week Fluent English; German a plus Nice-to-have: Cell culture, perfusion or microfluidics Gas handling or air sampling Startup or grant-funded R&D experience Why join Cellsor now Cellsor is an early-stage, VC-backed deep-tech startup, funded to focus on building. Most hardware roles mean optimizing one part of an existing product. Here you build the first instrument for a new category of sensor, and your design decisions become the foundation of the platform. The technical risk has moved from "does this work?" to "how do we build it for the field?" – which is exactly where an engineer makes the difference. As the platform grows into electrode integration, machine learning and product design, so does the scope of your role. What we offer Equity in Cellsor, so you share in the value you help create The opportunity to build and lead the Munich engineering team as we grow Real responsibility from day one, working directly with the founders and technical advisors Lab and workspace at UnternehmerTUM, with regular exchange with our Boston team Find more English Speaking Jobs in Germany on Arbeitnow

Many private companies publish little or no financial detail. Across a database of more than 5 million companies, we predict revenue and EBITDA from sparse labels, and we predict whether and when a company will be bought or sold, which is a time-to-event problem with censored data. Agents on a messy web. Our agents search, navigate and extract company data points from sources that contradict each other, then decide which source to trust before committing to an answer. Quality that holds while everything underneath moves. We're provider-agnostic. Model choices follow the evals, and we switch LLMs when the numbers say so. That only works if the evals are trusted. What will you do? The work is roughly half LLM agents and half custom ML, leaning slightly toward agents. The design of our agent pipelines: architecture, tools, and which model for which task. You'll shape the technical direction with our AI Lead. The evaluation behind agents and models: offline reference sets, live production evals, and the call on whether an improvement is real. Our prediction models for financials and deals: features, validation, retraining, and knowing when a simpler model wins. Getting work into production: trace where pipelines fail and fix the weakest links first, with compute, memory and model cost in view. Raising the bar in the team through design reviews, pairing, and an eval-first habit that sticks. In your first six months you'll own the evals for our agent pipelines, propose where we invest next, and ship measurable improvements to both the agents and the prediction models. Who are you? You've built and owned ML systems in production for years, typically 6+ in ML or software engineering. In the last 1–2 years you've shipped LLM agents or pipelines that real users depend on, not demos. You have modelling judgement. You've dealt with leakage, distribution shift and calibration on real data. You measure before you claim. You can build an evaluation set and tell an honest improvement from a lucky one. You care about the user outcome more than the technique. Ideas without a clear customer benefit don't get built here, however interesting. Nice to have: time-to-event modelling, noisy or conflicting data sources, financial or private-company data. No finance background needed. description: Who we are: Geotab ® is a global leader in IoT and connected transportation and certified “Great Place to Work™.” We are a company of diverse and talented individuals who work together to help businesses grow and succeed, and increase the safety and sustainability of our communities. Geotab is advancing security, connecting commercial vehicles to the internet and providing web-based analytics to help customers better manage their fleets. Geotab’s open platform and Geotab Marketplace ®, offering hundreds of third-party solution options, allows both small and large businesses to automate operations by integrating vehicle data with their other data assets. Processing billions of data points a day, Geotab leverages data analytics and machine learning to improve productivity, optimize fleets through the reduction of fuel consumption, enhance driver safety and achieve strong compliance to regulatory changes. Our team is growing and we’re looking for people who follow their passion, think differently and want to make an impact. Ours is a fast paced, ever changing environment. Geotabbers accept that challenge and are willing to take on new tasks and activities - ones that may not always be described in the initial job description. Join us for a fulfilling career with opportunities to innovate, great benefits, and our fun and inclusive work culture. Reach your full potential with Geotab. To see what it’s like to be a Geotabber, check out our blog and follow us @InsideGeotab on Instagram . Who you are: We are always looking for amazing talent who can contribute to our growth and deliver results ! Geotab is seeking a Senior Product Manager who will oversee product development from conception to launch across multiple products or segments and discover, develop, and cultivate new products and ongoing product enhancements that support Geotab’s business models and continued growth . If you love technology, and are keen to join an industry leader — we would love to hear from you ! What you'll do: As a Senior Product Manager your key area of responsibility will be understanding the infrastructure needed to support the growth of revenue streams, owning the comprehensive product roadmap, and driving portfolio-level prioritization aligned with overall business strategy . You will need to work closely with UX designers, developers, data scientists, technical project managers, customers, and senior leadership . To be successful in this role you will be a self-starter, resourceful, empathetic listener, and a strong team player with well-defined diplomacy, negotiation, and conflict resolution skills . In addition, the successful candidate will have strong analytical and problem-solving skills, an entrepreneurial mindset, strategic thinking, and experience leveraging user engagement metrics and product KPIs to drive data-informed dec ision-making. How you'll make an impact: Understand the infrastructure needed to support the growth of existing and new revenue streams within Geotab, the associated market, and how custo mers can benefit from telematics solutions to improve their business. Own the development of a comprehensive product roadmap, ensuring alignment across internal stakeholders while driving the execution of strategic initiatives that support long-term business objectives. Lead high-impact customer discovery initiatives and mentor other team members in conducting interviews to refine value propositions and product fit. Drive prioritization at a portfolio lev el, aligning efforts with overall business and product strategy. Establish advanced reporting and monitoring frameworks that measure success (both qualitative and quantitative) across multiple product dimensions. Design and implement feedback loops at scale, ensuring continuous alignment with market needs. Ensure company-wide unde rstanding of product efforts, regularly communicating the Why at senior leadership forums and cross-departmental meetings. Lead complex problem and solution validation, ensuring strategic alignment and providing direction on critical solutions. Oversee the translation of needs into detailed epics and initiatives, ensuring alignment with overall product strategy. Work closely with technical project managers toward execution. Collect and analyze feedback from customers, stakeholders and internal teams to continuously make improvements to products that are launched. Lead efforts to enhance product management frameworks, mentoring other product managers and contributing to company-wide initiatives. What you'll bring to this role: 5 - 8 years of required experience in product management and/or customer discovery. Bachelor’s degree or Post-Secondary Diploma/Degree (or equivalent work experience), with specialization in Engineering, Business, Computer Science, or a related field highly valued. Demonstrated experience and strong understanding of user engagement metrics and product KPIs to drive data-informed decision-making and enhance product performance. Strong proficiency in Agile planning methods, practices, and managing products through discovery, launch, and continuous review. Excellent written, verbal, and virtual presentation skills, with the ability to stitch together disparate insights to uncover common patterns and communicate complex concepts clearly. Strong strategic mindset, diplomacy, negotiation, and conflict resolution skills with comfort working in a flat organization. If you got this far, we hope you're feeling excited about this role! title: Quantitative Researcher - 2027 Graduates
description: At Graviton, we don't believe the best trading strategies come from following established playbooks. They come from asking better questions. Why does a pattern exist? What is driving it? Is it real or just noise? Can it be explained, modelled and turned into an edge? As a Quantitative Researcher, you'll work on those questions every day. You'll investigate market behaviour, develop quantitative models, build and test hypotheses and turn insights into trading strategies, working alongside researchers and technologists in an environment where an idea on a whiteboard can reach live trading quickly. This isn't a role where the answers are in a textbook. The problems are open-ended, the data is enormous, and finding the answers is the job. Ideal candidates are rigorous thinkers who genuinely enjoy mathematics, programming and figuring out things that aren't obvious, based in our Singapore, London, Amsterdam or US offices. What You'll Work On You'll work across quantitative research and systematic trading, taking ideas through the full lifecycle: question, hypothesis, experiment, model, validation, strategy, production. Depending on your team and research interests, your work would include: Discovering predictive patterns and sources of alpha from billions of market events Formulating hypotheses about market behaviour and designing experiments to test them Applying probability, statistics, optimization and machine learning to build predictive models and quantitative signals for systematic trading Designing robust backtests and statistical tests to distinguish genuine signals from noise Working with large and complex datasets to uncover patterns that aren't immediately visible Investigating market microstructure and how markets behave at different timescales Evaluating strategy performance, identifying weaknesses and continuously refining models Developing research infrastructure and AI-powered tools and agents that make experimentation faster and analysis deeper Working closely with technologists to translate research ideas into efficient, production-ready systems Exploring new techniques in machine learning, statistics and quantitative finance to uncover new sources of edge No two research problems are the same. Good research finds patterns. Great research understands why they exist. What Success Looks Like Successful researchers at Graviton discover new sources of alpha and turn them into robust trading strategies, build models that hold up under real market conditions and not only in backtests, develop a deep understanding of market behaviour, create research frameworks and tools that make the broader team more effective, work with technologists to take ideas from research into production, and communicate complex quantitative ideas clearly and rigorously. Your impact isn't measured by how many models you build. It's measured by the quality of the ideas you discover and what those ideas enable. Who We're Looking For We're looking for exceptional problem solvers who genuinely enjoy mathematics, programming and figuring out things that aren't obvious. Degree in a quantitative discipline such as mathematics, physics, computer science, statistics, operations research or machine learning No active backlogs Strong programming skills in Python and/or C++ Solid grounding in probability, statistics, linear algebra and optimization, with experience in machine learning, statistical modelling or data analysis, whether through coursework, research or personal projects Comfort working with large, complex datasets, and strong analytical thinking A passion for applying quantitative thinking and rigorous research to solve open-ended problems in markets Excellent communication skills, with the ability to explain complex ideas clearly Prior exposure to quantitative research, algorithmic trading, market microstructure, competitive mathematics or machine learning is valuable, but we care more about how you think than whether you've worked in finance before. Our Culture More than specific tools or techniques, we care how you think. We look for people who are curious enough to keep asking why, analytical enough to separate signal from noise, persistent enough to pursue difficult problems, intellectually honest enough to abandon an idea when the evidence says so, and humble enough to keep learning. At Graviton, researchers sit alongside technologists on specialized trading teams that operate with significant autonomy. You'll have meaningful ownership of research problems from day one: forming your own hypotheses, challenging existing approaches and following the evidence wherever it leads, with the infrastructure and datasets to test ideas at scale, competitive compensation, and a culture where the best idea wins regardless of who proposed it. Markets are among the most complex systems humans have ever created, and they never stop changing. Neither should our thinking. Every day, someone asks a better question and finds an answer nobody had. That someone could be you. Find Jobs in Netherlands on Arbeitnow

title: Manager: Compliance Advisory and Data Protection
location: London or remote within the UK
description: About Griffin Hi, we’re Griffin. We’re moving into card issuing, stablecoin infrastructure, and agentic finance next as we continue to support the next generation of product-led companies. People who thrive here don’t require much hand-holding, and go out of their way to figure out how to contribute in the most valuable way possible. We've been remote-first since we were established in 2017 and we remain so today. Work here is asynchronous and fully flexible - because we want to be a part of your life in a way that helps you to get the most out of both your work and home life. We understand that our culture and ways of working aren’t for everyone, and we’re very intentional about our hiring process as a result. We won't hire people who don’t seem like a strong fit for our core values, even if they're otherwise extremely qualified. Our strong culture has helped us to remain a mission-driven company as we have scaled, and gives our people a clear, explicit operating framework and the space to focus on delivering real value for our customers. Learn more about our culture. The Team You'll join our Service guild and work across first line operations, sales and produt. Working closely with Protect (our second line) you'll be the first person dedicated to compliance within the team. You'll define what great compliance solutions look like. Then implement them , keeping Griffin's products and customer outcomes in shape as we grow. The opportunity We want compliance and data protection built into how we design, sell and run our products. As our hands on DPO and compliance adviser, in the first line (the teams who run the business and own its risks), you'll bring regulatory expertise to help our operations, commercial and product teams do exactly that. With card issuing and other launches coming up, there's plenty to get stuck into. What success looks like In your first year, you’ve taken ownership of our data protection agenda. You’ve gone looking for ways to improve, made the changes happen, and given our senior leaders an honest picture of where we stand. You’ve sought out our operations, sales and product teams and shown them that working with you makes things smoother, not slower. Now they bring you in early by default. You’ve guided at least one major launch, like card issuing, from first idea to go live. And you’ve put clear governance and outcome monitoring in place for our live products, so Protect (our second line risk and compliance team) sees fewer surprises and finds a stronger compliance foundation. To do this you'll be involved in: Product development: turning regulation into clear requirements, customer journeys, T&Cs and fair value assessments, from first idea through product approval to launch, with data protection built in from the start. Product lifecycle management: keeping live products compliant through periodic fair value assessments, outcome monitoring, reviews, changes and closures. Sales: helping our commercial team check early whether potential partners fit our risk appetite, and reviewing sales material. Marketing: working on marketing materials, both ours and our customers’, to make sure they comply with regulation and our own policies, and that our financial promotions are properly challenged. Service (Operations): building regulatory and data protection requirements into how Service works day to day, with procedures and controls people actually use. Regulatory change: working out what new rules mean for us, and making sure the right teams make the right changes on time. Issues and reporting: investigating and fixing compliance issues, including personal data breaches, and reporting clearly on compliance risks and customer outcomes. Working with second line (Protect): bringing them in early, sharing the evidence they need, and acting on their challenge. Data protection: being our Data Protection Officer (DPO), which means: advising our teams on their obligations, including data protection impact assessments (DPIAs) and transfer risk assessments (TRAs) monitoring and auditing how well we comply with the UK GDPR, other data protection laws and our own policies training colleagues and raising awareness of data protection being our contact point for the ICO and for people with questions or requests about their data As our DPO, you’ll report directly to our COO and have the independence you need to do the job well. We’ll involve you early in anything that affects personal data. We expect you to shape this role: This description reflects what we need today. How you achieve these outcomes, where you focus your energy, how this role evolves is for you to define as you learn what our customers need and where you can make the biggest difference. We expect you to shape this role: This description reflects what we need today. How you achieve these outcomes, where you focus your energy, how this role evolves—that's for you to define as you learn what our customers need and where our technical gaps are. Your background We need a proactive doer. You get stuck in without waiting to be asked, and you’re comfortable tackling regulations you haven’t met before. You use your experience and expertise to help our teams find simple, clear and compliant solutions. Your advice is balanced, easy to follow and focused on the risks that matter most. You want to push the business forward, and you see good compliance as part of how we get there. To ensure this, we're looking for people who have: Compliance experience in the first (preferred) or second line of a UK regulated firm, ideally a bank, e-money institution or payments firm. Practical knowledge of the rules behind our products , like Consumer Duty, BCOBS, CASS, FISMA, the Payment Services Regulations and the Money Laundering Regulations. As well as familiarity with HMRC requirements like BBSI and AEOI reporting. Expert knowledge of data protection law and practice , including the UK GDPR, the Data Protection Act 2018, PECR and the Data (Use and Access) Act 2025. Hands-on experience turning regulation into practical requirements for product, sales or operations teams. A curious, questioning approach. You know the right questions to ask before signing something off, not just the rules to check it against. The confidence to challenge, clearly and kindly, when something isn’t right. A love of writing . We have a major amount of written documentation that you will be contributing to, and we place a high degree of importance on clarity and readability (you can find out more here about how we write ). Ideally, you would also: Have deep expertise in at least one specialist area, such as payments, cards, Consumer Duty, BCOBS, financial promotions or similar. Have been a DPO, or worked closely with one, in a regulated firm. Have worked in finance or banking. What can we offer you? We are an early stage startup and we're working hard to expand our benefits package. We're planning to add to this list in the future. Salary: £ 80-90 (DOE) Remote-first flexibility: Work from anywhere in the UK Work from abroad: Up to 20 days a year Time off: 25 days’ holiday, bank holidays and a winter break (we shut down between Christmas and New Year) Share options: Own a part of what we’re building together Pension: Auto-enrolment into our Penfold scheme

title: Responsable Réadaptation en Urgence
description: Handicap International / Humanité & Inclusion (HI) est une association de solidarité internationale indépendante et impartiale, qui intervient dans les situations de pauvreté et d’exclusion, de conflits et de catastrophes. Œuvrant aux côtés des personnes handicapées et vulnérabilisées, elle agit et témoigne pour répondre à leurs besoins essentiels et améliorer leurs conditions de vie. Elle s’engage à promouvoir le respect de leur dignité et de leurs droits fondamentaux. Depuis sa création en 1982, HI a mis en place des programmes de développement dans plus de 60 pays et intervient dans de nombreuses situations d’urgence. Aujourd'hui, nous avons un budget d'environ 255 millions d'euros, avec 4794 employés dans le monde. Chez Handicap International, nous croyons fermement en l'importance de l'inclusion et de la diversité au sein de notre structure. C'est pourquoi nous sommes engagés dans une politique handicap afin de favoriser l'accueil et l'intégration de personnes en situation de handicap. Merci d’indiquer si vous avez besoin d’un aménagement particulier, y compris pour participer aux 1ers entretiens. CONTEXTE : La Direction des Programmes Internationaux (DPI) de Humanité & Inclusion comprend entre autres 5 Directions Géographiques, 4 Directions Techniques, 1 Direction Atlas Logistique et 1 Direction Urgence. La Direction Urgence est composée de 15 personnes: une équipe en charge de la veille, de l'alerte et de la préparation aux urgences et une équipe en charge des interventions d'urgence au niveau du siège et sur le terrain. C’est au sein de cette dernière, composée de 6 spécialistes des urgences et prêts à être déployés sous 72 heures que nous recrutons un ou une Responsable Réadaptation physique et Fonctionnelle en Urgence dans le cadre d’un remplacement temporaire. OBJECTIFS DU POSTE : Sous la responsabilité du responsable du pool d'urgence et en étroite coordination avec les Spécialistes en Réadaptation Physique et Fonctionnelle du siège, le responsable Réadaptation Physique et Fonctionnelle d'urgence aura la charge de : Participer au diagnostic initial des opérations de réponse d'urgence, à la suite d’une crise humanitaire ; · Contribuer à la définition de la stratégie, de la méthodologie et du dimensionnement du diagnostic initial, y compris la création et/ou l'adaptation des outils d'évaluation des besoins ; · Participer aux évaluations des besoins ; · Contribuer à l'analyse des résultats et à la définition de la stratégie de réponse immédiate en anticipant le nexus urgence-réhabilitation-développement ; · Contribuer à l'élaboration du projet et à la rédaction des propositions ; Diriger et coordonner : Piloter le déploiement des activités de réadaptation physique et fonctionnelle lors de l’ouverture de nouveaux programmes d’urgence, en assurant la définition du cadre opérationnel, le management des équipes, la coordination avec les autres secteurs d’intervention et les partenaires, ainsi que le suivi de la qualité, du budget, des résultats et du reporting. Le poste contribue également à la mise en œuvre de la stratégie d’intervention d’urgence, au renforcement des capacités des équipes et partenaires, et à la capitalisation des retours d’expérience. title: Performance Marketing Manager - Paid Search (m/f/d)
description: About Hilo by Aktiia High blood pressure is the world's most common disease, causing 18M deaths each year. At Hilo by Aktiia, we're building a world where no lives are lost to its effects — with technology that helps people take control of their health. We're a venture-backed scale-up with $96M raised from investors in Europe and the US. Rooted in 18 years of research at the Swiss Center for Electronics and Microtechnology (CSEM), our device is the world's only medically accurate, cuffless, continuous blood pressure monitor for daily use — clinically validated and CE Marked as a Class IIa medical device, now available in 12 countries. In July, we launched in the US. We're a remote-first company headquartered in Neuchâtel, Switzerland, united by our passion for impact and innovation. Applicants must already hold a valid visa or work permit for their country of residence, as Hilo is not able to provide visa sponsorship. You will use data to identify where we can grow, improve performance from ad click to purchase and make clear decisions about where to spend. Beyond paid search, you will drive the development and testing of additional paid acquisition channels, including native advertising and help scale those with strong commercial potential. Reporting to the Head of Performance Marketing, you will play a key role in our performance marketing team, working with internal teams and external partners to strengthen our paid acquisition capabilities and prepare our channels for Hilo’s next stage of growth. Occasional travel to our office in Neuchâtel, Switzerland, or to team events may be required. Core responsibilities Set the paid search strategy across the US, UK, Germany and further growth markets. Lead campaign strategy and execution across Search, Shopping and Performance Max, working closely with internal teams and external partners and include Google Demand Gen where it support our goals. Manage budgets, pacing, bidding and investment across platforms and markets. Measure performance against acquisition cost, conversion, revenue, and ROI, using business data alongside platform reporting. Build a testing roadmap across keywords, audiences, creative, product feeds and landing pages and use the results to improve conversion and guide investment. Partner with marketing, product, creative and analytics colleagues to strengthen tracking and improve the customer journey. Use AI tools and platform automation to accelerate research, analysis and execution, while checking outputs and keeping health claims accurate. Drive the testing and development of additional paid channels, such as native advertising and scale successful approaches. Present results, risks and opportunities clearly, with a point of view on what Hilo should do next. Requirements Background & Experience At least 5 years of hands-on paid search experience in an international setting, with accountability forbudgets and measurable business results. Deep expertise in Google Ads, and strong working experience with Microsoft Advertising. A data-driven approach grounded in sound measurement, rigorous testing, and commercial judgment. A track record of improving conversion rates, acquisition efficiency, and ROI across multiple markets. Experience with media planning and performance forecasting. Experience launching and evaluating paid channels beyond search. The ability to set direction and influence colleagues while staying close to campaign execution. Practical experience using AI and automation, with the judgment to verify their outputs. Nice to have: experience in health tech, medical devices, wearables, or subscription products. Benefits What Makes You A Great Fit At Hilo by Aktiia, our values guide everything we do: Move the Needle — You focus on what truly drives impact for our customers and company. You use data and clarity to guide your decisions and prioritize what matters most. You push boundaries with bold, thoughtful innovation and hold yourself accountable for results. Move Fast, Learn, Refine — You work with urgency and purpose, balancing speed with high quality. You treat mistakes as learning opportunities, experiment thoughtfully, and iterate quickly. You take ownership, act hands-on, and always look for smarter, faster ways to get things done, including leveraging AI and new tools. Team First — You put the team above individual interests, building trust through openness and respect. You encourage healthy debate, challenge directly while caring personally, and stand behind team decisions. You act as an owner, stepping in when needed and doing what’s necessary for the team’s success. Why Join Us? Hilo by Aktiia is becoming one of the most important med-tech companies and you can be part of this exciting story. Work on a mission that matters: transforming cardiovascular health at global scale. Comfortable using computers and software-based diagnostic or configuration tools. Strong attention to quality and safety. Able to work independently and solve problems in the field. Comfortable working directly with customers and other technical teams. Willingness to travel extensively across the UK. Authorized to work in the UK. Strongly preferred Experience with one or more of: Industrial automation Robotics or autonomous systems Heavy equipment Forklifts or material-handling equipment Construction or mining machinery Automotive or off-highway equipment Field service engineering Controls or electrical systems Sensor installation and calibration Linux-based systems Industrial networking Experience commissioning complex systems in customer environments is a major advantage. title: Senior Supply Chain Coordinator
description: At i3D.net , we provide world-class global coverage with one of the most interconnected networks in the world. Our solutions focus on low latency, zero packet loss, and unmatched scalability, enabling seamless experiences for millions of users worldwide. With dedicated support, bespoke solutions, and cutting-edge technology, we deliver reliable, cost-efficient infrastructure that empowers game developers and businesses to scale effortlessly. Partnering with major names like Nvidia, DuckDuckGo , and Ubisoft , we are shaping the future of gaming and network technology. Waarom jouw rol belangrijk is Als Senior Supply Chain Coordinator bij i3D.net speel je een belangrijke rol in de succesvolle realisatie van onze infrastructuurprojecten in Nederland. Je zorgt ervoor dat inkoop, leveranciersrelaties, contractmanagement en financiële beheersing goed op elkaar aansluiten, zodat complexe projecten volgens planning verlopen. Je opereert op het snijvlak van Supply Chain, Data Center Operations, Finance, technische teams en Legal. Daarbij ben je verantwoordelijk voor de commerciële en contractuele aspecten van infrastructuurprojecten. Van het begeleiden van aanbestedingen en onderhandelen over contracten tot het beheren van contractwijzigingen, meer- en minderwerk, claims en kosten tijdens de uitvoering: jij zorgt voor structuur, overzicht en grip op het proces. Met jouw werk heb je directe invloed op projectplanningen, kostenbeheersing en de succesvolle uitbreiding van de infrastructuur van i3D.net . Wat ga je doen? Aanbestedingen en inkoop: Je begeleidt het volledige aanbestedings- en inkoopproces voor infrastructuurprojecten, waaronder het opstellen en uitzetten van offerteaanvragen (RFQ's), het vergelijken en beoordelen van aanbiedingen, het selecteren van aannemers en het voeren van commerciële onderhandelingen. Contractmanagement: Je bent verantwoordelijk voor het beheer van contracten gedurende de volledige projectcyclus. Van de eerste onderhandelingen en contractafspraken tot het afhandelen van contractwijzigingen, meer- en minderwerk en claims tijdens de uitvoering. Leveranciers- en aannemersmanagement: Je bouwt en onderhoudt sterke relaties met aannemers, leveranciers en andere externe partners. Je bewaakt contractuele afspraken, kwaliteitsnormen en oplevertermijnen. Ondersteuning van infrastructuurprojecten: Je bent het eerste aanspreekpunt vanuit Supply Chain voor de uitvoering van infrastructuurprojecten in Nederland en werkt nauw samen met datacenter-, technische en projectteams. Kostenbeheersing en rapportages: Je bewaakt financiële verplichtingen, uitgaven en contractwaarden. Met jouw gevorderde Excel-vaardigheden zorg je voor betrouwbare financiële inzichten en signaleer je tijdig mogelijke risico's. Contractmanagementsystemen: Je ondersteunt bij de selectie, implementatie en ingebruikname van een Contract Lifecycle Management (CLM)-systeem binnen de Supply Chain-afdeling. Samenwerking met stakeholders: Je werkt nauw samen met Finance, Legal, technische teams en externe aannemers om projecten soepel te laten verlopen en besluitvorming te ondersteunen. Procesverbetering: Je signaleert kansen om inkoopprocessen, contractbeheer, kosteninzicht en de algehele efficiëntie van projecten verder te verbeteren. Wat heb je in het eerste jaar bereikt? Je hebt aanbestedingstrajecten en contractonderhandelingen voor belangrijke infrastructuurprojecten succesvol begeleid. Je hebt duidelijk inzicht en overzicht gecreëerd in contractuele verplichtingen, projectkosten, wijzigingen en claims. Je hebt actief bijgedragen aan de succesvolle implementatie en ingebruikname van een contractmanagementsysteem binnen de afdeling. Je hebt relaties met aannemers en leveranciers versterkt en betere commerciële resultaten gerealiseerd. Je hebt meer structuur, transparantie en financiële beheersing aangebracht in de uitvoering van infrastructuurprojecten. Je bent uitgegroeid tot een betrouwbare sparringpartner voor Supply Chain, Data Center Operations, Finance, Legal en technische teams. Wie ben jij? Proactief en oplossingsgericht: Je signaleert contractuele en commerciële uitdagingen vroegtijdig en onderneemt actie voordat ze de voortgang van projecten beïnvloeden. Sterk in onderhandelen: Je gaat zelfverzekerd het gesprek aan met aannemers en leveranciers en weet commerciële belangen te combineren met duurzame samenwerkingen. Verantwoordelijkheidsgevoel: Je neemt eigenaarschap over contracten, afspraken en resultaten gedurende de volledige projectcyclus. Gestructureerd en nauwkeurig: Je houdt overzicht over complexe contracten, budgetten en verschillende belanghebbenden. Commercieel ingesteld: Je begrijpt de financiële en contractuele risico's van infrastructuurprojecten en weet hoe je deze beheerst. Communicatief en samenwerkingsgericht: Je schakelt gemakkelijk met technische specialisten, projectteams, Finance, Legal en externe partners. Gericht op verbetering: Je krijgt energie van het aanbrengen van structuur, het verbeteren van processen en het efficiënter laten samenwerken van teams. Wat breng je mee? 5 tot 10 jaar relevante werkervaring binnen inkoop, contractmanagement, projectinkoop of een vergelijkbare commerciële functie binnen infrastructuurprojecten. Aantoonbare expertise in contract- en leveranciersmanagement, waaronder het beheren van contractwijzigingen, meer- en minderwerk en claims tijdens de uitvoering van projecten. Ervaring met het zelfstandig begeleiden van volledige aanbestedingstrajecten, inclusief offerteaanvragen (RFQ's), offertevergelijkingen, aannemersselectie en commerciële onderhandelingen. Een achtergrond binnen infrastructuur, bouw, datacenters, industriële projecten of andere bedrijfskritische omgevingen. Kennis van Nederlandse contractvormen en voorwaarden binnen de bouw en infrastructuur, met name UAV en UAV-GC . Praktische ervaring met het implementeren of gebruiken van een Contract Lifecycle Management (CLM)-systeem. Gevorderde Excel-vaardigheden en ervaring met kostenbeheersing, financiële monitoring en uitgavenrapportages. Sterk commercieel inzicht en het vermogen om contractuele en financiële risico's te herkennen en te beheersen. Uitstekende beheersing van zowel de Nederlandse als Engelse taal , mondeling en schriftelijk. Je woont in de regio Rotterdam, zodat je regelmatig aanwezig kunt zijn op kantoor en op projectlocaties. Mooi meegenomen Een PRINCE2- of PMP-certificering. Ervaring met het ontwikkelen van financiële dashboards, uitgavenanalyses en kostenrapportages. Beheersing van de Franse taal, met het oog op mogelijke internationale infrastructuurprojecten. Waarom werken bij i3D.net ? Je levert een directe bijdrage aan de realisatie en uitbreiding van bedrijfskritische infrastructuurprojecten. Je krijgt veel verantwoordelijkheid voor belangrijke contracten, aannemersrelaties en commerciële onderhandelingen. Je speelt een sleutelrol in het verder professionaliseren van contractmanagement en inkoopprocessen. Je werkt nauw samen met ervaren technische, financiële en juridische professionals in een internationale omgeving. Je komt terecht in een dynamische, snelgroeiende organisatie waar jouw expertise en ideeën daadwerkelijk het verschil maken. Je profiteert van toegang tot Ubisoft-games en faciliteiten op kantoor. Capacité à penser stratégie, marque et performance ensemble . Sensibilité forte à l’image sans être uniquement DA . À l’aise dans des environnements rapides, mouvants et ambitieux. Intérêt pour des projets à dimension internationale . title: Senior Accountmanager Zorg & ICT
description: Je opent nieuwe deuren bij zorgorganisaties en bouwt vanuit vertrouwen aan nieuwe samenwerkingen. Wil jij bijdragen aan dienstverlening in de zorg die er echt toe doet? Krijg jij energie van het leggen van nieuwe contacten en het omzetten van een eerste gesprek in een duurzame samenwerking? En geloof jij oprecht dat goede digitale zorg het verschil maakt voor patiënt en zorgprofessional? Dan willen we jou graag leren kennen. Bij Beter Healthcare draait accountmanagement niet in de eerste plaats om de cijfers. Het draait om mensen, vertrouwen en trots zijn op wat je doet, en om de sterke drive om de zorg én Beter Healthcare stap voor stap vooruit te helpen. Elke dag weer. Wat je gaat doen Als (Senior) Accountmanager ben jij voor nieuwe zorgorganisaties vaak de eerste kennismaking met Beter Healthcare . Je richt je op ziekenhuizen, GGZ- en VVT-organisaties en samenwerkingsverbanden waar we nog niet of nauwelijks werken. Je verkoopt geen product, maar dienstverlening : advies, projectmanagement, interim-inzet en implementatie, samen met de consultants die de inhoud brengen. Je zoekt actief kansen op, weet klant behoeften niet alleen te identificeren maar ook te sturen en laat je niet uit het veld slaan door een nee. Tegelijk verkoop je niets wat niet past: je begint bij echte interesse in de klant en zijn uitdagingen. En je bent een echte teamspeler. Eerst het team, daarna jijzelf. Geen groot ego, geen solist. Je groeit hard mee met ons bedrijf, helemaal in lijn met onze missie: hoe meer we groeien, hoe groter onze positieve impact op de zorg. Jouw werkzaamheden omvatten onder andere: · Je brengt de markt in kaart, kiest doelorganisaties en bouwt een gerichte pipeline op; · Je legt contact met CIO's, CMIO's, managers informatievoorziening, inkopers en bestuurders, via je eigen netwerk en actieve acquisitie; · Je verkent in gesprekken wat er echt speelt en vertaalt dat samen met consultants naar een passend voorstel; · Je stelt offertes op en onderhandelt over inzet, tarieven en voorwaarden; · Je volgt aanbestedingen en raamovereenkomsten en coördineert inschrijvingen; · Je vertegenwoordigt Beter Healthcare op netwerkevenementen, congressen en vakbijeenkomsten, op een manier die past bij onze waarden: betrokken, betrouwbaar en bekwaam; · Je rapporteert over pipeline, forecast en kansen aan het managementteam en hebt dat gewoon goed op orde. Wie jij bent Je bent geen typische verkoper. Je bent een ondernemende verbinder : iemand die nieuwe kansen ziet, deuren durft te openen en mensen en organisaties oprecht wil begrijpen. Herken jij jezelf hierin? · Je haalt energie uit het binnenhalen van nieuwe klanten en hebt het doorzettingsvermogen dat daarbij hoort; · Je hebt een intrinsieke drive om bij te dragen aan betere zorg door digitalisering; · Je bent nieuwsgierig en leergierig: de wereld van zorg en ICT blijft je boeien en je houdt je kennis actief bij; · Je bent een echte teamspeler en zet het gezamenlijke resultaat boven je eigen ego; · Je hebt minimaal acht jaar ervaring in de verkoop van dienstverlening , zoals consultancy, interim of detachering, in de zorg-ICT; · Je hebt een trackrecord in het binnenhalen van nieuwe klanten en kent de inkoop- en aanbestedingsprocessen in de zorg; · Je beschikt over een actief netwerk bij zorgorganisaties, bij voorkeur op het niveau van CIO, CMIO, IM-management of bestuur; · Je hebt hbo- of wo-werk- en denkniveau; · Je communiceert helder en overtuigend in het Nederlands, mondeling en schriftelijk. Wat je van ons mag verwachten Bij Beter Healthcare kom je terecht in een werkomgeving die draait om groei, vertrouwen en samenwerking. Je kunt rekenen op: · Een goed salaris dat we bepalen op basis van jouw kennis en ervaring; · Sterke secundaire voorwaarden, zoals een leaseauto, bonusregeling, pensioen, laptop en telefoon; · Een rol met echte impact: jij opent de deuren waardoor Beter Healthcare kan groeien en de zorg kan verbeteren; · Veel ruimte voor eigen initiatief en invloed op onze commerciële koers; · Ruimte om jezelf te ontwikkelen, zowel commercieel als inhoudelijk; · Kennisgroepen, intervisies en ontwikkelmogelijkheden om continu te blijven leren; · Interactieve kwartaalbijeenkomsten met collega's op inspirerende locaties; · Een hecht team van gedreven healthcare consultants dat altijd met je meedenkt; · Een actieve personeelsvereniging voor wie het leuk vindt om samen dingen te ondernemen; · Heel veel plezier in een prachtig team. Over Beter Healthcare Beter Healthcare is een consultancybureau op het snijvlak van zorg en ICT. We ondersteunen zorgorganisaties bij de digitalisering van hun processen en dragen zo bij aan een toekomstbestendige zorg. We zijn al met zo'n 100 IT healthcare specialisten en we groeien hard: niet als doel op zich, maar omdat onze klanten ons nodig hebben en onze aanpak werkt. Sinds 2012 helpen we zorgorganisaties met advies, projectmanagement en beheer. Onze kracht is dat we niet alleen adviseren, maar ook samen met klanten oplossingen succesvol implementeren. Onze consultants kennen de zorg van binnenuit, en dat maakt echt het verschil. Beter Healthcare is onderdeel van IG&H, een toonaangevend adviesbureau dat verantwoordelijkheid neemt voor de resultaten van zijn werk. Met de eigen ‘Make Strategy Work’-methodologie richt IG&H zich op digitale transformaties. Binnen IG&H Health werken we samen met teams die gespecialiseerd zijn in onder meer strategy consulting, data en AI, security en managed cloudservices. Voel jij een “ja”? title: Post-doctorant(e) :  Problèmes publics des centres de données - Chaire SHS TerrAINs  - CDD de 18 mois
description: Qui sommes-nous ? Télécom Paris, école de l’IMT (Institut Mines-Télécom) et membre fondateur de l’Institut Polytechnique de Paris, est une grande école du top 6 des écoles d’ingénieurs généralistes françaises. La Raison d’Être de Télécom Paris est de former, imaginer et entreprendre pour concevoir des modèles, des technologies et des solutions numériques au service d’une société et d’une économie respectueuses de l’humain et de son environnement. Nous recherchons notre futur(e) post-doctorant(e) en problèmes publics des centres de données pour rejoindre le département de recherche Sciences Économiques et Sociales (SES) et plus particulièrement la chaire SHS TerraAINs. Contexte scientifique : La Chaire SHS TerrAINs s’intéresse aux enjeux territoriaux du développement des infrastructures numériques et plus particulièrement des centres de données en France. Elle est portée par Pauline Gourlet et financée par la Région Ile de France (2026-2029). Longtemps demeurés une infrastructure invisible, les centres de données ( data centers ) se trouvent désormais au cœur des problématiques des politiques publiques et industrielles et la Région Ile de France concentre aujourd’hui ces infrastructures (plus de 165 en 2024), avec de nombreux projets de data centers hyperscale à l’étude. Vecteurs d’innovation, objets de spéculation, instruments de réaffirmation de puissance nationale, leur développement rapide génère aussi de nombreuses inquiétudes, voire du rejet, en France (comme à l’étranger), et ne fait pas à ce jour l’objet d’une planification concertée, mais relève encore largement d’opportunités isolées. Or, ces projets d’infrastructure se trouvent à la croisée d’enjeux locaux, voire hyper-locaux — de l’aménagement territorial aux effets sur l’environnement — et d’enjeux nationaux et internationaux — de la tension sur les réseaux d’électricité aux questions de souveraineté technologique et d’investissement. Au sein de la Chaire, le ou la post-doctorant(e) étudiera la manière dont les centres de données, objets clés de l’infrastructure numérique, se développent et organisent différents problèmes publics relatifs aux « territoires » à différentes échelles territoriales. Comment en retour, la définition et la hiérarchisation de ces problèmes peuvent permettent des arbitrages concertés pour planifier leur déploiement ? Les modalités de participation à la construction de ces problèmes publics, autant que la fabrique des données nécessaires pour nourrir les positions des acteurs, sont autant un enjeu de démocratie technique qu’une manière de retrouver prise sur l’aménagement des milieux de vie. En articulant sociologie des sciences et des techniques et études urbaines avec une méthodologie innovante de recherche-action , TerrAINs contribue à rendre visibles et discutables les infrastructures numériques, tout en expérimentant des outils de représentation des problèmes et de participation, adaptées aux enjeux infrastructurels contemporains. La Chaire est organisée selon trois axes principaux : Analyse des discours sur les centres de données, et notamment les discours médiatiques régionaux, nationaux et étrangers ; Description des modalités du « faire infrastructure » : pratiques situées, relations aux milieux, frictions. Cet axe investira trois sites franciliens concernés par des projets de centres hyperscale. la chaire est conçue comme un laboratoire de recherche-action qui expérimente de nouvelles modalités de représentation et de participation autour des infrastructures numériques. Vos missions principales seront de : Assurer des missions de recherche dans le cadre de la Chaire Terrains Participer à l’animation de la chaire et contribuer aux projets menés par les autres membres de l’équipe Participer à des actions de valorisation des travaux menés au sein de la chaire Assurer des missions d’encadrement (stagiaires, workshops étudiant) Consulter la description des missions complètes dans la fiche de poste détaillée. Nous recherchons une personne avec un profil SHS – interdisciplinaire ( humanités environnementales, Science and Technology Studies (STS) ou anthropologie expérimentale, géographie sociale, architecture / design…) avec une solide maîtrise théorique et empirique des transformations socio-environnementales, des savoirs situés, des problèmes publics, de l’enquête collective et des relations entre sciences / société. Niveau de diplôme exigé : doctorat ou équivalent Pourquoi nous rejoindre ? Vous travaillerez dans un environnement en plein développement, agréable, verdoyant et accessible (notamment pour les personnes en situation de handicap) à seulement 20 km de Paris (RER B et C, proximité des grands axes routiers). Vous bénéficierez de : 49 jours de congés annuels (CA + RTT) flexibilité des horaires de travail (en fonction de l'activité du service) télétravail 1 à 3 jours/semaine possible Remboursement abonnement transports en commun à 75% Proximité de nombreuses infrastructures sportives, conciergerie, parking souterrain, restauration interne... A savoir : nos cotisations sociales sont moins élevées que dans le secteur privé Découvrez notre environnement de travail, nos engagements en image et en vidéo sur notre page dédiée . Dossier de candidature à envoyer avant le 20 novembre : un CV détaillé une lettre (2-3 pages max) qui esquisse les contributions que le ou la candidat·e souhaiterait apporter au sein de la Chaire ainsi que sa motivation à y prendre part; deux publications significatives au regard de cette intention (au-delà des critères académiques classiques) une lettre de recommandation Informations diverses : Date limite de candidature : 22 novembre 2026 Type d'emploi : CDD de 18 mois Description de poste détaillée ici Rémunération : 36 000 euros brut/an En fonction du statut du profil retenu et du nombre d’années après la thèse, un contrat d’ingénieur de recherche pourra être envisagé. Nos recrutements sont fondés sur les compétences, sans distinction d’origine, d’âge, d'identité de genre et d’orientation sexuel et tous nos postes sont ouverts aux personnes en situation de handicap. title: Post-doctorat en évaluation et réduction des biais en reconstruction faciale 3D_CDD 36 mois
description: Grande école d’ingénieur généraliste de l’IMT-Institut Mines-Télécom, premier groupe d’écoles d’ingénieurs de France, IMT Atlantique a pour ambition d’accompagner les transitions, de former des ingénieurs responsables et mettre l'excellence scientifique et technique au service de l'enseignement, de la recherche et de l'innovation. Dans le cadre du projet ANR-DFG 3DFaceBias , qui vise à mesurer, expliquer et réduire les écarts de précision dans la reconstruction faciale 3D à partir de photographies 2D, nous recrutons un Post-doctorat en évaluation et réduction des biais en reconstruction faciale 3D au sein de notre département Data Science sur le campus de Brest. Vous piloterez les travaux d’IMT Atlantique sur l’évaluation et la réduction des biais en reconstruction faciale 3D avec pour principales missions : Auditer les biais de la reconstruction faciale 3D à partir d'images 2D. Identifier les sources de biais par une analyse centrée sur les données. Concevoir et évaluer des stratégies centrées sur les données pour atténuer les biais. Contribuer aux activités transverses du projet. Consultez la fiche de poste détaillée ✔️ Vous avez une solide expérience en recherche expérimentale et en méthodes statistiques avancées. Votre expertise inclut la conception d’expériences contrôlées, l’évaluation des incertitudes, la gestion des facteurs de confusion, ainsi que la prévention des fuites d’information (data leakage). ✔️ Maîtrisant Python et un framework comme PyTorch, vous savez modifier, tester et déboguer du code de recherche avec efficacité.
