title: Senior Product Owner - Social Connection & Loyalty
description: Our Team We believe travel can create citizens of the world. We spark moments of connection and transformation, giving people the freedom to explore openly and shape their own story. With colleagues from more than 50 countries, our diversity sparks curiosity, insight, and a culture of openness, essential to understanding our travellers and one another. We work in a flexible hybrid model from our Utrecht HQ and our homes across the Netherlands. Just as travel is about discovery, we’re looking for people who want to go one stop further, joining a journey that inspires personal transformation through train travel. We’re on the search for… At Interrail, we help people experience Europe by train. We are looking for a PO to make that experience more connected, rewarding, and transformative. You will lead the strategy and roadmap for products that bring travellers together, recognise their journeys, and give them more reasons to return to Interrail and make them feel a sense of belonging. From social connection, community, to loyalty, referrals, and gamification, you will create experiences that turn a great trip into a lasting relationship with our brand. Some of these experiences will also support informal learning, intercultural exchange and personal development through travel. You will work closely with Design, Engineering, Data, Lifecycle Marketing, Customer Experience, and Commercial teams to build products that customers genuinely value and that strengthen engagement, retention, advocacy, and lifetime value. The role exists to solve one fundamental challenge: how do we create meaningful reasons for travellers to remain engaged with Interrail between journeys, and return not only to travel again, but to participate, contribute and advocate for the brand? What you’ll be doing Define and deliver the product vision, strategy, and roadmap for community, loyalty, referrals, and gamification. Own the digital loyalty experience and economics. Design products that enable meaningful interactions and real-world connections between travellers, while maintaining a safe, respectful and inclusive environment. Develop product experiences that encourage cultural exchange, curiosity and informal learning through social interaction. Work with Institutional Initiatives to translate relevant programme objectives into engaging traveller experiences, where these align with the broader Social Connection & Loyalty product strategy. Build experiences that help travellers connect, share, contribute, and discover useful travel content. Create loyalty, recognition, and referral journeys that encourage advocacy and repeat travel. Work with Design, CX, and Engineering to deliver simple, scalable web and mobile experiences. Partner with Lifecycle Marketing to connect campaigns with relevant in-product journeys. Use customer insight, behavioural data, AI, and experimentation (A/B testing) to identify opportunities and personalise experiences. Work with Customer Support and relevant partners to ensure community experiences are safe, trustworthy, and useful. Define and track success metrics across Traveller Participation Rate, engagement, retention, repeat purchase, referrals, loyalty participation, and customer lifetime value. What we’re looking for It's already a possible match when you share the same mindset as us, being forward-thinking, results-driven, caring and embracing diversity. In terms of your experience and skills: 8+ years of product management experience, with experience building and scaling B2C digital products across web and mobile. A track record of building products that improve engagement, retention, loyalty, community participation, or growth. Demonstrated experience building social, community-driven or interaction-led digital products, with a strong understanding of how to create meaningful interactions between users. Experience owning a product area from strategy and discovery through delivery, scaling, and optimization. Experience designing for trust, safety, inclusion and healthy community participation, particularly where digital experiences facilitate interaction between people who do not already know one another. Strong qualitative user research and behavioral insight skills, with the ability to understand why people connect, participate and contribute, not only what they click or use. Strong product judgment and the ability to turn customer insight into simple, valuable experiences. Confidence using data, experimentation, and product metrics to make decisions and measure incremental impact. Experience working closely with Design, Engineering, Data, Marketing, and other business stakeholders. A thoughtful approach to customer trust, privacy, safety, and responsible engagement design. Comfort working in a fast-moving, international environment. Nice to have: Experience translating institutional, educational or social-impact objectives into compelling consumer-facing digital experiences. An interest in travel, rail, and the ways people discover and share experiences. Experience with user-generated content, personalisation, CRM platforms, or notification systems. Our offer We offer a flexible hybrid model that combines remote work with in-office days each week, enhancing teamwork and connection. A complimentary NS train card to travel across the Netherlands for work and leisure. An annual free Interrail/Eurail travel pass for you and a companion, so you can explore Europe and share the same experiences as our customers. Unlimited access to OpenUp for lifestyle & well-being recommendations. Support for your well-being through a personal allowance of €1500. We provide a training allowance of €4000 to support learning opportunities relevant to your role. Variable annual bonus (target 4%), based on company and individual performance. An annual team trip across Europe to experience our product first-hand. 20 working days per year from abroad. An annual leave package of 28 days, plus study days, volunteer days, and a culture day. Salary Scale: 61, Monthly gross salary (excluding 8% allowance): €7000 - 8000 (full-time) based on experience. Curious to apply? Apply directly via our website ( https://www.interrail.com/en/careers ). We'll ask you to share your resume in English (our business language) and tell us why you're interested in Eurail and this particular role. It doesn't hurt to be creative; we enjoy seeing your personality shine through. As part of the process, we may also ask you to complete a short assessment to showcase your skills. If we think you might be a good candidate, the next step is a relatively informal interview. For you, this is a chance to understand if Eurail is your ideal workplace, and for us, it tells us more about the value you would bring. To support fair and unbiased hiring, we use a blind recruitment process in the early stages. Personal details such as your name, date of birth, photo, contact information, social media links, gender, and nationality are hidden, allowing us to focus on your skills, experience, and potential. In the meantime… If you’re curious, why not check us out on LinkedIn and get a sense of our culture and values? Got questions? Our People & Culture team would be happy to help — just drop us a note at While you're here, explore our travel passes and get inspired for your next journey at https://www.interrail.com/en . title: Senior Silicon Validation Engineer
description: About IonQ: IonQ, Inc . [NYSE: IONQ] is the world’s leading quantum platform and merchant supplier - delivering integrated quantum solutions across computing, networking, sensing, and security. IonQ’s newest generation of quantum computers, the IonQ Tempo, is the latest in a line of cutting-edge systems that have been helping customers and partners including Amazon Web Services, and AstraZeneca achieve 20x performance results and accelerate innovation in drug discovery, materials science, financial modeling, logistics, cybersecurity, and defense. In 2025, the company achieved 99.99% two-qubit gate fidelity, setting a world record in quantum computing performance . Headquartered in College Park, Maryland, IonQ has operations in California, Colorado, Massachusetts, Tennessee, Washington, Italy, South Korea, Sweden, Switzerland, Canada, and the United Kingdom. Our quantum computing services are available through all major cloud providers, while we also meet the needs of networking and sensing customers across land, sea, air, and space. IonQ is making quantum platforms more accessible and impactful than ever before. Location: Oxford, England, UK Working pattern: Hybrid Role: We are looking for a Senior Silicon Validation Engineer to join our Cryo-CMOS IC team at IonQ Oxford. You will lead the validation and characterisation of analogue and mixed-signal ASICs for our trapped-ion quantum processors, from test planning and platform development through first-silicon bring-up, debug and system integration. This is a hands-on technical role. You will shape our validation architecture, build reusable hardware and software, and provide the evidence needed to make confident silicon acceptance decisions. The work includes room-temperature silicon validation and silicon characterisation at cryogenic temperatures (around 4 kelvin), on packaged parts, chip-on-board assemblies and bare die on a cryogenic probe station. Responsibilities: You will own validation delivery across chip and system interfaces, working closely with analogue and digital design, verification, modelling, firmware and systems engineers. You will turn requirements into measurable tests, prepare platforms before silicon arrives and resolve failures across the chip, board and software. As a Senior engineer, you will set technical standards, guide other engineers and improve coverage, repeatability and test efficiency across successive ASIC generations. Key responsibilities include: Own the silicon validation strategy, plans, acceptance criteria and readiness reviews, with traceability from block and system requirements to tests, results and unresolved risks. Present the silicon acceptance report to the Cryo-CMOS IC Lead and programme stakeholders. Lead first-silicon bring-up and characterisation of sample-and-hold and switch arrays, DACs, ADCs, references, amplifiers, switches, regulators, clocking and device-level test structures, across supply, temperature, operating modes and device variation, with sound calibration and measurement uncertainty. Develop validation boards, fixtures and reusable Python automation, instrument drivers and regression suites, addressing signal integrity, grounding, power integrity and measurement access, with version-controlled tests and reproducible data analysis. Plan and lead cryogenic measurements with specialist colleagues, including bare-die probing and the cold signal chain, and drive failures to root cause, separating silicon defects from board, firmware and test artefacts and correlating results with simulations, device models and foundry or partner data. Influence testability before tape-out, coordinate validation with external design partners, the foundry and other IonQ sites. Lead technical reviews, mentor engineers and document methods to improve throughput, data quality and reuse. Requirements: You will bring substantial experience in analogue or mixed-signal silicon validation and characterisation, with ownership of multiple silicon bring-up programmes. A degree in electrical or electronic engineering, or equivalent practical experience, is expected. You should combine hands-on laboratory skills with sound judgement on test coverage, measurement confidence and programme risk. You’d be a great fit with: Strong electronics fundamentals and experience validating precision signal chains, data converters or power-management circuits, including their digital control interfaces. Practical expertise with oscilloscopes, precision sources and meters, signal generators, spectrum and logic analysers; confidence designing reliable low-noise, low-leakage measurements. Strong Python programming for instrument control, automated testing and statistical analysis; disciplined use of Git or equivalent version control and maintainable test software. Experience designing and debugging test PCBs, reviewing layouts and working with interfaces such as SPI, I2C, JTAG and custom shift-register chains, alongside embedded firmware or FPGA-based platforms. A record of resolving complex chip, board and software interactions through structured experiments and collaboration. Experience leading technical projects, mentoring engineers and communicating evidence, uncertainty and decisions in clear written reports. Useful additional experience includes cryogenic or other extreme-temperature testing; wafer or bare-die probing; early-stage IP or test-chip evaluation; FPGA development and C/C++; circuit simulation; and production test correlation. Prior quantum computing is welcome but not required. Benefits: Be part of a team that’s shaping the future of quantum. We offer more than just a role, you’ll join a world class community of scientists, engineers and innovators working to unlock the full potential of quantum computing. We offer a range of benefits, including opportunities to further your career alongside industry leaders, a competitive salary with IonQ stock options, an annual performance bonus, generous annual leave, flexible hybrid working, private medical and dental insurance for you and your family, and much more. title: Chief Engineer Operations H/F
description: 📍 Paris / Île-de-France | Environnement Data Center | CDI | Périmètre multisite Rejoignez mon client au cœur des infrastructures critiques. Dans un contexte de forte croissance et de développement de ses infrastructures, mon client renforce son organisation Operations en France et crée un poste de Chief Engineer . Au sein d'un nouvel pôle d'expertise technique transverse , vous devenez le référent technique des opérations sur plusieurs sites stratégiques en France, avec un périmètre prioritaire couvrant notamment deux sites. Votre mission : apporter votre expertise, sécuriser les opérations et contribuer à faire progresser l'ensemble de l'organisation vers davantage de standardisation, de rigueur opérationnelle et d'excellence technique . Ce poste s'adresse à un profil expérimenté qui souhaite aller au-delà de l'expertise technique pure et jouer un rôle central dans la structuration des opérations d'un acteur Data Center en pleine croissance . Vos missions Votre rôle Le Chief Engineer intervient comme référent technique et opérationnel multisite . Vous êtes à la fois : un expert technique capable de challenger les équipes et les prestataires ; un référent opérationnel garant de la sécurisation des opérations ; un acteur transverse capable de fédérer des équipes aux profils et niveaux d'expérience différents. Vous disposez d'une véritable autorité technique : lorsque les conditions de sécurité ou de maîtrise des risques ne sont pas réunies, vous êtes capable de challenger une opération et, si nécessaire, de prononcer un NO GO sur un mode opératoire ou une intervention. Vous travaillez en étroite collaboration avec les responsables de site, qui conservent la responsabilité opérationnelle de leur périmètre. Vos principales missions 1 - Être le référent technique des infrastructures critiques Vous apportez votre expertise sur l'ensemble des infrastructures techniques du Data Center et êtes capable d'en comprendre les interactions et les impacts opérationnels. Votre périmètre couvre notamment : les infrastructures électriques HT/BT ; les systèmes de secours électrique ; les UPS / onduleurs ; les groupes électrogènes ; les infrastructures CVC / HVAC ; les systèmes de refroidissement ; la protection et la sécurité incendie ; les systèmes de contrôle-commande et infrastructures associées. Vous intervenez comme référent technique auprès des responsables de site et des équipes Operations , et êtes capable de challenger les différents interlocuteurs internes ou externes sur leurs choix et leurs pratiques. 2 - Sécuriser les opérations L'une de vos responsabilités majeures sera de garantir que les opérations réalisées sur les infrastructures critiques sont préparées et exécutées dans les meilleures conditions de sécurité et de maîtrise des risques. À ce titre, vous : challengez les modes opératoires (MOP) ; vérifiez la cohérence et l'exhaustivité des procédures ; identifiez les risques et leurs impacts potentiels ; sécurisez les opérations avant leur réalisation ; challengez les premières analyses et propositions d'intervention ; pouvez émettre un NO GO lorsqu'une opération ne présente pas les garanties nécessaires ; accompagnez les responsables de site dans la prise de décision technique ; contribuez à la mise en place de mécanismes de double vérification. Vous êtes en quelque sorte le garde-fou technique de l'organisation , avec pour objectif de sécuriser les opérations sans perdre de vue les impératifs de continuité de service. 3- Structurer et harmoniser les pratiques L'un des enjeux majeurs du poste est de contribuer à l'harmonisation des pratiques entre les différents sites. Aujourd'hui, les niveaux de maturité et les pratiques peuvent varier d'un site à l'autre. Votre rôle sera de contribuer à construire un socle commun de méthodes et de standards opérationnels . Vous serez notamment amené(e) à : structurer les processus d'exploitation ; définir et harmoniser les standards techniques ; rédiger et améliorer les procédures et modes opératoires ; mettre en place des workflows opérationnels ; contrôler leur bonne application ; identifier les écarts entre les sites ; proposer et suivre les plans d'amélioration ; partager les bonnes pratiques ; réaliser des REX multisites ; accompagner les équipes dans l'adoption des nouveaux standards. La capacité à construire et faire vivre des process sera donc aussi importante que votre expertise technique. 4- Apporter votre expertise lors des incidents critiques En cas d'incident technique complexe, vous intervenez comme référent technique auprès des équipes Facility et Operations. Vous êtes notamment amené(e) à : analyser techniquement l'incident ; identifier les causes et les impacts potentiels ; apporter votre expertise aux responsables de site ; challenger les analyses proposées ; accompagner les équipes internes et les prestataires ; contribuer à la définition des actions correctives ; participer à la résolution de l'incident ; organiser et partager les retours d'expérience à l'échelle des différents sites. Votre capacité à prendre du recul, analyser rapidement une situation complexe et apporter une réponse techniquement robuste sera essentielle. 5 - Développer une culture d'excellence opérationnelle Vous ne vous contentez pas de définir les standards : vous accompagnez les équipes dans leur appropriation. Vous serez ainsi amené(e) à : former et accompagner les équipes ; expliquer les exigences techniques et opérationnelles ; faire progresser les pratiques ; fédérer autour d'objectifs communs ; accompagner la conduite du changement ; favoriser le partage de connaissances entre les sites. Vous disposez d'une forte capacité d'influence et savez faire avancer les sujets sans nécessairement disposer d'un lien hiérarchique direct . 6 - Être l'interlocuteur technique des clients majeurs Vous serez capable de : représenter la société sur les sujets techniques ; expliquer une situation ou un incident complexe ; présenter les actions mises en œuvre ; répondre aux interrogations techniques des clients ; apporter un discours structuré et crédible sur les enjeux d'exploitation et de sécurité des infrastructures. Une organisation en construction Vous rejoindrez un pôle d'expertise technique transverse nouvellement structuré , regroupant différentes compétences destinées à accompagner les opérations et les projets. L'objectif est de créer une véritable communauté d'experts capable d'apporter son expertise à l'ensemble des sites et de faire progresser collectivement les standards d'exploitation. Vous travaillerez au quotidien avec : les responsables de site ; les équipes Facility et Operations ; les équipes projets ; les experts techniques ; les prestataires et partenaires externes ; les fonctions transverses ; les clients majeurs. Le poste est donc particulièrement transverse et nécessite une forte capacité à créer du lien entre les différentes parties prenantes . Vous avez idéalement évolué dans un environnement où les exigences en matière de procédures, de sécurité opérationnelle, de maintenance et de continuité de service sont particulièrement élevées. Une expérience dans un environnement critique comparable serait particulièrement appréciée. Votre expertise technique Vous disposez d'une excellente connaissance des infrastructures critiques et notamment : électricité HT/BT ; systèmes de secours électrique ; UPS / groupes électrogènes ; CVC / HVAC ; refroidissement ; protection incendie ; contrôle-commande ; maintenance des infrastructures critiques. Vous êtes capable de comprendre l'intégralité de l'infrastructure et les interactions entre les différents systèmes , et pas uniquement votre domaine d'expertise initial. title: QC Inspector (m/f/d)
description: Mission Brief As QC Inspector, you are responsible for verifying that incoming materials, manufactured parts, assemblies, and released products conform to drawings, specifications, workmanship standards, and quality requirements. You will perform dimensional and visual inspections, review supplier documentation, record objective evidence, and support reliable conformity decisions throughout incoming and final inspection. This role is critical to protecting product quality and production continuity. You will work closely with Incoming Inspection, Production, Metrology, Supplier Quality, Manufacturing Engineering, and Product Assurance to identify non-conformances, improve inspection methods, and ensure only compliant hardware progresses through the manufacturing flow. Your Role in Our Space Mission: Perform incoming and final inspections of parts, materials, assemblies, and associated documentation against approved drawings, specifications, and inspection plans. Conduct dimensional inspections using hand gauges, measurement equipment, microscopes, and coordinate measurement systems as applicable. Perform visual and workmanship inspections, including verification of surface condition, coating, cleaning, marking, damage, and assembly quality. Review certificates of conformity, inspection reports, material certificates, and other supplier quality documentation for completeness and compliance. Record inspection results and maintain accurate, traceable quality and product acceptance documentation. Identify, segregate, and report non-conforming products and support technical clarification, containment, and disposition activities. Create and improve inspection checklists, measurement plans, and inspection instructions for incoming and final inspection. Develop and optimize measurement programs using applicable metrology software and equipment. Support supplier quality requests, source-related investigations, and supplier qualification activities with inspection evidence and technical input. Collaborate with Production, Engineering, Metrology, and Quality teams to resolve inspection issues and improve product conformity. Ensure inspection and measurement equipment is used correctly and remains within valid calibration status. Contribute to continuous improvement, standardization, and quality-at-source initiatives across manufacturing operations. Qualification Checklist Completed technical vocational training in quality inspection, machining, mechanics, mechatronics, metrology, or a comparable technical discipline. Practical experience in quality inspection, incoming inspection, final inspection, metrology, or manufacturing quality within a technical production environment. Ability to read and interpret complex engineering drawings, geometric tolerances, specifications, and inspection requirements. Hands-on experience with calipers, micrometers, height gauges, comparators, microscopes, and other dimensional inspection equipment. Experience with coordinate measurement systems and metrology software such as PolyWorks, ZEISS CALYPSO, PC-DMIS, or equivalent is advantageous. Knowledge of measurement uncertainty, calibration principles, traceability, and controlled inspection documentation. AUKOM Level 1 or comparable metrology qualification is advantageous. Experience inspecting aerospace, precision-machined, propulsion, valve, composite, or other safety-critical hardware is beneficial. title: Senior Propulsion Engineer - Combustion Devices (m/f/d)
description: Mission Brief You will be a senior technical contributor within Combustion Devices, responsible for high-fidelity combustion CFD and the physical understanding required to design, assess and mature liquid rocket engine combustion hardware. You will apply reactive-flow simulation, combustion fundamentals and test correlation to injectors, preburners , gas generators, ignition systems and main combustion chambers, ensuring that designs are performant, stable, thermally robust and ready for manufacture and hot-fire testing. Your Role in Our Space Mission: Own and execute CFD analyses of reacting flows in liquid rocket engine combustion devices, from model definition and meshing through solution, verification, validation and technical recommendation. Develop and apply premixed , partially premixed and non-premixed combustion models for rocket-relevant propellant systems and operating conditions. Perform steady and transient RANS/URANS and, where justified, scale-resolving simulations such as LES to investigate mixing, ignition, flame stabilisation, combustion efficiency and unsteady heat release. Model injector and chamber flows including atomisation, evaporation, multiphase effects, real-gas behaviour, conjugate heat transfer and wall heat flux where relevant to the design question. Assess combustion stability and operability, including flame dynamics, pressure oscillations, injector coupling, acoustic interaction, chugging and high-frequency instability risks. Build robust CFD workflows in Simcenter STAR-CCM+ and Ansys Fluent, including geometry preparation, meshing strategies, solver setup, automation, post-processing and model-quality documentation. Correlate simulations against component, cold-flow and hot-fire test data; quantify model uncertainty and clearly define the limits of predictive confidence. Translate CFD results into practical design decisions for injectors, chambers, preburners, gas generators, igniters, cooling concepts and combustion-device interfaces. Work closely with design, thermal, structures, materials, test, engine systems and manufacturing teams to converge combustion-device designs and resolve multidisciplinary issues. Plan analysis and validation activities, review work from colleagues and external partners, and contribute to technical reviews, development roadmaps and risk-retirement plans. Advance combustion modelling methods, engineering standards and reusable best practices across the Propulsion organisation. Qualification Checklist MSc or PhD in aerospace engineering, mechanical engineering, chemical engineering, computational engineering or a comparable technical discipline. Typically 5–10 years of professional experience in rocket propulsion, with substantial hands-on responsibility for combustion CFD and combustion-device development. Deep knowledge of fundamental combustion physics, chemical kinetics, flame structure, turbulence–chemistry interaction, ignition and extinction phenomena. Demonstrated experience modelling reactive premixed and non-premixed flows under rocket-engine-relevant pressure, temperature and mixture-ratio conditions. Advanced proficiency in Simcenter STAR-CCM+ and/or Ansys Fluent for complex reacting-flow simulations; strong capability in meshing, solver selection, convergence assessment and post-processing. Strong understanding of liquid rocket engine combustion devices, particularly injectors, preburners or gas generators, main combustion chambers, igniters and associated thermal environments. Experience with CFD verification and validation, mesh and time-step sensitivity, uncertainty assessment and correlation to experimental or hot-fire data. Proficiency in Python, MATLAB or a comparable language for automation, data reduction and engineering analysis. Strong technical ownership, first-principles judgement, clear communication and professional fluency in English. Bonus Skills Experience with LES or other scale-resolving methods for combustion dynamics, instability and injector–chamber coupling. Experience with spray combustion, atomisation, evaporation, real-fluid or real-gas thermodynamics, conjugate heat transfer, radiation or reacting multiphase flows. Experience supporting rocket-engine hot-fire campaigns, defining instrumentation needs and diagnosing combustion anomalies from test data. Experience developing custom models, user-defined functions, reduced chemical mechanisms, HPC workflows or automated CFD pipelines. Dabei verstehst du wie du ein trockenes Thema wie Cybersecurity, an den deutschen Mittelstand bringst. Kreativität: Du hast eigene Ideen und Lust, sie auszuprobieren. Und wenn etwas beim ersten Versuch noch nicht funktioniert, probierst du es eben anders. Sprache: Sehr gute Deutschkenntnisse in Wort und Schrift. Teamgeist: Du arbeitest gerne mit anderen zusammen, teilst deine Ideen und hast genauso viel Spaß daran, gemeinsam etwas auf die Beine zu stellen. Dein Kommunikationsstil: Locker, kreativ und abwechslungsreich und hast keine Scheu Fragen zu stellen, genau das was wir suchen! Portfolio: Du hast vlt. sogar schon eigene Videos, Uni-Projekte, einen Social-Media-Account oder andere Arbeiten, die du uns zeigen kannst? Ein Plus aber kein Muss Interesse an Tech- oder Security-Themen, das Fachwissen bringen wir mit, du übersetzt es in Content. Benefits Warum JAMORIE genau der richtige Ort für dich ist Wir könnten hier jetzt die üblichen Benefits hinschreiben. Kennst du alles. Deshalb lieber das, was dahintersteckt: Urlaub: Auch als Werkstudent. Urlaub ist Urlaub, deswegen bekommst du nicht automatisch weniger davon, nur weil du neben dem Studium arbeitest Geburtstag frei: Das ist dein Ehrentag. Und wir finden, den darfst du gerne mit deiner Familie, deinen Freunden oder einfach auf der Couch verbringen. Weihnachten frei: Dazu zählt bei uns auch Heiligabend. Du musst da nicht noch einen halben Tag arbeiten, wenn du nicht möchtest. Transparente Vergütung: Du bekommst 20€/h und zusätzlich jeden Monat einen 50€ Gutschein über Probonio, den du dir bei verschiedenen teilnehmenden Partnern selbst einlösen kannst. Remote in ganz Deutschland: Du kannst arbeiten, von wo du möchtest. Deine Arbeitszeit stimmen wir flexibel mit deinem Studium & Bedürfnissen ab. Offsite: Neben unseren Sommer- und Weihnachtsevents, packen wir als Team mindestens einmal im Jahr die Koffer und reisen gemeinsam irgendwohin. Ja, auch als Werkstudent. Denn Team ist Team, egal ob Werkstudent, Senior oder Geschäftsführer Teamevents: Wir treffen uns mehrmals im Jahr, sowohl online als auch offline, verbringen Zeit miteinander und haben als Team gemeinsam Spaß. Dann bleib doch einfach**.** Ob für deine Abschlussarbeit oder danach direkt bei JAMORIE, wenn es für beide Seiten passt, finden wir gerne einen Weg. Mittendrin, statt nur dabei: Wir sind ein kleines Team. Du arbeitest direkt mit uns und nicht allein, du bekommst Raum, um deine kreativen Ideen einzubringen und Dinge auszuprobieren. Es gibt keine fünf Hierachieebenen zwischen deiner Idee und der Umsetzung. Wir wollen nicht, dass du dich bei uns wie „nur die Werkstudentin“ oder „nur der Werkstudent“ fühlst. Du bist Teil des Teams. WE MEAN IT Bei JAMORIE arbeiten Menschen mit verschiedenen Hintergründen, Erfahrungen und Persönlichkeiten zusammen, das macht unser junges Team so besonders. Hier kannst du sein, wie du bist und wir finden dich trotzdem großartig! Dare to be different. Perfektion ist nicht unser Anspruch. Wir sind auf der Reise, machen Fehler und lernen kontinuierlich. Our wide range of Global Employee Networks connect people from across the organization, supporting career development and providing forums for individuals to share experiences on topics they're passionate about. Here at Jensen Hughes, our clients trust us to respond rapidly and deliver conclusive reports, of the highest technical standard. You will undertake on-site fire inspections/surveys (particularly during the construction phase as well as the operational phase) and will be involved in undertaking fire stopping and fire compartmentation surveys, fire door inspections and from time to time fire risk assessments. You will ultimately support the fire safety disciplines at Jensen Hughes. You will report direct to our Lead Surveyor and Divisional Director. Responsibilities Carrying out active and passive fire protection systems surveys and technical reports Compliance assessment and understanding of the main British Fire Safety Legislation and standards applied to different building occupancies, such as Approved Document B (ADB), BS9999, BS9991 & BS7974 etc. Updating the passive fire protection technical knowledge base as industry updates are implemented. Undertaking third party oversight role of fire stopping and fire compartmentation installations. Ability to liaise with product manufacturers and discuss tested details and primary test evidence which supports the installations in the field of application on-site. Undertaking visual fire doors inspections and confirming any non-conformities with reference to BS8214. Successfully managing your own client base and exceeding client expectations. Providing in-house CPD presentations when the need arises in your specialist field. Keeping updated with the latest industry guidance, product literature and sharing this knowledge with the wider organisation as part of continuous improvement. Routinely travel to client sites for site surveys and meetings will be required on a regular basis with overnight stays sometimes required. Requirements and Qualifications Degree educated in Building Surveying, Fire Safety Management or other similar discipline. Full UK driving licence and access to your own private vehicle. Understanding of fire safety design and guidance for different building types. Experience undertaking fire compartmentation surveys for internal fire stopping installations and advising the contractor based on the relevant manufacturer's literature. The ability to author in depth technical reports utilising the information obtained during the site inspection using both bespoke digital fire protection software and Microsoft Word. The ability to input survey data utilising an app on a mobile phone or tablet device, undertake works independently and manage your own workload as required. A good knowledge of the Fire Risk Assessment process is desirable but not essential and a general appreciation of general risk/hazards within the built environment. An advanced knowledge of construction methods, forms of construction. Knowledge of internal passive fire protection products, fire testing regimes and the products field of application with reference to manufacturers installation details. An advanced knowledge of refurbishment schemes and managing/advising Contractors on-site. The ability to have an elevated attention to detail when reviewing information and during the surveying process on-site. The ability to obtain the pertinent information from the relevant parties in order to formulate robust reporting. title: Senior Product Manager – JetBrains Air (Agentic Development in IDEs)
description: Are you comfortable navigating complex software systems, working with coding agents, and defining what makes developer tools actually useful? Do you want to shape how developers and AI work together inside IDEs? About JetBrains We create intelligent software development tools for developers and teams. More than 15 million users, over 300,000 companies, and 88 of the Fortune Global Top 100 rely on our products to solve real, complex problems. Our mission is simple: make development teams more productive and AI adoptable at scale. What you’ll do Agentic development is changing how software gets built. Developers no longer just chat with AI – they delegate tasks, run parallel agent sessions, and steer autonomous changes. As agents take on more work, reviewing and owning the output is becoming the hardest part of the process. JetBrains Air is our open system for agentic development. It brings tools like Codex, GitHub Copilot, Claude Agent, Gemini, and Junie directly into JetBrains IDEs, providing an agentic-first user experience. We are looking for a Senior Product Manager to lead key areas of Air. You’ll take ownership of high-impact workflows, work closely with cross-functional teams (including software engineers, designers, ML researchers, analysts, DevRel, and product marketing), and turn technical complexity into clear product direction. Day to day, you will: Take end-to-end ownership of key parts of Air in JetBrains IDEs, driving work from problem framing and discovery to delivery, adoption, and iteration. Define and refine core agentic workflows, including task delegation, session monitoring, steering, and code review. Model complex user flows, system states, permissions, and integration schemes to guide engineering and design decisions. Maintain a transparent roadmap that balances quick improvements with long-term strategic investments. Define telemetry, design experiments, analyze product data, and make evidence-based roadmap decisions. Study how developers interact with leading AI agents and tools to inform product priorities. Engage with the Agent Client Protocol (ACP) ecosystem and collaborate with partners building on it. Partner with enterprise sales and support teams to address governance, privacy, and control requirements. What you’ll bring A systems-thinking mindset that easily breaks down complex architectures, workflows, and dependencies. A data-driven approach to product decisions, including hands-on experience querying and analyzing telemetry. Active personal experience using coding agents and clear perspectives on where current AI tools succeed and fail. Strong product intuition for complex technical user experiences and developer workflows. Clear, concise, and collaborative communication skills with the ability to explain complex technical concepts simply and build alignment across diverse groups of stakeholders. Comfort navigating fast-changing technical landscapes with high ambiguity. What you’ll need Proven experience shipping end-user products as a product manager or in a similar role. Strong technical grounding in software development workflows, including IDEs, git, code review, CI/CD, and package management. A hands-on technical background sufficient to collaborate closely with software and ML engineers. An understanding of core AI and agent concepts, including tool use, protocols (MCP/ACP), context retrieval, evaluations, and latency/cost trade-offs. The ability to write SQL or Python to analyze product metrics and experiment results independently. Fluency in English, both written and spoken. What success looks like In your first 6 to 12 months, success in this role means: Driving measurable growth in active Air users and improving weekly/monthly retention (D7/D30). Increasing agent session completion rates and the proportion of agent-generated changes accepted by developers. Establishing clear, telemetry-backed decisions across your product roadmap areas. Delivering validated product hypotheses consistently each quarter. Contributing directly to JetBrains AI revenue growth and overall IDE value. Why join JetBrains? title: Junior Marketing & Social Media Manager (m/w/d)
description: DU LIEBST MARKETING? WIR LIEBEN ES, MENSCHEN ZU BEWEGEN. Dann lass uns gemeinsam etwas bewegen! Stell dir vor, deine Ideen und deine Kreativität tragen dazu bei, dass Menschen weniger Schmerzen haben, nach Verletzungen oder Operationen wieder aktiv werden und Sportler ihre Leistungsfähigkeit zurückgewinnen. Oder dass Menschen bereits heute etwas für ihre Gesundheit tun, um morgen möglichst lange fit, beweglich und voller Lebensfreude zu bleiben. Genau dafür steht K-Active. Und vielleicht bald auch du! WER WIR SIND K-Active ist weit mehr als ein Unternehmen für Therapie-, Medizin- und Sportprodukte. Seit über 25 Jahren begleiten wir Therapeuten, Ärzte, Trainer, Sportler und gesundheitsbewusste Menschen – vom Freizeitsportler bis zum Olympiateilnehmer. Unsere Leidenschaft gilt der Therapie, Rehabilitation, Regeneration, Diagnostik, Prävention und Longevity. Was uns antreibt? Menschen zu helfen, ihre Gesundheit, Beweglichkeit und Lebensqualität zu verbessern – und ihre persönlichen Ziele zu erreichen. Dafür stehen wir mit innovativen Produkten, neuen Ideen, internationaler Erfahrung und einem Team, das mit Herz und Begeisterung zusammenarbeitet. DEINE MISSION BEI UNS Wir suchen keinen Menschen, der einfach nur Beiträge postet. Wir suchen einen kreativen Kopf, der unsere Begeisterung nach außen trägt. Du erkennst spannende Geschichten, entwickelst Ideen und machst aus unseren Produkten, Partnerschaften und Projekten Inhalte, die Menschen wirklich erreichen. Das kannst du bei uns bewegen: Du entwickelst kreative Social-Media-Inhalte für Instagram, Facebook, LinkedIn und weitere Kanäle. Du erstellst Fotos, Videos, Reels und Kampagnen, die begeistern und echten Mehrwert bieten. Du begleitest unsere Sportpartner, Therapeuten, Veranstaltungen und Produktneuheiten. Du gestaltest Marketingaktionen, Newsletter und Inhalte für unsere Onlineshops mit. Du bringst eigene Ideen ein, erkennst Trends und entwickelst unsere Kommunikation weiter. Du analysierst den Erfolg unserer Maßnahmen und hilfst, unsere Reichweite und Markenbekanntheit auszubauen. DAS BRINGST DU MIT Wir suchen vor allem Persönlichkeit, Kreativität und Begeisterung. Du hast Erfahrung oder eine passende Ausbildung im Bereich Marketing, Social Media oder Kommunikation, ein gutes Gespür für Bilder, Sprache und Menschen und Freude daran, kreative Inhalte selbst umzusetzen. title: Data Scientist
description: Do you want to work out how you actually measure whether an AI system is doing a good job, and then make it better? We're looking for a sharp, analytical data scientist to own the evaluation and quality loop of our AutoQA product. You can be early in your career (recent graduates with strong LLM fundamentals are welcome), we have room and a clear path for you to grow. In a nutshell Join a fast-growing SaaS company in an international environment (steep learning curve guaranteed). Own a high-impact problem: making LLM-powered quality assurance measurably accurate at scale. Sit at the intersection of AI and CX, working directly with enterprise customers and their real-world QA rubrics. Grow into a Senior Data Scientist, AI Engineer, or ML Engineer role. We invest in progression. Enjoy the perks: flexible hours, open holiday policy, an office in the heart of Amsterdam with hybrid flexibility, visa sponsorship, great gear, workations, and team events. About Kaizo At Kaizo, we build a performance development and quality platform for customer support teams. Our AutoQA product uses LLMs to review support conversations against each customer's own quality rubric, automatically and at scale. Behind it sits a microservices-based stream processing platform handling over 200 million events per day (Kafka, Kubernetes on Google Cloud, ElasticSearch, MongoDB, BigQuery), and an LLMOps stack built around LangSmith for experimentation, prompt management, and tracing. The hard part isn't calling an LLM. It's knowing, with evidence, how well the system performs on every customer's unique rubric, and having a reliable, repeatable way to improve it. That's where you come in. What you'll focus on Translate customer rubrics into AutoQA instructions. Work with real customer quality criteria and turn them into precise, testable instructions that LLMs can score reliably. Run experiments that move accuracy. Design and execute evaluation experiments on large, representative datasets using LangSmith and BigQuery, and track quality with our performance metrics. Build the datasets that make evaluation possible. Curate raw production data into golden datasets with balanced coverage, and generate synthetic data to cover the rare cases that matter most. QA is a discipline of rare occurrences: distributions are skewed, positives are scarce, and resourcefulness beats volume. Build LLM-as-a-judge pipelines to assess system quality internally and make evaluation repeatable. Make results actionable. Your experiments should end in a decision: change a prompt, adjust which tools the system uses, surface context the AI is missing, or flag where new capabilities are needed. You'll work with the AI team to ship those decisions. Evaluate across the full stack. Beyond scoring quality, you'll help validate retrieval (RAG/IR), tool calling, and speech pipelines (transcription and diarization quality). Join customer calls with the team to understand how QA leaders define quality, and feed what you learn back into the product. What you'll grow into Shaping how customers monitor quality themselves, catch drift, and keep their AutoQA setup improving over time. Smarter categorization and routing of conversations to power analytics and get the right tickets to the right evaluation. A solid understanding of how LLMs work and hands-on experience prompting them for accuracy (coursework, thesis, internships, or side projects all count; production experience is a bonus). Good applied statistics: experiment design, classifier evaluation, precision/recall trade-offs, and working with heavily imbalanced data. Strong Python skills and fluency with the standard data toolkit (Pandas, NumPy, Jupyter). SQL is a plus. An analytical, evidence-first mindset: you'd rather measure than assume. Product sense and empathy for end users. You'll be building for QA managers and support agents, not just for benchmarks. Excellent written and verbal communication. You'll present findings to the team and join customer conversations. 0 to 2 years of industry experience. Recent graduates with strong relevant work are encouraged to apply. A team player who's comfortable wearing multiple hats. We're an early-stage company and things move fast. Bonus points for: Experience with LangSmith or similar LLMOps/evaluation tooling Google Cloud Platform, BigQuery, Docker, or Kubernetes Speech/audio processing or ASR evaluation Fine-tuning or building synthetic datasets for LLMs Who you'll work with You'll join our AI team (two data scientists, an AI engineer, and an ML engineer) and collaborate closely with our data engineers, frontend engineers, designer, product manager, and CX teams. You'll have mentorship from day one and real ownership fast. What's in it for you? An office in the heart of Amsterdam, with the flexibility of hybrid working Visa sponsorship available for eligible candidates Great office gear: MacBook, tools, desk, chair, whatever you need Flexible working schedule and an open holiday policy Fun workations and team events A clear growth path into Senior Data Scientist, AI Engineer, or ML Engineer roles Find Jobs in Netherlands on Arbeitnow

title: Google Cloud Platform Engineer
description: Are you excited by the idea of architecting and managing cloud infrastructure that powers complex web applications and data processing systems? Can you design and implement scalable, secure, and cost-effective solutions using Google Cloud Platform services? And can you do all of this while maintaining operational excellence and reliability? Then don't wait another minute to apply! 🧑‍💻 What we are doing? Kaizo aims to actively guide employees towards achieving their goals and making an impact at their companies. We are building a performance development platform for customer support teams that leverages gamification and AI to improve operational efficiency, elevate teams' performance and retention with actionable goals. We are a product-led, fast-growing SaaS company with a diverse team and a globally active customer base. Kaizo is leveraging gamification and machine learning to make the daily work experience for customer support agents more engaging, fun and productive. We run our entire infrastructure on Google Cloud Platform, managing Kubernetes clusters that handle 200+ million events daily, with data flowing through Kafka streams and being stored in Elasticsearch and MongoDB. Our cloud architecture is designed around GCP best practices to create a resilient, auto-scaling infrastructure that supports our microservices ecosystem and data processing pipelines. 🗓️ What are your 12 labours here? Designing and implementing cloud infrastructure solutions in a fast-paced startup environment Managing and optimizing GCP services Building Infrastructure as Code using Terraform and implementing CI/CD pipelines with Github actions Working with development teams to architect scalable, secure, and cost-effective cloud solutions Monitoring system performance, implementing observability solutions, and ensuring high availability across all services Analyzing infrastructure needs, suggesting improvements to our cloud architecture with freedom to implement innovative solutions Implementing and maintaining security best practices to ensure a secure and protected cloud environment, including IAM policies, network security, and compliance frameworks 🧑‍💻 What you bring to the table? 3+ years of professional experience with Google Cloud Platform services and cloud infrastructure management Strong experience with Kubernetes, Docker containerization, and orchestration at scale Experience managing and scaling Kafka clusters, Elasticsearch deployments, and MongoDB instances in production environments Proficiency with Infrastructure as Code tools (Terraform, Deployment Manager) and CI/CD pipelines Experience with monitoring and observability tools (New relic, Logging, APM solutions) Knowledge of networking, security best practices, and cost optimization in cloud environments Experience working within cross-functional teams, collaborating with Product Managers, developers, and DevOps engineers BS/Masters degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or equivalent experience 🏆 What's in it for you? title: Senior Marketing Specialist
description: Senior Marketing Manager Location: Europe, Amsterdam preferred (hybrid or remote possible) Competitive salary Start date: as soon as possible Let’s be blunt: Kaizo doesn’t have a real marketing engine yet. We’ve had marketers before, but the company we are today is a different company. Over the past 18 months we’ve signed enterprise customers like Canva, Instacart, UiPath and Indeed. We’ve also rebuilt our product around a new reality: support teams now run on a mix of human agents and AI agents, and someone has to check the quality of both. Kaizo is the independent Agentic QA layer for that hybrid workforce. We work across helpdesks and Customer Service platforms, and we don’t build AI agents of our own, so we have no reason to mark our own homework. The problem is that the market doesn’t know this yet. We’re the customer service industry’s best-kept secret. The website architecture has just been rebuilt, but the content is outdated and doesn’t tell today’s story. We have strong enterprise customer stories that nobody has written up. Inbound is no longer enough. AI search has changed how buyers find vendors, so pipeline now has to come from outbound, partners, events and reputation. We’re going to the field and starting to attend international events. Sales doesn’t have all the decks, battlecards and collateral it needs. Outbound has started, and it needs content behind it. That’s where you come in. What this role really is We need a senior marketer who wants to build from scratch, and who sees a blank page as an opportunity, not a threat. You’ll be the one who: Brings the website to life so it reflects who we are today and gets found, by people and by AI search. Turns our enterprise wins into case studies and references that open new doors. Owns our review and analyst presence : a proper G2 strategy, competitor and comparison pages that convert, and support for analyst relations. Gives Sales and CS the content, one-pagers, battlecards and decks that win deals and renewals. Starts product marketing : positioning, launches, and clear messaging on AutoQA, Agentic QA, Insights and AI Coaching for customers and prospects. Builds our brand through thought leadership , PR and executive content on the future of CX quality in an AI-agent world. Owns our social channels and online reputation . Defines and runs a field marketing plan, so Kaizo shows up at the international events that matter to our enterprise ICP. Works with Sales on outbound and partner campaigns , including our helpdesk and Customer Service ecosystem partners. You won’t inherit a polished machine. You’ll be the architect, the builder and the driver of Kaizo’s marketing. The deal Location: Amsterdam preferred, flexible across Europe, hybrid or remote possible. Reporting: directly to Thibaud, Co-CEO, as part of the commercial leadership team. Real ownership, a fast feedback loop with Sales and Product, and a seat at the table where positioning gets decided. Why this matters Marketing is the missing piece in Kaizo’s growth engine. The product is there, the enterprise customers are there and the deals are there. Now the market needs to know it, and we need demand that scales. If you succeed, your fingerprints will be all over Kaizo’s next growth chapter: From a handful of enterprise logos → recognised category voice From inbound dependency → repeatable, multi-channel pipeline From scrappy content → thought leadership → If you’re looking for a comfortable role with a big team, a big budget and playbooks already written, this isn’t it. → If you want to build the marketing engine that takes Kaizo from great product to visible market leader, let’s talk. Who you are A content-first marketer. Storytelling is your edge, not growth hacks. You’ve marketed complex B2B SaaS, ideally to enterprise buyers with long sales cycles and buying committees. You’re hands-on: you write, edit, brief designers, manage freelancers and run campaigns yourself. You know what good marketing ops looks like, and you can get by with lean tools (we run on HubSpot). You understand how AI search is changing B2B discovery, and you know how to adapt SEO and content to it. Your English is native or near-native. Everything we publish has to read sharp and professional. Bonus: AI, QA and CX excite you, and acronyms don’t scare you. You’re keen to learn our product, our customers’ pain points and the trends on both the CX and QA sides. Bonus: experience with field events, G2 or analyst relations, or partner and ecosystem marketing. Equal opportunities At Kaizo, we believe diversity drives innovation. We’re committed to an inclusive environment where everyone feels respected, supported and able to do their best work. We welcome applications from people of all backgrounds, regardless of age, gender identity, race, sexual orientation, disability, religion or beliefs. If you’re excited about this role but don’t meet every requirement, we’d still love to hear from you. Find Jobs in Netherlands on Arbeitnow

Kaluza is the Energy Intelligence Platform, turning energy complexity into seamless coordination. We help energy companies overcome today's challenges while accelerating the shift to a clean, electrified future. Leveraging Data, AI, and real-time decision-making we turn energy complexity into growth opportunities for our partners. By combining predictive algorithms with human-centred design, Kaluza makes clean energy dependable and affordable. With teams across Europe, Asia and Australia, and a joint venture with Mitsubishi Corporation in Japan, we power leading companies including OVO, AGL and ENGIE, as well as innovators like Volvo and Volkswagen. What will I be doing? This is a global leadership role accountable for how clients experience Kaluza day to day. Reporting to the VP Product & Tech Operations, you'll run three global functions and hold global accountability for client support and SLA performance across every client and region: Client Support (incl. Incident & Problem Management) - our client-facing service desk, owning triage and first-contact resolution, incident response and the client/product-team relationship. Kaluza Platform Performance Assurance (KPPA) - our neutral source of truth on platform performance, monitoring contractual SLAs and journey health per client. Kaluza Product Specialists (KPS) - Global retail-energy experts fixing broken journeys and operational gaps outside core platform coverage - driving an automation-by-default approach across all client brands You'll lead the practice / craft globally, set the strategy and standard for how each operates, and be the steady, credible presence clients and colleagues rely on - from a board-level service review to a live Sev1. Specifically, you'll: Client Support, Incident & Problem Management Own incident response end to end - severity, Major Incident command, root cause analysis, client communication and resolution within contractual SLAs. Manage incoming support requests. Own Problem Management, driving root-cause remediation and reducing the rate and duration of incidents. Keep support frictionless - shielding Product & Engineering from noise while closing the loop with clients, and making sure postmortems land as real systemic change. SLA & Performance Assurance (KPPA) Own global monitoring of contractual SLAs, KPIs and performance metrics as the agreed source of truth per client. Run the assurance loop - prevent, diagnose, treat - and coordinate performance reporting into Client Service Reviews and senior leadership, raising events when performance deviates. Hold the line on data integrity (Datadog, Jira, Databricks) and embed Kaluza's Global Standard SLAs consistently across regions. Own the commercial relationship, budget and roadmap with our key Operational tooling vendors Provide oversight and inputs on commercial conversations related to client reporting of performance. Operational Resolution & Product Specialists (KPS) Own the processes that fix broken journeys and coverage gaps across all of our client brands, including new clients as we grow. Balance scheduled and ad-hoc work while keeping a safe, well-governed operational estate. Feed recurring manual interventions back to Product & Tech as signals for systemic fixes, and drive down manual effort through automation and AI. Across all three, you'll be genuinely AI-native - pushing AI into support, assurance and operations so each function does more with less - and you'll operate fluently at every altitude, staying neutral, evidence-led and a steady presence under pressure. About You Ideally you'll have/be: An accomplished operations and support leader with a strong track record. A builder, not an executor - you define what good looks like, take full accountability, and go looking for what you need rather than waiting for a brief. Genuinely AI-native - AI feels like leverage, and you actively push it into support, assurance and operational delivery. Steady in ambiguity - nimble, sharp and decisive in a live incident, and a steady presence clients and colleagues rely on. Experienced leading client support, service operations or service management at scale, ideally across multiple regions and enterprise clients. Fluent in incident and problem management (severity and Major Incident command, postmortem culture, root-cause remediation) and in managing against contractual SLAs. Able to understand, or quickly master, retail-energy operations and the operational reality of running processes around a platform. What will set you apart Comfortable with the data and tooling of assurance - SLAs, KPIs, observability (Datadog), Jira Service Management, and BI/warehouse tooling (Databricks/BigQuery) - enough to challenge the numbers, not just receive them. A credible partner to senior leadership and C-level clients, especially in a tense service review or live incident. A strong people leader and coach across multiple disciplines, able to build a self-solving, high-performing culture. Committed to radical candour and customer centricity, with experience scaling a high-growth SaaS business. Where you'll work We offer flexible working, with an expectation of 3 days a week in the office. This gives us the best of both: real time together to collaborate and build relationships, with the flexibility to work in the way that suits you best the rest of the week. Kaluza Values Here at Kaluza we have five core values that guide us as a business: Play to win, Solve the real problem, Build trust every day, Own the outcome, Go further together. Our Perks Pension Scheme Discretionary Bonus Scheme Private Medical Insurance + Virtual GP Life Assurance Access to Furthr - a Climate Action app Free Mortgage Advice and Eye Tests Perks at Work - access to thousands of retail discounts 5% Flex Fund - to spend on the benefits you want most 26 days holiday Flexible Bank Holidays - Giving you an additional 8 days which you can choose to take whenever you like Progressive Leave Policy - With no qualifying service periods, including up to 26 weeks full pay for primary caregivers and 4 weeks full pay for secondary caregivers when welcoming a new addition to your family. Personal Learning Budget - Upskill, learn and grow! Home Office Budget And more! We want to build teams which represent a variety of experiences, perspectives and skills, and we recognise talent on the basis of merit and potential. We understand some people may not apply for jobs unless they tick every box. But if you're excited about joining us and think you have some of what we're looking for, even if you're not 100% sure, we'd still love to hear from you. title: AI Ops Engineer (Business Operations)
description: About Kernel Agents are starting to sell, buy and operate on behalf of companies. But before an agent can close a deal, qualify an account, route a lead or assess risk, it has to answer a basic question: which company is this? Today, that answer is messy, and no one answers it reliably. Business identity lives across CRMs, ERPs and third-party datasets full of duplicates, missing parent companies, stale addresses and incorrect enrichment. The cost shows up across the enterprise: sales teams miss revenue opportunities because they lack the right account context; operations teams take on avoidable exposure because risk signals are fragmented or wrong; and finance teams end up chasing, writing off, or defaulting on bad debt that should have been caught earlier. Humans have worked around that mess for years. Agents cannot. They need a reliable business identity layer they can trust. Kernel is building that layer: the business registry for agents. We issue a permanent Kernel ID for every business, plus the context an agent needs to act on it. Ops, data and revenue teams at Gong, Legora, Mistral, Canva and Notion already use Kernel on their own systems. Agents are next, and there will be far more of them. We have raised $20M from top VCs and operators at Plaid, OpenAI, Slack and others, and we are growing 10x YoY. The Role We’re looking for an AI Ops Engineer to build the internal systems that help Kernel scale without adding unnecessary manual work. You’ll work across GTM, Marketing, Customer Success and Operations - finding the highest-leverage problems and building practical AI-powered workflows. This is a hands-on builder role. You’ll take ideas from a vague business problem to a tool or workflow that people use, then maintain and improve it in production. You’ll choose the fastest sensible approach for each problem - coding agents, automation platforms, APIs, data pipelines or lightweight code. You’ll report to Arvin Ashrafi, Head of Finance & Operations , and partner closely with GTM, Marketing, and Customer Success leadership. What You’ll Be Doing Define how an AI-native company operates: help build Kernel’s internal playbook for using AI across GTM, Marketing, Customer Success and Operations Make our GTM team more productive: automate the repetitive work in prospecting, account research, meeting prep and CRM hygiene, so BDRs, AEs and Account Managers spend more time with customers Build internal tools and workflows: use coding agents, APIs, automation platforms, no-code tools or lightweight code Turn company data into operational leverage: connect and improve data across our systems, then put it to work in AI agents, proactive workflows and better decision-making Put AI agents to work across Kernel: give teams agents with the right context, tools and guardrails so they can move faster without sacrificing judgement or reliability Be Kernel’s own internal customer: deploy Kernel on Kernel’s CRM, improve our GTM data and turn what you learn into useful feedback for Product and Engineering Level up the team: help colleagues become confident AI users, document what works and turn successful experiments into repeatable ways of working Your First 6 Months For your first six months, you’ll focus on our sales team. You’ll sit with our BDRs, AEs and Account Managers and learn how they work day to day. Then you’ll automate everything that doesn’t need a human. That means going deep on Salesforce and our GTM stack, and owning the RevOps workflows behind them. After that, you’ll bring the same approach to Marketing, Customer Success and Operations. What You Bring A track record of shipping: you’ve built tools, automations or AI workflows that people use every day, ideally inside a small, fast-moving startup. Around 2–5 years of experience is typical, but what you’ve built matters more than your years. Ex-founders welcome Experience inside a high-growth startup, or building your own, is highly desirable Curious about sales: you’re keen to learn how our BDRs and AEs work, and how Salesforce is set up, before you build for them AI-tool obsessed: you are constantly testing new models, agents, MCPs and workflows, and you have the judgement to turn them into reliable systems that people actually adopt Strong data instincts: you can turn fragmented, messy information into reliable workflows and create feedback loops that keep it trustworthy Can’t unsee inefficiency: you see the company as a connected system; when you find a broken or unnecessarily manual process, your instinct is to understand it, build the fix and make sure it sticks ⚠️ This role may not be for you if you: Prefer deep specialization over breadth: this role means switching between projects and teams, depending on business needs Prefer steady-state work over project-based sprints: priorities will shift as the business evolves Only want “strategic” work: you will personally build the tools, clean the data and fix the workflows ❌ This role is definitely not for you if you: Need every task to be clearly scoped before starting: ambiguity and learning on the fly are constant Avoid operational grunt work or lose interest after the prototype Want to protect a 9-to-6 or a mostly remote setup: we are in the office together 4–5 days a week and the pace is high What We Offer We will do our best to offer you a ride of a lifetime. It will not be easy, but it will be thrilling. 💰 Salary: £60,000–£85,000 + equity 🗓️ 24 days holiday per year + bank holidays 🥕 £450 monthly office dinner allowance ✈️ 2 weeks work-from-anywhere 🍼 Generous parental leave policy 💼 Pension plan 💻 Top-spec equipment and central London office 🎉 Team events and dinners 🚀 Work directly with the founders to deploy AI across a fast-growing company 🏆 High-autonomy, high-trust environment with a small team shipping at pace ❤️ Team Arvin Ashrafi, Head of Finance & Operations Amin Shafi, BizOps Associate Dave Bentham, Head of Sales 🎫 Visas & Relocation Not offered for this role. Interview Process Stage 1: Screening - Intro call Stage 2: Technical - In-person case interview Stage 3: Coffee chat - In-person discussion with members of our GTM team Final Stage: Values - Interview with founders for culture and values alignment If there is mutual fit, we move to references and offer. title: Senior EHS Advisor | Finsterwalde
description: Permanent position available with a considerable portfolio of works for the next 5+ years To build your career by assisting in the delivery of ‘leading edge’ engineering projects. To work with a vibrant, agile and multi-functional team in delivering projects on time, safely, to budget and to the required quality standards. To benefit from Kirby’s Career Development Programmes that will enhance your leadership capability. To work with the best. Excellent package on offer with room for negotiations About Kirby Group Engineering Kirby Group Engineering is an international multi-disciplinary engineering services contractor and leading provider of high-value engineering services to a number of ‘blue chip’ companies. Operating across Ireland, the UK, Europe and South Africa, Kirby has become the engineering service provider of choice in growth segments such as pharmaceuticals, data centres and power transmission and distribution. Our culture is innovative, collaborative and performance focused. The successful candidate will have the opportunity to grow and develop in a company committed to developing talent and rewarding performance. Role Purpose The role of the Senior EHS Advisor is to provide Environment, Health and Safety guidance working with the project team. You will implement and maintain the Kirby management system for the project. The role is to coordinate all EHS Matters within various Project Management Teams and to report constructively all EHS matters to Project Manager. Under the direction of the EHS Manager, the EHS Advisor will be responsible for providing support to the Project Managers, supervisors and workers. This position will provide leadership and coordination of the day-to-day EHS requirements of the assigned project(s). Key Functions of the Senior EHS Advisor Provide advice, guidance, support and instruction in all EHS matters to management, safety representatives and employees (including where applicable to sub-contractors, suppliers and visitors to sites). Provide leadership through good example. Be proactive in all matters concerning the role. Identify training needs, report requirements to project team and carry out training as required. Audit and inspect projects, agree and prepare achievable corrective and preventive action plans towards compliance to and continual improvement of the EHS on the project. Report on business EHS risks, KPIs and trends accurately with data and recommend constructive actions towards continuous improvements. Ensure incidents are reported and investigations are carried out in a thorough and professional manner in order to identify root causes and corrective and preventive action plans. Ensure that Site EHS Plans, RAMS and other associated site documents are updated and compliant with statutory and other requirements and that they are reviewed on a continuous basis. EHS Advisor Responsibilities Reports to EHS Manager, Site Managers/Supervisors and Project Manager. Is conversant with the contents of the Kirby safety statement, environment manual, risk assessments, aspects & impacts, legislation and procedures. Provides advice, guidance, instruction and training in all EHS matters to management, safety representatives and employees (including where applicable to sub-contractors, suppliers and visitors to sites). Carries out internal audits and site inspections in conjunction with Site Management, recommends corrective actions, improvements and document findings. Prepares in conjunction with site management team a project specific EHS Plan, induction and Risk Assessment Method Statements (RAMS). These shall be compiled and agreed prior to work commencing and ongoing through lookaheads. Ensures that the project specific EHS Plan, induction and RAMS are up to date, reviewed periodically and communicated to all relevant persons (including clients, Main Contractor, other contractors, visitors and others who may be affected by that work). Visits each new project, sets up the necessary site safety files (Series 500 & 600), registers, abstracts of regulations, posters, SEOR program, etc., and ensures that site establishment complies with the legislation, client regulations and company regulations as a minimum. Reviews Contractor Appointments and ensures that correct appointment is carried out and that only competent contractors are used on projects. Introduces and implements effective measures aimed at the prevention of incidents at work. Reports on incidents and/or dangerous occurrences should they occur to the EHS Manager, Project Manager and Site Managers as required. Reports on areas of concern to the relevant party for correction. Persistent and serious areas of concern are to be reported immediately to line management as per (1) above. Retains evidence of communications with relevant parties. Carries out incident investigation in conjunction with site management, establishes cause of incident or dangerous occurrence and recommends method for future avoidance. Audits the company site safety file, (Series 500 & 600), makes sure that hazards/risks are regularly assessed, that control measures are implemented, that inspections are carried out and that all incidents are reported, investigated and closed out. Prepares Monthly KPI Report for their projects, issues monthly return of Site Visit Schedule, SEORs, KPIs, violations to the EHS Manager and the Business Unit Manager. Issues new SDS to EHS Manager. Provides training and information to the workforce using appropriate training aids and media as required. Issues records of training to HR to update the training matrix. Attends the regional EHS Coordination Meeting. Attends the EHS meeting with the Business Unit Manager, as required (1 per region). Attends internal and external site meetings as required – safety meetings, coordination meetings etc... Implements and promotes the company Incentive Scheme on all projects. Arranges distribution and maintenance of fully stocked first aid boxes on site. Monitors P.P.E usage and advises site management on type of protective equipment required. Issues non-conformances, commendations and disciplinary warnings both written and verbal if required or instructed to do so. Necessary requirement of the EHS Advisor 5+ Years’ Experience in similar industry. Knowledge of Electrical, Mechanical and CSA preferably. Diploma to NFQ 8 in Occupational H&S. Certificate to NFQ 6 Environmental Management. Safe Pass, (CSCS (UK)), Train the Trainer, First Aid, Training Instructor. Internal ISO14000 and ISO45000 system auditor. Experience with the Construction Regulations and CDM roles, with experience working with sub-contractors. Experience with EHS Management Systems, safety schemes and tendering e.g. ISOs, Achilles, SSiPs etc. Excellent communication skills, through presentations, reports, written and verbal. Ability to work with Kirby / client / main contractor Safety and Project teams. Ability to work well within strict deadlines. Ability to be able to prepare Audits and EHS reports, to a high standard. Up to date with Legislation, Standards, Guidance, Advice and Compliance. Proactive in identifying positive and negative acts, ability to follow through with realistic corrective and preventive actions. Ability to lead and coordinate incident investigations and utilise root cause analysis. IOSH Member or Equivalent. For more information on this role, or other Construction / Engineering opportunities across Ireland, the UK, Europe, or South Africa please review our careers page ( Vacancies - Kirby Group Careers ) or contact the Talent Acquisition Team at Kirby Group in confidence on +353 (0)1 454 0411. Kirby Group Engineering is an equal opportunities employer. We are committed to fostering an inclusive workplace and welcome applications from all suitably qualified candidates, regardless of race, gender, disability, religion, sexual orientation, or age.
