description: Are you ready to unlock intelligence? If you don’t think you meet all of the criteria below but are still interested in the job, please apply. Nobody checks every box - we’re looking for candidates that are particularly strong in a few areas, and have some interest and capabilities in others. About the Role: As the Senior Engineering Manager, you will serve as the global leader for Quality Engineering across Kong’s flagship runtime platforms (AI Gateway, API Gateway, Event Gateway and Mesh). This is a high-visibility, transformative leadership role. Beyond overseeing our distributed global SDET organization, you will be the primary architect of Kong’s next-generation AI-driven testing strategy. You will spearhead the transformation of our quality engineering function from traditional automation to an intelligent, agentic, self-healing test substrate, using LLMs and automated prompt/agent loops to test the very infrastructure powering the AI era. What You’ll Do: Global Team Leadership & Operations: Lead, mentor, and grow a high-performing, geographically distributed team of Software Development Engineers in Test (SDETs) across North America, Europe, and Asia. Architect the AI Testing Strategy: Define and execute the roadmap for integrating AI, LLMs, and autonomous test agents directly into our testing lifecycle. Implement generative AI capabilities for automated test case generation, smart failure triage, self-healing test scripts, and dynamic edge-case synthesis. Own Runtimes Quality Strategy: Establish testing strategies for low-latency, high-throughput C/Lua/Rust data planes. Modernize Frameworks & CI/CD Pipelines: Oversee the architectural evolution of our end-to-end, performance, regression, and chaos-testing automation harnesses embedded within modern CI/CD pipelines (GitHub Actions, Docker, K8s). Shift-Left Quality & Governance: Drive quality ownership upstream. Partner closely with Software Engineering and Product Management to embed rigorous testability standards into initial architectural designs. Define Enterprise-Grade Metrics: Establish and monitor clear QE health indicators (e.g., CI signal reliability, automation coverage, defect density, time-to-triage, and release stability). What You’ll Bring: 10+ Years in Software Engineering / SDET: Proven track record building and scaling enterprise software test automation systems. 4+ Years in Engineering Management: Direct experience leading distributed or global software engineering/SDET teams. Hands-on AI Integration Vision: Proven experience applying LLMs, Generative AI, or autonomous agent frameworks (e.g., Model Context Protocol, agentic tool-calling, synthetic data generation) to software quality or developer workflows. Operational Excellence: Demonstrated ability to manage follow-the-sun operational cadence, vendor partnerships, and cross-timezone execution seamlessly. Bonus Points: Direct experience testing high-performance networking data planes, proxies, or API Gateways (e.g., Kong, NGINX, Envoy). Background in performance, chaos engineering (e.g., Gremlin, Litmus), and load testing high-availability SaaS platforms. Active involvement or contributions to open-source quality frameworks or AI development tooling. #LI-BR2 About Kong: Kong Inc., the AI Connectivity Company, is building the connectivity layer of AI. Trusted by the Fortune 500® and AI-native startups alike, Kong’s unified API and AI platform enables organizations to secure, manage, accelerate, govern, and monetize the flow of intelligence across APIs and AI traffic — on any model, any cloud. title: Systeembeheerder Linux - High Performance Clusters (m/v/x)
description: Wat ga je doen? In een team van systeembeheerders ben je verantwoordelijk voor de ontwikkeling en het beheer van de Linux omgeving, inclusief High Performance clusters. Je draagt bij aan de architectuur, het ontwerp, de implementatie en het beheer van de NLR systemen. Je zorgt voor een projectmatige aansturing van nieuwe ontwikkeltrajecten, vanaf de analyse fase, het ontwerp, de implementatie tot en met ingebruikname. Je waarborgt de functionaliteit, actualiteit, beveiliging en effectiviteit van de Linux omgeving in het NLR datacenter. Een interessante functie met een combinatie aan werkzaamheden, waarbij geen werkdag hetzelfde is. Je werkt vanaf onze locatie in Amsterdam met de mogelijkheid om gedeeltelijk thuis te werken. Wat breng je mee? HBO werk- en denkniveau, bij voorkeur een afgeronde ICT opleiding Aantoonbare kennis en ervaring met Linux Interesse in nieuwe ICT-technologieën, die je kunt vertalen naar praktische en effectieve oplossingen Analytisch vermogen, overtuigingskracht, visie en het vermogen om boven de materie uit te stijgen Je staat stevig in je schoenen op basis van vakdeskundigheid Uitstekende communicatieve vaardigheden in het Nederlands en het Engels Wat bieden wij jou? Werken bij NLR, betekent werken in een nationale en internationale hightech omgeving. Samenwerken en betrokkenheid staan bij ons hoog in vaandel. Door jou vrijheid en eigen verantwoordelijkheid te geven, ben jij het best in staat om tot baanbrekende innovaties te komen. Wil jij jezelf vakinhoudelijk én op persoonlijk vlak ontwikkelen of misschien promoveren? title: Client Delivery Lead (Accounting Experience preferred) (w/f/d)
description: Help us use technology to make a big green dent in the universe! Kraken powers some of the most innovative global developments in energy. We create the technology that redefines utilities and unlocks a new energy system of the future. By optimising renewable generation, building a more intelligent grid, and empowering utilities to deliver an exceptional customer experience, our operating system is transforming the industry worldwide. It’s an incredibly exciting time to work in energy. Join us on our mission to improve the lives of ONE BILLION humans within the decade and shape a cleaner, better future for everyone. Kraken Customer What we do: build the most AI-driven, innovative, forward-thinking platform for energy management. From optimizing resources to delivering cost-effective, exceptional customer experiences through advanced Customer Information Systems (CIS), billing, meter data management, CRM, and AI-driven communications, Kraken is powering the next wave of innovation in the energy industry. Why we do it: future energy will not look like energy as we know it today. We need to not just think about our future, but build for it. Now. We have been licensing Kraken for over 4 years now, transforming businesses by not only moving their customer base to our Kraken platform but also changing their operating model & ways of working. Throughout this time our team has been at the forefront of industry leading migrations whilst setting a new standard for what business transformation can look like. 🏠 Where you'll fit in: You will be joining the client delivery team with Kraken working to support European clients through their technology transformation journeys, supporting long term migration projects. The Client Delivery Lead has direct responsibility managing a tech domain (billing, finance, comms..) for our client projects. This is either migrating onto our Kraken platform or managing long term technology requirements. They need to work in partnership with the technology and operational teams at Kraken as well as the client to deliver results for our client’s project or business needs. The Client Delivery Lead has to really understand how Kraken works, understand problems or requests raised by the client and refine solutions in the best way to leverage existing and new capability. They will bring technology, people and processes together to innovate improvements for our clients. You will also support the client in adapting to ways of working that are aligned to Kraken’s development style. You will work closely with Kraken’s product managers and developers to request development needs and act as a link to the client. 🚀 What you'll own: You will be managing the relationship with client counterparts (often product owners and business owners) You will be the first point of contact for tech development and the escalation and resolution point with customers for specific domain/product issues Being the knowledge base of how Kraken works and how we deliver Kraken Platform Triaging incoming requests and communicating client priorities internally. Summarising and articulating client needs, considerations, timelines internally to enable the ongoing development of the Kraken platform. Supporting the engineering team to deliver product features Challenging the client to think differently about tech development, having full belief in the continuous iteration and deployment approach we have. This is a hands-on, individual contributor position. The role is European based and your projects could be run from any country, travel is expected as part of this role. We are a flat and agile organisation and plan to remain this way. We are looking for open minded individuals who are comfortable with ambiguity and an ever changing environment. To thrive here you must be a self-starter and willing to roll your sleeves up to solve any problem, constantly flexing outside of your typical job role to drive progress for our clients and organisation. You must be committed to the Kraken way of delivering tech based on simplicity, client benefit and efficiency while bringing stakeholders through a journey of change. You must be willing to challenge beliefs, have the ability to see through multiple viewpoints and, if needed, reach beyond your remit to support the client. We are building a Kraken for everyone, a universal platform where there is greater benefit in sharing development to enable the green energy transition. Pioneers in this space, we are excited about how Kraken can change the lives of our customers and convinced that Kraken is the best answer, not only for efficiency but as a tool to tackle the climate crisis. If you believe this too then Kraken Tech is the right place for you. 🧠 What you'll bring to the party: In this position you will be laser focused on satisfying our customer’s needs. We are looking for people with strong problem solving skills and a super positive solutions oriented mindset. If you have a taste for raising up to challenges and a winner mindset, this position is the right fit for you! (“Every problem has a solution, facing new challenges is exciting because that’s what makes us better every day and the bigger the challenge, the bigger the feeling of success”) Strong client delivery and/or product ownership experience Agile delivery experience Experience of product management and customer journeys Solid understanding of technology and associated trends Excellent communications, collaboration and presentation skills Strong influencing skills and ability to challenge traditional ways of thinking Experience of working with significant complex delivery pipelines for clients Patience and initiative - our clients are undergoing huge transformations that take time and require our understanding Time management and a get-stuff-done attitude Consulting experience is a plus Fluent English + German Previous experience in accounting and billing or payments is nice to have for this position If this sounds like you then we'd love to hear from you. Are you ready for a career with us? We want to ensure you have the right tools and environment to unleash your potential. title: Global Head of Commercial Negotiations
description: Help us use technology to make a big green dent in the universe! Kraken powers some of the most innovative global developments in energy. We create the technology that redefines utilities and unlocks a new energy system of the future. By optimising renewable generation, building a more intelligent grid, and empowering utilities to deliver an exceptional customer experience, our operating system is transforming the industry worldwide. It’s an incredibly exciting time to work in energy. Join us on our mission to improve the lives of ONE BILLION humans within the decade and shape a cleaner, better future for everyone. 🏡 Where you'll fit in You'll own strategic technology negotiations end to end. That covers tier-1 SaaS, outsourcing, and core billing platform deals for regulated utilities and energy retailers. You'll report to the Chief Commercial Officer and carry board-level accountability for deals above $100m. You'll lead a cross-functional deal team and make sure every seat is filled by the right person: Executive sponsor and deal owner: holds the mandate and budget, and breaks deadlocks fast. Lead negotiator: runs the table, controls pacing and concessions, and stays separate from the delivery owner. This is the seat you'll usually hold. Commercial and pricing lead: builds the should-cost model and covers pricing structures, benchmarking, and total cost of ownership (TCO). Legal and contracts counsel: covers liability caps, intellectual property (IP) ownership, indemnities, termination, data protection, and step-in rights. Technical and solution architect: tests feasibility, scope, service levels (SLAs), and integration and security claims. Operations and service owner: brings realistic requirements, transition plans, and governance from the business. Finance and procurement: covers payment terms, currency and indexation, and audit and benchmarking rights. Risk, security, and compliance: handles regulatory, data residency, and resilience requirements. 🚀 What you'll own Lead negotiation of multi-year technology and outsourcing agreements worth $250m to $1bn+ in total contract value, from selection through signature. Set the commercial playbook: pricing structures, walk-away positions, a concession log, and fallback positions on liability, service levels, and exit. Agree one position before you sit down. Rank priorities as must-have, trade, or give, and define your walk-away point (your best alternative to a negotiated agreement, or BATNA). Structure deals that fit the risk: fixed price, time and materials, outcome-based, and gain-share, with volume bands, rate cards, indexation, and price-down glide paths. Decide which risks to transfer, share, or keep, and put a price on each one. Negotiate core billing and Customer Information System (CIS) replacements, including migration plans, regulatory change, service levels, and exit terms. Define scope precisely: baseline, assumptions, dependencies, and exclusions. Most disputes start here, so you'll settle them before signature. Plan the exit from day one: lock-in, data portability, step-in rights, and termination assistance. Build competitive tension, keep alternatives alive, and manage timing, such as a vendor's quarter-end. Bring Delivery and Operations into the deal early, so the contract works in practice. Lock in key-personnel clauses, so the vendor's A-team doesn't sell while the B-team delivers. Set up governance, benchmarking, and audit rights that keep working after signature, and track change requests, renewals, and exit costs alongside the headline price. Recruit and grow the team: energy-billing experts, a migration lead, SaaS counsel, and regulatory specialists, with a clear capability model and a RACI (who's responsible, accountable, consulted, and informed). Coach executive sponsors on leverage and timing, and run negotiation war-gaming before the big moments. Step in early when a deal or migration drifts, and reset milestones, scope, and commercials to get it back on track. 🧠 What you'll bring to the party Experience Ideally 20+ years negotiating multi-year technology and outsourcing agreements for regulated utilities or energy retailers. A track record on 15+ transactions of $250m to $1bn+ total contract value, including core billing or CIS replacement, cloud migration, or managed services. Energy domain knowledge: meter-to-cash, tariffs, market codes, and regulatory billing obligations. The credibility to work with boards, CFOs, and regulators, and to say no when a deal doesn't add up. Capabilities Commercial acumen. You understand vendor economics and margin levers, and you know where suppliers make their money (change requests and renewals, for example). Deal structuring. You choose between fixed price, time and materials, outcome-based, and gain-share, and you set volume bands and price-down paths that hold up over 3 to 7 years. Risk allocation judgment. You know which risks to transfer, share, or keep, and you can price them. Technical depth. You can challenge a vendor's assumptions on scope, effort, and architecture. Scope and requirements clarity. You define what's in, what's out, and what has to be true for the price to hold. Exit and transition planning. You cover lock-in, data portability, step-in, and termination assistance from the start. Commercial modeling. You build multi-year margin, cash flow, cost-to-serve, and should-cost models. How you work You bring one voice to the table. No side deals, and every concession goes in the log. You build leverage with a competitive process, and you keep your composure when a vendor pushes a deadline or a "sign now for a discount" offer. You push hard on terms and protect the long-term partnership, because we'll live with the deal for years. You work well across cultures and time zones, including with vendors based in other markets. You bring legal, commercial, and technical colleagues into one room instead of letting them negotiate in silos. ⭐ Bonus points Time spent on the supplier side, so you know how vendor economics and margin levers work from the inside. A legal or contracts background. Negotiation or value-selling certifications, such as Harvard PON. Working knowledge of Ofgem licence conditions, the General Data Protection Regulation (GDPR), and operational resilience rules such as the Digital Operational Resilience Act (DORA). A degree in business, engineering, law, or a related field. Are you ready for a career with us? We want to ensure you have the right tools and environment to unleash your potential. title: Senior Customer Success Manager

Om onze marktleidende positie verder uit te bouwen en nog meer impact te maken, zijn wij op zoek naar een commercieel gedreven Senior Customer Success Manager. In deze rol krijg jij de verantwoordelijkheid over een portfolio van middelgrote en grote accounts. Je helpt nieuwe klanten succesvol te onboarden en bouwt aan langetermijnrelaties. Een hoge klanttevredenheid en zo veel mogelijk werknemers op de fiets krijgen zijn hierbij jouw belangrijkste doelen. Je schakelt dagelijks met werkgevers en bent intern de verbindende schakel tussen Sales, Product & Innovation, Marketing en Customer Support. In jouw portefeuille richt jij je specifiek op bedrijven met 500+ medewerkers. Zodra Sales de samenwerkingsovereenkomst heeft getekend, neem jij het stokje over. Je leidt de implementatie en begeleidt de klant gedurende de gehele levenscyclus. Je adviseert werkgevers bij cruciale beleidskeuzes, helpt hen het platform optimaal in te richten en ontwikkelt gerichte activatiecampagnes. Zo zorg je ervoor dat de fietsregeling ook op de lange termijn top-of-mind blijft en de betrokkenheid van werknemers continu hoog is, met als ultiem doel: zoveel mogelijk werknemers op de fiets krijgen! Daarnaast ben je analytisch ijzersterk. Je gebruikt data om jouw klantsegment grondig te analyseren, ontdekt waar kansen liggen en weet creatieve ideeën om te zetten in concrete acties en resultaat. Wat vragen we van jou? Een afgeronde hbo- of wo-opleiding; Minimaal 3 jaar relevante werkervaring in Customer Success of Accountmanagement; Aantoonbare ervaring met het begeleiden van implementatietrajecten, relatiebeheer en het schrijven van accountplannen; Commercieel ingesteld en communicatief ijzersterk: je doorgrondt klantbehoeften snel en vertaalt deze naar effectieve actieplannen; Een hoge mate van zelfstandigheid en het vermogen om projecten met diverse stakeholders of complexe vraagstukken te leiden; Een sterk probleemoplossend en analytisch vermogen met focus op het uitbouwen van duurzame klantrelaties; Je kunt goed plannen, bewaart het overzicht en gaat gestructureerd te werk; Een flexibele en hands-on mentaliteit die past bij een snelgroeiende marktleider; Uitstekende beheersing van de Nederlandse en Engelse taal in woord en schrift; Wat bieden wij? Naast een uitdagende rol met veel vrijheid, verantwoordelijkheid en een grote impact op de verdere groei van Lease a Bike bieden wij nog veel meer: Een bruto maandsalaris tussen de € 3.950,- en € 4.450. 8% vakantiegeld, een bonusregeling van 10% én een jaarlijkse winstuitkering; Een jaarlijkse toekenning van 20 wettelijke verlofdagen, 5 bovenwettelijke vakantiedagen en 6 ATV-dagen op basis van een fulltime dienstverband; Een gloednieuwe leasefiets naar keuze (Pon-merk) met een maandelijkse werkgeversbijdrage; Een reiskostenvergoeding of Shuttel-kaart voor de dagen dat je naar kantoor reist; Focus op ontwikkeling: De mogelijkheid om je continu te blijven ontwikkelen via onder andere onze Winter- en Summerlabstrainingen; Een gezonde lunch op kantoor in Amersfoort tegen een kleine bijdrage; Een thuiswerkplek door ons gefaciliteerd met de mogelijkheid voor een netto thuiswerkvergoeding voor als je af en toe thuis wil werken; Een collectieve Zorgverzekering bij ONVZ of Zilveren Kruis met een werkgeversbijdrage; Én, last but not least, een aantrekkelijke pensioenregeling bij het Pon Pensioenfonds van 30% waarbij Lease a Bike 20% bijdraagt. Over de organisatie Lease a Bike is ontstaan vanuit liefde voor mensen en fietsen. Voor ons is fietsen niet zomaar een manier van vervoer. Voor ons is fietsen een ‘way of life’. Fietsen is goed voor je gezondheid. Goed voor je portemonnee. Goed voor de wereld. Anderen stimuleren om de fiets te pakken, daar gaan wij voor! Wil jij een bijdrage leveren aan een duurzamere wereld, waarbij vitaliteit en fun hand in hand gaan? Join the ride en draag bij aan de verwezenlijking van onze missie. Als scale-up is Lease a Bike onderdeel van mobiliteitsprovider Bike Mobility Services Group (Pon)! title: AI Engineer (Agentic AI)
description: Legal AI is only as good as the knowledge behind it. At Lefebvre Sdu, we’ve been building that knowledge for 200 years. Day in, day out. Law by law. Word by word. Other legal AI tools run on our data and software. As the Dutch heart of Lefebvre Group, the European leader in legal and tax knowledge, we’re also developing our own platform: GenIA-L, where lawyers and tax professionals don’t just get an answer, but an answer they’re willing to put their name to. More than 75,000 professionals use it every day, accounting for over €100 million ARR across Europe. We’re looking for a Medior AI Engineer to help shape how the intelligent core of that platform evolves. HOW YOU'LL MOVE US FORWARD GenIA-L is a research platform for legal professionals. A user asks a question. The platform searches our trusted sources and turns them into a useful answer. It does this with agents: specialised AI components that each handle part of the question and work together. In the legal domain, an answer can't just sound fluent. It has to be correct, and you must be able to see which source it comes from. This is not a pilot project: the platform runs in production and is used heavily every day. As a medior, your focus is on building. You work independently, on challenges that come from customers and on challenges we spot ourselves. You break down a legal process, translate it into a technical process and work out how to best connect the pieces. Stuck on something? You say so, and your colleagues think along with you. You build and improve the agents of GenIA-L and the way they work together. You build and maintain our knowledge packages: for each legal article, an expert-validated set of commentary, case law, parliamentary history and practical interpretation. You also work on the pipelines that create these packages and keep them up to date. You make quality measurable. With evaluation sets, observability and metrics, you show that answers, source attribution and reliability really improve. Not by gut feeling, but with evidence. You build features for customers, such as analysing their own documents and new ways to search case law. You work directly with editors and subject-matter experts, and check with them which parts of a legal question really matter. You come up with and test ideas to make the product sharper or faster, and alternate AI experiments with back-end development. WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR You have a realistic view of LLMs. You see what they can do, but you also know their weak spots. You enjoy following new AI developments, but you don't just follow the herd: you stay critical. You think in a structured way and can break a complex problem into smaller pieces. You work independently, take initiative when things are unclear and are eager to learn fast. And you enjoy working with lawyers and editors, because they know what a good answer looks like. You have several years of experience in software or ML engineering. Depth in recent projects counts for more than years. Strong experience in agentic AI. You have good knowledge of Python and experience with relevant machine learning libraries. You have helped build an LLM application that runs in production. Not just prototypes, notebooks or courses. You have hands-on experience with agent frameworks such as LangGraph and LangChain, tool calling, MCP or comparable orchestration. Our entire product is built around this. Experience with only a simple search-and-answer (RAG) setup is not enough. You have measured the quality of an LLM system with evaluation sets or observability, and can give a concrete example. Experience with tools like MLflow and LiteLLM is a plus. You have back-end experience, including building REST APIs. You have experience in Kubernetes. Experience with Postgres is useful. Experience in a legal, tax or other knowledge-intensive domain is a plus. WHAT YOU'RE SIGNING UP FOR On Tuesdays and Thursdays, the team works together at the office. What colleagues value most here: mutual trust, room to experiment, and a team that helps each other out when someone gets stuck. A place where you have influence from day one: on the approach, the processes, and the direction. Colleagues who deliberately chose Lefebvre Sdu over big tech jobs because here, they're building something that doesn't exist yet. Base salary between €4,477 and €5,793 per month, based on a 36-hour week, since that's full-time for us. Plus a lot of extra allowances (see below). A bonus tied to company performance: a fixed year-end bonus of 4% and profit sharing of up to 6%. 23 vacation days and a personal choice budget of 12%, of which 8% is holiday pay and 4% is freely allocable. As Senior CRM Executive, you'll build and ship them: email, push, in-app and SMS, across remittance, credit, savings and whatever we launch next. You take a brief and turn it into a live, tested, correctly targeted send - then tell us what it did. You'll report to the Senior CRM Manager for Campaigns and work daily with Growth Managers, Product Marketing, Design and Compliance. This is a hands-on role with a high volume of sends and a high bar for getting each one right, because a wrong rate, a broken link or the wrong segment lands in a customer's pocket. Do it well and you'll be the person the rest of the business trusts to get their message out. What you'll build and own Build and launch campaigns end to end in our marketing automation platform: segments, content, scheduling and send. Turn campaign requests from across the business into clear builds, and push back when a brief doesn't hold up. QA every send before it goes: targeting, personalisation, links, localisation and compliance sign-off. Run A/B tests on subject lines, timing, offers and channels, and feed what wins into the next campaign. Keep the campaign calendar honest so customers aren't hit by five messages in one day. Report on every campaign in numbers the team can act on: who received it, who converted, what it was worth. Spot what's repetitive in your own work and template or automate it. Your experience 1-3 years in CRM, email marketing or lifecycle, ideally in fintech, e-commerce or another high-frequency consumer product. Hands-on with a marketing automation platform ( Customer.io , Braze, Iterable or similar) - you build the campaign yourself. Working knowledge of Liquid and HTML for personalised, dynamic content. An eye for detail that catches the wrong segment or the broken link before the customer does. Comfortable pulling your own numbers, with basic SQL or a BI tool such as Tableau, Looker, Amplitude or Mixpanel. Bias to ship: you'd rather launch, measure and iterate than polish a brief. Comfortable using AI tools to speed up copy variants, translations and QA checks. Nice to have Lived experience or deep empathy with the life of our users - the millions who move countries to build something better. Language skills in Italian, Portuguese, German, Mandarin, Wolof or Swahili. Experience running campaigns in a regulated or compliance-sensitive comms environment. Why Join LemFi? Your work here puts money back into families' pockets. That's the reward, and the weight of it. You'll take on some of the hardest problems in finance alongside people who do their best work when the stakes are real. We move fast and we expect a lot, because our customers can't afford for us to do otherwise. In return you get room to own real problems, global impact you can see, and a team that won't slow you down. Bring grit and ownership and there's a place for them here. Ambition belongs here, come and show us yours. Follow us on LinkedIn and Instagram and if you haven't already, download the app on the App Store or Google Play . title: Chef.fe de Projet Hôpitaux / Project Manager Hospital
description: Chez Lifen, nous pensons que les données médicales ont le potentiel de transformer le système de santé. Mais seulement si elles sont accessibles. Plus de données accessibles → moins de charge administrative, une meilleure coordination des soins et des découvertes scientifiques plus rapides. Depuis 2015, notre mission est de libérer ce potentiel. Nos solutions basées sur l'IA permettent aux professionnels de santé de partager les informations médicales sans effort et aux chercheurs d'accélérer les découvertes cliniques : avec un impact sur des millions de patients en France chaque jour. Alors que nous nous préparons à nous développer en Europe, 2 choses déterminent notre succès : nos équipes et notre mission. Aujourd'hui, plus de 150 personnes travaillent depuis nos bureaux et à distance pour libérer le potentiel des données de santé. Nous avons connecté 800 hôpitaux et 150 000 professionnels de santé, et nous ne faisons que commencer. Nous recherchons des personnes qui embrassent la complexité, veulent résoudre des problèmes difficiles et sont prêtes à construire le futur de la collaboration en santé. ⚡ Notre équipe Customer Operations L’équipe Customer Operations accompagne les établissements de santé dans le déploiement et l’usage des solutions Lifen. Son travail conditionne une adoption durable : comprendre l’organisation de chaque client, coordonner les parties prenantes et faire avancer les projets jusqu’à leur mise en service. En tant que Project Manager, tu piloteras des déploiements auprès de grands comptes, notamment des groupements hospitaliers de territoire (GHT). Tu seras le point de repère côté Lifen pour structurer le projet, donner de la visibilité aux clients et lever les obstacles avec les équipes internes. 🎯 Ce que tu feras chez nous Cartographier les établissements, les services concernés et leurs besoins pour cadrer chaque déploiement. Construire le planning projet, poser les jalons et suivre leur avancement. Animer les réunions de suivi et formaliser les décisions. Coordonner Business Development, Customer Operations, Ops Manager et R&D. Suivre les usages après le déploiement et identifier les difficultés rencontrées sur le terrain. Centraliser les bugs et demandes d’évolution, puis communiquer sur les corrections et nouveautés. Tenir la documentation projet à jour et contribuer à faire évoluer les méthodes et processus de l’équipe. ⭐️ Ce que nous recherchons Must-have Une solide expérience dans la gestion de projets, idéalement dans le déploiement de logiciels ou de solutions numériques. Une bonne connaissance fonctionnelle et technique du secteur de la santé et de l’organisation d’un établissement de santé. Des bases en interopérabilité, en flux de données et en FHIR. La capacité à cadrer en autonomie des projets simples, suivre un calendrier, identifier les blocages et solliciter son manager lorsque nécessaire. Une communication écrite et orale claire auprès de clients comme d’équipes internes. Nice-to-have Une expérience auprès de grands comptes hospitaliers ou de groupements d’établissements de santé. Une connaissance des enjeux techniques liés à l’architecture d’une plateforme logicielle et aux intégrations entre systèmes. L’habitude de former des utilisateurs sur des outils ou processus fonctionnels. Une bonne maîtrise de Notion, des outils Google ou Office et d’outils de suivi de projet. Soft skills Tu sais organiser ton travail sans attendre qu’on te donne chaque prochaine étape, tout en signalant rapidement les risques ou les dépendances. Tu aimes comprendre le fonctionnement concret d’un client avant de proposer une solution. Face à des interlocuteurs aux priorités différentes, tu gardes le cap, tu reformules et tu fais avancer les décisions. Nos valeurs Embrace Complexity : tu prends le temps de comprendre les contraintes d’un établissement, les dépendances techniques et les besoins des utilisateurs. Bienveillance : tu communiques avec clarté, écoutes les difficultés et cherches des solutions avec les parties prenantes. Real Impact : tu veilles à ce que les solutions déployées soient réellement utilisées et facilitent le travail des professionnels de santé. 👥 Process de recrutement Échange avec Laura, Talent Acquisition - 30 min. Un premier échange pour comprendre ton parcours, tes attentes et ta motivation pour le poste. Entretien avec Loïc, Hiring Manager - 45 min. Une première rencontre avec ton potentiel futur manager qui approfondira ton expérience de gestion de projet et de déploiement, ta compréhension des environnements de santé et ta connaissance fonctionnelle des produits déployés. Étude de cas avec Loïc et un membre de l’équipe Customer Ops - 60 à 90 min. Quelques jours avant l’échange, nous t’enverrons une étude de cas à préparer. Lors de la restitution, tu présenteras ton raisonnement et la façon dont tu cadres un déploiement sur le plan fonctionnel. L’objectif est d’évaluer ta capacité à structurer un plan de déploiement, prioriser les actions et les risques, coordonner les parties prenantes et communiquer avec le client. Entretien Cultural Alignement avec Raphaël, VP ops - 30 min. Cet échange permet de discuter de ta façon de travailler, de ta collaboration avec les autres équipes et de revenir sur d’éventuels sujets à approfondir après les premières étapes. Nous nous engageons à te faire un retour dans les 72 heures suivant chaque étape. Compensation: €47K – €52K • €47K – €52K Find Jobs in France on Arbeitnow

Sa mission : faire en sorte que les professionnels de santé utilisent Lifen au bon niveau, dans la durée, et qu’ils en tirent un bénéfice concret au quotidien. Ce poste n’est pas un rôle d’Account Manager ou de CSM orienté renouvellement, upsell ou gestion contractuelle. Il ne s’agit pas non plus de piloter le déploiement technique ou de prendre en charge le support. Ton terrain de jeu commence une fois les solutions en place : comprendre comment elles sont réellement utilisées, identifier ce qui limite leur adoption et construire les actions permettant de faire évoluer durablement les usages. Tu rejoindras l’équipe en charge des établissements publics les plus stratégiques. Ton portefeuille regroupera des organisations aux tailles, configurations, pratiques et contraintes très différentes. Tu devras être capable de comprendre rapidement ce qui se passe chez chaque client, de distinguer les symptômes des causes et de mobiliser les bons leviers, côté client comme chez Lifen. Le poste couvre les trois produits Lifen Care déjà déployés chez nos clients. Ta mission peut se résumer simplement : comprendre pourquoi nos solutions ne sont pas encore utilisées à leur plein potentiel dans certains établissements et faire évoluer durablement ces usages. 🎯 Ce que tu feras chez nous Prendre en main un portefeuille d’environ 35 hôpitaux et cliniques et construire, pour chacun, une lecture précise des usages, des interlocuteurs clés, du contexte organisationnel, des points de blocage et des opportunités. Construire une véritable stratégie de portefeuille. Tu ne pourras pas accompagner 35 établissements avec le même niveau d’intensité : à toi d’identifier où ton intervention aura le plus d’impact, quels comptes nécessitent une attention immédiate et lesquels peuvent être accompagnés de manière plus scalable. Diagnostiquer les freins à l’adoption à partir des données d’usage, des échanges avec les clients et de ta compréhension de leur environnement. Une baisse d’usage peut avoir des causes très différentes : configuration, organisation, processus internes, compréhension du produit, changement d’interlocuteur ou inadéquation entre l’usage réel et l’objectif initial. Transformer ce diagnostic en plans d’action concrets. Selon les situations, cela pourra passer par de la formation, une évolution des pratiques, une modification de configuration, la mobilisation de nouveaux interlocuteurs ou un travail avec nos équipes Produit, Support ou Customer Operations. Accompagner les premières phases d’usage après le déploiement afin de rapprocher progressivement l’usage réel des objectifs définis avec le client. La formation fait partie des leviers possibles, mais ton rôle est avant tout de comprendre quel levier activer et pourquoi. Utiliser les données disponibles pour repérer les signaux faibles et prioriser tes actions : baisse d’usage, adoption partielle, comportement atypique, insatisfaction, évolution de l’organisation ou opportunité d’étendre un usage existant. Animer la relation avec les référents, chefs de projet et équipes opérationnelles côté client. Cela passe par des échanges réguliers à distance et environ un à deux déplacements par mois dans les établissements. Faire avancer des sujets qui nécessitent plusieurs équipes sans avoir nécessairement d’autorité directe sur elles. Tu documentes le problème, fais émerger les priorités et coordonnes les équipes Customer Operations, Produit, Support, Product Marketing ou commerciales lorsque leur intervention est nécessaire. Mesurer l’effet des actions engagées. Un plan d’action n’est pas terminé lorsqu’il est lancé : tu vérifies si les usages évoluent réellement et ajustes ton approche en conséquence. Améliorer les outils et méthodes de l’équipe : tableaux de suivi, segmentation du portefeuille, campagnes d’accompagnement, pratiques de formation, indicateurs ou partage structuré des retours terrain. ⭐️ Ce que nous recherchons Must-have Tu as une expérience significative dans la gestion de clients ou d’organisations complexes et tu as déjà exercé un rôle avec un niveau élevé d’autonomie. Nous recherchons un profil senior, capable de prendre en charge un portefeuille rapidement et de construire sa propre approche. Tu as déjà géré de façon autonome un portefeuille conséquent, idéalement composé d’au moins une vingtaine de comptes significatifs, et tu sais arbitrer où investir ton temps plutôt que traiter chaque client de manière identique. Tu as déjà été directement responsable de l’adoption, de la réussite client ou de l’amélioration des usages d’un produit ou d’une solution. Tu ne te limites pas au suivi relationnel ou commercial d’un portefeuille. Tu es à l’aise avec des données d’usage produit. Tu sais passer d’un tableau de bord ou d’un ensemble d’indicateurs à des hypothèses, identifier les situations à investiguer et confronter les données à ce que tu observes sur le terrain. Tu sais travailler sur des problèmes qui ne sont pas immédiatement formulés. À partir d’un signal (baisse d’usage, insatisfaction, faible adoption) tu sais mener le diagnostic, distinguer les causes possibles et choisir une approche adaptée. Face à des organisations, des outils et des processus différents, tu sais apporter du conseil sur les dimensions fonctionnelles, organisationnelles et techniques d’un usage. Tu sais cadrer un plan d’action, le prioriser, obtenir l’implication des interlocuteurs nécessaires et suivre son effet dans le temps jusqu’à constater un changement concret. Tu sais faire avancer un sujet sans nécessairement avoir d’autorité directe sur les personnes impliquées. Tu es capable de documenter un problème, défendre une priorité et obtenir des décisions auprès de plusieurs équipes. Nice-to-have Tu connais l’environnement hospitalier, les contraintes des établissements de santé ou les grands programmes de transformation numérique du secteur. Tu as travaillé dans le SaaS, la fintech, les logiciels métiers ou un environnement réglementé où la rigueur opérationnelle compte autant que la qualité de la relation client. Ton intitulé de poste précédent importe peu : CSM, consultant·e, chef·fe de projet ou autre. En revanche, tu as déjà été responsable de faire évoluer durablement les usages d’un produit ou d’une solution chez des clients complexes. Tu as déjà contribué à faire évoluer des tableaux de bord, des indicateurs, une segmentation client ou des pratiques d’accompagnement. Soft skills Tu es à l’aise dans des situations où ni le problème ni la solution ne sont immédiatement évidents. Tu sais avancer avec des informations incomplètes, formuler des hypothèses, décider où investir ton temps et expliquer tes arbitrages. Tu poses les bonnes questions, prends des initiatives réfléchies et assumes tes choi

title: Payments Risk Analyst
description: Hi there! Thanks for stopping by 👋 Are you actively looking for a new opportunity? Or just checking the market? Well… you might just be in the right place! We’re looking for an experienced Payments Risk Analyst based in Belfast to join our Global Risk team. In this role you will independently manage less-defined and more complex risk work while contributing to team projects and operational improvements. This role builds on Analyst I capability by recognising patterns, expanding findings, suggesting solutions, and applying sound judgement with minimal direction. What you’ll be doing: Reporting to the Risk Operations Lead, you will be responsible for daily monitoring within multiple risk queues along with various operational tasks including but not limited to: Manage complex transaction, merchant, onboarding, fraud, credit, and compliance cases across risk queues, owning end-to-end assessments using merchant,business, account, transaction, and other risk signals. Apply company, partner, supportability, and restricted-product policies to less-defined reviews with minimal direction, weighing competing factors and making sound decisions with imperfect information. Use reports, risk signals, case trends, operational data, and web-service tools to identify emerging threats, high-risk or suspicious activity, and opportunities for proactive mitigation. Balance portfolio protection and chargeback risk by assessing chargeback likelihood alongside the merchant’s capacity to repay. Resolve compliance violations and complex cases, identify material risks, escalate unresolved issues appropriately, and contribute to resolution and follow-up. Identify recurring issues, control gaps, and risk patterns across tools, workflows, queues, policies, and playbooks, and recommend practical improvements. Produce concise case summaries, findings, recommendations, and decision rationale; maintain accurate documentation and contribute to knowledge material, playbooks, and team learning. Lead complex customer communications and collaborate with Support, FS Merchant Services, Product, risk analysts, and other teams to resolve shared problems. Contribute to incidents, complex reviews, trend investigations, projects, process improvements, and team best practices while prioritising competing work effectively. What you need to bring: We are looking for a highly analytical and collaborative professional with experience within a relevant analyst role along with: 2 years of experience in payments, fraud, credit risk, compliance, or financial services operations or related discipline. Exposure to structured workflows, case management, queues, or service-level targets. Experience working with written procedures and maintaining accurate records. Interest in deepening existing knowledge on fraud, credit risk, merchant risk, and payments and suggesting improvements based on said knowledge. Knowledge of Card Scheme rules and regulations Understanding of the full Chargeback flow and process - Understanding chargeback risk timeframes. Strong working knowledge of Excel/Google Sheets Good conceptual thinking with proven analytic, problem-solving and effective reporting skills Experience managing structured case work with increasing complexity and limited direction. Ability to work independently and make decisions based on available information Ability to work in a dynamic fast-paced environment with tight deadlines We know that people are more than what’s on their CV. If you’re unsure that you have the right profile for the role... hit the ‘Apply’ button and give it a try! What’s in it for you: Come live the Lightspeed Experience… Genuine career growth opportunities based on performance within a company that's continuously expanding Work with highly skilled people who are as passionate about Fraud & Risk as you are An environment that encourages initiatives and leadership Work in a team big enough for growth but lean enough to make a real impact Fun activities with your teammates & social events throughout the year Opportunity to learn, expand your skill set, forge wonderful relationships and make your mark within the diverse and inclusive Lightspeed culture, a true Canadian tech success story … and enjoy a range of benefits that’ll keep you happy and healthy: Lightspeed equity scheme (we are all owners) Flexible Paid Time Off - providing you the freedom to take time off however you like Private Medical Insurance and cash health plan for optical, dental and more. Health & Wellness Credit- expense up to 400 GBP per year towards your gym membership, yoga classes, a new bike or whatever else you do for your health Mental Health Support through the LifeWorks and Modern Health Apps- whether it is meditation, coaching or counselling you need - each employee gets access to this platform Time off to volunteer and give back to your community Transit / parking benefit - for when you need to travel to the Belfast office A variety of drinks & snacks in our offices in Belfast. To all recruitment agencies: Lightspeed does not accept unsolicited agency resumes. If we have not directly engaged your company in writing to supply candidates for a specific vacancy, Lightspeed will not be responsible for any fees related to unsolicited resumes. Lightspeed is a proud equal opportunity employer and we are committed to creating an inclusive and barrier-free workplace. Lightspeed welcomes and encourages applications from people with disabilities. Accommodations are available on request for candidates taking part in all aspects of the selection process. Where to from here? Obviously, this has to be mutually beneficial: we want you to step into a role you love, and we want to offer you a place you’re proud to come to every day. For a glimpse into our world check out our career page here . Lightspeed is building communities through commerce, and we need people from all backgrounds and lived experiences to do that. We were founded in 2005, in Montreal’s gay village and our original members were all part of the LGBTQ+ community. The ethos of our business has been about inclusion from the very beginning, and we strive to provide a workplace where everyone belongs. Who we are: Powering the businesses that are the backbone of the global economy, Lightspeed's one-stop commerce platform helps merchants innovate to simplify, scale, and provide exceptional customer experiences. Our cloud commerce solution transforms and unifies online and physical operations, multichannel sales, expansion to new locations, global payments, financial solutions, and connection to supplier networks. Founded in Montréal, Canada in 2005, Lightspeed is dual-listed on the New York Stock Exchange (NYSE: LSPD) and Toronto Stock Exchange (TSX: LSPD). With teams across North America, Europe, and Asia Pacific, the company serves retail, hospitality, and golf businesses in over 100 countries. title: Research Scientist / Research Engineer, Automated Safety
description: Your Impact at LILA We're building a talent-dense, high-agency AI safety team at Lila that will engage all core teams within the organization (science, model training, lab integration, etc.), to identify and mitigate risks from scientific superintelligence while retaining the core scientific discovery capabilities of the stack. The initial focus of this team will be to build and implement a bespoke safety strategy for Lila, tailored to its specific goals and deployment strategies. This will involve technical safety strategy development, broader ecosystem engagement, safety-focused evaluations, safety systems to mitigate risks, and a research agenda that explores longer-term needs such as oversight of superintelligent scientific systems. As scientific AI systems become more capable and autonomous, their safety assessment and safeguards must develop alongside them. At Lila Sciences, you will help build the research methods and tools that make this possible, so that more and more decision-enablers can be automated safely. This will move us closer to the vision of a safety and security apparatus that is robust to a fully autonomous scientific engine. Your initial focus will be misuse: developing flexible and automated red-teaming approaches that test safety-relevant scientific capabilities and the robustness of safeguards. You will also contribute to safety automation beyond red teaming, helping the team evaluate, monitor and respond to risks across increasingly autonomous scientific workflows. You will own reusable research methods and assessment tools, working with mitigation engineers who implement protective mechanisms. We welcome Research Scientists and Research Engineers; responsibilities can span or evolve between the two profiles. What You'll Be Building Develop and run capability evaluations of scientific models, agents and tool-mediated workflows (including simulated lab environments), working with domain experts to make tests scientifically meaningful. Create methods or systems that explore diverse failure modes, adapt tests as evidence emerges and support systematic investigation beyond fixed benchmarks. Build reproducible experiments and evaluation tools that capture relevant behavior, outcomes and the evidence needed to interpret findings. Measure the quality and coverage of automated assessments, including failure cases in the evaluators themselves. Develop broader safety automation, across threat model management, evidence triage, regression testing, monitoring workflows or tools that help researchers assess and respond to risks. Collaborate with risk researchers and mitigation engineers to translate findings into improved assessments and safeguards, and verify whether those changes work. What You'll Need to Succeed Strong empirical judgment, practical programming ability and experience working with modern AI systems. The ability to investigate ambiguous failures, design informative comparisons and communicate limitations clearly. An interest in scientific misuse risks and the ability to collaborate productively with domain specialists. For the Research Scientist profile: evidence of selecting valuable research questions, developing or adapting methods, and designing experiments that yield defensible conclusions. You should be able to prototype and test your ideas. For the Research Engineer profile: evidence of building reliable research software, evaluation infrastructure or agent systems that enable reproducible experiments and efficient iteration. You should be able to contribute to experimental design and interpretation. Bonus Points For Automated red teaming, adversarial testing or evaluation-method research. Scientific AI, tool-using agents, laboratory automation or other complex environments. Experience with safety monitoring, model-based evaluators or scalable experimental infrastructure. Compensation We offer competitive base compensation with bonus potential and generous early-stage equity. Your final offer will reflect your background, expertise, and expected impact. U.S. Benefits. Full-time U.S. employees receive a comprehensive benefits program including medical, dental, and vision coverage; employer-paid life and disability insurance; flexible time off with generous company wide holidays; paid parental leave; an educational assistance program; commuter benefits, including bike share memberships for office based employees; and a company subsidized lunch program. International Benefits. Full-time employees outside the U.S. receive a comprehensive benefits program tailored to their region. USD salary ranges apply only to U.S.-based positions; international salaries are set to local market. Expected Base Salary Range $180,000 — $298,000 USD About LILA Lila Sciences is building Scientific Superintelligence™ to solve humankind's greatest challenges. We believe science is the most inspiring frontier for AI. Rather than hard-coding expert knowledge into tools, LILA builds systems that can learn for themselves. LILA combines advanced AI models with proprietary AI Science Factory™ instruments into an operating system for science that executes the entire scientific method autonomously, accelerating discovery at unprecedented speed, scale, and impact across medicine, materials, and energy. Learn more at www.lila.ai. Guided by our core values of truth, trust, curiosity, grit, and velocity, we move with startup speed while tackling problems of historic importance. If this sounds like an environment you'd love to work in, even if you don't meet every qualification listed above, we encourage you to apply. We’re All In Lila Sciences is committed to equal employment opportunity regardless of race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital status, disability, gender identity or Veteran status. Information you provide during your application process will be handled in accordance with our Candidate Privacy Policy . A Note to Agencies Lila Sciences does not accept unsolicited resumes from any source other than candidates. The submission of unsolicited resumes by recruitment or staffing agencies to Lila Sciences or its employees is strictly prohibited unless contacted directly by Lila Science’s internal Talent Acquisition team. Any resume submitted by an agency in the absence of a signed agreement will automatically become the property of Lila Sciences, and Lila Sciences will not owe any referral or other fees with respect thereto. title: Senior / Principal Computational Biologist, AI Safety
description: Your Impact at LILA We're building a talent-dense, high-agency AI safety team at Lila that will engage all core teams within the organization (science, model training, lab integration, etc.), to identify and mitigate risks from scientific superintelligence while retaining the core scientific discovery capabilities of the stack. The initial focus of this team will be to build and implement a bespoke safety strategy for Lila, tailored to its specific goals and deployment strategies. This will involve technical safety strategy development, broader ecosystem engagement, safety-focused evaluations, safety systems to mitigate risks, and a research agenda that explores longer-term needs such as oversight of superintelligent scientific systems. You will conduct original computational biology research for AI safety and build an integrated understanding of biological risks. You will investigate how capabilities across large language models, specialized biological models, agents and automated laboratories combine to change what is biologically feasible. Our work spans protein and nucleic-acid design, cellular systems and biological delivery; we welcome other specialisms that bring relevant scientific depth and risk judgment. What You'll Be Building Formulate and pursue original computational biology research questions relevant to safety, developing computational approaches and designing and running studies that generate new evidence about biological capabilities, risks and safeguards. Build and update an integrated picture of risks, examining how capabilities across LLMs, specialized biological models, agents and automated laboratories interact within scientific workflows and change practical constraints. Combine your research with literature, model assessments, experimental findings and expert input to judge biological feasibility, uncertainty and the significance of emerging capabilities for misuse. Identify gaps in expertise, frame questions for external specialists and critically integrate their findings with support from the expert-program team. Translate scientific risk judgments into dual-use policy boundaries, evaluation priorities and mitigation requirements that preserve beneficial biological research. Work with threat modelers, automated-safety researchers, experimental scientists and mitigation engineers to design informative evaluations and red-teaming studies, test assumptions and assess safeguards. What You'll Need to Succeed Deep expertise (a PhD, or comparable experience) in computational biology or a related quantitative biological discipline, with a record of original research from question formulation and computational study design through to defensible findings. Substantive experience assessing biological dual-use risks, with a strong understanding of relevant harmful applications, including pathogen- or toxin-related risks or other consequential biological misuse. Prior experience applying biological expertise to AI safety through analysis informing threat models, evaluation or red-teaming work, or mitigation design. Sound judgment about the relationship between computational predictions, biological function and experimental evidence, including uncertainty and the limits of your expertise. Modern web search is built for humans, not AIs . Instead of trusted facts, it serves links, ads, and click‑bait. People want visually engaging pages; AI systems need structured truth. An AI can absorb oceans of data, while human attention barely skims the surface. Humans think visually and intuitively; AI reasons in latent space. Web 2.0 is sunsetting . The deck is being reshuffled, and the Bing‑Google search oligopoly is crumbling. Indexing ever more pages is no longer the goal; semantically organizing facts for AI systems is. In the coming agentic web, Google’s ad‑driven model has no natural home. Search for AI must be rebuilt from the ground up . We are reconstructing the web as a rigorously structured knowledge layer, mapping every concept, entity, and claim into a coherent semantic graph. This foundation delivers verified facts and rich context to AI instantly, unlocking faster reasoning, higher accuracy, and radically more useful answers for everyone. Humans search Google; AI searches Linkup. Our Mission Reality never stands still, and neither should intelligence. Linkup reconnects language models to a living stream of verified facts, ensuring AIs remain as current and insightful as the world they serve. Our mission is to deliver the world’s freshest, most trusted knowledge to AIs. Our Culture Our culture is built on the following values: Mission . We believe we play a critical role in building the agentic web. We are 100% committed to our mission of bringing the reality of the world to AI agents. Speed . We build fast, we build to last. We get things done, well. Ownership . We empower every team member to take ownership of their projects, ensuring they see them through to successful completion. Teamwork . Our strength lies in our unity. We rely on one another and embrace our diversity as a core asset. Humility . We maintain low egos, showing respect for others and continuously learning from their insights and experiences. We expect all team member to take an active role in shaping our company culture. Our Team We are small technical team, working shoulder to shoulder to build the web of agents. title: Account Executive EMEA
description: Who is Litmus Litmus is building the data foundation that powers industrial AI. AI doesn’t work without real-world, contextualized data - Litmus makes that data usable. As AI adoption accelerates, most industrial environments still can’t access or use their operational data. We solve that gap. We’re a growth-stage software company helping manufacturers access, structure, and use real-time data from machines, systems, and sensors at the edge. Our platform sits at the intersection of edge computing, AI, and industrial operations, enabling some of the world’s largest companies to run operations in real time, reduce downtime, and optimize production. Backed by leading investors and trusted by global manufacturers and partners like Google, Microsoft, Dell, Oracle, and Mitsubishi, Litmus is powering the shift toward software-defined manufacturing. Why join Litmus Build the infrastructure that makes industrial AI possible AI is moving beyond the cloud and into the physical world. At Litmus, you’ll build the infrastructure that enables real-time data to power AI and machine learning systems in production environments. Work on problems where software meets the real world Most AI systems fail without access to real-world data. You’ll build the layer that makes them viable in production. We solve challenges at the intersection of distributed systems, real-time data, and industrial constraints — where reliability, scale, and performance are non-negotiable. Have real impact, fast You’ll work on systems used by real customers in production, with direct impact on product and company trajectory. As a scaling company, we move quickly. You’ll have ownership, visibility, and the ability to shape both product and company as we scale. Join a high-performance team We’re building a team that holds a high bar and pushes each other to improve. You’ll work alongside experienced operators, engineers, and leaders who have done this before and are building again at scale. We hire people who take ownership, move quickly, and care about outcomes. No passengers. Our culture At Litmus, the team is collaborative, curious, and low ego. People are scrappy, take ownership, and look for ways to make an impact. We value empathy just as much as execution, whether that’s in how we build, how we communicate, or how we support each other. We’re a growing company, so things move quickly and not everything is perfectly defined. If you enjoy figuring things out, working closely with others, and making steady progress, you’ll do well here. About the role Litmus is hiring an Account Executive to own and grow new business with industrial manufacturers across Southern Europe, primarily Spain, Portugal and Italy. Litmus is an industrial DataOps and edge AI platform. We help manufacturers connect, normalize and use data from their plants, from shop-floor assets up to the cloud. Our customers use Litmus to break down OT data silos and scale analytics and AI across sites. You will be the face of Litmus in Southern Europe. You will build pipeline, run complex enterprise sales cycles end to end, and work closely with our pre-sales team, hyperscaler partners (Microsoft, AWS, Google, Databricks) and system integrators. You report to the EMEA sales lead. What you will do • Own a Southern Europe territory and its revenue target, from prospecting to signed contract and expansion. • Build and qualify pipeline through outbound, events, partners and inbound leads. • Run discovery with plant, operations, OT and IT stakeholders up to C-level, and map their business case for change. • Lead structured, multi-stakeholder enterprise sales cycles, including proofs of value, commercial proposals and negotiation. • Work hand in hand with pre-sales on demos, solution design and technical validation. • Co-sell with hyperscalers and system integrators, and develop partner-sourced opportunities in your region. • Keep forecasts and opportunity data accurate in Salesforce. • Expand existing accounts from first site to multi-site and global rollouts. • Bring market feedback back to product, marketing and leadership. What you bring Segment experience (required) • 5+ years of B2B enterprise software sales, with a proven record of meeting or beating quota. • Direct sales experience in industrial software: IIoT, industrial DataOps, data historians, MES, SCADA, edge computing or manufacturing analytics. • A solid grasp of the OT/IT landscape in manufacturing, and of how plant data flows from machines to the cloud. • Experience selling into manufacturing, process industries, energy or similar industrial sectors. Southern Europe market knowledge (required) • An established network among industrial manufacturers in Spain, Portugal and/or Italy. • A working understanding of local buying culture, decision-making and procurement. • Familiarity with the regional partner and system integrator landscape. • Fluency in English and Spanish or Italian; Portuguese is a plus. How you work • Comfortable running long, complex deals with many stakeholders. • Disciplined in qualification and forecasting (MEDDIC/MEDDPICC or similar). • Self-driven and at ease building a territory in a growing team. Nice to have • Experience selling alongside Microsoft, AWS, Google or Databricks. • Track record of displacing incumbent industrial software, such as historians or legacy integration tools. • Experience in an early-stage or scale-up team in a new region. Travel and location • Up to 40% travel within Southern Europe and to EMEA team and partner events. • Based in Southern Europe, ideally near Madrid, Barcelona, Rome, Milan, Lisbon or Porto. title: Senior Product Owner Clinical Registries
description: Our mission We turn data into better healthcare. With our insights, we make healthcare more affordable and better, and we improve the patients’ and clinicians’ experience. Our mission We turn data into better healthcare. With our insights, we make healthcare more affordable and better, and we improve the patients' and clinicians' experience. Your impact Dutch clinical registries are among the richest sources of outcome data in Europe. At LOGEX, that data reaches clinicians and hospitals through applications such as Codman and Data Entry, and reaches researchers and healthcare professionals through data requests and exports. As Senior Product Owner you own that portfolio end to end: the applications that clinicians use every day, and the data pipelines that power them. You are the product owner for our largest registry partner and decide what gets built within a fixed capacity. You also make sure that what we build strengthens the wider LOGEX platform wherever possible. What you'll own Applications: user-facing applications for manual data entry, dashboarding and exports – owning the roadmap, priorities and release quality. Pipelines and business logic: registry processing (merge, load, curation), data exports, scientific data requests, data linkage and registry development sets. One backlog, two types of developers: you lead the product work of a team that combines data engineers with back-end and front-end developers. You translate user and partner’s needs into work for both, and you see early where a front-end change depends on a pipeline change. Prioritisation within fixed capacity: you align with one counterpart at our largest registry partner on what gets built and when, with transparent trade-offs, realistic yearly planning and a clear path to extra capacity when it is funded. Reusable by design: you turn partner-specific needs into shared LOGEX components wherever possible, in close collaboration with other Product Owners and Product Managers. Regulatory and standards readiness: you make sure the products keep meeting healthcare regulation and move along with open data standards, e.g. FHIR. Run and improve: you balance new development with maintenance and technical debt, and you help to reduce key-person risk in a small team. Customer-facing: you work closely with the Customer Office on scope, project proposals and delivery expectations, and you represent the products in partner and user sessions. What you bring At least 5 years of experience as product owner or product manager Proven experience with healthcare analytics or healthcare data: you understand how clinical, operational or registry data becomes insight Experience working with a team of mixed engineering profiles Experience managing a demanding, influential stakeholder or key client Commercial awareness: you understand the difference between paid and internal work, and what it means for team capacity Knowledge of clinical registries or research data is a strong plus Fluent in Dutch and English, spoken and written Why LOGEX? title: Growth & Marketing Manager (m/w/d)
company: Lovebetter Gesellschaft für männliche Sexualität mbH
description: Jobbeschreibung Warum gibt es diese Rolle - und warum jetzt? Lovebetter wächst in eine neue Phase. Wir haben eine klare Mission, starke Inhalte, eine etablierte Marke und zahlreiche Möglichkeiten, noch mehr Männer zu erreichen und nachhaltig zu wachsen. In den vergangenen Jahren haben wir unterschiedliche Marketingkanäle aufgebaut, Partnerschaften entwickelt und wertvolle Erfahrungen gesammelt. Jetzt wollen wir diese Aktivitäten noch besser miteinander verbinden, neue Wachstumschancen erschließen und unsere Ideen schneller in die Umsetzung bringen. Dafür suchen wir dich. Als Growth & Marketing Manager bist du eine zentrale operative Kraft in unserem Marketing. Du verbindest kreatives Denken mit analytischem Verständnis, entwickelst eigene Ideen und sorgst dafür, dass aus Konzepten konkrete Kampagnen, Tests und Ergebnisse werden. Diese Rolle ist bewusst breiter als ein klassischer Marketingjob. Du wirst nicht nur einen einzelnen Kanal betreuen, sondern in ganz unterschiedlichen Bereichen mitarbeiten, eigenständig Verantwortung übernehmen und neue Themen vorantreiben. Du musst dafür nicht alles bereits können. Entscheidend ist, dass du neugierig bist, schnell lernst, lösungsorientiert denkst und Lust hast, Dinge selbst in die Hand zu nehmen. Wofür Lovebetter steht Wir lösen sexuelle Probleme wie vorzeitigen Samenerguss oder Erektionsprobleme mit Männern und befähigen sie, ihre innere Stärke, sexuelle Zufriedenheit und Lebensqualität von innen heraus zu transformieren. Unsere Arbeit wirkt weit über den Einzelnen hinaus: auf Partnerschaften, Familien und kommende Generationen. Wir suchen jemanden, der unsere Mission mitgestalten möchte, Verantwortung übernimmt und versteht, dass wirkungsvolles Marketing Kreativität, analytisches Denken und konsequente Umsetzung verbindet. Deine Mission als Growth & Marketing Manager Du machst Lovebetters Marketing vielseitiger, effizienter und wachstumsstärker. Du entwickelst Marketingideen, setzt Kampagnen um, betreust bestehende und neue Wachstumskanäle und erkennst anhand von Daten, was funktioniert und wo wir besser werden können. Dabei arbeitest du eng mit unserem CMO, unseren Content-Produzenten, Agenturen und externen Partnern zusammen. Du übernimmst eigenständig Projekte – von der ersten Idee über die operative Umsetzung bis zur anschließenden Auswertung. Dabei bewegst du dich selbstverständlich zwischen kreativen, analytischen und organisatorischen Aufgaben. Besonders wichtig: Du wartest nicht darauf, dass dir jemand für jede Herausforderung eine Lösung vorgibt. Du recherchierst, probierst aus, eignest dir neue Fähigkeiten an und findest Wege, Dinge umzusetzen. Deine Aufgaben Marketingkampagnen entwickeln und umsetzen: Du planst und realisierst kanalübergreifende Marketingmaßnahmen, entwickelst kreative Ansätze und begleitest Kampagnen von der Idee bis zur Erfolgsauswertung. Neue Wachstumskanäle erschließen: Du identifizierst neue Möglichkeiten, unsere Zielgruppe zu erreichen, recherchierst Potenziale, entwickelst erste Tests und hilfst dabei, erfolgreiche Ansätze systematisch auszubauen. Ambassador Marketing und Kooperationen vorantreiben: Du entwickelst unser Ambassador-Programm weiter, recherchierst und gewinnst passende Partner, betreust Kooperationen und sorgst dafür, dass aus Beziehungen messbare Marketingmaßnahmen entstehen. Content und Creatives mitgestalten: Du entwickelst Themen, Hooks, Texte und Kampagnenideen, erstellst Briefings und arbeitest mit unseren Content-Produzenten an Inhalten für unterschiedliche Plattformen und Marketingkanäle. CRM und E-Mail-Marketing betreuen: Du setzt Newsletter und Kampagnen um, entwickelst Segmentierungs- und Reaktivierungsansätze und unterstützt dabei, bestehende Kontakte gezielter anzusprechen. Marketingperformance analysieren und optimieren: Du behältst relevante KPIs im Blick, analysierst Kampagnen, Content und Funnels, erkennst Verbesserungspotenziale und leitest konkrete Maßnahmen daraus ab. Websites und Landingpages weiterentwickeln: Du übernimmst kleinere Anpassungen an unseren digitalen Angeboten und unterstützt bei Tests und Optimierungen. Wenn du dafür ein neues Tool wie WordPress lernen musst, arbeitest du dich eigenständig ein. Marketingprojekte und Partner koordinieren: Du hältst laufende Projekte zusammen, koordinierst interne und externe Beteiligte und sorgst dafür, dass Aufgaben zuverlässig und termingerecht umgesetzt werden. KI und Automatisierung sinnvoll einsetzen: Du nutzt moderne KI-Tools für Recherche, Content, Analysen und operative Aufgaben und entwickelst Ideen, wie wir unsere Marketingprozesse kontinuierlich verbessern können. Was diese Rolle besonders macht Abwechslung statt Silodenken: Du arbeitest nicht ausschließlich an Content, Performance oder Analytics, sondern lernst unterschiedliche Marketingdisziplinen kennen und verbindest sie miteinander. Eigenverantwortung statt langer Abstimmungswege: Du bekommst Raum, eigene Ideen einzubringen, Entscheidungen vorzubereiten und Projekte selbstständig voranzutreiben. Kreativität trifft Zahlen: Du kannst neue Kampagnenideen entwickeln und anschließend anhand konkreter Ergebnisse nachvollziehen, ob sie erfolgreich waren. Lernen gehört zum Job: Du musst nicht jedes Tool und jeden Marketingkanal bereits kennen. Wir schätzen Menschen, die sich Herausforderungen stellen und neue Fähigkeiten selbstständig aufbauen. Direkte Zusammenarbeit mit dem CMO: Du erhältst Einblicke in strategische Marketingentscheidungen und bist eng an der Weiterentwicklung unseres Marketings beteiligt. Persönliche Entwicklung und Perspektive: Du wächst mit deinen Aufgaben und hast die Möglichkeit, mit der Weiterentwicklung von Lovebetter zunehmend Verantwortung für größere Projekte, Prozesse und perspektivisch auch Menschen zu übernehmen. Dein Impact Wenn du deinen Job exzellent machst, entsteht: ein Marketing, in dem gute Ideen schneller in konkrete Maßnahmen umgesetzt werden ein Ambassador- und Kooperationsprogramm, das kontinuierlich wächst und messbare Ergebnisse liefert neue Marketingkanäle, die strukturiert getestet, bewertet und weiterentwickelt werden bessere Kampagnen und Inhalte durch die Verbindung von Kreativität und datenbasierten Erkenntnissen optimierte Funnels, CRM-Kampagnen und digitale Kontaktpunkte, die mehr qualifizierte Leads erzeugen effizientere Prozesse durch Eigeninitiative, Automatisierung und den sinnvollen Einsatz von KI ein Marketing-Team, das schneller, selbstständiger und wirkungsvoller arbeitet Klingt nach dir? Dann freuen wir uns, dich kennenzulernen. Schick uns keine Standardbewerbung. Erzähl uns lieber: welche Marketingprojekte oder Kampagnen du bereits eigenständig umgesetzt hast wann du dich zuletzt in ein völlig neues Thema oder Tool eingearbeitet hast und was daraus entstanden ist wie du kreative Ideen entwickelst und herausfindest, ob sie tatsächlich funktionieren welche Aufgaben du schon übernommen hast, obwohl du sie vorher noch nie gemacht hattest und warum du glaubst, dass genau du Lovebetters Marketing mit Kreativität, Eigeninitiative und Umsetzungskraft auf das nächste Level bringen kannst Stellenanforderungen Wen wir suchen (und wen nicht) Diese Rolle passt zu dir, wenn … du bereits praktische Erfahrung im digitalen Marketing gesammelt und idealerweise Kampagnen oder Projekte eigenständig umgesetzt hast du sowohl kreativ als auch analytisch denkst und Spaß daran hast, zwischen unterschiedlichen Aufgaben zu wechseln du eine ausgeprägte Hands-on-Mentalität mitbringst und lieber ins Machen kommst, als lange über Möglichkeiten zu diskutieren du neugierig bist, schnell lernst und dir neue Tools, Plattformen oder Fähigkeiten eigenständig aneignen kannst du auch vor unbekannten Herausforderungen nicht zurückschreckst und den Mut hast, Neues auszuprobieren du Marketingkennzahlen verstehst und aus Ergebnissen sinnvolle Schlussfolgerungen ziehen kannst du strukturiert und zuverlässig arbeitest, Prioritäten setzen kannst und auch bei mehreren parallelen Projekten den Überblick behältst du

title: AI Implementation Intern
description: About MakiPeople Maki builds AI agents that help large companies hire faster and better, from screening to assessment to candidate engagement. Analytical thinking: You can spot patterns in test results, summarize them, and recommend clear next steps. Must have an internship agreement (convention de stage) with a French university Bonus points if you have Languages: You speak more than one language.
