title: Strategic Account Executive - EU
description: Strategic Account Executive, DACH (Paris or London) About Maki Maki is the worlds #1 AI Hiring tool and helps the world's largest companies hire the best people, fast. Nespresso, H&M, Deloitte and other global enterprises use Maki to screen, assess and amplify candidate engagement. Recruiters waste less time, candidates get a better experience, and companies get the best talent, that actually stay. Customers have cut time to hire by up to 45% and a large portion of our business comes from references directly in from customers, the same customers who rank Maki a High Performer 4.7 out of 5 on G2. Why now Enterprises cannot hire fast enough, and AI has made it worse: application volumes are higher than ever, and CVs tell you less. HR has been one of the slowest functions to adopt AI, and now it is pushing hard. Talent leaders know their legacy process hurts candidates, cost and revenue. A store that runs short of staff loses sales every hour it is short. Maki solves that. Maki is at an inflection point. Partners and customers recognise the quality of what we build. Now is the time where Maki goes global to meet the demand the market is putting on us. The role You build the strategy that lands the largest enterprise logos in Germany, Austria and Switzerland and build them into multi-year high growth accounts. You partner with a pod that comprises of a BDR, a forward deployed engineer and a customer success account manager. You bring the buyer a point of view, build the business case with them, and leave every signature with an account plan to grow the account for years. If you want large inbound enterprises that are ready to work with an expert, strategic rep, this is for you. If you want the chance to earn the most you ever have in your sales career, this is for you. What you will do • Run complex enterprise sales cycles across the DACH region, from first call to signature. • Build an account plan and point of view for every key account: the shift it needs to make, what waiting costs, and why Maki above all others in the crowded HR tech space. • Build business cases with the buyer, in the buyer's numbers, that makes them look like experts internally and a no-brainer to partner with Maki. • Lead complex negotiation processes with EB's, procurement, works councils and legal, trading value rather than giving it away. • Land where the customer is ready, and frame the full expansion before signature: entire platform, future use cases, forward thinking commercials. • After landing business, work with your pod to build out a strategic account plan that maximizes growth in the account for years to come. • Be AI first and be able to use AI every day to research, prepare and scale how you work. What you bring • Minimum 6+ years in sales, including 3+ years selling to enterprises in the DACH region. • Fluent German and professional English. • A strategic sales background: you have landed large logos and worked with many stakeholders at once. • Numerous closed six-figure deals you can walk us through in detail. • Points of view and business cases that executives acted on. • You use AI tools in your daily sales work. How we work We are an early team, during these early days these are the traits we demand in every single person: • Grit: you go big on accounts and keep going when a deal gets hard. • Candor: you give direct feedback, you want it back, and you act on it. • Curiosity: you crave learning and you want to build. • Ambition: you are ambitious about your own potential and the power of what Maki can do. What we offer • A competitive compensation that leads the market • Inbound and outbound enterprise demand, and a pod partner with to scale it. • Equity • The best Sales and AI tools • Based in our Paris office, with travel across Germany, Austria and Switzerland Our process • A short interview on Mochi, our AI interviewer, so you try the product yourself. It assess you for various skills and gives you a chance to ask questions. • A 30 minute call about what you are looking for, your background and how we work. • A 30 minute deal review with our VP of Sales. Bring one large strategic deal that you led and closed in the last 12 months. No slides. Be prepared to walk through the deal in detail. • An assignment: build a point of view on an enterprise account we choose, run a live discovery call with us, and show us how you used AI to prepare. • References. • Offer. Unser Ziel: den Alltag von Eltern mit durchdachten, soften und mitwachsenden Baby-Einteilern liebevoll einfacher machen. Und genau dafür brauchen wir dich! Deine Aufgaben: Was dich erwartet: Ideenfindung & Konzept: Du überlegst dir kreative Video-Ideen mit Fokus auf "Problem-Lösungs-Content", die Mamas echte Tipps geben und den Alltagsnutzen unserer Produkte klar zeigen. Präsenz vor der Kamera: Du bist das Gesicht dieser Videos. Du stehst selbstbewusst und sympathisch vor der Kamera und demonstrierst echte Alltags-Szenarien. Dreh & Schnitt: Du filmst und schneidest fesselnde Kurzvideos für unseren Instagram-Feed unsere Werbeanzeigen (Meta Ads). Performance-Fokus: Du produzierst Inhalte, die nicht nur ästhetisch sind, sondern begeistern und verkaufen. Dabei legst du besonderen Wert auf starke Hooks. Deine Qualifikation: Was du mitbringen solltest: Du hast große Lust auf Video-Kreation und fühlst dich zu 100 % wohl damit, dein Gesicht für unsere Social-Media-Kanäle und bezahlten Werbeanzeigen zu zeigen. Du verstehst, wie ein Social-Media-Video psychologisch aufgebaut sein muss, damit es „konvertiert“ – also aus Zuschauern auch wirklich Käufer macht. Du gehst sicher mit gängigen Design- und Videoschnitt-Tools (wie Canva, CapCut o. ä.) um und hast ein gutes Gespür für Ästhetik und aktuelle Social-Media-Trends. Du verwaltest Instagram eigenständig und hast ein echtes Händchen dafür, eine Community aktiv zu pflegen und zum Wachsen zu bringen. Du arbeitest selbständig, setzt Ideen zügig und unkompliziert in die Tat um. Du hast idealerweise einen Bezug zu Baby- und Mama-Themen (kein Muss, aber ein großes Plus!). Du sprichst und schreibst fließend Deutsch Deine Benefits: Was dich bei uns erwartet: Ein sicherer Minijob in einem wachsenden Start-up. Direkte Zusammenarbeit mit der Gründerin Du kannst dir deine Arbeitszeit super flexibel einteilen Mitarbeiterrabatte auf alle Kollektionen Raum für kreative Projekte, neue Formate & deine Ideen Eigenverantwortung ab Tag 1 – wir freuen uns auf deine Handschrift Klingt genau nach dir? Dann vergiss das klassische, langweilige Anschreiben! Schick uns stattdessen einfach eine kurze Nachricht mit ein paar Worten zu dir und – ganz wichtig – Links zu deinen bisherigen Reels/TikToks oder direkt ein kurzes Vorstellungsvideo von dir. Wir wollen sehen, wie du vor der Kamera wirkst! Wir freuen uns riesig auf dich! Find more English Speaking Jobs in Germany on Arbeitnow

title: Customer Success Consultant
description: About Mirakl: Founded in 2012, Mirakl has been at the forefront of marketplace innovation, empowering every business to compete in the platform economy. Today, Mirakl's operating system combines an enterprise marketplace solution (Mirakl Platform) that enables retailers and B2B organizations to launch, scale, and operate marketplaces and dropship, AI-powered multichannel selling (Mirakl Connect), retail media (Mirakl Ads) and an agentic commerce infrastructure (Mirakl Nexus). With dual headquarters in Boston and Paris, Mirakl helps a global ecosystem of 450+ marketplaces (B2C and B2B) and a network of over 100k third-party marketplace sellers. Brands like Macy's, Decathlon, Carrefour, Asos, and Airbus Helicopters use Mirakl to grow their businesses in new and remarkable ways. For more information, visit www.mirakl.com . Mirakl in Numbers: 🗓️ Founded in 2012 | Member of French Tech Next40 👥 750+ employees in 9 offices worldwide: Paris, Barcelona, Bordeaux, Boston, London, Munich, New York, Sydney, Tokyo Our Values: Working at Mirakl means accelerating your career alongside ambitious, passionate, and supportive colleagues. We're proud of the diversity of backgrounds, perspectives, and experiences that make our teams unique. Our 5 values guide how we collaborate: 💡 Work Hard Together: Teamwork and collaboration are the foundation of our success 🏆 Get Things Done: We prioritize action and efficiency for impactful results 🚀 Go Above & Beyond: We tackle challenges proactively and always aim for excellence 🎓 Succeed Through Expertise: Knowledge sharing and continuous learning are core to our culture 🤝 Satisfy & Empower Clients: We're committed to our clients' success The Team You'll Join You'll be part of our International Customer Success team led by Philippe, Director of Customer Success. The team consists of around ten Consultants based across Barcelona and Paris, covering a global portfolio of B2B and B2C accounts. Together, you'll be ensuring each client's marketplace reaches its full performance potential — acting as the strategic backbone behind their growth. Your Impact Serve as the strategic and functional point of reference for B2B and B2C clients across both project and run phases — running tailored workshops with C-level stakeholders, shaping marketplace strategy, and keeping projects firmly on track to go-live. Build personalised post-launch action plans with each client, lead data-driven business reviews, and translate KPI analysis into concrete growth recommendations for marketplace teams and senior leadership. Define seller and customer strategies, benchmark against leading global marketplaces, and leverage the latest e-commerce trends and Mirakl product features to continuously drive client performance. Work cross-functionally with Mirakl's Business and IT teams to anticipate risks early, align on priorities, and ensure clients extract maximum value from the platform. Embed AI into your daily workflows — testing agents, providing structured feedback, and applying critical thinking to push the boundaries of how the team operates. What You'll Bring to the Role Experience: 2 to 4 years' experience in at least one of the following: management consulting, a business role within an e-commerce company or online marketplace (B2B or B2C), or Customer Success in B2B Enterprise SaaS — marketplace or digital commerce experience is a strong plus Proven track record of influencing and guiding senior stakeholders, including C-level, in a client-facing environment Master's degree in Business, Management, Finance or a related field Skills: Analytical and data-driven thinking: comfortable building business cases, interpreting KPIs and turning data into actionable recommendations Senior stakeholder management and influence Strategic business advisory and structured problem-solving Strong written, verbal and presentation communication AI literacy with a critical mindset — you already use AI tools and are curious to go further Languages English: Full professional proficiency (required) French: Full professional proficiency (required) Spanish, Italian or Arabic (a real asset) Our Hiring Process We warmly encourage you to apply to any of our roles, even if you think you're not an exact match. Please click the "Apply" button to submit your application — this helps us make the best possible assessment and get back to you as quickly as possible. Screening call with Talent Acquisition Interview with the Hiring Manager (business reviews and analytical skills) Values interviews with 3 team members We welcome collaborators with their diverse perspectives and experiences to power us forward. These often far exceed conventional job requirements and help us create a culture of continuous learning. If you're ready to join a global leader powering digital transformation for 450+ of the world's most innovative retailers and B2B organizations. As part of our recruitment process, Mirakl processes your personal data to review and manage your application and, where appropriate, to consider your profile for future opportunities. You can exercise your data protection rights at any time, and as further detailed in our policies. For more information about how we process your personal data and your rights, please consult our Recruitment Privacy Notice, here in English and here in French. While AI helps us work efficiently, all final hiring decisions are made by humans. For more information, visit our AI Guidelines for Candidates and Interviews . title: Senior AI Engineer - Freelance

Mirakl in Numbers: 🗓️ Founded in 2012 | Member of French Tech Next40 👥 750+ employees in 9 offices worldwide: Paris, Barcelona, Bordeaux, Boston, London, Munich, New York, Sydney, Tokyo 🇫🇷 350+ Mirakl Tech teams members mainly based in France ⚙️ 5 Saas Solutions Our Values: Working at Mirakl means accelerating your career alongside ambitious, passionate, and supportive colleagues. We're proud of the diversity of backgrounds, perspectives, and experiences that make our teams unique. Our 5 values guide how we collaborate: 💡 Work Hard Together: Teamwork and collaboration are the foundation of our success 🏆 Get Things Done: We prioritize action and efficiency for impactful results 🚀 Go Above & Beyond: We tackle challenges proactively and always aim for excellence 🎓 Succeed Through Expertise: Knowledge sharing and continuous learning are core to our culture 🤝 Satisfy & Empower Clients: We're committed to our clients' success About the job Design, build, and scale production-grade AI systems that power the next generation of intelligent commerce. You will work at the intersection of Software Engineering, Machine Learning, and Generative AI to build AI-native products, agentic systems, and platform capabilities used by Mirakl customers and internal teams. This is a freelance position based in Paris or Bordeaux, with 1 day of remote work per week. Why Now, Why Mirakl Generative AI and AI Agents are fundamentally reshaping commerce software and the way our teams work on a day to day basis. At Mirakl, AI is becoming a core part of our product strategy. From Catalog Transformer and content generation to AI Agents and Agentic Commerce, we are building the next generation of commerce software. And we have the same ambition for our teams around AI products and adoption. We are looking for a Senior AI Engineer to transform the way our internal teams work, and to have a significant impact on the agentic side of our Saas products. You won't be joining a company that's thinking about AI. You'll be joining one that's already building it. What You'll Do 1. Design & Build AI Systems Design, build, and deploy production-grade AI systems for both Mirakl internal operations. Develop solutions leveraging: LLMs, RAG, AI Agents, Multimodal AI and Evaluation frameworks. Architect complex agentic workflows including tools, memory, retrieval, planning, and guardrails. Rapidly prototype new capabilities and evolve them into scalable, reliable AI production systems. 2. Integrate Across the Stack Connect AI systems to internal platforms, business applications, and data sources across the company. Enable AI agents to interact with systems such as CRM, data platform, Drive, Jira, support tools, and internal knowledge bases. Design robust orchestration layers between models, APIs, tools, retrieval systems, and business workflows. Ensure reliability, observability, scalability, and maintainability across the entire AI stack. 3. Iterate for Impact Partner with end users, business teams, Product Managers, and Engineers to identify high-value opportunities for AI. Run pilots and experiments, gather qualitative and quantitative feedback, and measure business impact. Analyze usage patterns, failure modes, costs, latency, and performance metrics. Continuously improve accuracy, reliability, adoption, and user experience through data-driven iteration. 4. Ensure Quality, Security & Reliability Implement evaluation frameworks, guardrails, validation layers, and monitoring systems. Design AI systems that are secure, explainable, and production-ready. Ensure compliance with data security, governance, and access control requirements. Document architectures, capabilities, limitations, KPIs, and operational best practices. 5. Drive Adoption & Enablement Build a scalable ecosystem of AI systems and agents that empower both internal teams and customers. Support teams in adopting AI-powered workflows and integrating AI into their daily operations. Contribute to AI engineering standards, reusable frameworks, and best practices across the company. Act as a champion for AI-driven ways of working and help shape Mirakl's transition toward Agentic Commerce. Our stack and tools Languages: Python and SQL AI Stack: OpenAI, Anthropic, Gemini, Mistral and Open-source models Agentic & Retrieval: LangGraph, LangChain, LlamaIndex, MCP and Vector Databases Infrastructure: AWS or GCP, Docker and Kubernetes What Makes You Successful Strong engineering mindset: able to design reliable and scalable systems Strong AI expertise: able to translate the latest AI capabilities into production products Strong product mindset: able to balance technical excellence with business impact Focus on measurable outcomes, not technical complexity Success Metrics Product adoption and business impact Performance and reliability of AI systems Quality of AI outputs and evaluation metrics You'll Love This Job If you have 5+ years of experience in Software Engineering, ML Engineering, Applied AI, or related fields Strong Python and software engineering fundamentals Hands-on experience building production AI systems using LLMs, RAG, and AI Agents Experience designing multi-step agentic workflows and retrieval systems Experience evaluating AI systems and improving model performance Experience deploying and operating production services in cloud environments Strong communication skills in English Curiosity, pragmatism, and passion for building AI products Feel free to add a link to your GitHub in your CV so we can understand what you have worked on! Want to join us? Here is our process A 30-40 min phone conversation with one of our Tech recruiters. This will be an opportunity to discuss your background, expectations, and discover what Mirakl can offer you in return. An initial 1h30 technical discussion with a member of the Data Science team and Engineering Team, which will allow you to delve into the more specific aspects of your expertise and discover how your skills can be integrated into our projects. 2 x 45-minute "STAR" interviews with future Mirakl colleagues to discuss our values and company culture. description: About Mistral Mistral provides full-stack AI solutions: from frontier models to developer tools, applications, and compute. We partner with enterprises tackling the hardest problems across high-stakes industries like finance, manufacturing, defense, healthcare, and the public sector, co-creating customized AI systems that they can run on their terms. We are a dynamic, collaborative team passionate about AI and its potential to transform society. Our diverse workforce thrives in competitive environments and is committed to driving innovation. Our teams are distributed between Europe, North America, Asia and the Middle East. We are creative, low-ego and team-spirited. Our mission Serve as Mistral AI’s senior technical authority for critical electrical, mechanical and life-safety infrastructure across assigned colocation sites. Protect the availability of high-density AI compute by identifying technical risks before they become incidents, challenging infrastructure operating practices and verifying that power and cooling systems perform within agreed requirements. Operating context & accountability Working with Engineering Operations leadership, IT Operations, hardware partners and colocation providers, you will provide hands-on technical assurance across a site or cluster. You will assess provider performance, advise on critical decisions, support incident response and ensure operational learning drives durable improvements. The role focuses on technical oversight and influence rather than direct management of the colocation provider’s maintenance workforce. Technical assurance and operational risk Own and maintain the site technical risk register, including electrical and mechanical single points of failure, maintenance exposure, redundancy limitations, cooling capacity, liquid-cooling interfaces and common-mode failure scenarios. Assess the resilience of utility connections, MV/LV distribution, transformers, generators, UPS, switchgear, busways, protection systems, pumps, cooling plant, controls and monitoring against the contracted operating envelope. Review provider preventive maintenance strategies, schedules, critical asset condition and outstanding defects; identify maintenance deferrals and vulnerabilities that may affect AI compute availability. Critically review high-risk methods of procedure, electrical switching and isolation plans, planned impairments, work sequencing, contingency measures, rollback plans and restoration criteria. Validate the completeness and quality of technical documentation, including single-line diagrams, P&IDs, operating sequences, alarm matrices, capacity records, asset registers and operating procedures. Use BMS/EPMS trends, alarms, power-quality records and cooling telemetry to identify abnormal operating conditions, capacity constraints and deteriorating resilience before service is affected. Incident response, investigations and reliability Act as a senior engineering escalation point during major infrastructure incidents; rapidly assess failure domain, remaining redundancy, safety implications, likely IT impact and viable restoration options. Coordinate technical information across the colocation provider, Mistral IT Operations and OEM partners, ensuring accurate incident timelines, risk communication and controlled return to service. Review and challenge root-cause analyses, distinguishing immediate triggers from underlying design, maintenance, controls, process and organizational contributors. Define and follow up corrective and preventive actions, requesting evidence of implementation and verifying that recurring failure modes have been addressed. Identify systemic trends across sites and share lessons learned with engineering design, commissioning and regional operations teams. Support emergency response planning and tabletop exercises covering loss of utility, cooling failures, liquid leaks, fire/life-safety events and critical equipment failures. Capacity delivery, commissioning and change control Participate in design and constructability reviews for expansions, retrofits and new AI deployments; flag operational, maintainability and resilience concerns early. Review commissioning and integrated systems testing plans, including power transfers, redundancy scenarios, controls failure modes, cooling recovery and operational readiness criteria. Challenge test results and acceptance evidence against defined electrical, thermal and operational requirements; track unresolved technical issues through handover. Partner with IT Operations on rack power and thermal limits, direct-to-chip liquid cooling, coolant distribution unit boundaries, leak response and load-restoration dependencies. Assess proposed changes to critical infrastructure, including concurrent maintenance, controls updates and brownfield works; recommend safeguards and escalation where exposure is unacceptable. Provide technical coaching to internal stakeholders, contribute to engineering standards and support recruitment and knowledge sharing as the portfolio expands. Success measures Critical technical risks are identified early, prioritized and reduced through verified mitigation actions, supporting Mistral’s availability objectives. High-risk maintenance and infrastructure changes receive timely, evidence-based technical review with clear mitigations and escalation. Major incidents are diagnosed accurately, communicated effectively and followed by robust root-cause analysis and verified corrective actions. New and expanded capacity meets agreed redundancy, electrical, cooling and operational acceptance requirements. Repeat failures, unresolved high-severity defects and preventable technical deviations decrease over time. Minimum qualifications 5–7+ years in critical facilities engineering, commissioning, data center operations or technical assurance in high-availability environments. Strong practical knowledge of critical electrical infrastructure (UPS, generators, MV/LV distribution, switchgear and protection) and mechanical systems (cooling plant, pumps, controls and heat rejection). Ability to review single-line diagrams, operating sequences, technical procedures, maintenance plans, commissioning evidence and root-cause analyses. Demonstrated experience troubleshooting complex infrastructure incidents and influencing external technical teams without direct line authority. Clear written and verbal English communication, sound judgment under pressure and willingness to travel and participate in incident escalation as needed. Preferred experience Full technical governance, multi-site operations or mission-critical facilities serving high-density AI/HPC workloads. Experience with direct-to-chip liquid cooling, CDUs, facility/technology cooling interfaces, water quality, leak detection and rack-level thermal management. Integrated systems testing, EPMS/BMS trend analysis, protection coordination, failure-mode reviews and cross-site engineering standardization. Experience partnering with hardware OEMs, design engineers, commissioning teams and infrastructure providers during live-site expansion. The team sits at the intersection of research and production: you will take ideas from recent literature, form hypotheses, run experiments, and ship the techniques that prove out into our serving stack. This role sits between our inference engineers, who own the production serving stack, and our research scientists, who focus on paper-level contributions. You will be more science-focused than a pure engineer: you are expected to generate new ideas, keep up with the state of the art, and implement proof-of-concepts that bridge the gap between academic results and production impact. Some techniques you explore will be lossy or require integration into training — retraining models, tuning architectures, or training auxiliary models to improve inference. You will work closely with the Inference Foundation and Kernels teams, who turn your validated techniques into production recipes, and with pretraining and RL teams when your work touches model training. Success is measured by demonstrated latency or throughput gains, first at small scale, then adopted in production. What You Will Do Research and prototype inference techniques — speculative decoding, quantization, KV compression, watermarking, and new model architectures — by reading recent literature and forming testable hypotheses. Design and run experiments to validate or refute ideas, iterating quickly on small-scale setups before proposing production integration. Demonstrate clear latency or throughput gains without unacceptable quality loss. Collaborate with the Inference Foundation team to integrate validated techniques into the vLLM-based serving stack. Partner with pretraining and RL teams when techniques require co-training, retraining, or training auxiliary models to improve inference. Build the right tooling and validation platforms to facilitate AI-driven inference research. What We're Looking For A strong ML background with solid knowledge of LLM training techniques — architecture, tokenization, fine-tuning, and evaluation. Hands-on experience with Python and PyTorch; you write clean, experimental code and iterate fast. JAX is acceptable with strong Python proficiency. C++ and Rust are not required, CUDA and GPU knowledge is expected but hands-on experience is not required. Research experience of some form: a thesis, publications, a dedicated research project, or efficiency-oriented work in a lab or industry research setting. A PhD is not required, but we are looking for genuine research depth. A track record of conducting experiments: forming hypotheses, designing controlled comparisons, and drawing clear conclusions from results. Familiarity with the state of the art in LLM inference — you know what has been tried, what works, and where the open problems are. Self-starter, low-ego, and collaborative. You are comfortable with ambiguity, negative results, and are eager to take matters into your own hands. Inference or serving experience is a plus, not a requirement. Prior work with vLLM, production LLM deployments, or serving systems will help you ramp up faster. Location and Remote This role is based in our Paris or London offices (hybrid). We will prioritize candidates who reside in the Paris area or are open to relocating. We strongly believe in the value of in-person collaboration to foster strong relationships and seamless communication within our team. Signaleren van verbetermogelijkheden binnen financiële processen en bijdragen aan verdere professionalisering van de financiële organisatie. Ervaring binnen een projectgedreven organisatie, bij voorkeur in architectuur, engineering, consultancy of een vergelijkbare omgeving. Een sterk begrip van financiële rapportage, project accounting en interne beheersing. Gevorderde Excel-vaardigheden en ervaring met ERP- en BI-tools. Vloeiend Engels; Nederlands is een pré. Analytisch, gestructureerd en kwaliteitsgericht. In staat financiële vraagstukken begrijpelijk te maken voor niet-financiële stakeholders. Proactief, zelfstandig en gericht op verbetering. title: Project Booking Manager B2B (m/w/d)
description: Firmenunterkünfte, Gruppenbuchungen und eigene Kunden Du übernimmst dein eigenes Portfolio an Firmenkunden. Du entscheidest, welche Unterkünfte wir anbieten, setzt die Preise, verhandelst mit Hotels und bist die feste Ansprechperson für deine Kunden. Kein Zuarbeiten, keine Freigabeschleifen für jede Kleinigkeit: Du trägst Verantwortung für das Ergebnis. Über MyFlexHome MyFlexHome ist die smarte Buchungslösung für Unternehmensbuchungen und Projektteams. Mit unserem Booking Board organisieren wir Übernachtungen für ganze Projektteams, etwa auf Baustellen, bei Montageeinsätzen oder Workshops, und verbinden Unternehmen mit passenden Unterkünften in ganz Deutschland. Wir sind ein schnell wachsendes StartUp im WERK1 München. Wir arbeiten mit eigenen Tools und KI-gestützten Abläufen, damit Zeit für das bleibt, was zählt: gute Entscheidungen für unsere Kunden. Deine Verantwortung: Eigene Kunden: Du betreust ein festes Portfolio an Firmenkunden eigenständig im Tagesgeschäft und bist ihre erste und feste Ansprechperson. Angebote und Preise: Du recherchierst Hotels, Serviced Apartments und Ferienwohnungen, entscheidest über die passenden Optionen und erstellst Angebote inklusive Preissetzung in einem klar abgesteckten Rahmen. Verhandlung: Du verhandelst Raten, Kontingente und Stornobedingungen mit Hotels und verantwortest das wirtschaftliche Ergebnis deiner Projekte. Laufende Projekte: Du steuerst mehrere parallele Projekte, setzt Prioritäten selbst und löst kurzfristige Änderungen, Probleme und Eskalationen eigenständig. Kommunikation: Du führst die gesamte Kunden- und Hotelkommunikation, auf Deutsch und bei Bedarf auf Englisch. Prozesse: Du arbeitest in unserem Buchungssystem und gestaltest Abläufe und Tools aktiv mit. Was dich ausbremst, verbesserst du. Das brauchst du: Lust auf (und bestenfalls Erfahrung in der) Organisation von Hotelbuchungen – egal ob auf Anbieter- oder Kundenseite (z. B. title: Full Stack Engineer
description: About myTomorrows myTomorrows is a global health tech company dedicated to breaking down barriers for patients seeking treatment options. Comfortable using AI-assisted development tools (e.g. Claude Code, Cursor, or similar) as part of daily workflow. title: Working Student Software Engineering
description: Intro For this position we are looking for students or recent graduates in Zürich , working hybrid at the ETH Student Project House (SPH) and remotely. Nairon GmbH is a Swiss startup building AI voice agents that answer and make phone calls for businesses. Our platform runs real-time conversations over the phone and on the web, connected to our customers' telephony and business tools. We value clear communication, thoughtful engineering, and a collaborative approach to problem-solving. Join us as we continue to develop tools that make a difference. We are looking for a Working Student (30–60%) who wants to work on real production systems next to their studies. We are flexible on the duration of the employment. Tasks As a Working Student at Nairon GmbH, you will work with our team on one or more of these areas, depending on your interests and skills: Voice AI: turn-taking, latency measurements, LLM prompting and tool calls, and evaluating speech models (STT and TTS). Voice model training: training foundational speech models (TTS and STT) on GPUs: data collection and preparation, training runs, fine-tuning for German and Swiss-German voices, and evaluation. Realtime backend: Python services around our LiveKit -based media platform, messaging and integrations with customer systems. Web and mobile: features in our Next.js / React / TypeScript web application and our Expo / React Native app. Platform: Docker , Kubernetes , monitoring and the tooling that keeps our services running. Commercial and tech sales: preparing demos and pilot agents, answering customers' technical questions, market and competitor research, and supporting offers and partner conversations. Building test calls, benchmarks and small internal tools, and writing down what you learn. Requirements Experience: Currently enrolled at ETH Zürich or another university or Fachhochschule, or graduated recently, in computer science, electrical engineering, data science, business and engineering (e.g. MTEC, Wirtschaftsingenieurwesen) or a related field. First project or work experience is a plus, not a must. Technical Skills: Required: Programming in Python or TypeScript ; for the engineering areas, good fundamentals in Git, APIs and debugging. For commercial work: a solid technical understanding and the ability to explain technology to customers. Nice to have: Experience with LLMs, speech or audio processing, or machine learning. Deep learning with PyTorch , training on GPUs, or a related thesis or research project. Next.js , React or mobile development. Docker , Linux or cloud platforms. Interest in sales, business development or startups. Communication: English proficiency is essential , both written and spoken, as it is the working language for all positions. German is a plus, and important for customer-facing work. Soft Skills: Curious, quick to learn and able to work independently. Reliable with the hours you commit to, next to your studies. Benefits Flexible Work Setup: Hybrid: work at the ETH Student Project House in Zürich and remotely, around your study schedule. Equipment Provided: Company laptop provided. Collaborative Environment: Join a small, agile team where your contributions go into production. Growth Opportunities: Real experience in AI voice technology and in building a startup, with the possibility of a thesis topic or a full-time role in engineering or sales after your studies. Closing If you want to build AI that talks on real phone lines while you study, we'd love to hear from you. Please tell us which areas interest you most, technical or commercial, and how many hours per week you can work. Find more English Speaking Jobs in Switzerland on Arbeitnow

title: Werkstudent (m/w/d) Projektmanagment
description: Du willst im Studentenjob nicht Kaffee kochen und Listen abtippen, sondern an echten Projekten und an einem System arbeiten, das danach dauerhaft anders läuft? Dann lies weiter. Wir sind neaSOL , ein junges, wachsendes Unternehmen im Bereich Photovoltaik. Wir bauen Photovoltaikanlagen, Speicher, Wallboxen und Energiemanagement – sauber, schnell und auf höchstem technischen Niveau. Und das ist nicht nur so dahingesagt: Von GoodWe , einem der führenden Hersteller weltweit, wurden wir als digitalste und schnellste Firma des Herstellers ausgezeichnet. Genau da setzt deine Rolle an. Du arbeitest direkt an der Seite unseres Projektmanagers : Ihr geht Projekte gemeinsam durch, prüft sie auf Vollständigkeit, Termine und Wirtschaftlichkeit – und du sorgst dafür, dass nichts durchrutscht. Parallel treibst du unser zweites großes Thema voran: unser Warenwirtschaftssystem auf Automatisierungsniveau zu heben . Bestände, Beschaffung, Materialflüsse und Projektzuordnung sollen künftig KI-gestützt und weitgehend automatisch laufen statt manuell gepflegt zu werden. Kurz gesagt: Du behandelst nicht nur die einzelnen Projekte – du behandelst die Warenwirtschaft selbst als Projekt . Wer bei uns Einblick will, wie ein Betrieb Schritt für Schritt KI-basiert aufgestellt wird, bekommt ihn hier aus der ersten Reihe. Aufgaben Projektbegleitung: Du unterstützt unseren Projektmanager im Tagesgeschäft – von der Auftragsübergabe über die Terminierung bis zur Fertigmeldung. Projektprüfung: Du gehst laufende Projekte gemeinsam mit ihm durch: Sind alle Unterlagen da? Stimmen Material, Termine und Kalkulation? Wo hakt es – und warum? Warenwirtschaft automatisieren: Du analysierst, wie unsere Warenwirtschaft heute läuft, findest die manuellen Bremsklötze und baust mit uns den Weg zur Automatisierung. KI & Tools einsetzen: Du testest und implementierst KI-gestützte Lösungen und Schnittstellen – von automatisierten Bestandsabgleichen bis zu Auswertungen, die vorher niemand hatte. Prozesse dokumentieren: Du hältst Abläufe sauber fest, damit aus Wissen im Kopf ein System wird, das auch ohne dich funktioniert. Auswertungen & Reporting: Du bereitest Zahlen so auf, dass Projektmanagement und Geschäftsführung schnell entscheiden können. Qualifikation Du bist eingeschriebener Student (m/w/d) – z. B. Wirtschaftsinformatik, BWL, Wirtschaftsingenieurwesen, Supply Chain / Logistik, Informatik oder ein vergleichbarer Studiengang. Wichtiger als der Titel ist, wie du denkst. Du hast Spaß an Prozessen und Systemen und willst verstehen, warum etwas so läuft, wie es läuft – nicht nur, dass es läuft. Digitale Affinität: Excel/Google Sheets sitzen, mit ERP-/Warenwirtschaftssystemen, Automatisierungstools oder KI-Anwendungen hast du schon gearbeitet oder willst es unbedingt. Du arbeitest strukturiert, eigenständig und verbindlich – wenn du etwas zusagst, kommt es auch. Du bist kommunikativ und traust dich, im Team nachzuhaken, wenn Informationen fehlen. Sehr gute Deutschkenntnisse in Wort und Schrift. Du hast ca. 20 Stunden pro Woche Zeit (in der vorlesungsfreien Zeit gerne mehr) und willst länger als ein Semester bleiben. Kein Muss: Vorkenntnisse in Photovoltaik. Die Technik bringen wir dir bei – Kopf und Motivation bringst du mit. Benefits Was wir dir bieten Ein echtes Projekt statt Hilfsjob: Die Automatisierung unserer Warenwirtschaft ist deins – mit Verantwortung, Budgetgesprächen und sichtbarem Ergebnis. Kurze Wege: Du arbeitest eng mit dem Projektmanagement und direkt mit der Geschäftsführung. Entscheidungen dauern bei uns keine Wochen. Einblick in einen KI-getriebenen Betrieb: Wir stellen unser Unternehmen von Lead bis Rechnung konsequent digital und automatisiert auf. Du bist mittendrin, nicht in der Theorievorlesung. Attraktive Vergütung: [15 € / Stunde] – fair und pünktlich. Flexible Zeiteinteilung , abgestimmt auf deinen Stundenplan und deine Prüfungsphasen. Bestes Equipment: aktuelle Hardware und Software – wir sparen nicht an den Werkzeugen unserer Leute. Ausgezeichnetes Umfeld: von GoodWe als digitalste und schnellste Firma des Herstellers ausgezeichnet. Familiäres, dynamisches Team , das anpackt – inklusive gemeinsamer Team-Events. Perspektive: Wer bei uns liefert, dem machen wir nach dem Studium gerne ein Angebot. Wenn du als Werkstudent Lust hast, diese Einblicke bei uns zu bekommen – melde dich einfach. Bewirb dich unkompliziert über Join. Ein Lebenslauf und zwei, drei Sätze dazu, warum dich das Thema reizt, reichen uns fürs Erste völlig. Zeugnisse und Anschreiben brauchst du nicht. Den Rest besprechen wir persönlich. Klingt nach dir? Dann lass uns reden. Find more English Speaking Jobs in Germany on Arbeitnow

title: Senior Machine Learning Engineer, LLM Inference Optimization
description: About Nebius: Nebius is leading a new era in cloud infrastructure for the global AI economy. We are building a full-stack AI cloud platform that supports developers and enterprises from data and model training through to production deployment, without the cost and complexity of building large in-house AI/ML infrastructure. Built by engineers, for engineers. From large-scale GPU orchestration to inference optimization, we own the hard problems across compute, storage, networking and applied AI. Listed on Nasdaq (NBIS) and headquartered in Amsterdam, we have a global footprint with R&D hubs across Europe, the UK, North America and Israel. Our team of 1,500+ includes hundreds of engineers with deep expertise across hardware, software and AI R&D. The role As a Senior Machine Learning Engineer on the Applied AI team at Nebius Token Factory, you will own model and endpoint optimization from model artifacts through production deployment. Your work will span model internals, quantization and model compression, speculative decoding, KV-cache optimization, inference engines, serving architecture, and benchmarking to improve latency, throughput, memory efficiency, GPU utilization, and cost per token while preserving quality and reliability. You will work with kernel and platform engineers to investigate serving problems, compare configurations, and resolve performance and quality regressions. You will evaluate model- and engine-level optimizations together with distributed inference designs, including request routing, scheduling, prefill/decode coordination, and multi-node GPU execution. Your improvements will be validated through reproducible benchmarks and safe production rollouts under real-world workloads. Your responsibilities Own optimization projects for specific model families, customer endpoints, or serving backends. Compare inference engines and recommend serving configurations suited to individual workloads. Diagnose model-quality and performance regressions during production rollouts. Improve LLM and VLM endpoint latency, throughput, memory efficiency, GPU utilization, quality, and cost per token. Deploy, configure, benchmark, and extend engines such as vLLM, SGLang, TensorRT-LLM, Triton Inference Server, and NVIDIA Dynamo. Develop production model-compression workflows covering quantization, quantization-aware training, distillation, low-bit serving, and accuracy recovery. Implement or integrate speculative decoding, draft-model approaches, KV-cache optimization, prefix caching, chunked prefill, continuous batching, and disaggregated prefill/decode serving. For prefill–decode disaggregation (PDD), evaluate KV-cache transfer, worker placement, and capacity balancing to determine which workloads benefit from the architecture. Design and improve LLM request routers and scheduling policies that balance worker utilization, queueing, request characteristics, and KV-cache locality while meeting latency and reliability targets. Scale dense and mixture-of-experts inference across multiple GPU nodes. Select and tune tensor, pipeline, data, and expert parallelism—including wide expert parallelism (WideEP)—with attention to hardware topology, expert load balance, and communication overhead. Build reproducible benchmark harnesses measuring TTFT, TPOT, tokens per second per GPU, p95/p99 latency, GPU memory, reliability, and cost per token. Validate architecture choices under representative traffic and consistent GPU budgets. Collaborate with GPU kernel and platform engineers to trace bottlenecks across model code, kernels, runtime, scheduler, gateway, and cluster layers. Produce design documents, performance reports, rollout plans, and customer-facing technical explanations. Must-haves Strong engineering skills in Python and PyTorch. Hands-on experience deploying or optimizing LLM, VLM, or high-throughput transformer inference. Practical knowledge of at least one modern inference stack, such as vLLM, SGLang, TensorRT-LLM, Triton Inference Server, NVIDIA Dynamo, Ray Serve, KServe, or an equivalent internal system. A strong understanding of transformer inference bottlenecks involving KV cache, attention, memory bandwidth, batching, parallelism, and long-context serving. Ability to quantify trade-offs among latency, throughput, quality, utilization, and cost. Experience designing or optimizing distributed inference system architecture, with hands-on work in one or more areas such as request routing, distributed scheduling, PDD, multi-node inference, or expert parallelism. Strong communication and collaboration skills across research, kernel, infrastructure, product, and customer teams. Nice-to-haves Experience with quantization-aware training, post-training quantization, FP8, INT8, INT4, NVFP4, MXFP4, AWQ, GPTQ, or SmoothQuant. Experience with distillation, speculative decoding, EAGLE, Medusa, multi-token prediction, or related inference acceleration methods. Experience supporting agentic workloads involving tool calling, structured outputs, streaming APIs, high concurrency, and multi-step orchestration. Familiarity with CUDA or Triton; the role does not require kernel engineering to be the candidate’s primary specialization. Contributions to open-source projects such as vLLM, SGLang, TensorRT-LLM, FlashInfer, LMCache, PyTorch, Triton, Ray, or KServe. Implementation experience with cache-aware request routing, PDD, or WideEP, including diagnosing communication bottlenecks and load imbalance. Familiarity with GPU communication libraries and interconnects, such as NCCL, NVLink, InfiniBand, or RoCE. title: Senior Software Engineer (Data Platform, C++)
description: About Nebius: Nebius is leading a new era in cloud infrastructure for the global AI economy. We are building a full-stack AI cloud platform that supports developers and enterprises from data and model training through to production deployment, without the cost and complexity of building large in-house AI/ML infrastructure. Built by engineers, for engineers. From large-scale GPU orchestration to inference optimization, we own the hard problems across compute, storage, networking and applied AI. Listed on Nasdaq (NBIS) and headquartered in Amsterdam, we have a global footprint with R&D hubs across Europe, the UK, North America and Israel. Our team of 1,500+ includes hundreds of engineers with deep expertise across hardware, software and AI R&D. The role #LI-MM1 We’re looking for a Software Engineer with strong C++ expertise to join the team building and operating Nebius Data Platform — a distributed storage and a processing platform that acts as the company’s “source of truth” and the backbone of many internal (and some external) products. Nebius Data Platform is a single multi-tenant ecosystem based on YTsaurus — instead of running separate HDFS/Kafka/HBase-style systems, we provide storage, compute, and analytics capabilities inside one platform. Built on top of the open-source YTsaurus ecosystem, we run and extend our own Nebius distribution and develop significant in-house functionality (core and platform-level). We can design, implement, and roll out features end-to-end on our clusters without waiting for upstream approvals and contribute upstream when it makes sense. At scale today, this includes ~500 servers, ~20k CPU cores and ~10 PB of compressed data in our largest production cluster, supporting workloads ranging from business-critical pipelines and financial transactions to large-scale ML/LLM training datasets and compute. What’s inside the platform You’ll work on a system that includes (and ties together): Distributed Storage (Cypress) : transactional semantics, tiered storage, erasure coding, replication, and strong reliability expectations. Compute & ETL : a cluster-wide job scheduler (tens of thousands of cores), MapReduce, YQL for SQL-like data processing, and SPYT (Spark over YTsaurus) for modern data engineering. Interactive analytics (CHYT) : ClickHouse® instances spun up directly on compute nodes for fast SQL over data in-place. description: Odin is building the investment infrastructure for the future of private markets. Brutal honesty: If work doesn't meet the bar, people need to hear it, and the right people want to. The OLIX Decode Accelerator 1 (DX-1) is the first accelerator architected specifically for decode. Rack-scale co-design of logic, data movement, packaging, optics and interconnect enables a step change in system level performance. The Role The Talent Director owns how OLIX finds, wins and hires the people who will build it. You will take a talent function built for around 200 people and make it one that carries us confidently to 1,000, across London, Bristol, Austin, San Francisco and Toronto, without lowering the bar on a single hire. This is a hands on leadership role. You will personally lead our most senior and executive searches, and close people who are not looking. Many of the people we need exist in pools of a few dozen worldwide: III-V device engineers, advanced packaging architects, optical interconnect specialists, AI software engineers, silicon leaders who have taken a chip to production. Hiring them is a precision problem, not a volume one. You will build a team of recruiters as sharp as the engineers they hire, and set an AI strategy for recruiting that changes how we decide, not just how fast we work. The best argument wins here, and we expect you to make it, welcome challenges to it, and change your mind when the evidence says so. Responsibilities Build and scale the talent function from around 200 to 1,000 people: org design, hiring, priorities and operating rhythm, in place before the headcount arrives Lead senior and executive searches directly, including the hires that signal the calibre of people joining OLIX Attract, hire and develop top Recruiters and Sourcers, and hold them to the same bar as our engineers Own the hiring bar: what great looks like for each role family, and how consistently every interviewer applies it Build the playbook for extremely scarce talent: mapping the market, building relationships early, and closing passive candidates Set OLIX's AI strategy for recruiting, deciding where AI improves our judgement and where people need to stay in the loop Own hiring systems, data and metrics, and partner with the exec team on workforce planning, including saying when a plan is not hireable as written Build OLIX's talent brand so the best people in photonics, silicon and AI know who we are Skills & Experience Has built and led a talent function through hyper-growth, from a few hundred people toward 1,000 or beyond, while keeping quality high. title: Team Lead Manager - Product Engineer
description: Our Mission: Omnea is the agentic operating system for procurement. Procurement touches every pound a business spends, yet requests still stall for weeks and approvals get lost in inboxes. Our AI-first platform changes that: our agents capture requests, route approvals, onboard suppliers, flag risk and track every renewal, while anyone in the business can ask a question and get an answer grounded in their own company’s data. Buying becomes painless for everyone, procurement gets a seat at the table, and our customers have saved more than 100,000 hours of manual work so far. Companies like Spotify, PayPal, T. Rowe Price, JustEat, Adyen and S&P Global run procurement on Omnea. We’re backed by $75M from Khosla Ventures, Insight Partners and Accel, and we’ve been named the UK’s number one startup in the Startups 100, ranked 11th on Sifted’s 2026 list of Europe’s fastest-growing companies, and recognised as one of Fast Company’s Most Innovative Companies. Talent density matters more to us than almost anything else. We keep the bar high in every team, so everyone here has real ownership and real impact. Our team is full of former founders and operators who’ve scaled unicorns, and we’re looking for people who want to do the best work of their careers alongside them. Find out more about the team and life at Omnea here . What We’re Looking For We’re looking for highly technical engineers who want to lead and manage one of our engineering teams. It took over 10,000 interviews to hire our first 50 Omneans, and we’re now growing from 11 to more than 14 engineering teams in the coming months. Over the next year, our engineering team will double in size, our enterprise customer base will grow from ~180 to 300+, and revenue will triple. As a Team Lead Manager, you’ll lead a small team of engineers. You’ll set its technical direction, line-manage and grow the people in it, and stay hands-on in the code. This is not a hands-off management role: our teams are small, and you’ll be one of the strongest engineers on yours. You’ll partner closely with a Product Manager and Product Designer to decide what to build, and you’ll be accountable for how well it’s built and how fast it ships. If you’re a strong Tech Lead who hasn’t managed people yet, we’d still love to hear from you. You can start as a Team Lead, with management handled by an Engineering Manager, and grow into the full role with our support. What Can You Expect As a Team Lead Manager? Lead and Manage a Small Team. Line-manage the engineers on your team, run 1:1s, give feedback, and help them take on bigger problems. Stay Deeply Technical. You’ll still build. Expect to spend a meaningful share of your time writing code, reviewing PRs, and unblocking the hardest technical problems. AI-Native Development. AI is core to how we build. Engineers use Claude, Code, and agentic workflows every day, and our product is built on AI agents that automate complex procurement workflows. You’ll set the bar for how your team uses them. Customers at the Center. Talk directly with customers to understand their problems, and make sure your team builds things that create real value for them. Own Technical Direction. Make the architecture and design calls for your team’s problem space, and own the trade-offs between speed, quality, and long-term maintainability. Work with Modern Technology. TypeScript across the stack, React, Postgres, and AWS serverless (Lambda, DynamoDB, EventBridge), managed through Pulumi and deployed via GitHub Actions. Datadog, Meticulous, and Incident.io round it out. Shape the Roadmap. Work with your PM and Designer on prioritisation, scoping, and sequencing so the team ships what matters most. Build the Team. Interview, hire, and onboard new engineers as we double in size. About You You’re a highly technical full-stack engineer. You’ve designed and shipped web apps end to end in TypeScript, ideally on AWS serverless, and you’re still one of the strongest engineers in the room. You’ve led engineers. You’ve been a Tech Lead, Team Lead, or TLM, owning delivery and technical direction for a team. You want to manage people, or grow into it. Ideally, you’ve line-managed engineers already. If not, you’re keen to learn. You still love to build. Leading hasn’t pulled you away from the code, and you want a role where you keep shipping. You raise the bar. You know what well-architected, reliable software looks like, and you help others get there through reviews, pairing, and clear feedback. You’re motivated by customer impact. You care about outcomes for customers, not just output, and you make good calls on what to build and what to cut. You’re a strong partner. You work well with product and design, push back when it matters, and bring people with you. You’re comfortable with ambiguity. You can take an unclear problem, shape it, and get a team moving on it. Nice-to-Haves You’ve led a team through fast growth, ideally at a scale-up where the team and product changed quickly. You’ve built B2B or enterprise SaaS, with complex workflows and demanding customers. You’ve performed exceptionally at something else, be it academics, sport, or work. Interview Process Before applying, we strongly encourage you to spend a few minutes in our R&D Candidate Hub. It covers our engineering culture, ways of working, interview process, tech environment, and what it’s like to build at Omnea. R&D Candidate Hub : https://omnea.notion.site/R-D-Candidate-Hub-2f688cce658780f1b942c81cd3a032d4 Note: our pair programming stage is in TypeScript OR Python and you’ll be assessed as if it’s your primary language. title: Senior PHP/Go Developer
description: In today’s world, cybersecurity is an integral part of everyday life. Companies need to be prepared for anything; at any moment a threatening situation can arise. Together with your colleagues (currently 8 developers and testers), you build small projects in containers. Those projects together form the software solution on which ON2IT’s entire business runs. We mainly use PHP and Go, but it doesn’t actually matter which language you use. As long as it works and is simple. Keep it simple, fail fast. And we have hefty demands of our own work quality, so we have CI and CD fully set up. Code styling is automatically checked and corrected, security checks are performed and of course our unit tests and functional tests (Cypress and Codeception) run before we roll out. You put your changes into production yourself after a code review and functional test. What you tell others you’re doing: I build software that keeps our customers from getting hacked. Cybersecurity, yes, something with computers. No, that doesn’t mean I can fix your printer. What will your work week look like: As expected, you will mostly be writing code, which you will be doing from home and, at least 2 days a week, from our Zaltbommel office. We start the day with a (remote) stand up. There, we discuss the progress of the work. Do you need help? There are always colleagues ready to help you. The work consists of fixing bugs and implementing small feature requests or new projects. We record all these things in Gitlab. Sometime around noon, we have lunch together (unless you work from home of course) in our cozy canteen. Everything is completely taken care of; we just ask you to put away your plate in the dishwasher after. Every two weeks, we have a general team meeting and we do a retrospective as a team, that way we keep improving. Is this you? You have excellent knowledge of PHP, Go, Java, Python or a similar language; You have a completed IT degree or you have demonstrable college level of thinking and working; In your code, you don’t risk an XSS exploit. Never. What do we offer you? We offer ample opportunity to continue to develop yourself by aiding you in furthering your education and encouraging you to follow training courses. A varied and well catered lunch will be available at the office every afternoon. You will also receive: 24 vacation days, with the possibility to buy extra Mobility allowance Opportunities to work from home Advancement opportunities Unlimited learning: access to training and education What does our job application procedure look like? Have we managed to excite you about this job? Then we look forward to receiving your application! You can apply by clicking the button below. This application process involves two rounds of interviews and an assessment. After this, we discuss the terms of employment in a separate interview. Positive completion of a screening is part of your onboarding. If you have any questions about the procedure, contact our HR team: 088-2266200. Find Jobs in Netherlands on Arbeitnow

title: Traineeship Cybersecurity
description: Have you ever thought about working in one of the fastest growing industries in the world? You may have, but what if you don’t have qualifications? For ON2IT, it doesn’t matter. We hire our people on intrinsic motivation for cybersecurity. We're looking for people who are genuinely driven to make the digital world safer. People who are curious about how a digital network works (and how they can be improved), who think like a hacker, and who won’t stop until they’ve figured things out. We will help you become the top 10%. How do we do this? Get ready for our Cybersecurity Traineeship. What to expect: Our traineeship is a training program, where you will start working in our SOC. We have experts in our SOC who will support you in learning and obtaining various certificates. Cases enter our SOC via our own eventflow. Our SOC Specialists investigate these cases to protect the environment of our customers. You will learn how to recognize and detect threats and how to protect and guide our customers. We will guide you with various trainings. This does not only include technical trainings. As customer contact is an important aspect of the role, we also offer trainings focused on improving your soft-skills. The duration: 1 year The working hours: Our SOC works in shifts to ensure 24/7 security for our customers. This means you’ll work in rotating shifts: - Two morning shifts ( 06:00 - 14:30 ) - Two afternoon shifts ( 14:00 - 22:30 ) - Two night shifts ( 22:00 - 06:30 ) - Followed by 4 days off What do we offer you? Besides an entry opportunity to become an expert SOC Engineer, we offer you a total starting package of € 3.750,00 . Depending on the obtained certifications, this can be increased by € 400,00 within the first year. What distinguishes our traineeship from a regular position? Our traineeship is designed for people who want to become the top 10% in Cybersecurity. This means that your development is our top priority. We have an unlimited development budget and you'll be surrounded by top experts in cybersecurity who are eager to share their knowledge. Are there any prerequisites? You hold an European passport to pass the security screening and you have a driver’s license and the possession of a car (because public transport isn’t sufficient for the shift times). Can I study for CCNA while applying? Yes. You don’t have to have your CCNA-certificate at the moment you apply. But you have to obtain it before you start in the traineeship. What kind of person thrives in this traineeship? People who are: Naturally curious Calm under pressure Communicating clearly Motivated to continuously learn Comfortable with dynamic environments and working in shifts What’s after the traineeship? You’ve finished the traineeship and wrapped up the first year. What’s next? There’s a wide variety of paths you could choose. Think of certifications in: Cloud Security Networking End point protection Threat Intelligence Most importantly: there’s no cap on your development. We would like to see you become the top 10%. Practical criteria summary In summary. To be able to join our SOC, you have to tick off the following boxes: You hold a CCNA-certification You hold a European passport to pass the security screening You have a driver’s license and the possession of a car (because public transport isn’t sufficient for the shift times) Your home address is located within a 50-minute drive from our office in Zaltbommel You are open to work in 24/7 shifts Want to become the top 10%? Great! Take a moment to leave your contact details behind and we will contact you shortly. Find more English Speaking Jobs in Netherlands on Arbeitnow

Today, with AI representing the latest and most impactful expansion of data yet, OneTrust is once again redefining what responsible innovation looks like. OneTrust, the AI‑Ready Governance Platform™, unifies regulatory intelligence, automation, and connected governance workflows so businesses can continue to move at the speed of AI while ensuring good governance to prevent data misuse at scale. Trusted by thousands of organizations worldwide, OneTrust is shaping the future where trusted data becomes a transformative force for business and society. The Challenge We’re looking for a Senior Principal Solutions Engineer to shape and lead technical strategy for OneTrust’s most strategic and complex opportunities in the UK & Ireland. Reporting to the Solutions Engineering Manager, you will bring broad portfolio fluency, deep enterprise technology expertise, executive-level customer engagement, and commercial judgement to help customers solve business-critical challenges with OneTrust. You will partner closely with Sales, Customer Success, Product, Engineering and partners to build deep account alignment, progress complex buying decisions, and create measurable customer and commercial outcomes. You will be a trusted advisor to senior customer stakeholders and a force multiplier for the Solutions Engineering organisation: setting s high bar, developing reusable approaches, and coaching others to raise the quality of our work. AI Governance is an important area of expertise for this role, alongside the breadth to lead opportunities across OneTrust’s entire platform. Your Mission Lead technical strategy for the highest-impact, most complex opportunities across OneTrust’s solutions portfolio, aligning the customer’s business priorities, technology environment, risk posture, architecture and decision process to the right OneTrust solutions and measurable outcomes. Bring particular depth in AI Governance where relevant to the customer’s needs. Build deep account alignment with Account Executives, Customer Success and other partners. Map the buying group and executive sponsors; understand account priorities and whitespace; and shape a coordinated, multi-stakeholder motion that advances the opportunity and contributes to sustainable ACV growth. Partner with the commercial account owners on expansion strategy; this role does not replace their ownership of the customer relationship. Engage credibly with executive and practitioner stakeholders—including CIO/CTO, CISO, Chief AI and Data leaders, Privacy, Legal, Risk, Security, Procurement, and AI/ML Engineering—to connect governance requirements with business value and delivery realities. Lead discovery and solution design for complex enterprise programmes across relevant OneTrust solution areas, translating fragmented requirements, regulatory obligations and technical constraints into practical, scalable operating models, architectures and workflows. Bring deep technical expertise in OneTrust’s solutions, enterprise integrations and the technology ecosystems relevant to each opportunity. Advise on APIs, data flows, identity and access, cloud and platform architecture, and—where relevant—AI/ML lifecycles and operational controls; identify risks and dependencies early; and recommend implementable designs. Lead tailored demonstrations, technical evaluations, proofs of concept, RFP responses and executive presentations across the portfolio. Set clear success criteria, prove technical fit and business value, and use evaluation outcomes to build stakeholder confidence and progress the sales motion. Articulate OneTrust’s differentiated value and position solutions thoughtfully against alternatives, connecting customer requirements to the most relevant solution capabilities, integrations and roadmap—including AI Governance where applicable—without overpromising. Act as a strategic bridge between the field and Product, Engineering, Marketing and leadership. Bring structured customer and competitive insight to inform product direction, positioning, packaging and go-to-market strategy. Create reusable solution patterns, account-planning practices, demos, technical guidance and field assets that improve consistency and outcomes beyond an individual opportunity. Coach and mentor Solutions Engineers and cross-functional partners in portfolio knowledge, strategic discovery, technical storytelling, executive engagement and complex deal execution, sharing AI Governance expertise where relevant. Maintain accurate opportunity strategy, technical risks, evaluation plans and next steps in Salesforce, in partnership with the account team. What Success Looks Like You are a trusted technical and strategic partner on the business’s most consequential opportunities across OneTrust’s solutions portfolio, improving deal progression and technical win outcomes. You build durable alignment across customer executives, practitioners and the OneTrust account team, connecting the right OneTrust solutions to funded priorities and demonstrable business value—including AI Governance where relevant. Your work contributes to healthy ACV growth by helping account teams identify, shape and win the right strategic opportunities. Customers see a credible path from their business priorities to operational outcomes, with connected, secure, scalable and realistic recommendations across the relevant OneTrust solutions. You raise the capability of the wider organisation through thought leadership, repeatable approaches, coaching and actionable customer insight. You Are A strategic, customer-led thinker who starts with outcomes and discovery, navigates ambiguity, and exercises sound judgement rather than defaulting to a product pitch or a standard playbook. Commercially astute: you understand how complex enterprise buying decisions are made, how technical strategy affects deal outcomes, and how to create mutual value without compromising customer trust. An executive-level communicator who can move from technical depth to a concise business narrative, influence senior decision-makers, and adapt to different audiences. A broad portfolio strategist and a credible AI Governance expert, with a strong, current point of view on the AI landscape, associated technologies and fast-moving developments. You continuously assess what is emerging, what is becoming operationally relevant, and what it means for customer needs and OneTrust’s solutions. A technical authority and generous coach: you are a go-to resource on complex problems and actively build the expertise and confidence of others. A cross-functional leader who influences through expertise, brings teams together across geographies, and turns customer and market insight into broader organisational impact. Comfortable setting direction where the answer is not yet established, while being transparent about assumptions, trade-offs, product capabilities and limitations. Your Experience Includes Typically 12+ years of relevant experience in Solutions Engineering, Solutions Consulting, technical sales or a comparable customer-facing enterprise technology role, including a track record of leading complex, strategic opportunities. Demonstrated success shaping strategic sales motions through deep account alignment, executive engagement, multi-threaded discovery and value-based solution design—with evidence of contributing to ACV growth and technical wins. Experience across multiple enterprise solution areas, ideally spanning OneTrust domains such as privacy, AI Governance, data use governance, technology risk and compliance, third-party risk, and consent and preferences. title: Applied AI Engineer, Digital Natives
description: About the Team OpenAI’s Applied AI Engineering team helps organizations turn frontier AI capabilities into safe, reliable, and high-impact production systems. Production-ready deployments are defined by complexity rather than any one industry: existing architectures, diverse data environments, security and governance requirements, multiple stakeholder groups, and organization-wide change. We turn lessons from these deployments into better products and reusable patterns for customers everywhere. About the Role As an Applied AI Engineer you will partner directly with leading organizations to design, build, and deploy AI systems that deliver measurable business outcomes. You will combine deep technical judgment, hands-on engineering, and customer leadership to take ambitious ideas from use-case selection and architecture through prototyping, evaluation, production launch, and scale. You will write and debug code, build evaluation systems, resolve complex integrations, and guide decisions involving model behavior, reliability, latency, cost, safety, security, governance, and operational readiness. Success is measured by production systems, sustained adoption, and meaningful customer impact—not simply activity or successful demonstrations. This is a rare opportunity to work on consequential real-world deployments at the frontier of AI while directly influencing how OpenAI’s products evolve. This role is based in Paris. We use a hybrid work model of 3 days in the office per week and offer relocation assistance to new employees In this role, you will: Partner directly with enterprise and digital native customers to identify high-value opportunities and translate them into technical architectures, implementation plans, evaluation strategies, and measurable success criteria. Design, build, and deploy AI systems that solve important customer problems and produce measurable business outcomes. Work hands-on in code to build prototypes, evaluation harnesses, reference implementations, integrations, and production accelerators. Make sound technical decisions across models, agents, retrieval, tools, data, reliability, observability, latency, cost, safety, security, and governance. Diagnose complex implementation challenges, reproduce failures, test hypotheses, and drive blockers toward resolution. Help customers progress from promising prototypes to reliable production systems, sustained adoption, and scaled impact. Partner closely with customer engineering teams and OpenAI Product, Research, Engineering, Security, and go-to-market teams, translating deployment experience into high-signal product feedback. Create reusable architectures, tooling, playbooks, and technical guidance that accelerate future enterprise deployments. You might thrive in this role if you: Have a demonstrated track record of designing, building, and delivering AI or machine-learning systems in enterprise environments, including taking systems from prototype to production. Centralise requests on delivery teams coming from partners and Business Development. Scale delivery processes and tooling: scale our project management system in Asana, from program templates and timelines to portfolio and capacity views. Automate reporting and follow-up, deploy AI tools where they remove manual work, and document how we run programs. Grow existing accounts: identify, qualify and convert follow-on opportunities within existing partnerships. Minimum Qualifications 4+ years in project management, alliance and/or account management, or partner delivery in biotech, pharma, a CRO or a techbio. Demonstrated delivery of complex scientific programs: you have led multidisciplinary projects from plan to final deliverable, including when results reshaped the plan. Pharma-facing experience: you have managed pharma stakeholders through steering committees, negative results and scope negotiations. Commercial track record: you have identified and converted follow-on opportunities within existing accounts. Hands-on systems building: you have designed project management systems and automated recurring workflows. Working knowledge of oncology or molecular biology, sufficient to lead scientific discussions with our teams and partners. Fluent in English Preferred Qualifications Experience in precision oncology or at a pharma-facing CRO. Familiarity with patient-derived tumor models, omics or drug screening. Scripting (Python) or experience deploying automation and AI tools. Experience working with SOWs and contracts. Professional French. Scientifically fluent: you understand what a result means for the partner's asset before you plan around it. Steady under pressure: you replan quickly if the data changes, and you deliver difficult news to partners clearly and early. A builder: you treat every recurring manual task as something to standardise or automate. Commercially minded: you recognise when a partner's needs extend beyond the signed scope and turn it into a proposal. Why Join Orakl Own a portfolio of pharma partnerships. description: About Payoneer Founded in 2005, Payoneer is the global financial platform that removes friction from doing business across borders, with a mission to connect the world’s underserved businesses to a rising global economy. Regulatory Counsel, Europe The Regulatory Counsel, Europe will be responsible for providing legal advice and strategy for the significant regulatory matters for Payoneer in Ireland, the United Kingdom and other jurisdictions in Europe. The position is based in Dublin or London and will report to the Global Regulatory Counsel in New York City. What You’ll Be Responsible For: Providing legal advice to assist Payoneer in the evaluation and management of significant and complex payments and financial services industry regulatory matters in Europe Supporting the Ireland and UK management, compliance, and finance teams in building and maintaining good working relationships with regulators Researching, analyzing and determining effects of quickly evolving regulations in multiple markets, and keeping current on issues and upcoming regulatory changes that may impact Payoneer’s strategic goals and objectives Liaising and working with outside counsel in the region Supporting business, marketing and other teams with the development of new services, and fostering strong relationships across multiple functional areas What We’re Looking For: Eligible to work/live in Ireland or the United Kingdom Qualified to practice law in Ireland or the United Kingdom At least 6-7 years of legal experience, including experience providing legal advice to the financial services industry. Payments industry and electronic money institution experience is preferred. Experience working directly with regulators and regulatory authorities is an advantage but not strictly required. Ability to evaluate fact situations, identify legal issues, analyze and understand statutes, regulations and recommend appropriate courses of action. Ability to provide practical legal advice and recommendations to internal stakeholders on matters of significant importance to the company. Ability to work independently as well as collaboratively within a team environment. Ability to handle a diverse set of issues and provide a high level of service to internal customers in a friendly and professional manner. An open communicator with skill in establishing and maintaining effective working relationships at all levels of the organization. Flexibility for occasional travel.
