title: Director, Sales (Nordics & Eastern Europe)
description: About Ping Identity: At Ping Identity, we believe in making digital experiences both secure and seamless for all users, without compromise. We call this digital freedom. And it's not just something we provide our customers. It's something that inspires our company. People don't come here to join a culture that's built on digital freedom. They come to cultivate it. Our intelligent, cloud identity platform lets people shop, work, bank, and interact wherever and however they want. Without friction. Without fear. While protecting digital identities is at the core of our technology, protecting individual identities is at the core of our culture. We champion every identity. One of our core values, Respect Individuality, reminds us to celebrate differences so you are empowered to bring your authentic self to work. We're headquartered in Denver, Colorado and we have offices and employees around the globe. We serve the largest, most demanding enterprises worldwide, including more than half of the Fortune 100. At Ping Identity, we're changing the way people and businesses think about cybersecurity, digital experiences, and identity and access management. The Sales Director will be tasked with influencing and developing an energized, competitive, high impact sales team that is characterized by its ability to create differentiated value for our customer base. We're looking for a seasoned leader from within the SaaS enterprise marketplace, with proven software solution selling combined with success in a fast growth business. This leader will be a model to drive the team in building extraordinary customer relationships and experiences, leveraging a strong teamwork approach, and cross matrix collaboration across all Ping functions. This role will demonstrate a depth of understanding when working alongside a partner community and posess a well-established customer and partner network in the Nordics & Eastern Europe regions. In order to acquire, develop and retain customer relationships and create a winning Ping business, this leader will be able to create and maintain a high-performance culture, that is grounded in data, transparency, accountability, and agility. The ideal candidate's mindset should be customer-focused, people-oriented, open, passionate, and authentic. Responsibilities: Creates, implements, measures and reviews a strategic or operational plan that drives achievement of business goals aligned to overall Ping strategy Uses mechanisms such as territory planning, account plans, opportunity inspection, pipeline management, account reviews, forecast calls, etc. Advises and coaches the sales team around how to position and articulate Ping Identity's value proposition at enterprise customers, thus increasing the average deal size Identifies and pursues opportunities to expand business activities within areas of responsibility Leverages GSIs & other partners to help source, develop and progress business Plans and controls the expense associated with the area of responsibility even if not responsible for overall cost center Establishes working relationships with external parties which supports the achievement of business goals Is conversant with Ping Identity's systems and procedures and ensures effective use of and conformance to standard business practices and tools (i.e. SFDC – SalesForce.com) Communicates Ping Identity's vision and aligns team and personal goals to achieve business results Provides direction and guidance, mentoring and development of the field team Lives teamwork and promotes cross-functional collaboration Recruits, builds and develops the team to deliver business results; Identifies, develops and promotes high potential employees Recommends and/or approves people-related decisions – hiring, promotions, merit increases, rewards & recognition, training initiatives, etc. Drives performance review and development planning process with annual and quarterly review meetings Has established multi-vertical C level contacts in large enterprise customers Has an established partner/SI network and is used to working with partners on projects Builds relationships with customers (internal or external) as necessary providing customer escalation management as necessary for problem resolution Provides support for customer relationship management as necessary and drives initiatives which result in improvement in customer satisfaction Drives initiatives which result in improvement in customer satisfaction Required Skills & Qualifications: Proven experience of successfully leading sales teams focused on the Nordics & Eastern Europe Expertise in enterprise software, SaaS, managed services and strategic account management Results-oriented with multiple years meeting or exceeding quota Flexibility to travel to across the regions Transitioned a team through on-prem to SaaS solutions Adept working in a fast-growing global organization Good interpersonal skills to align and foster positive working relationships across the organization Eligibility to work in the Netherlands or Norway Life at Ping: We believe in and facilitate a flexible, collaborative work environment. We're growing quickly, but remain true to the innovative, can-do startup values that got us here. Most importantly, we keep hiring talented, smart, fun, and genuinely nice people because that's who we want to succeed with every day. Here are just a few of the things that make Ping special: A company culture that empowers you to do your best work. Employee Resource Groups that create a sense of belonging for everyone. Regular company and team bonding events. Competitive benefits and perks. Global volunteering and community initiatives Our Benefits: Generous PTO & Holiday Schedule Parental Leave Progressive Healthcare Options Retirement Programs Opportunity for Education Reimbursement Commuter Offset (Specific locations) Ping is the collective sum of all our individual experiences, backgrounds and influences and we pride ourselves in growing and learning together. We are committed to building an inclusive and diverse environment where everyone's individuality is respected and everyone has an Identity. In recruiting for new colleagues, we welcome the unique contributions you can bring and encourage you to be your best self. We are an Equal Opportunity/Affirmative Action employer. title: Founding Deployment Strategist [ERP + AI]
description: TL;DR We're building the SAP/NetSuite of the AI era for mid-sized companies in the real-world economy, starting with their supply chain operations (buy, sell, stock, produce) Founding deployment strategist : you deploy two things into real factories, in the same project, the ERP that runs their operations, and the AI agents that work inside it. Every client goes from signed contract to go-live on the date we promised, running on Piston, with agents already doing part of the work A rare shape: someone who has led client projects that landed in industrial companies, who is genuinely AI-native, and who will write the deployment playbook for the team and our system integrator partners €3M Pre-seed (Top-tier VCs) €45–60k + equity What this role is (and isn't) Most ERP deployments are people moving data around for a year. Incumbents quote six figures for it, and the client gets the same software they had, just newer. Ours run in eight to twelve weeks and deliver two things at once: a new ERP that runs buying, selling, stock and production, and AI agents inside it that read the orders, recompute the production load, prepare the purchases, and ask a human only when it matters. This is not a product or a sales role, you are a deployment strategist. In one project, you replace a company's ERP and you put AI agents to work inside it. Why now Since day one, the founders have run every deployment themselves. Clients are now coming in faster than we can handle, and we need someone to own deployments. You work directly with Eric, CEO, who also leads product. That puts you as close as it gets to what success means at Piston: the success of our clients. What you'll do Deploy the ERP, with AI. The client's sales, purchasing, stock and production move onto Piston: data migrated from their old ERP and their Excel files, configuration built from their own documents, training, go-live. AI does the heavy lifting, you do the judgment. Put the first AI agents live, during the ERP deployment. You decide what each agent does on its own, what it hands to a human for approval, and you make sure it's still running three months later. Write the deployment playbook. Every go-live feeds a playbook that our next deployment hires and our system integrator partners will follow. Map where the client's time goes. On site, you find the work that eats people's days: re-keying orders, chasing suppliers, rebuilding the same Excel every month. That map is the backlog of the next agents. Teach humans to work with agents. The people you deploy with have never supervised software that acts on its own. You show them how to trust it, check it and correct it. Hold the date and the budget. You size each deployment before the contract and protect that budget. Use the tools engineers build for you. Our engineers build the tools that let you deploy on your own: AI-assisted data migration from the client's old ERP and Excel files, and a builder for screens and agents. You tell them what slows you down, they make it disappear. Agentify your own work. On top of the tools our engineers build, you create your own agents for the deployment itself: configuration checks, test scenarios, training material, status reports. Every manual step you repeat twice becomes an agent for the next deployment. What you bring You bring the energy to deploy AI at scale in industrial companies. You learn fast from discovery, and you're as comfortable with founders and leadership teams as with operators on the shop floor. Must have Customer-facing project experience. Two years or more managing client projects in an industrial environment, typically in consulting (operations, supply chain, transformation). You've held deadlines, managed stakeholders, and delivered. AI-native, for real. You use LLMs every day, and you've built things with them: automations, agents, prompts that run in production (Claude, GPT, n8n, Make, scripts, whatever works). You know what an agent can do alone, where it breaks, and where a human must stay in the loop. Listening before configuring. You translate what people say into what the system and the agents must do, and you notice when the two don't match. At ease in front of clients: Plant directors, finance, shop-floor operators. You can hold a room, and say no in it. A full load, gladly. Around 150 project days a year, several deployments running at once. Fluent English and French, both required. Our first clients work in French, our team writes in English, and you may support our deployments in the United States. Nice to have You've automated a real operations process end to end, with measurable hours saved You've already taken a complex B2B software live Comfortable with AI You've worked around manufacturing or food operations: lots, BOMs, production orders, campaigns Seed / Series A experience, where nobody's job description holds for long Talent beats checklists. If you're intrigued, apply anyway. How we'll measure success ERP go-lives on the date we promised Days spent against the plan we sold Agents still running three months after launch, and the hours of work they take off the client's hands What you'll get €45–60k + equity World-class peers The first hire of our deployment team: you write the playbook that future hires and our system integrator partners will follow, and you grow with the team it builds A front-row seat on how AI agents change the way real companies operate Regular company offsite (2–4 times per year) in great locations Ideal equipment and setup Remote-first (France), about 20% of your time on client sites Process We value efficiency and clarity. The entire process takes no more than 2 weeks: 30-minute intro call with Florian (CRO) 60-minute deployment deep dive with Eric (CEO) 30-min cultural-fit interview with Eugène (CTO) 2 days paid assessment, on a real client situation. Offer: If it's a match, we move fast. Interested? Tell us about a client project you led, and something you automated with AI. A short, personal note goes a long way, AI-generated cover letters don't. Find Jobs in France on Arbeitnow

title: Junior Business Data Analyst
description: PIX4D is seeking a talented Business Data Analyst to bridge Finance, Product Management and Commercial Operations (Sales and Marketing), develop complex analytical tools to drive strategic decisions and optimize processes. You will be a member of PIX4D’s dynamic Finance team, in a hybrid work environment, based in Lausanne, Switzerland. In this cross-functional role, you will query complex datasets, build dashboards, define KPIs, and translate emerging trends into actionable insights for stakeholders. You will balance data integrity with commercial impact, transforming raw data into insights that support high-level strategic decisions. Responsibilities Data Analysis & Reporting: Cleaning, manipulating, and analyzing large datasets to identify trends, patterns, and anomalies. Dashboard Development: Creating interactive dashboards and reports using dashboarding tools and leveraging AI-powered tools for enhanced automation and visualization. AI & Automation: Leveraging Generative AI, Agentic AI, and Model Context Protocol (MCP) to streamline data workflows and enhance intelligent decision-making. Database Querying: Using SQL to extract and prepare data from various systems. Actionable Insights: Translating complex data into clear, actionable recommendations for business growth, efficiency, and optimization. Stakeholder Collaboration: Working with cross-functional teams to define business requirements and Key Performance Indicators (KPIs). Data Governance: Ensuring data integrity, accuracy, and standardization. Requirements Technical Skills: Proficiency in SQL, Excel (advanced), and experience using data visualization tools (e.g. Tableau, Power BI, Looker). AI Proficiency: Familiarity with Generative AI, Agentic AI, and Model Context Protocol (MCP) implementations. Analytical Abilities: Strong statistical knowledge, problem-solving skills, and attention to detail. Communication: Ability to tell a story with data to non-technical stakeholders. title: Account Executive, Enterprise
description: About Plane Plane's mission is to build the infrastructure the world's work runs on. Every organization runs on three things: the projects it's driving, the knowledge it keeps, and the requests it fields. Plane brings all three into one open, adaptable platform: simple enough for any team to adopt, dependable enough for organizations to build on. And we are building it for a future where humans and AI agents do that work together. Plane began in public on GitHub at the end of 2022. Since then it has grown into a work management platform used by teams around the world: 55,000+ stars, 5,000+ forks, and a contributor community that reads our code and files our issues. Organizations run Plane as a managed Cloud service, on their own infrastructure, or inside fully isolated environments. Building in the open keeps us close to users and raises the standard for everything we ship. Plane is the #1 work infrastructure in aerospace, defense, financial services, and other regulated industries: organizations whose requirements for control, auditability, and data residency rule most software out. When the strictest buyers pick a system of record, that choice means something. Adoption is growing fastest on Plane Cloud and in sovereign clouds, deployments that keep everything inside a country's own borders and rules. Plane is backed by top investors and built across San Francisco, London, and Hyderabad. We work in tightly knit teams, stay close to users, and care about the visible product as much as the unglamorous details that make software dependable. People own problems end to end, and we add process only when it helps the work. Humans and agents We believe the next decade of work will be done by humans and AI agents together. Not agents replacing people, and not a chat window bolted onto software built for humans clicking around, but both working in one system of action, where an agent's work is as visible and as accountable as a person's. Most software treats AI as a feature. We treat agents as a kind of worker, and that changes what the system underneath has to be. Agents are only as good as the context they can see and the state they are allowed to change, so shared context, explicit state, durable history, and accountable action are not items on our roadmap. They are the product. Plane is built so that when an agent acts, the humans responsible can see what happened, why, and on whose authority, and the record survives. This is what the infrastructure is for: making the future where humans and agents work together useful, legible, and fully within the organization's control. Every role at Plane is some part of building that. About the role Plane has over a million users, and Fortune 500 companies deploying Plane. Enterprises in aerospace, defense, healthcare, and finance are running Plane in production — some in air-gapped, classified environments. The commercial demand is real and growing. This role exists to own it. You'll run full-cycle enterprise deals from first conversation to signed contract. You'll work directly with the CEO and the product team, because at this stage, a deal isn't just a sales process — it's a product feedback loop. You'll sell into technical buyers who already know the product, navigate complex procurement in regulated industries, and help build the playbook as you go. Plane's sales motion is product-led. The funnel doesn't start with cold outreach — it starts with teams already using Plane and hitting a ceiling where they need enterprise capabilities: compliance, SSO, air-gapped deployment, priority support. Your job is to convert that organic interest into expanding enterprise revenue. What you'll do Run deals end-to-end — from first enterprise inquiry to signed contract. You own the entire arc: discovery, demo, technical evaluation, security review, procurement, negotiation, close. Full-cycle means full ownership. Convert product-led interest into enterprise revenue — Plane's funnel doesn't start with outbound. It starts with someone self-hosting Plane, hitting a scale or compliance ceiling, and raising their hand. Your job is to recognize those signals, engage at the right moment, and guide the conversation from "we're evaluating" to "we're deploying." Navigate complex enterprise procurement — our buyers sit in aerospace, defense, healthcare, and finance. That means security questionnaires, compliance reviews, legal redlines, multi-stakeholder approval chains, and timelines measured in months, not days. You need to know how to move a deal through that machinery without losing momentum. Hold technical credibility in the room — you'll be talking to VPs of Engineering, DevOps leads, and IT architects about self-hosted deployments, air-gapped environments, SSO configurations, and data residency requirements. You don't need to be an engineer, but you need to hold your own in these conversations and know when to bring one in. Build and refine the sales playbook — document what works. Which objections come up repeatedly? What's the typical deal cycle? Where do deals stall? What collateral is missing? You're not just selling — you're creating the system that the next 3-5 AEs will run on. Feed product with deal intelligence — every deal you run generates signal about what the market wants, what competitors are doing, and where Plane has gaps. You bring that signal back to the product team in a structured, actionable way — not as a feature request list, but as a pattern. What you'll bring You've closed enterprise software deals in the $500K–$1M ACV range, running the full cycle yourself — not inheriting qualified pipeline from a BDR team or handing off to a solutions engineer for the technical conversation. You've sold into technical buyers — engineering leadership, DevOps, IT — and you can have a real conversation about deployment models, infrastructure, and security without reading from a script. You understand the difference between selling to someone who writes code and selling to someone who writes checks. You've worked at an early-stage company (Series A or earlier) where the sales infrastructure didn't exist yet. You've built your own pipeline, written your own sequences, created your own collateral, and figured out the motion before it was documented. You understand product-led growth and know how to work with it rather than against it. You don't fight the free tier — you see it as the top of your funnel and know how to identify when a user is ready for an enterprise conversation. You're comfortable with long deal cycles and multi-stakeholder procurement processes. You don't get rattled when a deal takes 4 months and involves legal, security, compliance, and IT all having veto power. You're structured in how you manage your pipeline, your notes, and your follow-ups. Not because someone made you use a CRM, but because you've learned that rigor is what separates someone who closes from someone who's "always about to close." You can write. Not marketing copy — clear, concise follow-up emails, proposals that address the buyer's actual concerns, and internal summaries that help the team understand what the market is telling you. Why Plane? Every company says it is different. We will try evidence instead. The scope is real. We are a passion team serving companies of every size, including some of the largest in the world. Something you ship this month will run inside a Fortune 500 company and a 50-person startup in the same week, and you will hear from both. The constraints make you better. title: Senior Product Manager
description: This position is fully remote/home based. Applications will be accepted from candidates based in the UK. Role Summary PLOS is a nonprofit Open Access publisher with an ambitious mission: to help transform research communication so that science can be shared, understood and used more effectively. Research publishing is changing rapidly. Researchers' expectations are changing. Technology is creating possibilities that didn't exist a few years ago. And at PLOS we're rethinking some of the services, systems and assumptions that have shaped scholarly publishing for decades. That means there are interesting product problems to solve - not just features to deliver. You'll take responsibility for a product area and work with designers, engineers and colleagues across PLOS to understand the problems that matter, work out where we can make the greatest difference and help the team learn its way towards good solutions. You'll be joining active product teams working on significant problems and will have plenty of opportunity to shape what we do and how we do it. How we work We want our product teams to be curious, evidence-led and comfortable with uncertainty. We don't expect a Product Manager to arrive with all the answers. We do expect them to ask good questions. You'll use continuous discovery alongside delivery: spending time with users, looking at data, understanding the wider service, identifying assumptions and finding practical ways to test them. You'll help the team break large problems into smaller things we can learn from, rather than waiting until everything is known before we release something. And you'll make the team's thinking visible - explaining what we're trying to achieve, what we've learned, what we're uncertain about and why we're making the choices we are. Responsibilities As a Senior Product Manager, you'll: Understand the problem. Build a deep understanding of our users, their needs and behaviours, as well as the organisational, operational and technical context surrounding them. Shape product direction. Work out where the greatest opportunities lie within your area and help translate PLOS's objectives into clear product outcomes and priorities. Practise continuous discovery. Work closely with design, engineering and others to explore problems, identify assumptions and regularly test ideas with users and through data. Turn uncertainty into learning. Frame hypotheses, design useful experiments and look for the smallest sensible way to learn whether we're heading in the right direction. Make good product decisions. Weigh evidence, impact, effort, risk and opportunity when deciding what to pursue - and what not to pursue. Measure whether things are getting better. Define useful measures of success and use qualitative and quantitative evidence to understand whether our work is having the intended effect. Work iteratively. Help the team deliver in small steps, learn from what happens and adapt rather than treating plans as fixed commitments. Communicate your thinking. Clearly explain problems, evidence, choices, trade-offs and learning to people with very different levels of technical and product knowledge. Create strong feedback loops. Use conversations, demos, reviews and other forums to get useful feedback early rather than presenting finished thinking late. Work as part of a team. Create the conditions in which designers, engineers and other specialists can contribute to product decisions rather than treating product management as something the PM does alone. title: Supply Chain Manager
description: About pplwise pplwise is a recruiting consultancy for fast-growing technology companies across Europe. Through Recruiting as a Service and Executive Search, we fill key roles for our clients, from start-ups to publicly listed companies. We are filling this position for our client Filics. Its double-runner system makes Filics the first and only AMR that can drive through load carriers such as Euro pallets. This breaks with forklift logic and sets a new standard for efficiency. Filics is a small, hands-on team that solves hard problems with engineering excellence. Leadership goes to those who take initiative and consistently deliver. Many come from a single source, and most aren’t under contract yet. Moving from prototypes to series production, one missing part can stop the whole line. Your job is to build a robust supply chain from scratch. It needs to know exactly what Filics depends on, secure those parts before they become a risk, and hold up as volumes grow, all while production is already running. You take full ownership of how every component is sourced, secured and managed. You’ll work closely with Engineering, which owns the technical specs and qualifies suppliers and alternative components. Assembly depends on reliable supply to plan builds. Leadership sets volume commitments based on your analysis. What you’ll do Identify critical dependencies, lock in availability through supplier contracts, and qualify alternatives so no single source can stop production Set up the ERP and the systems the supply chain runs on, including supplier quality tracking Define clear quality criteria for suppliers and components together with Engineering Give the assembly team the forward visibility they need to plan builds Turn supply analysis into input for Leadership’s volume commitments Once supply is robust, reduce component prices toward a leaner bill of materials About you Several years in supply chain , procurement or sourcing for hardware products (e.g. robotics, automotive, machinery, electronics) Proven experience moving products from prototype to series production A solid grasp of BOMs, component sourcing, supplier qualification and supplier quality Strong negotiation skills and experience closing supplier contracts A hands-on, structured approach: you prioritize well, work comfortably without defined processes, and deliver Clear, concise communication in English and German What Filics offers Full ownership of a function you build yourself, with direct impact on getting the robots into series production A small, ambitious team where initiative leads to responsibility Work on a first-of-its-kind product in intralogistics An on-site/hybrid role in Munich, close to Engineering and Assembly Sound like you? title: Technical Account Manager - EMEA
description: An Introduction to Primer Primer is the unified infrastructure for global payments. We give finance and payments teams the visibility and control to reduce complexity, improve performance, and capture more revenue - all from a single platform. Backed by Sofina, Peak XV Partners, ICONIQ, Tencent, Accel, and Balderton, we're building the payments layer the world's best companies rely on. Watch our showcase > Read up on our $100m Series C Learn more about our culture > 🔍 What will you be doing? Payment performance & risk mitigation Proactively monitor merchant integration and payment performance (authorisation rates, network tokenisation coverage, routing configuration) and flag risk before it becomes a problem. Recommend and drive routing/NT/config changes, making the economic case (auth rate, cost) for why they matter. Integration debugging Root-cause complex technical issues hands-on, failures, SDK conflicts, webhook gaps, using logs, traces and API behaviour. Loop in Primer engineering only when genuinely needed, rather than as a first resort. Technical escalation ownership You will act as an escalated contact during incidents that affect key merchants and require support from someone who has context on their particular payment stack. This sort of activity will be done in close contact with Support. During and after incidents, you will be in touch with key merchants to deliver RCA’s, walk-through any impacts and offer recommendations to prevent future exposure. Enablement & solution design Lead technical deep-dives and solution design sessions when a merchant adopts a new PSP connector, payment method, or unreleased Primer product as a design partner. Manage the expectation gap through rollout and feed structured, usable feedback back to Product and Engineering. Proactive technical reviews Run recurring technical integration reviews (e.g. quarterly) with each merchant's engineering/payments stakeholders, covering integration health, optimisation opportunities, and risk, independently of any commercial QBR run in-partnership with the AM. Regulatory & compliance navigation Translate changes in card scheme rules or regional regulation (e.g. BNPL rules, PCI requirements) into a concrete technical plan for each affected merchant. 👀 What we’d love to see: Deep, hands-on technical ability: comfortable reading API logs and traces, debugging integration issues directly, and writing basic scripts/SQL to investigate an issue — a real technical peer to a merchant's engineers, not a relationship manager with technical vocabulary. Experience in a technical, merchant/customer-facing role: Technical Account Manager, Solutions Engineer, Support Engineer, Customer Success Manager (technical focused), Implementation Specialist, in payments, fintech, or e-commerce. Strong understanding of APIs, webhooks, and SDKs: The ability to explain technical flows clearly to both engineers and non-technical stakeholders. A proactive operating style: Comfortable identifying and surfacing risk before being asked, not just responding to tickets. Confidence and credibility presenting technical material: Comfortable presenting to senior technical stakeholders (VP Engineering, Head of Payments) at enterprise merchants. Comfortable owning ambiguity: Coordinating across Primer's engineering, product, and support teams without heavy oversight. Direct experience with payments infrastructure: network tokenisation, PSP connectors/routing, or card scheme mechanics. Design-partner support experience: exposure to beta or early-access product rollouts across key merchants. What this role is explicitly not Not a renewals or commercial negotiation owner, that's the Account Manager. Not a support/ticket-routing role, the bar is proactive technical ownership, not reactive Q&A. ✅ A typical interview process An initial intro call with a Talent Partner An interview with the Hiring Manager Challenge Stage - Contextualised to the role A final, values-alignment interview What's the culture like at Primer? We're building a culture where people can do their best work and be proud of the impact they have. You'll be working with people who are mission-driven, smart, and reflective, and who are genuinely invested in building exceptional products and delivering success for our merchants. We work remotely, and have done since day one. We believe that building a successful, profitable company goes beyond proximity. We invest in our relationships through great remote working practices and thoughtfully designed face-to-face time, including workations, our annual company retreat, and access to co-working spaces across most major cities. The work is challenging. Scaleups are a challenge, and building category-defining products is a challenge. But there's a meaningful difference between a challenge and a struggle. At Primer, the right challenge comes with the right support: strong onboarding, a collaborative environment, and a team that is genuinely invested in your success. It's never something you face alone. Zahlen und Details sind Dein Ding: Ob Rechnungen, Tabellen oder Analysen – Du liebst es, den Durchblick zu behalten und erkennst Fehler, die anderen entgehen. Du behältst den Überblick – organisiert, verlässlich und immer einen Schritt voraus. Vertraulichkeit & Diskretion? Für Dich selbstverständlich. Teamplayer:in mit Köpfchen : Zusammenarbeit macht Dir genauso viel Spaß wie selbstständiges Arbeiten. Tools und Tech? Easy! : Du bist fit in MS Office, weißt, wie Du Excel rockst und verfügst über gute Deutschkenntnisse. Benefits Abwechslung garantiert: Spannende Aufgaben, die wirklich relevant sind, in einem dynamischen Umfeld – Langeweile hat bei uns keine Chance! Work Your Way: Ob Gleitzeit oder hybrides Arbeiten – wir machen Deinen Arbeitsalltag flexibel. Award-Winning Arbeitgeber: Wir sind nicht ohne Grund als „Top Company“ bei Kununu (2022-2026) ausgezeichnet worden – überzeug Dich selbst! Arbeiten mit Wohlfühlfaktor: Ein herzliches und freundschaftliches Team wartet auf Dich – und ja, auch Dein Hund ist bei uns herzlich willkommen! Stylisches Office in bester Lage: Unser modernes Büro in der Überseestadt Bremen hat alles, was das Herz begehrt – inklusive Getränken auf’s Haus und Parkplätzen vor der Tür. Zeig, was in Dir steckt: Bei uns bekommst Du Raum für Deine Ideen und kannst Dich so entfalten, wie es Dir gefällt. Einzigartiger Teamspirit: Ob Afterwork oder Teamevents – wir feiern gemeinsame Erfolge, weil wir sie gemeinsam erreichen! Fair bezahlt: Dein Einsatz wird belohnt – mit einer Praktikumsvergütung von 800 € (Bachelor) bis 1.000 € (Master) im Monat. Ready for Onboarding? Dann melde Dich jetzt! title: Medior System Engineer
description: We zijn op zoek naar een gedreven Medior Systems Engineer die thuis is in de Microsoft-cloud en daarnaast nog steeds weet hoe een server werkt. Je focus ligt op de grotere projecten: je richt moderne werkplekken in met Intune, migreert klanten naar Microsoft 365 en Azure en verbetert wat er al staat. Servers horen daar nog steeds bij, vooral in hybride omgevingen waar on-premises en cloud samenwerken. Daarnaast ben je een vraagbaak voor je eerstelijns collega’s. Lopen zij ergens op vast, dan denk je mee en help je ze verder. Je werkt zelfstandig aan meerdere projecten tegelijk, denkt proactief mee over de continuïteit van onze klanten en levert werk af waar je trots op bent. Een probleem leg je niet tijdelijk stil, je zoekt de oorzaak. Heb je minimaal 5 jaar ervaring als systeembeheerder of system engineer en word je blij van een strak ingerichte Microsoft-omgeving? Dan horen we graag van je. Wie zijn we? Welkom bij Progression IT. Wij zijn een hecht en ambitieus IT-bedrijf uit Terneuzen, Zeeland. Al sinds 2005 helpen we onze klanten met slimme, veilige en toekomstgerichte IT-oplossingen. Dat doen we met een team van ruim twintig specialisten, stuk voor stuk vakmensen met hart voor hun werk én voor elkaar. Onze focus ligt op Microsoft-cloud- en hybride omgevingen, en we zijn ISO 27001-gecertificeerd. Veiligheid is bij ons dus geen bijzaak, maar de standaard in alles wat we doen. Naast hard werken vinden we het minstens zo belangrijk om plezier te hebben. We lunchen dagelijks samen (op kosten van de baas), er ligt altijd vers fruit klaar en we sporten twee keer per week onder begeleiding van een personal trainer. Een of twee keer per jaar trekken we er samen op uit voor een teamuitje, gewoon omdat het gezellig is. Wat ga je doen? 🔹 Leiden van technische projecten, van ontwerp tot oplevering 🔹 Inrichten en beheren van moderne werkplekken met Microsoft Intune (Autopilot, compliance- en configuratieprofielen, app-uitrol) 🔹 Uitvoeren van migratietrajecten naar Microsoft 365 en Azure 🔹 Inrichten en beveiligen van Entra ID, met onder meer Conditional Access, MFA en identity management 🔹 Implementeren en beheren van Microsoft-securityoplossingen zoals Defender en Purview 🔹 Beheren van server- en netwerkomgevingen in hybride situaties, fysiek en virtueel 🔹 Inrichten en bewaken van back-upoplossingen 🔹 Ondersteunen van je eerstelijns collega’s met kennis en advies wanneer zij er zelf niet uitkomen 🔹 Proactief monitoren, patchen en onderhouden van klantomgevingen 🔹 Technisch adviseren van klanten en vertalen van hun wensen naar concrete oplossingen 🔹 Werken volgens onze ISO 27001-werkwijze en bijdragen aan een hoge beveiligingsstandaard 🔹 Documenteren van omgevingen en kennis delen met collega’s 🔹 Meedraaien in de 24x7-consignatiedienst (optioneel) 🔹 Signaleren van verbetermogelijkheden en actief bijdragen aan projectgroepen Wat bieden wij jou? 💡 Een uitdagende functie in een groeiend IT-bedrijf, met ruimte om het bedrijf mee vorm te geven 💡 Verantwoordelijkheden met de bijbehorende bevoegdheden, in een platte organisatie 💡 Gevarieerde klantomgevingen met direct klantcontact: geen dag is hetzelfde 💡 Een passend salaris afgestemd op jouw ervaring en een goede pensioenregeling 💡 Bonusregeling 💡 Ruime vergoeding voor 24x7-consignatiediensten (indien van toepassing) 💡 Laptop en een maandelijkse vergoeding voor internet en telefonie 💡 Volop ruimte voor certificaten en opleidingen: we streven naar minstens één certificaat per jaar (denk aan MD-102, MS-102, SC-300 of AZ-104) 💡 Dagelijkse gezamenlijke lunch (op kosten van de baas) en altijd vers fruit 💡 Twee keer per week sporten met een personal trainer én regelmatige teamuitjes 💡 Een warme, collegiale sfeer in een team van echte IT-vakidioten met humor Kennis & ervaring ✔️ MBO+/HBO werk- en denkniveau ✔️ Minimaal 5 jaar ervaring als systeembeheerder of system engineer ✔️ Ruime kennis van Microsoft Intune en modern workplace management ✔️ Ruime kennis van Microsoft 365, Entra ID en Exchange Online ✔️ Ervaring met Microsoft-securityoplossingen zoals Defender en Conditional Access ✔️ Kennis van Windows Server, Active Directory en hybride identiteit (Entra Connect) ✔️ Ervaring met virtualisatie (Hyper-V en/of VMware) en back-upoplossingen ✔️ Basiskennis van netwerken (TCP/IP, VLAN’s, VPN, firewalls) ✔️ Bekendheid met ISO 27001 of werken volgens een beveiligingsnorm is een pré Wie ben jij? ✔️ Je bent leergierig en houdt je kennis bij, nieuwe features in Microsoft 365 en Intune volg je op de voet ✔️ Je werkt zelfstandig en gedreven, maar vraagt op tijd om hulp als dat nodig is ✔️ Je deelt je kennis graag en helpt collega’s verder als ze vastlopen ✔️ Je bent proactief: je signaleert problemen voordat de klant ze merkt ✔️ Je denkt in oplossingen en pakt storingen gestructureerd aan ✔️ Je neemt verantwoordelijkheid voor je werk, van ontwerp tot oplevering ✔️ Je communiceert helder, zowel met collega’s als met klanten ✔️ Je blijft kalm onder druk, ook als er iets misgaat ✔️ Je bent klantgericht en begrijpt de vraag achter de vraag ✔️ Je bent positief, verantwoordelijk en professioneel in je uitstraling Find more English Speaking Jobs in Netherlands on Arbeitnow

title: AI-Native Software Engineering Lead / Agentic Development Expert

title: Lead R&D Engineer, Tritium-Breeding Blanket
description: WHO WE ARE Proxima Fusion is Europe’s fastest-growing fusion company and the continent’s best-funded fusion player, as well as the first spin-out from the Max Planck Institute for Plasma Physics (IPP). Backed by over €650M and powered by a growing team across Munich, Zurich, and Oxford, we are developing the hardware and infrastructure needed to deliver the world’s first commercial stellarator fusion power plant. Our concept advances the most mature fusion technology out there, the Wendelstein 7-X stellarator, through two next-generation machines: Alpha and Stellaris. Our work combines stellarator optimization, advanced computation, machine learning, and high-temperature superconducting magnets to unlock higher-performance designs that were previously out of reach. Turning these designs into a functioning fusion power plant requires excellence and ownership across every discipline, from physics and engineering to software, manufacturing, law, and business functions. TEAM AND ROLE Shape the architecture of the world’s first commercial fusion power plant – Own system-level decisions that determine how a first-of-a-kind energy technology is designed, integrated, and ultimately deployed at scale. Solve some of the most complex engineering challenges in industry – Work across tightly coupled disciplines (plasma physics, magnets, cryogenics, manufacturing, controls, and more) to resolve critical trade-offs and turn cutting-edge science into a functioning product. Build real hardware with a pragmatic, fast-moving team from all over the world – Combine advanced simulation and systems thinking with a strong execution mindset, focusing on practical engineering solutions that accelerate the path to commercial fusion energy. WHY JOIN PROXIMA FUSION You will get to work on some of the most complex tech challenges to bring abundant, safe, clean energy to the world. You'll get to join and learn from an exceptional selection of accomplished and driven individuals. Do your life’s best work and enjoy the journey. Get to show that big things are possible in Europe when you assemble the best talent. YOUR IMPACT As Lead R&D Engineer for the Stellaris tritium-breeding blanket, you will build and lead Proxima Fusion’s blanket development from initial concept to first prototype tests. You will translate a defined R&D budget into a small set of parallel breeder-blanket concepts, developed rapidly with external research and industrial partners. Remote maintainability is a fundamental part of the blanket architecture from day one. Each concept must be thought with the power plant architecture in mind and demonstrate how blanket modules can be installed, connected, inspected, replaced and recovered remotely. The objective is to leverage existing public research, challenge the most consequential assumptions, learn from hardware quickly and iterate to a functional blanket concept for our future commercial plant fleet. WHAT YOU WILL DO Own the blanket design from initial requirements through conceptual design, prototype manufacture and testing, with accountability for budget, schedule and technical outcomes. Own the integrated remote-maintenance architecture for each concept, including segmentation, access, handling, service connections, inspection, replacement and recovery from failed operations. Own the compliance analysis across neutronics, thermal hydraulics, structural integrity, materials, tritium, decommissioning, safety and remote maintenance. Own the rapid fail-fast prototype: select what to test and lead its design, procurement, manufacture, instrumentation, commissioning and test campaign on ambitious timelines. Own the translation of test results into updated models, requirements, risk assessments and design decisions. Own and build the multidisciplinary, technical design team. WHO YOU ARE A Master’s degree or higher in mechanical engineering, nuclear engineering, materials science, chemical engineering, physics or equivalent experience. Have led the development of complex nuclear, thermal, chemical or energy technology from conceptual design into hardware and testing, under budget and time constraints. Able to lead multidisciplinary trade studies without converging prematurely on a preferred solution. Strong knowledge in several relevant domains, such as thermal hydraulics, structural mechanics, neutronics, nuclear materials, tritium systems, high-temperature coolants, corrosion, manufacturing or remote handling. Able to distinguish between analysis that enables a decision and analysis that merely adds detail. Comfortable structuring and managing technical work with external institutes, industrial partners and specialist suppliers. Willing to test critical assumptions early, learn from failure and stop weak development paths. Able to make clear and defensible engineering decisions under uncertainty. Experience with fusion blankets, fission-reactor components, breeder materials, tritium systems or remotely maintained nuclear equipment are an advantage, but are explicitly not necessary. INTERVIEW PROCESS Recruiter Interview (30-60 min) Technical Screening (30 min) Technical Panel (3x60 min) At Proxima Fusion, our mission is bold: making limitless clean energy a reality. To get there, we need a high-performing, diverse team that brings different perspectives, challenges assumptions, and builds together with purpose. We know that diversity of thought and experience leads to better ideas, stronger execution, and a more resilient team. We don’t look at how you identify, what you look like, who you choose to worship or what ethnicity you are. We care about what you can bring to the table. title: Data Engineer
description: De wereld om ons heen verandert razendsnel. Wat vandaag nieuw is, kan morgen alweer achterhaald zijn. Bij PuurData krijg je de kans om samen met collega’s te werken aan slimme oplossingen voor onze klanten. Zo kun je bijvoorbeeld bedrijven helpen met het inzichtelijk maken van hun data of meedenken over hoe ze veiliger met hun data om kunnen gaan. Je helpt onze klanten vooruit door ze mee te nemen in nieuwe technologieën en te laten zien waar bijvoorbeeld AI daadwerkelijk waarde toevoegt. Op deze manier kun je zowel kleine, maar ook grote en veeleisende bedrijven helpen met oplossingen die kritisch zijn voor hun bedrijfsvoering. Tenslotte zorgen wij er samen voor dat jij continu blijft groeien en op de hoogte bent van de nieuwste ontwikkelingen. Wat ga je doen? Als Data Engineer bij PuurData ben je meer dan een technicus. Je bent een consultant die klanten helpt om meer waarde uit hun data te halen. PuurData werkt met platformen zoals Elastic en AWS, en bedient klanten op het gebied van zoektechnologie, observability, security en AI. Jij bent degene die die oplossingen tot leven brengt. Je start bij de klant. Je inventariseert de vraag: wat willen ze met hun data? Gaat het om betere zoekfunctionaliteit, real-time inzicht in systemen, of security en threat detection? Klanten weten vaak dat er iets niet klopt. Data is traag, er is geen inzicht, of er zijn performance problemen. Maar ze weten niet altijd hoe ze het moeten oplossen. Jij helpt dat helder te maken. Vervolgens ga je samen met de klant naar de juiste oplossing toe. Je vertaalt de behoefte naar een concrete aanpak en implementeert die van A tot Z: van het inrichten van de datastroom tot het opleveren van dashboards en inzichten. Geen dag is hetzelfde. De use cases lopen uiteen van zoekoplossingen en business process monitoring tot SIEM-implementaties en data engineering-pipelines. Dat geeft je veel vrijheid in de invulling van je werk. Continu leren is geen optie, maar de norm Technologie staat niet stil, en jij ook niet. Bij PuurData is training verplicht. Je blijft op de hoogte van de laatste ontwikkelingen, denk aan Elastic, AI-integraties en nieuwe dataplatformen, en past die kennis direct toe in klantprojecten. Wie ben jij? Je bent een ondernemende professional die weinig sturing nodig heeft. Je denkt vanuit de eindgebruiker en streeft naar maximale klanttevredenheid zonder kwaliteit en veiligheid uit het oog te verliezen. Dankzij jouw analytisch vermogen zie je snel de kern van een probleem en kom je met creatieve, structurele oplo ssingen. Je kunt technische keuzes helder onderbouwen en klanten daarin meenemen, ook als het complex is. Daarin mag je best een tikkeltje eigenwijs zijn. Nog geen doorgewinterde expert? Geen probleem. Als je leergierig bent en en affiniteit hebt met data, komen we graag met je in contact. Persoonlijke vaardigheden: Analytisch sterk, je ziet snel verbanden in data en datastructuren Leergierig en gedreven om jezelf continu te blijven ontwikkelen Zelfstandig maar samenwerkingsgericht, je pakt door zonder dat iemand je hoeft aan te sturen Communicatief vaardig, je vertaalt technische keuzes naar begrijpelijke taal voor klanten Probleemoplossend, je zoekt structurele oplossingen in plaats van tijdelijke fixes Professionele vaardigheden: HBO werk- en denkniveau in een technische of data-gerelateerde richting 1 tot 3 jaar werkervaring in data engineering of een vergelijkbare consultancy rol Ervaring met ETL/ELT processen, data modeling en data pipelines Pré: Affiniteit met of kennis van Elastic, SQL of vergelijkbare data-platformen Ervaring met data orchestration, data lakes of dashboarding tools Kennis van cloud omgevingen zoals AWS of Azure Begrijpt hoe data-architectuur bijdraagt aan AI-toepassingen en procesautomatisering Waarom werken bij PuurData? Je krijgt de vrijheid om je eigen werkweek in te richten en werkt aan uitdagende projecten bij uiteenlopende klanten, geen saaie repeterende klussen. Je werkt in een platte organisatie waar jouw mening telt en er snel geschakeld wordt. Daarnaast bieden we een salaris passend bij jouw ervaring, pensioen zonder eigen bijdrage en volop ruimte om door te groeien. Herken jij jezelf hierin? We horen graag van je. Wil je nog aanvullende informatie? Mail dan naar S.v.p geen acquisitie, wij werven zelf! Find more English Speaking Jobs in Netherlands on Arbeitnow

title: Quantum Applications Engineer
description: Quandela is a global leader in quantum computing, designing, building, and delivering cutting-edge quantum solutions for research and industry. Its offerings include very energy-efficient quantum computers for data centers, full-stack quantum computing solutions accessible via the cloud, and algorithm access services for academic and industrial customers. Following a pragmatic, step-by-step roadmap, Quandela has been deploying industrial-grade systems since 2023 while developing future generations of fault-tolerant quantum computers capable of scaling through the integration of thousands of photonic components. Quandela is committed to making quantum computing accessible to all in order to address the most complex industrial and societal challenges. Learn more at: Quandela | Leading Photonic Quantum Computing Solutions Description of the Project As a Quantum Applications Engineer , you will work at the intersection of quantum algorithms, real-world applications and customer projects . Your mission will be to identify relevant problems that can be addressed using Quandela's quantum computing technology, assess their feasibility and define how meaningful performance should be measured. Working directly with industrial and academic partners, you will translate real-world challenges into quantum computing problems, evaluate potential approaches and establish the appropriate benchmarks against classical methods. This is a highly technical role with strong exposure to customers and partners. It is particularly suited to someone with a background in quantum algorithms who wants to apply that expertise to practical use cases rather than focus exclusively on theoretical research. Your Key Responsibilities Identify and assess quantum use cases by working with customers, industrial partners and internal teams to understand their challenges and translate them into relevant computational problems. Perform feasibility studies to determine whether and how these problems can be addressed using current and near-term quantum computing technologies, with a particular focus on NISQ approaches. Define meaningful benchmarks , including relevant problem instances, expected outputs, accuracy targets and classical baselines to objectively evaluate quantum approaches. Explore promising application domains and contribute to application roadmaps, from near-term demonstrations to longer-term utility-scale applications. Evaluate scientific, industrial and economic value to help prioritize the applications where quantum computing can have the greatest impact. Design and maintain strategic demonstrations and Proofs of Concept , working with internal teams or external software partners depending on the project. Follow customer projects throughout their lifecycle , including projects where algorithm development is performed by external partners. Present technical work to customers and partners , explaining quantum approaches, results, limitations and opportunities to both technical and non-specialist audiences. Collaborate closely with Quandela's algorithm, machine learning, product, project management, sales and engineering teams. Depending on the strategic interest of a project, you may also contribute directly to the development and implementation of quantum algorithms in Python. What will make you successful You do not need to know every possible quantum application from day one. What matters is your ability to approach an unfamiliar problem, ask the right questions, understand its computational structure and determine whether quantum computing provides an interesting direction to explore. You are comfortable navigating between research and practical applications : scientifically rigorous enough to challenge an algorithmic approach, pragmatic enough to assess its real-world relevance, and comfortable enough with people to discuss your conclusions directly with customers. Requirements You have a strong technical background in quantum computing and quantum algorithms , combined with the curiosity and communication skills required to explore real-world applications. You ideally bring: A PhD in quantum computing, quantum information, physics, applied mathematics, computer science or a related field , or a Master's degree combined with relevant professional experience. A first professional experience in a similar environment is strongly preferred. Strong understanding of quantum algorithms , particularly approaches applicable to current or near-term quantum computers. Knowledge of NISQ algorithms and variational quantum algorithms . Good programming skills, particularly in Python . The ability to understand a complex industrial or scientific problem and translate it into a computational and algorithmic framework. A rigorous approach to benchmarking quantum and classical methods . Strong analytical and problem-solving skills. Excellent communication skills and the confidence to present technical topics directly to customers, partners and broader audiences. Professional proficiency in English . Previous experience working on customer-facing technical projects, quantum application projects, consulting, pre-sales, collaborative R&D projects or industrial partnerships would be a strong plus. Experience with Agile ways of working and tools such as Jira is appreciated but not essential. Benefits Competitive salary, flexible based on your experience Profit-sharing & company savings plan 100% health coverage (Alan) 50% transport reimbursement or sustainable mobility bonus Meal vouchers (Swile), Gymlib fitness support Childcare assistance & referral bonuses (€1,000–€2,000) What we offer: A role at the intersection of cutting-edge quantum research and real-world industrial applications. Direct exposure to a wide variety of quantum computing use cases and industries. The opportunity to work with leading researchers, engineers, industrial partners and customers. Significant ownership in shaping Quandela's application portfolio and identifying the problems quantum computing should address next. The opportunity to work across the full quantum stack, from algorithms and software to Quandela's photonic quantum computing technology. A hybrid work model (3-4 days/week onsite in Massy, 1 day in Paris or 1 to 2 days remotely). We are committed to building a respectful, inclusive, and welcoming work environment. All applications are welcome. Find Jobs in France on Arbeitnow

title: Select Major Account Executive, UK&I
description: Who we are Samsara (NYSE: IOT) is the pioneer of the Connected Operations™ Cloud, which is a platform that enables organizations that depend on physical operations to harness Internet of Things (IoT) data to develop actionable insights and improve their operations. At Samsara, we are helping improve the safety, efficiency and sustainability of the physical operations that power our global economy. Representing more than 40% of global GDP, these industries are the infrastructure of our planet, including agriculture, construction, field services, transportation, and manufacturing — and we are excited to help digitally transform their operations at scale. Working at Samsara means you’ll help define the future of physical operations and be on a team that’s shaping an exciting array of product solutions, including Video-Based Safety, Vehicle Telematics, Apps and Driver Workflows, and Equipment Monitoring. As part of a recently public company, you’ll have the autonomy and support to make an impact as we build for the long term. About the role: The Select Major Accounts team is Samsara’s primary engine for enterprise growth, responsible for landing high-value, net-new logos across the UK & Ireland’s largest physical operations. In this role, you will lead multi-million-dollar, full-cycle sales processes from a cold start—executing a disciplined qualification playbook, building true C-suite champions, and closing strategic $1M+ ARR deals . This position is built for an elite, strategic Account Executive who thrives in complex, multi-stakeholder environments—equally comfortable navigating IT and lines of business to digitize industries traditionally reliant on legacy systems. Why Now? Samsara combines the agility of a high-growth startup, the market authority of a public company, and the momentum of a hyper-scale tech leader. Named a Best Place to Work for 3 consecutive years , we offer enterprise sellers a combination of unique differentiators: Proven Leadership & Hyper-Growth: Founded by serial entrepreneurs with a history of building multi-billion-dollar companies, Samsara has scaled past $2.1B+ ARR with 30%+ YoY global growth. Market-Dominating Platform: Backed by $2.8B+ in R&D investment, our Connected Operations Cloud makes us the Category Leader delivering class-leading AI, IoT, and telematics capabilities with a genuine AI moat. Massive Untapped Market: Physical operations represent a $160B+ Global TAM, with EMEA remaining 99% greenfield opportunity . This brings strong upside earning potential on a winning trajectory, rapid professional growth alongside elite sales talent, and a massive, unpenetrated territory waiting to be captured. Whilst we do support remote working, flexibility is required to travel to visit customers onsite across the region as required. You should apply if: You want to impact the industries that run our world: Your efforts will result in real-world impact—helping to keep the lights on, get food into grocery stores, and most importantly, ensure workers return home safely. Your mantra is #alwaysbeprospecting: The world of operations is vast. Your customers are often out in the field and the best way to catch them is live on the phone. Samsara’s top reps do constant research to find companies and contacts to expand their pipeline. You have innate curiosity in how businesses work: One day you’ll meet with someone in waste management and the next you may be learning about the inner workings of a food distribution center. Our top sales team members seek to learn the ins and outs of the businesses they support in order to make a larger impact. You are a life-long learner: Samsara sales are complex. You will need to learn about businesses where you previously had little knowledge. The payoff is big but you have to be willing to put in the work. title: Senior Full-Stack Engineer (Web + Infrastructure)
description: Searoutes makes the emissions data that shippers use to run and reduce their logistics. It is an operational problem before it is an environmental one, and in our hands it is mostly an engineering one. We are hiring a senior engineer who works across our web frontend and our infrastructure — the same two codebases, in the same week. Someone who ships a product screen on Monday, changes an identity-provider flow on Wednesday, and considers those the same job. We are looking for a broad profile rather than a specialist. The next year is mostly platform work with a user-facing edge — user management, API gateway management, payments, SEO, and a great deal of compliance, GDPR and ISO 27001. If you are passionate about the environment, proactive and pragmatic in getting things done, and love to work in a complex but fascinating industry where you learn every day — then this is the place for you. The work in front of us Some of the items on our tech roadmap for the coming year. Bets are picked a cycle at a time and shared out, so you would take the ones that suit you and grow into the rest. Product and marketing UI in React — multi-brand, WCAG AA, strong on technical SEO, fast enough to hold a performance budget. User management and identity — Keycloak realms, organisation hierarchies, partner brokering, and the entitlement model in the app. API gateway work in APISIX — routes, plugins and auth policy as code. Payments and billing. ISO 27001 and GDPR — access control, change management, audit logging, observability and alerting, consent and retention. The infrastructure underneath — Pulumi in TypeScript, Docker Swarm on Hetzner, Cloudflare at the edge, Tailscale for all engineer and CI access. Third-party integrations — usually the seam between two systems that were never designed to meet. Nobody arrives fluent in all of that, and we are not expecting it. We want someone strong across a good part of it, comfortable being new to the rest, and used to working things out — with a team and with agents, rather than alone. Also in daily use: Postgres and PostGIS, Valkey, ClickHouse; Vite, Tailwind and Radix; Jest and Playwright; GitHub Actions; HAProxy. Most of what we write is TypeScript, strict — though our core API is Java and Spring, and the identity layer has Java in it too, so how far you go into that side is up to you. How we work LLM-native, in the codebases you would work in. They are built around agent-assisted development rather than merely tolerant of it — the conventions, the tooling and the review gates all assume it. Agents do most of the implementation and much of the review; humans design, verify and approve. What we are really hiring for is judgement over output you did not write by hand : knowing what to specify, what to check, and what to throw away. The bar did not move when the tooling did. Shape Up, and you own what you take. Roughly three weeks of building, then a week of cooldown, with bets chosen at a betting table. We are small enough that an area becomes yours quickly — you make the calls inside it and you answer for how it turns out. We hand out problems, not the steps that solve them. Remote first, with most of the team in Europe and everyone together in person at least twice a year. Significant technical decisions get written down, and a green build is never on its own enough to merge. Requirements You'll thrive here if you have… Senior full-stack experience — you have owned features from the browser to the machine they run on. A track record of taking something and running with it — a domain, a migration, a subsystem you took on, decided and stayed accountable for. Taste. You can tell a good design from a merely plausible one, and you will reject work that functions but is not right — your own, and an agent's. React beyond the client — server rendering, static generation, data loading and hydration; you know what runs where and why it matters. TypeScript at strict — typed boundaries, and an instinct for when types are carrying real weight. Infrastructure as code — Pulumi ideally; Terraform if you are ready to pick up Pulumi. Containers and Linux in production — not writing a Dockerfile, but debugging a service on a machine you have to SSH into. Postgres beyond queries — backup and restore, migrations, what a schema change does under load. Wholehearted LLM-assisted development — you use coding agents daily, have opinions about steering them, and review their output as critically as a colleague's. Integration instincts — third-party APIs, webhooks, OAuth/OIDC, and patience for other people's undocumented edge cases. A working day that overlaps ours : based within CET ±3. Fluent in English, our working language. Nice to have Identity and API gateways in depth — Keycloak, OIDC, SAML brokering, APISIX. Compliance from the inside — an ISO 27001 certification lived through, or GDPR beyond a cookie banner. Payment systems, billing models, or PSP integrations. Observability and alerting — Prometheus, Grafana or equivalent. Experience in the maritime, logistics or freight industry. Familiarity with emissions accounting frameworks (GHG Protocol, GLEC, EU ETS..). Benefits As part of our team, you will: 🌱 Have a chance to re-shape the future of climate in the logistics. 👩‍💻 Be empowered to deliver your best work remotely, and get a stipend to set you up. 🏄‍♂️ Have a flat hierarchy, where you will have direct access to the founders and won't be tied up in politics. 🎓 Have a high degree of learning and ownership in a dynamic environment. 🏝 Take part in our team-building events. title: Chief Science Officer
description: Chief Science Officer @ Sereact 🦾 Chief Science Officer (m/f/d) · Zurich or Stuttgart, Boston possible · Reports to the CEO · Full-time Who we are Sereact builds the robot brain for physical work. Cortex , our vision-language-action foundation model, is hardware-agnostic: the same model runs single-arm and dual-arm systems, mobile manipulators and humanoids that pick, sort and handle returns in live production across Europe and the US. Customers include Zalando, IKEA, BMW, Rohlik and DHL. Founded in 2021 in Stuttgart, with an R&D hub in Zurich and a US office in Boston. We have raised more than $145 million, most recently a $116 million Series B led by Headline, with Zalando as a strategic investor. We work in small, senior teams with a flat structure; execution counts more than titles. Why this role, why now Our robots produce data no lab can stage. Our fleet has recorded more than 500 million manipulation interactions in live warehouse operations; Cortex 2.0 was trained on a curated 10 million of them and added a world model that plans before it acts ( arXiv 2604.20246 ). Cortex 2.5 learns a new task from a few demonstrations instead of a training run. Deployments are growing from single robots to fleets, and the research team is growing with them. We now want one scientific leader who owns the research behind Cortex end to end and turns what our fleet experiences every day into the next step change in what robots can do. The Real-World Learning Loop is your system Sereact is a frontier research lab and a production-grade robotics company in one. Our bet: general-purpose robotic intelligence “must be learned from live deployments” ( The Real-World Learning Loop , Feb 2026). Every stage of that loop is yours to raise: In-Situ Policy Execution. Every robot in production runs the current policy, and every shift is an experiment. You decide what the policies expose for learning. Continuous Data Acquisition. Robots annotate their own interactions while they work. You decide what is worth recording and which situations the fleet should go and find. Data Curation and Learning. Novelty, uncertainty, failures and distribution shift decide what we learn from. You own the curation and the training recipe. Evaluation and Policy Redeployment. Updated policies pass validation gates before they return to the fleet. You set the bar, and how fast we can clear it safely. Every deployment teaches the next one. Your job is to make that loop turn faster and teach more each time. Responsibilities Set the research agenda for Cortex: vision-language-action models, world models and planning, learning from interaction on real robots, and generalization across tasks and embodiments. Make the big bets: which directions get people and compute, and which ones we stop. Own the data strategy: the mix of deployment, teleoperation, open-source and synthetic data, and what the fleet collects next. Own the compute strategy, from large-scale training to real-time inference on the robot. Build the evaluation science: benchmarks that predict performance in a customer’s operation, not only on a leaderboard. Build and lead the research organisation in Zurich and Stuttgart: structure, leads, rhythm. Set the hiring bar and make Sereact the place the best people in robot learning want to join. Take research into production with engineering, so results reach the fleet in weeks and hold up in 24/7 operation. Decide with the founders what we publish, open-source or patent, and build our standing at CoRL, RSS, ICRA, NeurIPS and ICML. Be Sereact’s scientific voice with customers, partners, universities and investors, and build academic partnerships. Partner with the CTO, product and operations, so research, engineering and deployment pull in one direction. Not in scope, by design Software platform, hardware and field deployment engineering. They stay with the CTO and operations: the CTO owns how we build and ship, you own what we learn next. A research lab beside the business. Research at Sereact ends on a robot, ideally at a customer. Product roadmap and pricing. What makes this role hard Research and production compete for the same robots, people and compute. You make that trade-off every week, in the open. Cortex is not a blank page. It already runs in customer operations, and our founders are deeply technical. You raise the ceiling of a running system. A result counts when it holds up in a customer’s operation, not when the paper is accepted. Your first 12 months First 90 days: know the fleet, the data and the team; agree the research roadmap with the founders; one evaluation standard everyone uses. By month 6: a research organisation with clear ownership and a release rhythm from experiment to fleet. By month 12: a new generation of Cortex in customer operations with measurable gains, key senior hires made, and work that puts Sereact on the map of robot learning. What you bring You have led research in robot learning or embodied AI (VLA models, imitation or reinforcement learning, world models) and built a team around it. Your work runs on real robots, ideally outside the lab and for long stretches. You know what breaks first. Scientific standing: a strong record at the top venues and a network that great researchers want to join. You have made real calls on research bets, data and compute, and stopped what did not work. You explain science to engineers, customers and investors alike, and you enjoy it. PhD in machine learning, robotics or a related field, or an equivalent track record. Nice to have: large-scale pretraining of foundation models · fleet learning or data engines · industrial manipulation · experience in both academia and industry. Three questions we will ask you Tell us about a model you took from a paper to a robot that ran for weeks without you. What broke first? If you had our deployment data tomorrow, which bet would you make first, and what would you stop? How do you decide what to publish and what to keep? What we offer Robots in live production that learn every day, and the data that comes with them. A seat in the leadership team of a company scaling from Europe into the US, with meaningful equity. Large-scale compute and the freedom to build the research organisation you would want to work in. Teams in Stuttgart, Zurich and Boston; relocation support. How we hire Conversations with both founders, a research deep dive with the team, and a working session on a real problem from our deployments. We move fast. Find Jobs in Germany on Arbeitnow

Bonus Certificeringen zoals NEBOSH, HVK, MVK of vergelijkbaar. Ervaring met chemische veiligheidsvraagstukken en REACH-verplichtingen. Ervaring met ISO-certificeringstrajecten en externe audits. We werken volgens internationale standaarden en Nederlandse wet- en regelgeving om de impact op mens, natuur en omgeving zorgvuldig te beheersen. Veiligheid, duurzaamheid en samenwerking staan daarbij centraal. Wat wij bieden DSL-01 is volop in ontwikkeling. title: Reliability & Maintenance Engineer | DSL-01
description: Please note: For this role proficiency in both Dutch and English is required. Reliability & Maintenance Engineer | DSL-01 As Reliability & Maintenance Engineer DSL-01, you are responsible for building and continuously improving the facility's maintenance, reliability, and asset integrity framework. You will: Develop and continuously improve maintenance, inspection, and asset integrity strategies Translate reliability studies, FMECA analyses, and engineering data into practical maintenance plans within the CMMS/EAM system Act as owner of the asset register from a maintenance, reliability, and integrity perspective Support the implementation and continuous development of the facility's CMMS/EAM system Drive reliability improvements through asset health monitoring, KPI analysis, and predictive maintenance techniques Lead Root Cause Analyses (RCA) and implement sustainable corrective actions Monitor and improve reliability performance indicators such as MTBF, MTTR, availability, and inspection compliance Support asset improvement, modification, and long-term replacement strategies throughout the asset lifecycle Your profile As a growing company in a rapidly evolving industry, we are looking for people who embrace change and are motivated to actively contribute to building and scaling our business. You are someone who feels comfortable in an entrepreneurial environment, takes ownership, and enjoys turning complex technical challenges into practical solutions. You recognize yourself in the following: Must have Fluent in Dutch and English Bachelor's degree in a relevant engineering discipline (i.e. electrical or mechanical) 5+ years of experience in Reliability Engineering, Maintenance Engineering, Asset Integrity, or Asset Management Experience with RCM, FMEA/FMECA, RCA, and maintenance strategy development Experience with CMMS/EAM systems such as SAP PM, Maximo, or IFS Preferred Experience in chemical, petrochemical, energy, or other process industries like food or FMCG Experience with CMMS/EAM implementation or optimisation Experience with predictive maintenance and condition monitoring Knowledge of ATEX, PED, and asset integrity management About DSL-01 DSL-01 is SkyNRG’s frontrunning renewable fuels facility in Delfzijl, Netherlands. The plant will produce Sustainable Aviation Fuel (SAF) from residual fats and greases using the HEFA (Hydrotreated Esters and Fatty Acids) pathway, with additional renewable products like butane, propane, and naphtha as by-products. Once operational, it will produce 100,000 tonnes of SAF and 35,000 tonnes of sustainable by-products per year, cutting greenhouse gas emissions by around 80% compared to conventional jet fuel. Environmental and social responsibility are at the heart of DSL-01. We follow international frameworks and Dutch regulations to manage impacts on people, nature, and local communities. We are committed to offering an attractive total package to ensure we attract the best talent in the market. This includes a competitive salary, performance-based incentives, and a range of benefits that support your personal and professional growth. Is this you? At DSL-01, you will work in a dynamic, innovative environment where technical curiosity, problem-solving, and teamwork are valued. title: Stagiair(e) Business Development

Klaar om jouw stempel te drukken op de CO₂-transitie? Lees dan verder! De rol Skytree ontwikkelt actief DAC-projecten in de Nederlandse glastuinbouw — een markt met veel potentieel op het gebied van duurzame energie en een groeiende vraag naar circulaire CO₂. Als stagiair(e) Business Development voor Nederland ondersteun je het team bij het identificeren en ontwikkelen van deze kansen — van het eerste contact tot een project partnerschap. Dit is een praktische, commerciële rol: je brengt klanten in kaart, benadert prospects en helpt de pijplijn op te bouwen die de technologie van Skytree in de praktijk brengt.
