title: Talent Acquisition Specialist
description: We are looking for a Talent Acquisition Specialist to build the team behind our launch vehicles and propulsion systems. This is a hands-on, primarily onsite role focused on high-quality technical recruitment at pace. You will partner closely with engineering and business leaders to attract exceptional talent across propulsion, mechanical engineering, systems engineering, electronics, software, manufacturing, operations, and corporate functions. You will be expected to move quickly without lowering the hiring bar, while delivering an outstanding candidate experience from first contact through to offer. Working as part of a high-performing TA function capable of supporting hyper-growth while protecting and strengthening the quality and density of talent across the company. Fluent German is essential. A key part of the role will be developing relationships with German institutions, rocketry teams, suppliers, and technical communities. About us We’re a Germany-based rocketry startup currently in stealth mode, scaling up rapidly to meet the demand for high-performance, reliable, and scalable solid propulsion technologies for space and defense applications. We are already launching suborbital and ballistic rockets on a regular basis, generating significant revenue and applying our knowledge toward the development of an orbital rocket. We are working hard to build something truly spectacular. To thrive here you will need to be comfortable working at pace, with the autonomy to make decisions and execute on them quickly. If you’re excited by hard technical challenges and want a role where you will make a real difference each day to the future of the company, we may be the place for you. At our company, job titles and career progression are earned, not determined by years of experience alone. They reflect the responsibility you take on and the dedication you bring to each project. If you’re ready to rise to the challenge, we’d love to hear from you. Key responsibilities Own end-to-end recruitment for technical and business roles, delivering a fast, structured, and high-quality hiring process. Partner with hiring managers and technical leaders to define roles, calibrate requirements, build scorecards, and improve assessment quality. Source exceptional candidates across propulsion, mechanical, systems, electronics, software, manufacturing, and operations. Build trusted relationships with German universities, technical institutions, rocketry teams, suppliers, professional networks, and specialist communities. Deliver a thoughtful and responsive candidate experience while maintaining a high bar for capability, ownership, and cultural contribution. Actively optimise and continuously improve the TA function, including sourcing strategy, recruitment systems, metrics, employer brand, referrals, and scalable hiring processes. What we are looking for Proven experience in-house or within an embedded recruitment solution; strong agency recruiters with demonstrable technical hiring results will also be considered. Experience recruiting highly specialised technical talent in a fast-growing or demanding environment. Fluent German and strong professional English, with the ability to build trusted relationships in both languages. Demonstrated ability to source and engage hard-to-find candidates through direct outreach, networks, referrals, events, and technical communities. Excellent judgement, organisation, communication, and stakeholder-management skills. A proactive, high-ownership approach and the ability to work primarily onsite in a fast-paced, rapidly scaling company. Desirable experience Recruiting within a complex technical discipline such as aerospace, space, rocketry, propulsion, defence, advanced manufacturing or engineering. Existing relationships with German technical institutions, universities, rocketry teams, suppliers, or engineering communities. Benefits and important information: We offer top-decile compensation packages, bonuses and meaningful equity, to attract exceptional aerospace talent. Every employee is awarded stock options in the company, you will directly benefit from your own hard work and success. Comprehensive relocation support including flights, shipping and visas. Lunch, dinner and drinks provided everyday Free access to shared company housing Please note, we are a fast paced, hyper-scaling startup. You will need to be comfortable working extended hours with high levels of autonomy, ownership, and flexibility, with contracts structured around a 48-hour working week. We are committed to building an equitable and inclusive workplace where everyone feels valued, has equal access to opportunity, and can thrive. We welcome different perspectives, backgrounds, and experiences—and believe our differences make us stronger. title: Senior medewerker Financiële Administratie

Je verzorgt en bewaakt de debiteurenadministratie, waaronder het factureren, controleren van openstaande posten, aanmanen en controle op volledigheid van facturatie. Je verzorgt de financiële administratie van samenwerkingsprojecten in het kader van het Integraal Zorgakkoord (IZA) en subsidieprojecten. Je onderzoekt verschillen tussen administratieve gegevens en realisaties en zorgt voor een passende opvolging. Een afgeronde hbo-opleiding in de richting van financiële administratie, finance & control of vergelijkbaar. Ervaring met debiteurenadministratie en projectadministratie. Bij voorkeur ervaring met de financiële administratie en verantwoording van subsidieprojecten en samenwerkingsprojecten. Kennis van financiële verslaglegging en het controleren van financiële gegevens. Een nauwkeurige en analytische werkwijze, met oog voor detail en deadlines. Jij bent de schakel tussen strategie en uitvoering, en vertaalt onze organisatiedoelen naar een duidelijke technologische koers. Wat ga je doen? Als Solution Architect ontwerp en bewaak je de ICT-architectuur van GGZ inGeest. Je zorgt dat onze informatievoorziening aansluit bij de strategische ambities van de organisatie én bij de behoeften van zorg en bedrijfsvoering. Je bent vanaf de start betrokken bij initiatieven, analyseert de informatiebehoefte en bepaalt de kaders waarbinnen ontwikkelaars en leveranciers de oplossing moeten bouwen. Je vertaalt abstracte doelen (zoals 'cloud-first' of 'security-by-design') naar praktische richtlijnen en 'building blocks' die projectteams kunnen toepassen. Je adviseert management en projectleiders gevraagd en ongevraagd over technologische keuzes, de impact van nieuwe software en de haalbaarheid van innovaties. Je schakelt met management, leveranciers en interne stakeholders om te zorgen dat jouw ontwerpen daadwerkelijk de knelpunten in de praktijk oplossen. Wie ben jij? Je combineert analytische scherpte met verbindend vermogen. Je kunt conceptueel denken én praktisch adviseren. Verder heb je: WO-werk- en denkniveau, bij voorkeur richting Bedrijfskundige Informatica. Ervaring met architectuurmethoden, zoals TOGAF of vergelijkbare raamwerken. Kennis van AWS, Microsoft en (zorg)applicaties. Inzicht in bedrijfsprocessen en de vertaling daarvan naar informatie- en ICT-architecturen. Goede communicatieve vaardigheden en het vermogen om draagvlak te creëren binnen verschillende lagen van de organisatie. Een proactieve houding: jij signaleert kansen, adviseert en neemt initiatief. Wat bieden wij jou? Een afwisselende strategische rol in een maatschappelijk relevante organisatie. Ruimte voor eigen initiatief, visie en innovatie. title: Staff Software Engineer, Backend
description: Staff Software Engineer, Backend About Stream Stream powers real-time Chat , Video , Activity Feeds , and AI Moderation for more than 1 billion end users across 4,000+ apps, from Strava and Bumble to eBay and Patreon. Our platform processes billions of API requests per month and supports applications with millions of concurrent users, while delivering highly reliable, low-latency services and a great developer experience. The role We’re looking for Staff Software Engineers . You’ll join our Chat or Activity Feeds team and own backend systems that thousands of developers build their products on, from how they’re structured to how they scale. This is a full-time role based in our Amsterdam (visa & relocation support possible), Toronto, or Skopje office. We are also open to hiring the right person remote from the EU. About you You’ve built backend systems at high scale and stayed long enough to live with your own decisions, good and bad. You care about how a system is structured, not only the next feature, and you can explain your trade-offs to the people who’ll live with them. Maybe you led a team for a few years and chose to go back to hands-on work. That’s welcome here: this is an individual contributor role, and you’ll write code and touch databases yourself. Our leads spend about 80% of their time hands-on too. You won’t enjoy it if you want to manage people, or if you’d rather stay away from infrastructure and database work. We’re also hiring Senior Engineers on these teams. If your experience fits Senior better than Staff, we’ll say so openly and talk it through with you. You have Extensive backend engineering experience, including technical leadership on systems in production. Proficiency in Go, Python, or in another backend language plus the willingness to switch to Go. Experience building features used by a large number of users, and scaling them as usage grows. Strong experience with a relational database. We use PostgreSQL, but any relational database counts. Hands-on experience with Redis or a similar in-memory data store. Experience building public APIs or SDKs that other developers use. Comfort with infrastructure and database work as part of your normal week, including Kubernetes. Good written and spoken English. It’s our working language. Bonus points PostgreSQL in production at scale, including sharding, partitioning or large migrations. Experience improving or redesigning legacy parts of a system that’s serving live traffic. Go and gRPC in production at high request rates. Messaging, feeds or other real-time systems, or message queues such as RabbitMQ or Kafka. Distributed storage internals, such as Raft or RocksDB. You’ve cut infrastructure cost at a company where margins mattered. Experience running workloads on GCP or AWS. Don’t worry if you haven’t used every tool we run. You’ll get exposure to most of them, and you’re welcome to convince us to add your favorites. What makes this role exciting Scale: more than 1 billion end users and billions of API requests a month go through the systems you’ll own. Impact: cost per message and query latency show up directly in our margins and in the apps of customers like Strava and Patreon. Stack: Go, gRPC, RocksDB and Python; PostgreSQL and RabbitMQ; GCP and Kubernetes; Grafana, Prometheus, ELK (Elasticsearch and Kibana), Jaeger and Tempo for distributed tracing, and Datadog; Redis, Valkey and Memcached. Starting point: you’ll ship to production in your first weeks and own a meaningful area within your first months. What we offer Generous compensation Stock options Amsterdam office benefits: 28 days paid time off plus Dutch public holidays. Pension plan with a company contribution. NS Business Card or a company bike, covered by Stream. EUR 500 per year for personal development. Catered lunches in the office. MacBook Pro. Up to EUR 60 a month toward a gym or sports club membership of your choice. Relocation support if you move to Amsterdam, including visa sponsorship as a recognised IND sponsor. Toronto, Skopje and remote EU: local benefits depending on your country of employment. Why join Stream? We’re a Series B company with offices in Boulder, Amsterdam, Skopje and Toronto, and a team of 140+ people from 37 nationalities. We’re backed by Felicis Ventures, GGV Capital, 01 Advisors, Techstars, and Arthur Ventures, with angels including Dick Costolo (ex-CEO of Twitter), Olivier Pomel (CEO of Datadog), Tom Preston-Werner (co-founder of GitHub), and Nicolas Dessaigne (co-founder of Algolia). We’ll be straight with you: a startup is more demanding than a large company. There’s no fixed playbook, you’ll own things end to end, and you’ll sometimes pick up work outside your title. That’s also what makes it a fast place to grow. If you want real ownership and high scale more than structure and a set career ladder, you’ll feel at home here. Hybrid office policy: applicants based (or relocating to) one of our office locations are expected to work according to the applicable local office attendance policy. Equal opportunity employer statement: Stream provides equal employment opportunities to all employees and applicants for employment and prohibits discrimination and harassment of any type without regard to race, color, religion, age, sex, national origin, disability status, genetics, protected veteran status, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, or any other characteristic protected by federal, state or local laws. This policy applies to all terms and conditions of employment, including recruiting, hiring, placement, promotion, termination, layoff, recall, transfer, leaves of absence, compensation and training. Note for external recruiters: We currently have this role covered and do not accept unsolicited agency resumes. We are not responsible for any fees related to unsolicited resumes. title: Senior Data Engineer
description: 📍 Manchester (Hybrid, up to 4 days WFH) | 💰 £55k-£70k Street Group is one of the fastest-growing PropTech companies in the UK. We want to be the leading creator of delightful experiences for everybody involved in buying, selling, renting and letting property, regardless of their involvement, to improve the industry for everybody by elevating UK Estate Agencies through world-class technology. Our products, Street.co.uk and Spectre , form a powerful duo, working harmoniously together to transform an agent's job. From securing more leads and winning new instructions to streamlining business operations and growing market share, our products are supercharging 1,000s of agencies across the UK. How we work in 2026 Engineering at Street Group has changed. Most of us don't write code by hand day-to-day anymore - agents do; we direct. The bar has moved with it; planning and judgement matter more than typing speed. Being genuinely tuned into AI tooling is core to the role here, not a side skill - and if you'd rather work the "old" way, that's fair - but we're probably not the place for you. Our Data team builds and runs the data platform behind both products. That means sourcing property data, scraping the property portals with our in-house tool Road, and serving it all through Kraken , our UK property data API. Terabytes of data move through the platform every night, and since we launched a new version of Road there’s more to do than ever. Nobody owns a single pipeline, so you’ll flex across all of it. At this level, the platform is yours to steer: you won’t just build things well; you’ll decide how they should be built, and call it out when the way we’ve always done it is no longer the right way. If you love autonomy, are naturally curious, and want to have a genuine impact within a growing company, we think you'd fit right in! Here's what you can expect to be working on as a Senior Data Engineer (L5) at Street Group Owning data work end to end - from working out whether the data exists, through ingestion and modelling, to getting it to the teams who need it. Building high-volume pipelines and ETL with performance, reliability and cost in mind and keeping up as sources, schemas and data sets change underneath you. Running the platform our pipelines run on, our own Kubernetes cluster and deployment tooling and helping decide what we host, what we pay for and what we retire. Setting the patterns, tooling and code review standards that make the whole team faster, including the Claude skills and MCP servers we rely on. Being the go-to for questions about our data, what we hold, where it comes from and what it can (and can’t) tell people. A bit about you You have strong commercial experience with Python and SQL - you know a good query from a bad one, and you've built ETL at scale with performance and cost in mind. BigQuery experience is a big plus. You have production experience with Google Cloud Platform. You have hands-on platform experience with containers, Kubernetes and Helm. You don't need to write charts from scratch, but you've changed them and deployed them yourself. You work AI-natively as a default, using tools like Claude Code, plugins and skills fluently, and you're always experimenting with what's next. (If your current employer limits AI at work, tell us what you're doing with it outside work - we'd love to hear about it.) You enjoy creative problem solving, when data is too expensive or doesn't exist, you find your own way to get it. You communicate clearly in writing, design docs, RFCs and explaining the decisions you've made. Bonus points for Go, Terraform, API design, managing a large SQL database or BI exposure. No property experience needed! Why join Street Group? 🏠 Hybrid-working - you can work from home up to 4 days per week 🏖️ Guilt-Free R&R - £1000 towards a holiday after your first year with the team (we'll even cover the tax!) 💪 Joining a culture that supports your development and encourages growth 📚 £500 yearly L&D budget for your career development 🎂 Your birthday on us - we pay, you stay away 🙋 'Give something back' - 2 paid days volunteering on us 👶 Enhanced maternity, paternity & adoption pay 🧠 Mental health & well-being support via Health Assured 🧘 Regular well-being initiatives 🕒 Flexible working hours 🚂 Public transport season ticket loans 🌷 Paid menopause leave 🌞 Holiday buying scheme 🚀 Joining a new team in an exciting business with huge ambition 👥 Be a part of something bigger - everyone in our team is passionate about improving the entire property industry! It's a huge goal, but it motivates us to do better every single day 👩🏿‍💻 A chance to work on cutting-edge technology 🐶 Comfortable, relaxed office space - office dogs welcome! 🍻 Fully stocked fridge and beers (or an alternative) on us every Friday afternoon 🎊 Company and team off-sites, events and happy hours 🚴 Cycle to work scheme 🚗 Electric car salary sacrifice scheme 🌍 Feel good about sustainability - we're a climate-positive company ! Salary £55,000 - £70,000 dependent on experience. However, sometimes the perfect person is far more or less experienced than we anticipated. In these situations, planned ranges go out the window. title: Senior Voice Routing Specialist
description: The Challenge We connect over 500’000 callers in 190 countries: that represents 36,000 calling corridors and over 100 million calling minutes. We work with various global suppliers optimising for call quality. It’s complex. Each calling corridor has its own quality quirks and legal and regulatory rules to work within. We want someone to own call quality and routing holistically across all of it: routing daily to optimize what's happening right now, while watching the data for the long-term trends that tell us where to fix things next. A failed call is not a metric to us. It's someone not hearing their mother's voice or its an important business call that fails. We also have real ambitions to scale calling well beyond where we are today, so this complexity isn't going anywhere. It's only going to grow. Talk360 has been profitable since 2025, expanding beyond our core calling app into embedded, B2B2C calling for partners. We are lean, around 30 people globally, spread across the Netherlands, South Africa, Nigeria, Suriname, Turkey, Egypt, Kenya, Ukraine, and beyond. That means this role has real scope from day one: no layers between you and the decisions that matter, and no shortage of things worth tackling. This is a remote opportunity. What You'll Do Own call quality holistically : hold the full picture of call quality end to end, working with the team on both the daily grind and the long-term view, moving fluidly between quick fixes and structured experiments. Manage zones, codes, and origins : own and continuously refine our zone, dialing code, and call origin management, keeping the underlying structure clean and accurate across all 900 zones. Update routing continuously : change routing several times a day, from immediate fixes to longer-running tests of new suppliers. Work cross-functionally by design : partner daily with Ozcan, who owns supplier account management and deal creation, and Mahmoud, who runs hourly monitoring and support-team escalations to suppliers. Work with Ewan on automating the processes behind routing, and with Product and CRM to improve the experience for our end users. Move routing toward automation : work toward (semi) automated routing and pricing, reducing how much of this still runs on manual, single-person work. What You'll Bring Hands-on experience with international A-Z calling and telco routing: zones, codes, LCR, and SIP response codes, built at a telco, carrier, or comms platform with real cross-border calling experience. NOC or technical support background: comfortable troubleshooting live voice traffic and reading call detail records and quality metrics like ASR and ACD. Exposure to a routing/testing platform such as iTest or an equivalent tool. Familiarity with Digitalk Cloud Carrier (DCC), our current routing platform, is a plus. Nice to have: working technical literacy in SIP signalling and SBC concepts Who You Are Process driven and meticulous: you build the audit trail as you go, not after something goes wrong. You are methodical and analytical by nature, and you would rather have a clean, repeatable process than a clever one-off fix. Hands-on: you do the routing work yourself, day to day, not just direct others to do it. A strong communicator: equally at ease explaining a routing issue to Product or Marketing as debating a fix with a supplier's NOC team. Ownership without a script: you see a bottleneck and you fix it rather than wait to be asked. Genuinely commercial: you understand a dropped call or a bad route costs Talk360 real money and a real user's trust, not just an SLA breach. title: Senior Partner Solutions Engineer - EMEA
description: The Sr. Partner Solutions Engineer is a highly experienced technical lead responsible for driving the growth and technical enablement of our key partners (Telcos, Global Systems Integrators, Resellers and BPOs) across the Netherlands, Belgium and Luxembourg and Germany. This senior individual contributor role reports directly to the Vice President, Partner Solution Engineering. You will act as the primary technical point of contact, supporting partners in establishing and scaling their Contact Center as a Service (CCaaS) and Customer Experience Automation (CXA) practices built around the Talkdesk platform. title: Principal Engineer, Data Quality Platform
description: Institutional Fabric for the Digital Asset Market Founded in 2018, Talos provides institutional-grade trading technology for the global digital asset market, powering many of the major players in the crypto ecosystem. Our mission is clear: to advance the mass adoption of digital assets by seamlessly connecting institutions to the digital asset ecosystem. We are committed to building the most innovative and trusted platform in the world, supporting the entire trading lifecycle. At Talos, you’ll find an environment that champions kindness and respect, values diverse perspectives, and upholds inclusivity at every turn. We believe every member of our team brings invaluable insights and abilities that drive Talos forward. In our pursuit of excellence, we foster a culture of trust, integrity, collaboration, and mutual growth. We are a tight-knit yet globally distributed team of highly experienced engineers and business leaders, with hubs in New York, London, Singapore, and Cyprus. You’ll be part of a hybrid-friendly environment where your unique talents and insights will play a crucial role in building something extraordinary. Principal Engineer, Data Quality Platform You'll own data correctness across Talos. You'll lead the data quality engineering team, run BAU data operations, and own reference and security master data, along with the pipelines and platform that deliver it. Our goal: the data we return to clients is always correct, and we find defects before a client does. You'll join a small team with the mandate to work independently from product engineering and challenge it. Engineering teams make assumptions about how their systems behave. Your job is to test those assumptions and prove or disprove them with evidence. Responsibilities Lead AI-first data quality engineering Validate every client-facing endpoint continuously. The focus is our REST and WebSocket APIs. Cloud delivery (S3, Snowflake, Databricks) is also in scope. Assert correctness against independent sources of truth, across every environment and client entitlement. Cover streaming as well as request/response. For WebSocket, that means: sequencing and gap detection snapshot-to-increment consistency reconnect and replay correctness staleness of live subscriptions agreement between the streamed view and the REST view of the same state Use adaptive detection, not static thresholds. Learn baselines per endpoint and per market, and let them adjust as "normal" changes. Hand-set limits get noisy, go stale, and teach people to ignore alerts. Apply LLM and agentic tooling to generate checks from API specs and schemas, keep them current as the product changes, and triage alerts before a human sees them. Know when a deterministic rule, invariant or cross-source reconciliation is the better tool. Test resilience and load. Design load, performance and failure-mode tests. When you find a fault, raise it with the owning team with enough evidence for them to act. Drive it to resolution, then add a check that would have caught it earlier. Measure and publish endpoint and field coverage, time to detect, detected-before-client rate and false-positive rate. Run data governance Build and maintain a catalog of our data assets and APIs, covering lineage and downstream consumers. Maintain an understanding of assets, how they're used and what breaks when they change. Own data governance tooling such as OpenMetadata. Own reference and security master data Lead the build-out of the next-generation security master platform, then run it day to day: new listings, symbol mapping across venues, and increment and contract specs. Design processes for safe updates to security entries, with validation and rollback. Expand coverage across the firm Over time, extend data quality coverage beyond client APIs to: trade signals pre-trade analytics client post-trade analysis PMS analytics Qualifications A track record of leading data QA or data quality teams, preferably on market data or other high-throughput, real-time data. A deep understanding of streaming and API behaviour: throughput, WebSocket semantics, ordering, recovery and failure modes. Experience inventorying and testing a large API and data surface end to end. Hands-on experience with data governance: cataloging, lineage, ownership. Experience with performance and load testing of distributed systems. A strong engineering background. You design platforms, not scripts on a cron job, and you build on shared infrastructure rather than creating one-off tooling. Practical experience applying LLM and agentic tooling to engineering problems. Our stack: Flink, Doris, Dagster and Spark, plus OpenMetadata (or an equivalent such as Apache Atlas). Experience with comparable tools is just as relevant. Check out these videos and links to learn more about Talos and our culture! Spotlight Article: Talos Snapshot by DRW Podcast: 2023 episode with co-founders Anton & Ethan Website: Explore Talos: Products, Investors, Team & More Case Studies: Real world examples of client solutions Awards: Talos Wins Hedgeweek Global Digital Assets Award 2024 Culture: Award-winning, Forbes-listed, low-attrition team Andreessen Horowitz re: Talos: "The company best suited to drive institutional adoption is one that understands traditional capital markets deeply and is forward-thinking enough to fully grasp the promise of crypto. Talos is that company." Benefits You will also enjoy a comprehensive array of competitive benefits, regardless of your location, within our warm, welcoming, and ambitious company culture. Some of our benefits include: Retirement plan contributions Unlimited Vacation + a PTO bonus: Employees that take 15 days of vacation, with 5 days being consecutive, receive a $2000 USD bonus. title: Partner-Manager:in Lernprogramme
description: Worum es geht Mit Coachweave macht die Teachlume GmbH aus dem Wissen von Coaches, Trainer:innen und Berater:innen digitale Lernprogramme, die Menschen über Wochen begleiten. Produziert wird mit einer eigenen KI-Kette: Strukturvorschläge, Kurse, Bilder, Stimmen, Übersetzungen. Was die KI nicht kann: verstehen, was ein Coach wirklich braucht, beurteilen, ob ein Programm wirkt, und es so bauen, dass es sich trägt. Dafür suchen wir dich. Die Nachfrage wächst gerade schneller, als unser Gründer allein Gespräche führen kann. Was du machst Du führst Erstgespräche mit Coaches und findest heraus, was sie wirklich brauchen. Wenn es nicht passt, sagst du es freundlich. Du hältst die Pipeline in Bewegung: viele Partner parallel, jeder mit klarem nächsten Schritt. Du prüfst, was unsere KI aus Gesprächen und Material erstellt (Strukturvorschläge, PDFs, Kurse), gibst ihr präzises Feedback und gibst frei, wenn es gut ist. Du besprichst die Ergebnisse mit den Partnern und entwickelst die Programme mit ihnen weiter. Du denkst Programme wirtschaftlich: Preis, Einstieg, Abo, Upgrade, und was Lernende dranhält. Nach dem Start schaust du, was funktioniert, und machst daraus die nächste Staffel. Was du mitbringst Mehrere Jahre Erfahrung in Beratung oder Partner- und Kundenbetreuung mit eigener Verantwortung, gern in Coaching, Weiterbildung, EdTech oder SaaS. Du arbeitest strukturiert mit vielen Beteiligten gleichzeitig und lässt nichts liegen. Du rechnest gern nach, ob ein Modell trägt. Du weißt, wie Menschen lernen und dranbleiben; Erfahrung in L&D ist ein Plus, den Rest lernst du bei uns. Du erkennst, wenn ein Text oder Konzept nicht trägt, und kannst genau sagen, warum. Mit KI-Werkzeugen arbeitest du selbstverständlich. Deutsch verhandlungssicher, Englisch gut. Was wir bieten 70.000 bis 85.000 € brutto im Jahr in Vollzeit. Wenn du lieber vier Tage arbeitest, geht das auch, mit anteiligem Gehalt. 100 % remote, Wohnsitz in Deutschland. Keine Produktionsarbeit: Gespräche, Urteil, Programme. Direkte Zusammenarbeit mit dem Gründer und die Perspektive, den Partnerbereich zu verantworten. Find Jobs in Germany on Arbeitnow

From architecting and amplifying the reach of a private, global, multi-cloud IP network , to bringing hyperlocal edge technology right to your fingertips through intuitive APIs, we're shaping a new era of seamless interconnection between people, devices, and applications. We're driven by a desire to transform and modernize what's antiquated, automate the manual, and solve real-world problems through innovative connectivity solutions. As a testament to our success, we're proud to stand as a financially stable and profitable company. Our robust profitability allows us not only to invest in pioneering technologies but also to foster an environment of continuous learning and growth for our team. Our collective vision is a world where borderless connectivity fuels limitless innovation. By joining us, you can be part of laying the foundations for this interconnected future. We're currently seeking passionate individuals who are excited about the opportunity to contribute to an industry-shaping company while growing their own skills and careers. The Role You will own go-to-market for Telnyx's AI Compute products: inference, embeddings, AI Gateway and the GPU infrastructure beneath them. Telnyx runs inference on its own NVIDIA GPUs inside its private global network and ships new compute products and models every month. You'll turn that cadence into positioning, launches, public benchmarks and sales enablement that win ML platform teams and voice-AI builders, working day to day with product, engineering, sales and demand generation. This is a senior individual-contributor role with full ownership of a product line, on a marketing team that runs on code and agents rather than SaaS: you'll improve on PMM workflows and always look to automate parts of the job. What you'll own You'll own the full AI Compute line: inference (serverless and dedicated GPU), embeddings, AI Gateway and Decision Models. Your buyers are ML platform teams, inference buyers, and voice-AI builders choosing a speech stack. The story you'll tell is that performance is a function of the network and the hardware: Telnyx is carrier-native, runs on its own GPUs, and adds no cloud margin to every token. You'll prove that story through public latency and quality benchmarks, inference economics and TCO, and competitive campaigns against hosted-inference and speech providers. Success is measured by inference consumption, dedicated GPU contract value, and pipeline attributed to compute launches and campaigns. The opportunity Own positioning and messaging for every AI Compute product, from the model catalogue to dedicated GPU contracts, and keep it consistent across web, sales decks, docs and campaigns. Run launches end to end: tiering, launch brief , product update emails, web pages, enablement, and the post-launch read-out on activation and pipeline. Lead the benchmarking program as a marketing asset: decide which latency , quality and cost comparisons to publish, work with engineering on methodology , and turn results into pages, blogs and sales proof points. Build the inference economics story: T CO and savings calculators, pricing narrative versus hyperscalers and hosted-inference providers, and the competitive battlecards behind it. P artner with demand generation on compute campaigns (competitive, webinar series, paid) by owning the brief , the ICP , the offer and the conversion path. Design product-activation and ICP-based lifecycle email for compute users with sales, and hand the build to the G TM engineering team. Enable sales: battlecards, one-pagers, objection handling, sales labs and the pricing and competitor data AEs and BDRs rely on. Maintain the competitive map for inference and speech (hosted-inference providers, speech vendors, hyperscaler AI services) and feed it into roadmap conversations with product. Be the compute voice for analyst briefings, customer stories and press. What we are looking for Must have 5+ years in product marketing for developer-f acing infrastructure, with at least 2 years on AI/ML, cloud compute, GPU, or data platform products. W orks AI-first, not AI-assisted. Our marketing stack is agents rather than SaaS: you'll work with the teams shared agents day to day and continuously build and improve autonomous agents for reporting, campaign tracking, ICP research and content production. Can explain inference serving, GPU economics, latency and throughput trade-offs, and speech model quality to an ML engineer without a translator , and to a CFO in one slide. Has run launches for a f ast-shipping product line (monthly or f aster) and can show the launch system, not just the launches. Writes clearly and f ast: pages, briefs, battlecards and talk tracks are the daily output. Comfortable owning a number (consumption, pipeline, T CV) jointly with sales. Nice to have Experience marketing usage-based or consumption-priced products. Hands-on with an inference API, open-weight models or a speech API; can run a demo from the terminal. Background at a hosted-inference, speech, GPU cloud company , or marketing against them. Exposure to analyst relations (Gartner , Frost, G2) and customer-story programs is a plus. #LI-RH1 Find Jobs in United Kingdom on Arbeitnow

title: Director of Product Marketing
description: About Telnyx Telnyx is an industry leader that's not just imagining the future of global connectivity—we're building it. From architecting and amplifying the reach of a private, global, multi-cloud IP network , to bringing hyperlocal edge technology right to your fingertips through intuitive APIs, we're shaping a new era of seamless interconnection between people, devices, and applications. We're driven by a desire to transform and modernize what's antiquated, automate the manual, and solve real-world problems through innovative connectivity solutions. As a testament to our success, we're proud to stand as a financially stable and profitable company. Our robust profitability allows us not only to invest in pioneering technologies but also to foster an environment of continuous learning and growth for our team. Our collective vision is a world where borderless connectivity fuels limitless innovation. By joining us, you can be part of laying the foundations for this interconnected future. We're currently seeking passionate individuals who are excited about the opportunity to contribute to an industry-shaping company while growing their own skills and careers. The opportunity We're looking for a Director or VP of Product Marketing to lead that effort globally. This is a senior, hands-on role for someone who can connect deep technical understanding with positioning, distribution and commercial results. The title will reflect the experience and scope of the person we hire. A good product story matters, but a story alone isn't enough. The person in this role needs to turn our infrastructure into clear customer problems we solve, compelling reasons to choose Telnyx and practical ways to try it. A great sample application, integration or reference architecture can do more than another 30-slide deck. So can a precise message that reaches a developer at the moment they are deciding how to build. You'll work across Product, Engineering, Developer Relations, Sales and Marketing to bring those pieces together. You'll help shape what we launch, how we explain it, how buyers discover it and how our field teams take it to market. What you'll build A coherent product story. Own positioning, segmentation and competitive differentiation across AI inference, Voice AI, agent and edge infrastructure, communications, networking and wireless. Make the full platform understandable without flattening the technical details that make it valuable. Solutions people can actually use. Drive the packaging of sample apps, reference architectures, integrations, templates and working demos that prove what the infrastructure makes possible. Build repeatable plays for use cases such as contact centers, agent assist and industry-specific workflows. These should accelerate adoption and enterprise sales, not become disconnected software products. Distribution that reaches technical buyers. Shape how we win discovery through product pages, developer content, SEO, answer engine optimization (AEO), technical communities and paid acquisition. You won't necessarily operate every campaign, but you must understand the mechanics deeply enough to direct them: search and answer-engine visibility, technical site structure, intent, targeting, conversion paths, attribution and economics. A field-ready commercial engine. Give enterprise sellers, FDEs and solutions teams the pitches, discovery frameworks, architecture diagrams, competitive proof, demos and ROI narratives they need to generate and advance opportunities. Translate platform capabilities into buying reasons for developers, technical executives and enterprise decision-makers. Launches that translate into adoption. Work with Product and Engineering early, not after something ships. Choose the audience, packaging and launch strategy, then measure activation, qualified demand, field utilization and downstream pipeline. Build an operating cadence that keeps pace with a rapidly changing roadmap. An AI-native PMM team. Use AI research tools, coding assistants, agents and automation as part of everyday work to accelerate market research, competitive analysis, messaging tests, content production, demo development and go-to-market execution. Know when to trust those tools, how to evaluate outputs and where human technical judgment still matters. Lead the team to operate the same way. How we'll measure success The ultimate measure is pipeline. Not the number of launches, assets, impressions or campaigns. We expect this leader to partner closely with Demand Generation and Sales to create measurable, qualified pipeline, improve conversion and accelerate opportunities. Product marketing should be able to show how specific product narratives, solutions, integrations and programs contribute to commercial results. Early wins will look like a dramatically clearer platform story; a small number of flagship use cases with runnable demos and integrations; sellers using consistent, technically credible plays; stronger discovery and conversion from search, AEO and paid channels; and a repeatable link from product launches to adoption and pipeline. We care about what works and scales, not activity for its own sake. What we're looking for You've led product marketing for a complex B2B technical platform, ideally in AI infrastructure, developer tools, APIs, cloud, networking or communications. You can be strategic without becoming removed from the work. You are technically fluent. You can understand architecture, work with APIs or SDKs, interrogate a latency or cost claim and talk comfortably with engineers. You don't have to be a production engineer, but you need to know when a demo is real and when it's just a pitch. You understand modern technical acquisition. You're credible directing AEO, SEO, paid programs and developer-focused content, and can connect channel-level metrics to funnel economics and qualified pipeline. You're already effective with AI tools and agents in your own work. You experiment, build workflows and use the technology to move faster. Familiarity with the limitations and evaluation of AI-generated outputs is as important as enthusiasm for the tools. You write exceptionally well, have strong instincts for enterprise sales, and know how to turn a complex product advantage into a clear reason to buy. You've built or led strong teams, can prioritize across competing launches and products, and enjoy working directly with product leaders and technical builders. Telecom experience is not required. Technical curiosity, taste, speed and a track record of generating commercial impact matter more. Why Telnyx This is a chance to shape the market narrative for a company that owns the underlying network, communications and compute infrastructure it sells. The platform is real, customers are deploying it in production, and the commercial opportunity is substantial. You'll have direct access to senior leadership and the ability to build a PMM function measured by its contribution to growth. Equal opportunity Telnyx is an equal opportunity employer. We welcome applicants from different backgrounds and evaluate candidates based on the skills and experience relevant to the role. #LI-RH1 Find more English Speaking Jobs in France on Arbeitnow

title: Director, EMEA Sales Operations
description: About the Role We're looking for a Director of EMEA Sales Operations to be the dedicated GTM Operations partner for our EMEA region. This role sits at the centre of EMEA's go-to-market motion, spanning New Logo, Growth, and Commercial/hybrid motions across a fast-growing, multi-country region. You will partner directly with the VP of EMEA and the region's Account Executives, Business Development Reps, and Solutions Architects to deliver the insights, enablement, and processes that power territory design, quota allocation, pipeline and forecasting hygiene, and the region's operating cadence. Because EMEA spans many countries and time zones relative to global GTM Operations and Systems teams based in the US, this role requires someone who can operate with real autonomy, exercise judgment on what to escalate versus solve locally, and represent EMEA's specific needs (FSI and financial services-heavy Strategic accounts across UK/Ireland and DACH, multiple hybrid Commercial motions, territory splits across UK/Ireland, DACH, Nordics, and Southern Europe) back into Temporal's global GTM Operations function. We're building a GTM Operations function that is AI-native from the ground up. We expect this leader to bring demonstrated experience using AI tools to accelerate analysis, surface insights, and scale operational work—not as a future aspiration, but as a core part of how they work today. Responsibilities Serve as the dedicated Sales Operations partner for EMEA, supporting New Logo, Growth, and Commercial/hybrid motions across the region, and knowing when to solve locally versus escalate to global GTM Operations or Systems. Partner with the VP of EMEA and regional sales leadership to deliver actionable insights on net-new pipeline generation, account penetration, and territory design. Own pipeline visibility and forecasting hygiene across all EMEA motions, including large complex enterprise deals, consumption workload ramps, and Commercial/self-serve pipeline. Conduct white-space and TAM analysis to identify high-propensity targets across EMEA's markets, with particular attention to the region's concentration of financial services, banking, and fintech accounts. Identify process gaps across the region's hunting, growth, and hybrid motions, and partner with GTM Systems to scope and implement automation—including AI-assisted workflows that reduce manual effort and increase regional coverage. Analyse regional sales performance (win/loss, deal velocity, conversion, quota attainment) across segments, and translate findings into clear recommendations for the VP of EMEA and regional leaders; leverage AI tools to accelerate analysis and surface patterns at scale. Build and maintain Salesforce and Omni reporting and dashboards tailored to EMEA, supporting Strategic, Growth, and Commercial views (including CQA/Tiered account, SSU, and workload metrics specific to the region). Support the region's full operating cadence: forecasting calls, QBRs, pipeline reviews, and account planning sessions, often prepping leadership with regional metrics ahead of cross-timezone reviews. Drive annual and in-year planning for EMEA: capacity plans, territory carving and re-carving (including account transitions as reps' territories evolve), and quota allocation across New Logo, Growth, and Commercial. Evaluate new market entry and partner with regional GTM leadership on market expansion priorities, including coverage models and impacts to org design. Qualifications Experience in Sales Operations, Revenue Operations, or Field Operations supporting a B2B enterprise or strategic sales organization in technology or software. Proven track record supporting multiple sales motions at once: net-new logo hunting, growth/expansion within existing accounts, and self-serve or hybrid AE-assisted motions. Demonstrated AI-native working style: hands-on experience using AI tools (e.g., ChatGPT, Gemini, Notion AI, or purpose-built GTM AI tools) to accelerate analysis, automate repeatable ops tasks, generate insights from large datasets, and improve the speed and quality of decision-making. We are not looking for theoretical familiarity—we want to see how AI is embedded in how you work today. Deep experience across EMEA markets and fluency in the cultural and commercial similarities and differences across these markets. Hands-on experience with building equitable territories, account scoring, quota allocation, and capacity modelling across a multi-country region. Strong Salesforce expertise, including building scalable reports and dashboards across multiple sales motions and segments. Highly analytical, with the ability to turn data into clear, actionable insights for regional sales leadership; comfortable pairing SQL, BI tools, and AI assistants to move faster and go deeper. Strong cross-functional partner who can work effectively with regional sales and SA leadership, global GTM Operations, GTM Systems, and Marketing. Comfortable presenting insights and recommendations to senior regional and global leadership. Able to operate both strategically and tactically depending on business needs. Bonus: experience operating in a consumption-based business, with a strong understanding of how usage impacts forecasting, pipeline, and quota planning for newly acquired and expanding accounts. Bonus: experience evaluating or deploying AI-powered GTM tools (e.g., AI forecasting, account scoring, pipeline intelligence, or conversation intelligence platforms) and driving adoption across a regional sales team. title: Senior Umwelt- und Raumplaner (m/w/d)
description: Über uns Seit über 25 Jahren stehen wir von Terra Consulting GmbH für unabhängige und innovative Ingenieurdienstleistungen in den Bereichen Verkehr/Infrastruktur, Umwelt, Lagerstätten, Geotechnik, Flächenrecycling, Gebäudeschadstoffe und Altlasten für die Privatwirtschaft und für öffentliche Auftraggeber. Einen Schwerpunkt dabei bilden Projekte der Energiewende. An unseren Standorten in Dortmund und Bonn arbeiten wir mit über 30 Mitarbeitern. Unser Bonner Büro bietet ein breites Spektrum an umwelt- und naturschutzfachlichen Planungsleistungen an, u.a. die Analyse und Bewertung umweltrelevanter Eingriffe sowie die Erstellung von Anträgen und Fachgutachten. Unsere Überzeugungen spiegeln sich in unseren Leistungen wider. Wir legen großen Wert auf einen kooperativen Führungsstil, der auf gegenseitigem Respekt und ein offenes Ohr für neue Ideen basiert. Bei uns stehen die individuellen Fähigkeiten, Erfahrungen und Perspektiven unserer Mitarbeiter im Vordergrund – unabhängig von Geschlecht, Herkunft, Behinderung, Weltanschauung, sexueller Orientierung oder Alter. Als Team setzen wir auf ein faires und wertschätzendes Miteinander und offene Kommunikation untereinander, aber auch gegenüber unseren Kunden. Unsere Hauptauftraggeber sind neben den Lagerstättenbetreibern die Energieversorgungsunternehmen und die Straßen- und Eisenbahninfrastrukturunternehmen. Bei der Terra Consulting GmbH nimmst du aktiv an der Energiewende und dem Infrastrukturausbau teil. Wir schätzen unsere Traditionen, sind offen für Innovationen und entwickeln uns weiter. Möchtest du mitgestalten? Zur Stelle Welche Anlagenstandorte eignen sich für die Energieinfrastruktur von morgen? In unserem Projektteam mit fünf bis sechs Kollegen vergleichst du Alternativen und führst technische Anforderungen, Umweltbelange und raumplanerische Gesichtspunkte zu einer fundierten Bewertung zusammen. Damit schaffst du belastbare Grundlagen für Standortentscheidungen und wirkst an der Genehmigungsunterlage mit. Du übernimmst fachliche Projektaufgaben und entsprechend deiner Erfahrung eigene Teilbereiche. Erfahrene Teammitglieder begleiten deine Einarbeitung und stehen dir als Ansprechpartner zur Seite. Deine Aufgaben Du vergleichst und bewertest Standortalternativen eigenständig anhand fachlicher und rechtlicher Kriterien. Dabei identifizierst Du Konfliktlagen, bewertest Genehmigungshemmnisse und leitest belastbare Entscheidungsgrundlagen ab. Du analysierst und beurteilst komplexe Planungsunterlagen, Fachbeiträge und Geodaten und führst umweltfachliche, raumplanerische, technische und rechtliche Erkenntnisse zu einer konsistenten Gesamtbewertung zusammen. Du verfasst, strukturierst und prüfst anspruchsvolle Gutachtentexte. Deine Bewertungen, Abwägungen und Schlussfolgerungen begründest Du fachlich fundiert, präzise und nachvollziehbar. Du beurteilst die Belastbarkeit von Quellen, Daten und fachlichen Argumentationen und stellst sicher, dass Aussagen zwischen unterschiedlichen Fachbeiträgen und über mehrere Prüfebenen hinweg konsistent sind. Du identifizierst fachliche Widersprüche, methodische Schwächen und offene Fragestellungen, entwickelst Lösungsansätze und koordinierst erforderliche Klärungen mit internen und externen Projektbeteiligten. You will start with a small, senior team and grow it through technical depth, delivery excellence and thought leadership, rather than inheriting a large organisation. Job responsibilities Shaping and winning Agentic AI advisory and strategy: shape and solution complex German, Dutch and DACH pursuits with account, commercial and delivery leaders, translating client needs into differentiated propositions, credible architectures and executable delivery approaches that support regional pipeline conversion. Partner with product, data, software engineering, enterprise architecture, governance and change specialists to design end-to-end solutions that deliver measurable business outcomes. Anticipate technical, organisational and governance challenges in enterprise AI adoption and define practical approaches to address them. Build our German and Dutch market presence through local-language points of view, ecosystem and partner initiatives (hyperscalers, SAP, European model providers) and community events. title: Industrial Software Engineer - Railway Applications (m/w/d) 80-100%
description: About Traila At Traila, we are dedicated to shaping the future of rail transport through cutting-edge technology. Since our founding in 2017, we have been driven by a passion for sustainability and excellence. We believe that rail transport is a cornerstone of a greener future, and our mission is to make it quieter, more efficient, and more reliable. Our talented team is at the heart of this mission, and we are looking for an Industrial Software Engineer - Railway Applications to join us in developing robust software solutions that operate reliably in real-world railway environments. What you will do - Industrial Software Development: Design, implement and maintain robust application software for industrial and railway products using C++, C#, Python or comparable technologies. - Application & System Integration: Translate system and operational requirements into practical software functionality and integrate software with real hardware and physical systems. - Hardware & Device Interfaces: Integrate sensors, actuators, controllers, DAQ systems and other industrial devices. - Communication Protocols: Implement and troubleshoot interfaces such as CAN/CANopen, EtherCAT, TCP/IP and other industrial or vehicle communication protocols. - Controls & Application Logic: Implement state machines, operational logic, control functionality and system behaviour required by the application. - Commissioning & Field Support: Support installation, commissioning and field testing on prototypes, test systems and rail vehicles, including travel to customer and test sites when required. - Diagnostics & Troubleshooting: Analyse logs, interfaces and system behaviour to identify root causes and solve software and integration issues efficiently. - Testing & Validation: Develop unit, integration and system-level tests and contribute to HIL/SIL or other validation activities where relevant. - Software Architecture, Quality & Controlled Releases: Own software architecture and release discipline, including configuration and version control, code reviews, test evidence and controlled software releases. - Product Cybersecurity: Own threat assessment, secure access and software updates, vulnerability handling and lifecycle security maintenance; coordinate specialist security reviews and work with Systems/RAMS on vehicle interfaces and safety consequences. - Technical Guidance & Mentoring: Review implementations, share practical software-engineering practices and mentor colleagues to strengthen consistency, maintainability and technical ownership across the team. - Tools & Data: Develop tools for configuration, testing, diagnostics, data acquisition and analysis that support engineering and field activities. - Documentation & Continuous Improvement: Maintain clear software and interface documentation and improve existing code as Traila products mature from development into deployed systems. What you bring - Degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Automation, Mechatronics or a related discipline, or equivalent practical technical experience. - Hands-on professional software-development experience in an industrial, automation, automotive, machinery or comparable technical environment. - Proven professional railway software experience, including products released and maintained in service. - Strong practical programming skills in C++, C#, Python or a comparable industrial software stack; you do not need to be an expert in every language listed. - Experience developing software that interacts with real hardware, devices or physical systems. - Experience taking software beyond prototypes into tested, maintainable and deployable industrial use. - Practical railway software lifecycle experience aligned with EN 50716:2023, including requirements traceability, configuration management and verification/validation appropriate to the required software integrity level; relevant EN 50128 / EN 50657 predecessor experience is also valuable. - Practical embedded or industrial cybersecurity experience, including secure credentials and access, signed software updates and rollback, and handling vulnerabilities in released products. - Strong debugging and troubleshooting skills across software, communication and hardware interfaces. - Experience with Git and structured software-development workflows. - A practical ownership mindset: comfortable working directly with prototypes, test equipment and deployed systems and driving technical problems through to resolution. - Ability to work effectively across engineering disciplines and communicate technical issues clearly. - Fluent English; German is a strong advantage. Nice to have - Experience with industrial Linux, embedded Linux, automation or control systems. - MATLAB/Simulink, HIL/SIL testing, data acquisition or condition-monitoring experience. - Working knowledge of railway cybersecurity under CLC/TS 50701:2023 and of EN IEC 62443-4-1 (secure development) and EN IEC 62443-4-2 (component security) is desirable. - Familiarity with EN 50155 and EN 50126 for equipment integration and collaboration with Systems/RAMS. - Experience in a regulated or safety-relevant product-development environment. Benefits 25 days of annual leave, plus paid bridge days at Christmas. Flexible working hours and home office options. Annual professional development allowance for courses, certifications and conferences. Competitive compensation with milestone bonus scheme and full Swiss social coverage. A collaborative team culture with regular social and sports activities. Real autonomy and short decision-making paths. If you want your software engineering to have real-world impact in rail, we’d like to hear from you. Contact Yasi Samari, HR Responsible, by applying directly here. description: Since 2004, we’ve been bringing investment ideas to life and connecting capital with the right people and opportunities. Today, we manage more than £2.5 billion for a broad range of investors across five key investment strategies: Private Credit, Social Housing, Clean Heat, Energy and Venture. These strategies underpin the innovative range of investments we offer to both private (retail) and institutional clients. There are 230+ employees at Triple Point, all committed to leaving the world demonstrably better than we found it. That’s why we’re a certified B Corp, signed up to the Principles for Responsible Investment, and were named a Sunday Times 'Best Place to Work 2025 & 2026' . I f this sounds like an environment where you would flourish, then read on… The Function & Team Our purpose is to ensure that Triple Point operates in strict adherence to the rules and regulations established by the FCA. It’s our duty to diligently monitor industry standards and incorporate best practices throughout the organisation. A crucial part of our mission is to enhance awareness and understanding of the financial regulations that directly impact our business. By joining the GRC function, you will become part of a collaborative and professional team that plays an essential role in supporting the firm’s success. Your contributions will directly influence how the business protects the personal data entrusted to it, while providing you with broad exposure to the firm’s operations, systems and third-party relationships. This is an opportunity to strengthen Triple Point’s control environment and to play a meaningful role in sustaining the company’s long-term resilience and reputation. Key Responsibilities Purpose of the Role The Data Privacy Analyst will play a crucial part in ensuring Triple Point’s day-to-day business processes, structure and operations adhere to UK data protection frameworks, including the UK GDPR and the Data Protection Act 2018 (DPA 2018). Reporting to the Data Protection Officer (DPO), the role provides dedicated capacity for the GDPR enhancement programme, tracked against the ten pillars of the Group’s Accountability Tracker, and takes on a growing share of business-as-usual privacy activity. It works closely with Compliance, Digital & Technology, Legal, People and Client Operations. We are looking for someone with a positive attitude who embraces problem-solving and enjoys collaborating with teams across the business. Risk assessments: support the completion of Data Protection Impact Assessments (DPIAs) and Transfer Impact Assessments (TIAs). Data inventory and data governance: support the business to complete system and information data-flow mapping, including supporting Digital & Technology with the Information Asset Register. Records and retention: help develop and maintain the Record of Processing Activities (ROPA) and the Data Retention Schedule, providing guidance and support to senior personnel within the business. Rights and request resolution: help develop the subject access rights process and procedure, and handle data subject requests and related complaints in line with statutory obligations and timescales. Contracts and data sharing: support the review of contracts, including through the Vertice contract management system, to ensure compliance with the UK GDPR and to support the completion and maintenance of the ROPA. Incident support: assist in investigating potential personal data incidents, logging details and coordinating step-by-step documentation to support internal and external compliance. Documentation and delivery: produce high-quality documentation, process maps and records to evidence compliance improvements, ensuring all proposed actions are tracked to completion with clear audit trails and supporting artefacts. Reporting: help prepare progress updates and MI on the GDPR programme for the DPO, for onward reporting to the Risk & Controls Committee and ManCom. Experience Essential Proven direct experience in a dedicated data privacy, information security compliance or paralegal risk function. Solid and proven understanding and experience of the UK GDPR, the DPA 2018 and The Privacy and Electronic Communications (EC Directive) Regulations 2003 (PECR). Familiarity with data governance frameworks, privacy impact assessments and third-party data processor oversight. Excellent interpersonal, written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to explain legal and regulatory requirements to non-legal colleagues. High attention to detail, with strong documentation and analytical capabilities. Desirable Prior experience in banking, financial services or SaaS sectors (highly advantageous, though not essential). Awareness of the Data (Use and Access) Act 2025. Experience of, or familiarity with, IT infrastructure (such as cloud platforms, networks or data architecture) Personal Qualities A positive, can-do, commercial attitude with a solution-oriented approach to problems and challenges. Able to work independently and drive progress within tight timeframes. Adaptable to evolving priorities in a dynamic, multi-stakeholder environment. Strong commitment to professional standards, integrity, confidentiality and continuous improvement. Comfortable working under Risk and Compliance. Why Join us? You’ll join a talented, collaborative team in a connected environment where ideas and initiative are valued. Be part of a growing and innovative team We offer a competitive salary, a comprehensive benefits package, and genuine opportunities for growth and progression. Opportunities for professional development and career progression. At Triple Point, high performance means living our values every day: · Stay Curious. · Be Generous. · Take Thoughtful Action. · Pull Together. · Own It. title: Origination Director - Specialty Finance
description: Since 2004, we’ve been bringing investment ideas to life and connecting capital with the right people and opportunities. These strategies underpin the innovative range of investments we offer to both private (retail) and institutional clients. There are 230+ employees at Triple Point, all committed to leaving the world demonstrably better than we found it. That’s why we’re a certified B Corp, signed up to the Principles for Responsible Investment, and were named a Sunday Times 'Best Place to Work 2025 & 2026' . I f this sounds like an environment where you would flourish, then read on… The Function & Team Triple Point Specialty Finance provides revolving credit facility (RCF) warehouse funding to UK alternative lenders, supplying liquidity and capital to parts of the non-bank lending market that might otherwise be underserved. It's a fast-growing division within Triple Point Private Credit and is a strong opportunity for someone from a structured finance, capital markets or securitisation background, with a working knowledge of LMA documentation, to take genuine ownership of deals from origination through to Credit Committee and completion. Key Responsibilities& The Role As an Origination Director, you'll own a portfolio of asset-backed facility relationships end-to-end: sourcing and structuring new transactions, leading Credit Committee presentations, and managing your book through legal completion and beyond. You'll lead new transactions, represent Triple Point at industry events, and help broaden the introducer network that feeds the wider team's pipeline. Beyond your own deals, you'll be a visible market voice internally, and supporting colleagues on complex or strategic opportunities across the existing portfolio. The team is currently building out new capabilities, including Forward Flow, mezzanine and incubator strategies, so there is real scope to help shape where Specialty Finance goes next rather than simply execute what's already established. Transaction Delivery: Lead the end-to-end structuring and delivery of a minimum of three new money debt transactions a year, for both new and existing Triple Point borrowers, from origination through to legal completion. Credit Committee & Relationship Management: Present transactions to Credit Committee and manage relationships with the management teams of new and existing borrowers throughout the deal lifecycle. Origination & Market Profile: Build and maintain a network of borrowers and intermediaries; represent Triple Point at a minimum of four industry or sector events a year to build the Specialty Finance profile and broaden the introducer base. Portfolio & Risk Monitoring: Analyse borrower financials, loan portfolios and borrowing base information to identify, communicate and challenge early warning signs; ensure internal risk and portfolio reporting, including Aspire, is accurate and complete at all times. Market Knowledge & Internal Insight: Maintain current knowledge of the UK Specialty Finance and asset-backed finance markets, including products, competitors, pricing and opportunity, and share this with Credit, RST and Management to increase internal awareness of the sector. Supporting the Wider Team: Support on complex or strategic opportunities within the existing portfolio, and help mentor more junior colleagues (Associate Directors, Portfolio Managers) in deal skills and credit judgement. Experience Specialty Finance Experience: Extensive experience in lending and loan documentation across a bank or non-bank environment, including a minimum of 3 years in Specialty Finance or a related field such as structured finance, capital markets or securitisation, with a particular focus on asset-backed financing. Deal Leadership: Track record of leading transactions end-to-end, including preparing and presenting detailed credit applications for new money transactions, ideally from a front-office debt origination or structuring role. title: Senior Channel Sales Manager (w/m/d)
description: Über uns: Gute Entscheidungen entstehen selten von allein. Wir bauen die Software dafür. Mit Valsight verstehen Unternehmen, wie ihre Geschäftstreiber und Finanzzahlen zusammenhängen. Controlling und Fachbereiche planen auf einem gemeinsamen Werttreibermodell und sehen, was eine Annahme oder Maßnahme für Umsatz und Ergebnis bedeutet. Führende DAX-Konzerne und mittelständische Unternehmen setzen auf uns, darunter Siemens, Mercedes-Benz Group, Volkswagen und Commerzbank. Bei uns gibt es einen sicheren Rahmen und gleichzeitig Raum, Neues auszuprobieren. Wir arbeiten transparent und AI-first: Engineering und KI übernehmen, was sich automatisieren lässt, damit mehr Zeit für das bleibt, was Erfahrung braucht. Aus dem, was wir ausprobieren, lernen wir und werden jeden Tag ein Stück besser. Über die Stelle: Neukunden entstehen bei uns über Beziehungen: über Partner, die uns in ihre Projekte holen, und über Zielaccounts, die wir gezielt ansprechen. Den Partnerkanal baust du neu auf und ownst ihn komplett. Inbound und Outbound übernimmst du ab dem qualifizierten Lead beziehungsweise dem erkannten Signal. Die Systeme dahinter, von der Signalerkennung bis zur Kampagne, bauen wir mit dir und um dich herum. Bis zur Opportunity liegt der Lead bei dir, für den Abschluss übergibst du intern. Du organisierst deine Arbeit selbst und bist die Verbindung zwischen deinem Netzwerk und unseren Teams. Unseren Sales-Prozess entwickeln wir gerade weiter, und du gestaltest ihn mit. Die Stelle wird hybrid mit drei Bürotagen pro Woche in Berlin ausgeübt. Für Partnertermine und Events bringst du eine Reisebereitschaft von etwa 5 bis 10 Prozent mit. Deine Aufgaben: Du gewinnst Partner, vor allem Beratungen mit Schwerpunkt Finance, Controlling und Strategie, dazu Finance- und ERP-Beratungen, die schon dort sind, wo Planungsfragen entstehen. Dafür nutzt du dein bestehendes Netzwerk und erweiterst es gezielt. Für jede Partnerschaft legst du fest, was ihr gemeinsam anbietet, welche unserer Zielaccounts ihr zusammen angeht, wer was tut und wie ihr zusammenarbeitet. Daraus entwickelst du Partnerschaften, aus denen neue Kundenbeziehungen entstehen und betreust sie langfristig. Du erkennst früh, wo ein Partner Schulung oder Enablement braucht und steuerst die Umsetzung durch unsere Consultants. Auf Signale zu Branchen, Unternehmen und Personen, die wir automatisiert erzeugen, reagierst du mit dem passenden Format, etwa Roundtable, Webinar, Anruf oder Mail-Sequenz. Angebot und Tonalität legst du fest, Marketing und GTM Engineering bauen die Systeme dahinter. Du führst Intro Calls und Demos, beurteilst den Fit und übergibst Opportunities nach gemeinsam festgelegten Kriterien. Deine Rückmeldung zur Lead-Qualität fließt in die Kampagnen zurück. In einem Markt, der über Vertrauen funktioniert, findest du heraus, was bei Partnern und Leads wirkt. Welche Leads bei dir ankommen, steuerst du mit Marketing und GTM Engineering nach. Was du mitbringst: Du hast mehrere Jahre im Partner- oder Channel-Vertrieb von B2B-Software gearbeitet und Partnerkanäle selbst aufgebaut, idealerweise mit oder über Beratungen. Du bringst ein eigenes Netzwerk zu Beratungen und Partnern mit, das du direkt ansprechen kannst. Du baust Beziehungen, die tragen, auch wenn sie nicht sofort zu einem Deal führen. Gespräche mit CFOs und Controlling-Leitern sind dir vertraut. Nach einem ersten Austausch kannst du einschätzen, ob ein Lead zur Opportunity wird. Du nutzt KI täglich und kannst an Beispielen zeigen, wo sie dich schneller macht. Was automatisierte GTM-Systeme liefern, verstehst du und setzt es ein. Bauen musst du sie nicht. Auch bei mehreren Stakeholdern und parallelen Initiativen organisierst du dich selbst und behältst den Überblick. Du sprichst sehr gut Deutsch und verhandlungssicher Englisch. Ein Plus, kein Muss: Du hast schon Outreach-Kampagnen oder Roundtable-Formate konzipiert. Was wir dir bieten: Arbeite an relevanten Problemen: Unsere Software unterstützt Finance-Teams bei Siemens, Mercedes-Benz Group, Volkswagen, Commerzbank und weiteren Konzernen und Mittelständlern dabei, unter Unsicherheit bessere Entscheidungen zu treffen. Du vertreibst ein Produkt mit echtem Business Impact. Lerne schnell und arbeite AI-first: Wir nutzen AI als Teil unseres Arbeitsalltags für Recherche, Prototyping, Analyse, Kommunikation, Automatisierung und bessere Entscheidungen. Flexibles Arbeiten: Wir vertrauen dir, gute Arbeit zu leisten. Der Fokus liegt auf Ergebnissen, Zusammenarbeit und Verlässlichkeit. Dazu gehören hybrides Arbeiten, 30 Tage Urlaub und ein halber Urlaubstag als Geschenk zu deinem Geburtstag. Lernen & Entwicklung: SaaS und AI verändern sich rasant, und wir uns mit ihnen. Deshalb investieren wir in Lernen und persönliche Weiterentwicklung. Team & Austausch: Bei Valsight bekommst du Kontext, Vertrauen und Raum, Dinge voranzubringen. Wir arbeiten direkt und teamübergreifend zusammen und nutzen bewusst das Wissen aller. Weekly Shows, All-Hands mit Ask-Me-Anything und Team-Events machen genau das im Alltag sichtbar. Standort & Office: Unser Büro in Berlin-Kreuzberg ist gut angebunden und soll ein Ort sein, an den du gern kommst. Dafür sorgen wir mit Frühstück, Getränken und Snacks deiner Wahl, höhenverstellbaren Tischen und der Ausstattung, die du dir wünschst. Vierbeiner sind willkommen. Mobilität: Wir bieten JobRad-Leasing für dein Wunschrad. Ready to join? Wenn du dich in dieser Rolle siehst, melde dich gern. Wir freuen uns über jede ernstgemeinte Bewerbung, auch wenn du nicht jeden Punkt abhakst. Studien zeigen, dass sich vor allem Frauen erst bewerben, wenn sie 100 % der Anforderungen erfüllen. Bitte nicht. Lass uns gemeinsam herausfinden, ob wir zueinander passen. Für Fragen sind wir jederzeit für dich da! Hinweis zum Einsatz von KI im Bewerbungsprozess Wir nutzen auch im Bewerbungsprozess KI, zum Sichten von Bewerbungen und zum Strukturieren von Antworten. Das spart Zeit für das, worauf es ankommt: das Gespräch mit dir. Über deine Bewerbung entscheidet immer ein Mensch aus unserem Team. Fragen zur Datenverarbeitung? Schreib uns gern, wir antworten persönlich. Find Jobs in Germany on Arbeitnow

title: Studentstage
description: Kom stage lopen bij een van Nederlands toonaangevende kantoren in advocatuur en notariaat Ben jij een rechtenstudent in de laatste fase van je studie en wil je ervaren hoe het eraan toegaat bij een groeiend, ambitieus en vernieuwend fullservice kantoor? Maak kennis met ons en ontdek zelf wat het betekent om in een gedreven en hecht team te werken! Advocatuur Wil jij ontdekken wat de advocatuur jou te bieden heeft? Bij VBK kun je kiezen uit twee uitdagende stages van twee maanden: een brede stage of een focusstage. Brede stage: je werkt mee binnen twee verschillende praktijkgroepen, waarbij je de eerste maand bij de ene praktijkgroep meedraait en de tweede maand bij de andere. Je kunt daarnaast worden ingezet voor opdrachten van andere praktijkgroepen en je kunt ook aansluiten bij inhoudelijke overleggen, besprekingen en zittingen van andere praktijkgroepen. Zo ervaar je in korte tijd de veelzijdigheid van de advocatuur én ons kantoor. Op deze manier ontdek je welke rechtsgebieden jou het meest aanspreken, waar jouw passie ligt en hoe het is om multidisciplinair te werken. Focusstage: weet je al welke richting je op wilt? Kies dan voor een focusstage en beleef de dagelijkse praktijk van een specifieke praktijkgroep. Een mooie kans om je te specialiseren en uit te vinden hoe jouw toekomst eruit kan zien in jouw favoriete rechtsgebied. Let op: de stagemogelijkheden zijn afhankelijk van beschikbaarheid, dus geef je voorkeur aan bij je sollicitatie. Notariaat Kies je voor een stage binnen het notariaat? Dan ontdek je alles over de fascinerende wereld van corporate en commercial real estate. Je krijgt een goed beeld van de dagelijkse praktijk, werkt nauw samen met onze notarissen, kandidaat-notarissen en advocaten, en je ervaart de diversiteit van het notariële vakgebied. Klaar om jouw talenten te ontdekken, jezelf uit te dagen en te ontwikkelen? Zet dan jouw eerste stap op weg naar een veelbelovende carrière bij VBK. Wat bieden wij jou? Meewerken in echte zaken. Vanaf dag één krijg je een vaste begeleider die je wegwijs maakt in de vele facetten van ons vak. Je draait mee in lopende zaken, gaat mee naar zittingen en neemt deel aan cliëntbesprekingen. Daarnaast werk je inhoudelijk mee door notities, adviezen en processtukken op te stellen en doe je diepgaand jurisprudentie- en literatuuronderzoek. Jouw input telt! Vakkennis. Schuif aan bij de wekelijkse praktijkgroep-lunches, waar nieuwe zaken, jurisprudentie en literatuur worden besproken. Verder kun je deelnemen aan inhouse-cursussen, lezingen en pleitoefeningen van de Jonge Balie Midden-Nederland. Een unieke kans om jezelf te ontwikkelen en je kennis naar een hoger niveau te tillen. Plezier en netwerken. Naast hard werken is er volop ruimte voor ontspanning en plezier.
