Reporting to the Director of Brand & Communications, you will translate Yubo's brand strategy into an executable US marketing programme. You will lead integrated brand campaigns, own campaign and paid-media planning and management, and build and manage influencer capabilities. This is a hands-on, high-ownership role for someone who can move comfortably between strategic thinking and execution. You will challenge plans constructively, make recommendations grounded in insight and data, and work closely with Creative, PR, Product, UA, Data, Trust & Safety and Legal to deliver marketing that builds the brand and drives growth. The role will focus on the US first, with scope to contribute to expansion into new markets as Yubo's marketing activity grows. This is a freelance position on a 6-month contract, with a target start of Q4 2026. Your responsibilites Turn strategic priorities into impactful marketing activity Lead the development and execution of Yubo's priority brand campaigns in the US, from insight and strategy through briefing, delivery, optimisation and reporting. Translate Yubo's positioning, audience priorities and seasonal moments into cultural marketing activity that earns attention amongst Gen Z. Develop integrated channel plans across paid, earned and owned activity, working closely with PR and Creative to ensure every channel plays a clear role. Own campaign budget planning and day-to-day management, partnering closely with UA on paid-media strategy and optimisation. Explore new, less traditional ways for Yubo to reach and engage people, challenging default channel choices and designing approaches that make marketing work harder. Establish brand marketing operations and measurement Establish effective working rhythms across Brand, Creative, PR, Product, UA and Data, from briefing and approvals to reporting and learning. Work closely with Data and UA to analyse performance and make clear, evidence-based optimisation recommendations. Build clear measurement plans so every campaign, test and experiment informs future investment and potential expansion into new markets. Identify, recommend and deliver smaller tests and experiments that help Yubo learn quickly and improve future investment. Build influencer, social and community activity Build the plans, operating models and internal capability needed to deliver consistently strong influencer activity and integrate it into wider campaign plans. Manage influencer agency relationships, negotiating cost-effective partnership models that maximise impact and effectiveness. Who you are You are an experienced brand marketer with strong consumer instincts and a genuine interest in youth culture. You know how to turn a positioning and a business objective into a campaign people notice, and how to turn campaign results into smarter decisions next time. You are as comfortable building a strategic recommendation as you are writing a brief, reviewing creative, shaping a media plan, interrogating performance data or getting into the practical detail needed to make work happen. You don't wait for perfect information or a fully formed process; you create clarity, bring people together and move work forward. You will bring: A breadth of experience in brand and integrated marketing, ideally in a high-growth tech, consumer app, entertainment, lifestyle or youth-culture business. A track record of developing and delivering integrated campaigns across paid, owned and earned channels, working closely with cross-functional partners. An understanding of the US market and how 18–24-year-olds engage with brands, culture and social platforms. Experience owning campaign and paid-media planning and management, ideally in close partnership with performance marketing, creative and comms teams. Confidence analysing campaign performance and translating data into clear optimisation and investment recommendations. Experience working closely with creative teams to develop strong campaign platforms, briefs and work that is both strategically sharp and creatively ambitious. A curiosity for less traditional channels, partnerships and approaches, with the creativity to test new ways of reaching people and maximise earned attention above what we buy. A proactive, autonomous and highly collaborative working style. Within a month, you will Get up to speed on Yubo's brand, product, US market and audience. Meet your key stakeholders across Brand, Creative, PR, Product, UA and Data. Review current campaign activity, budgets and ways of working. Start shaping the US marketing calendar and briefs with the Director of Brand & Communications. Within 3 months, you will Be leading delivery of Yubo's US campaigns, with briefs, channel plans and budgets in place. Have established the operating model between Brand, UA, Creative, PR, Product and Data. Be building the campaign measurement framework. Have started shaping Yubo's influencer marketing approach, including early agency conversations. Within 6 months, you will Have delivered Yubo's priority US brand campaigns end to end, from strategy through reporting. Have embedded the cross-functional operating model and measurement framework. Have established influencer marketing at Yubo, with agency partnerships operating. Have delivered key tests and experiments, with recommendations to inform 2027 priorities. Join Yubo and help shape the future of Social Discovery while enjoying a culture that values flexibility, well-being, and impact. title: Lead Software Engineer
description: Building the intelligence behind Solskin Are you a driven person who wants to make buildings come alive? We are Zurich Soft Robotics (ZSR), a Zurich-based startup developing Solskin – a climate-adaptive solar facade. Solskin is not just a PV system or a shading system; it’s an intelligent skin that uses weather and building data, occupant feedback, and AI algorithms to decide how the facade moves, so buildings stay comfortable, avoid overheating, and use energy as efficiently as possible. Solskin is already running on several buildings across Switzerland, with many more to follow. In this role, you own the software that makes that happen. You write the code that runs Solskin, keep it reliable in the field, and constantly improve it. You will also architect and lead our future sensor-to-data platform. Your focus is where software meets hardware, and the control and AI on top of it. You don't need to be a front-end specialist. What you will do This is a hands-on leadership position: you code every day. Own the full stack: You maintain and develop the whole software stack, from cloud and data management to user-facing applications, and from low-level embedded firmware to high-level AI controllers learning from users. You keep it reliable and keep making it better. Be the link between the teams: You build the software that runs on real buildings and support the hardware team. You also build the internal tools used by sales and the business team. Lead what comes next : With the CEO and CTO, you set the software direction and lead development of future products. Our stack: Backend: Python, FastAPI, PyTorch Frontend: React, TypeScript Hardware: C/C++, STM32 microcontrollers, Beckhoff PLCs Database: PostgreSQL (TimescaleDB) DevOps & Cloud: Linux, Docker, AWS, Grafana What we are looking for Required: Education : MSc or PhD in Computer Science, Robotics, Electrical or Mechanical Engineering, or similar. Python : This is a must. You write clean Python that runs in production, on real systems. Embedded & Hardware: Shipped C/C++ on microcontrollers running on physical hardware; comfortable working with sensors, actuators, and basic electronics. Applied AI & Control: Understanding of modern control and ML/RL methods, with hands-on PyTorch experience applied to physical or dynamic systems. Cloud & data : You are comfortable with PostgreSQL, Docker and AWS. Leadership attitude : You take ownership, make decisions, and want to grow as a leader. Languages : English. German is a big plus. Hybrid setting : You will be expected to be on-site at least three days per week, and sometimes at customers’ locations, to work on real products. Availability : 100%, as soon as possible. Work-permit: You need the right to work in Switzerland for this position. Preferred: Startup experience: You have worked in a startup before and know what that means. Building modeling and control: You have prior experience handling building data, modeling building dynamics, and developing building controllers; ideally with ML and RL tools. Frontend: React and TypeScript. Mindset: Hands-on: You lead, and you still do the hard work yourself. Fast: You are pragmatic and iterate quickly. Things break, and plans change, and that doesn't scare you. Purpose: You care about climate and want to make buildings smarter. Benefits Impact: Your code runs on real buildings. You see the result of your work. Ownership: A key role with a real say in our product and technology, and room to grow with the company. Flexibility: Hybrid work and flexible hours. We like being in the Zurich office together, so plan for regular office days. Team: A small, skilled, and down-to-earth team that helps each other out. The reality: We are a startup. It is often messy; things rarely work the first time, and the workload is real. In return, you get a lot of freedom and responsibility from day one. Sounds like you? Send us your CV and a short document instead of a classic cover letter. It doesn’t need to be long, just enough for us to understand who you are and where you stand. Please cover these points: About you: A short description of yourself. Proud of: One thing you are really proud of, in a few sentences. Startup: Why do you fit a startup? Software meets hardware: Your experience where software and hardware come together. Juggeling many hats: You’ll rarely finish one thing from A to Z without interruptions: different stacks, different people, different projects, and on-site surprises. Describe a time your work was like that, and how you handled it. Find more English Speaking Jobs in Switzerland on Arbeitnow

title: Social Media Manager (m/w/d)
description: Die ÖDP Bayern sucht idealerweise ab Dezember 2026 einen Social Media Manager (m/w/d) für 15 Stunden pro Woche. Die Stelle ist zunächst auf zwei Jahre befristet. Bei uns geht es um Themen, die Bayern direkt betreffen: Natur und Umwelt, sauberes Wasser, Artenvielfalt, direkte Demokratie, Gemeinwohl und politische Unabhängigkeit. Und wir reden nicht nur über politische Veränderungen. Mit Volksbegehren bringen wir sie selbst auf den Weg. Die ÖDP hat „Rettet die Bienen“ initiiert, das mit rund 1,7 Millionen Unterstützerinnen und Unterstützern zum erfolgreichsten Volksbegehren in der Geschichte Bayerns wurde. Auch beim konsequenten Nichtraucherschutz und bei der Abschaffung des Bayerischen Senats spielte die ÖDP als Initiatorin von Volksbegehren eine zentrale Rolle. Aktuell läuft mit „Macht auf Zeit“ das nächste Volksbegehren zur Begrenzung der Amtszeit des bayerischen Ministerpräsidenten auf zehn Jahre. Das bedeutet für Deinen Job: starke Themen, echte Kampagnen, politische Debatten und jede Menge Stoff für guten Content. Was Du bei uns machst Du arbeitest remote oder in der Landesgeschäftsstelle in Passau und kannst bei wichtigen Terminen, Drehs und Aktionen in Bayern vor Ort sein. Du entwickelst und produzierst Content für unsere Social-Media-Kanäle, insbesondere Instagram und TikTok. Du drehst und schneidest Videos, entwickelst neue Formate und bereitest politische Themen so auf, dass sie verständlich, relevant und interessant werden. Du erkennst, welche Themen und Geschichten Potenzial haben, reagierst auf aktuelle Debatten und entwickelst gemeinsam mit unserem Presse- und Kommunikationsteam Redaktionspläne und Kampagnen. Du betreust unsere Community, analysierst Reichweiten und Formate und nutzt die Ergebnisse, um unsere Kommunikation kontinuierlich weiterzuentwickeln. Und Du bekommst Gestaltungsspielraum: Wir suchen niemanden, der einfach nur Posts abarbeitet. Wir suchen jemanden, der Ideen entwickelt, Dinge ausprobiert und unsere Social-Media-Arbeit gemeinsam mit uns weiter aufbaut. Wen wir suchen Ein bestimmter Studienabschluss ist uns weniger wichtig als das, was Du kannst. Berufserfahrung, eigene Social-Media-Projekte, journalistische Arbeit, Agenturerfahrung oder ein überzeugendes Portfolio sind ausdrücklich willkommen. Du bewegst Dich sicher auf Instagram, TikTok und anderen relevanten Plattformen. Du kannst guten Content nicht nur erkennen, sondern selbst produzieren. Videoaufnahme und Videoschnitt gehören für Dich dazu. Du hast ein gutes Gespür für Sprache, Bilder, politische Themen und dafür, was Menschen im Feed tatsächlich interessiert. Du arbeitest eigenständig, zuverlässig und pragmatisch und kannst auch mit begrenzten Ressourcen gute Ideen umsetzen. Du interessierst Dich für Politik und kannst Dich mit den grundlegenden Zielen der ÖDP identifizieren. Was wir bieten 15 Stunden pro Woche, zunächst befristet auf zwei Jahre. Freie Zeiteinteilung und eine Aufgabe, die sich gut mit Studium, Familie, Selbstständigkeit oder einer weiteren beruflichen Tätigkeit verbinden lässt. Ein kleines Team, kurze Wege und viel Eigenverantwortung. Bei uns arbeitest Du nicht in einer großen Parteienbürokratie. Wir entwickeln Ideen, probieren Dinge aus und bringen politische Themen gemeinsam auf die Straße, in die sozialen Medien und in die Öffentlichkeit. 30 Tage Urlaub auf Basis einer Fünf-Tage-Woche. title: AI Senior Engineer (Vision)

What you’ll be doing We are seeking someone who enjoys working at the cutting edge where Computer Vision meets Logic . You will be responsible for the "eyes" and the "brain" of our system—extracting complex data from visual documents and then orchestrating how that data is used by Large Language Models. In short, someone who likes: Unlocking Visual Data: Building pipelines that can "read" complex documents, understanding layout, charts, and visual context using Vision-Language Models (GPT-4V, Claude 3.5) and Layout Analysis . Orchestrating Intelligence: Owning the application logic layer. You will use LangChain or LangGraph to build the agents and chains that query our data, reason about it, and generate responses. Native PDF Handling: Handling the messy reality of PDF processing (PyMuPDF, layout parsing) to preserve structure before the AI even sees it. Prompt Engineering & Logic: Crafting complex prompts and control flows to ensure models interpret financial charts and layouts accurately without hallucinating. Cost & Scale: Applying a cost-optimization mindset (batch processing, model selection) to ensure our vision and orchestration layers are economically viable. With the ones that are open about their shortcomings and what they do not know now, but remain eager to keep on growing and closing those gaps. Ideally, they would also have: LLM Orchestration (Must Have ): Deep experience with LangChain, LangGraph, or similar frameworks. You know how to manage context windows, tool calling, and agentic workflows. Multimodal AI Experience: Hands-on experience integrating state-of-the-art vision models (GPT-4V, Claude 3.5 Sonnet) and embedding models (CLIP). Document Intelligence Specialist: Familiarity with specialized models (e.g., Donut, Pix2Struct) and tools like Unstructured.io or Docling. PDF Processing Mastery: Mastery over tools like PyMuPDF or pdfplumber for native element extraction. Python ML Stack: Strong proficiency in PyTorch or TensorFlow. Nice-to-Have: Fine-Tuning: Experience fine-tuning vision or language models, specifically to improve accuracy on domain-specific artifacts like financial charts or tables. Domain Knowledge: Prior experience handling documents in the Real Estate or Finance sectors. Able is powered by curious, thoughtful people who care about what they build and how they build it. We’re actively investing in our team through AI training, knowledge-sharing, and hands-on experimentation to ensure everyone grows alongside the technology. This position is 100% remote within LatAm. Strong verbal and written communication skills in English are a requirement. As a team member, you can expect: To work 40 hours per week, and be available during normal business hours as needed. Payments made in USD. 18 days of PTO per year, observance of local holidays, and an annual break between Christmas and New Years. Wellness + Remote Stipend AI Voucher About Able Able builds technology products in a portfolio model. We believe that people, teams, and processes are more important than the ideas themselves, so we’ve focused on bringing great people together, and investing in their growth. We’ve built products in a variety of industries. Everything from media to finance to toys to healthcare. Sometimes we work with management teams to help their businesses grow faster or unlock value using technology. Other times we start or buy businesses outright. Each time, we look for opportunities to leverage technology built at the portfolio-level to drive value faster. Able is committed to inclusion and diversity and is an equal-opportunity employer. title: Lead Solutions Engineer
description: Job Description - Lead Solutions Engineer The Lead Solutions Engineer is a technical expert and trusted advisor driving Acquia’s growth across the Japan market. Operating at the intersection of business strategy and technical architecture, this role is primarily focused on winning new-logo business, while also driving cross-sell and expansion across the Acquia Digital Experience Platform (DXP) portfolio. Working hand-in-hand with Account Executives and, critically, Acquia’s partner ecosystem — through which nearly all new business in Japan is sourced — the Lead Solutions Engineer turns customer challenges into compelling solutions that deliver demonstrable business value and substantial revenue growth. Key Responsibilities Strategic Account Growth & Cross-Sell New Logo Acquisition: Be the technical lead partnering with Account Executives and channel / SI partners to identify, qualify, and win new-logo opportunities across Japan — the primary focus of the role. Cross-Sell & Expansion: Identify and accelerate cross-sell and expansion opportunities within strategic accounts where Solutions Engineering support adds value, mapping Acquia’s DXP portfolio to each client’s future-state digital roadmap. Business Value Alignment: Drive a value-based approach by translating solutions into clear, quantifiable business outcomes and return on investment for both technical and business stakeholders. Trusted Technical Advisor: Serve as the technical contact for client stakeholders, providing guidance on digital strategy, cloud adoption, and DXP trends across their technical and business teams. Solutions Architecture & Governance Technical Discovery: Lead the technical discovery, design, and presentation of DXP solutions tailored to each customer’s context and business priorities. Custom Proofs: Design and execute impactful custom demonstrations and Proof-of-Concepts (PoCs) that clearly illustrate the business value of the Acquia platform. Competitive Positioning: Position Acquia against key competitors through strong discovery and a clear point of view on fit, reinforcing Acquia’s unique value. Partner Enablement & Market Presence Partner Enablement: Enable partners at the pre-sales layer — coaching their teams to position and present Acquia products confidently in their own pitches, both one-to-one and at events. Market Presence: Represent Acquia at industry events, webinars, and community gatherings, proactively creating opportunities and visibility across the Japan market. Product Feedback Loop: Serve as a feedback loop to Acquia’s Product and Engineering teams, synthesizing insights from the Japan market to help shape positioning and priorities. Skills and Qualifications Required Experience: Proven experience in a Solutions Engineering, Sales Engineering, or pre-sales role, or a strong, deeply technical Account Executive ready to operate in a Solutions Engineering capacity. What matters most is the ability to understand a customer’s business and translate it into the right solution. DXP Expertise: Experience selling or pre-selling an enterprise CMS / DXP, or a comparable SaaS platform — vendor-agnostic. Strong understanding of CMS, personalization, and modern digital experience concepts (Drupal a plus, not a requirement). Technical Foundation: Solid working knowledge of modern web architectures and how DXP / web applications are deployed on a major public cloud (AWS, Azure, or GCP), including APIs and security fundamentals. Partner & Channel: Proven ability to work with and through partners / channel to source and win business — central to this role, as nearly all new-logo ACV in Japan is partner-sourced. Communication: Strong presentation and demonstration skills, with the ability to lead both the technical and the business conversation with customers and partners. Language: Native-level Japanese and business-level English — leading customer and partner discussions in Japanese (including written RFP / PoC work) and collaborating with a UK / EMEA-based team in English. Ways of Working: A self-starter who works with autonomy as the dedicated Solutions Engineering presence for the region, acting on sound judgment while maintaining strong visibility with manager and team, and with a genuine appetite for continuous learning. Desired (Extra Credit) Proven track record of success working within a named global or strategic account program. Experience with a major programming language and hands-on ability to build technical prototypes. Published articles, white papers, or presentation experience at major industry conferences. Acquia DNA & Culture This is a remote, Japan-focused role for a self-starter who thrives on high-impact work and enjoys operating with autonomy. The ability to work across time zones with a collaborative, virtual team is essential. Occasional travel within Japan to engage customers and partners is expected; coverage beyond Japan is possible as an upside but is not a requirement.

title: Director of Product Marketing
description: AI is fundamentally changing how product strategy and market strategy work together. The boundary between building the right product and bringing it to market the right way is disappearing — and the companies that recognize this will build product marketing functions that operate as strategic growth engines, not service organizations. ActiveCampaign ’s Active Intelligence platform — autonomous AI agents serving 180,000+ growing businesses — is redefining how marketing works. We need a Director of Product Marketing who shapes how the market understands it through bold storytelling, drives adoption that compounds, and transforms the PMM discipline in the process. This role reports to the SVP of Product. Product and Product Marketing operate as a single strategic arm — you’ll have the same context as the people building the product and the same accountability for what happens when it meets the market. This is a player-coach role: you lead a team, but you also personally create — strategies, narratives, content, programs. AI makes that possible at a level it never was before, and we expect our leaders to use it. Why This Role Matters: The way companies build, market, and grow products is being reshaped by AI. Product Marketing must evolve from a support function into a strategic operating system for customer understanding, market differentiation, and intelligent go-to-market execution. At ActiveCampaign, we’re building that now. This role is at the center of it. On a typical day, you might: Market Narrative & Positioning: Define and evolve positioning that clearly articulates why Active Intelligence represents a fundamentally new way for businesses to run their marketing — and why that matters now. Translate complex AI capabilities into clear, compelling customer value that resonates across segments. Bring conviction to the narrative — if the story isn't bold enough, make it bolder. We want a PMM leader whose point of view strengthens every room they're in. Adoption & Customer Outcomes: Lead go-to-market strategies measured by adoption and continued usage, not launch ceremony. Your success is customers who build their business on Active Intelligence. Own the market-side of the customer lifecycle — the narrative that moves someone from “I tried it” to “I can’t turn this off.” Partner with Product to build both sides of that engine. Run experimentation-driven programs: every initiative has a hypothesis, a signal, and a learning cycle. We move in weekly learning cycles, not quarterly planning windows. AI-First Execution: Automate traditional launch mechanics — release notes, enablement decks, internal comms. Your team operates above the automation line. Leverage AI to transform how the PMM craft works, not just what it produces. Speed, experimentation, and operational scale improve by default. Sales, Partner & Revenue Enablement: Arm Sales, CS, and our partner ecosystem with positioning, proof points, and talk tracks that improve conversations and conversion. Establish feedback loops between GTM teams and Product — friction points and market opportunities flow back into product decisions. Evangelism & Market Authority: Build the market presence that makes ActiveCampaign the reference point for autonomous marketing — thought leadership, proof points, and narrative formats that establish our position. Team Leadership: Lead a PMM team of outcome owners who own strategic priorities the way PMs own product areas — with backlogs, experiments, and shipped impact. Set the standard by doing the work yourself, not just directing it. The best PMM leaders we’ve seen create alongside their teams — AI makes that leverage real. Build a culture of accountability, ownership, and urgency. Create clarity in ambiguity and drive alignment through influence and results. Invest in your people's growth as seriously as the work itself — create conditions where they do the best work of their careers in service to their individual and collective success. The ideal candidate will bring: Required: 8+ years of hands-on experience in Product Marketing, Growth, or Product Strategy in B2B SaaS or AI-driven technology companies. 3+ years of proven leadership experience leading PMM teams — experience building or transforming a function, not just running one. A product-strategy mindset: you think about market impact the way great PMs think about product-market fit. A proven track record driving adoption and retention outcomes, not just launch metrics. Proven ability to influence across Product, Sales, Marketing, and Customer Success. Highly Valued: Prior experience with AI-native products , marketing automation, or platform products serving SMB/mid-market Experience building experimentation-driven marketing functions. Deep customer empathy paired with analytical rigor. A mindset that thinks beyond launches — you understand how product marketing drives company growth. A desire to erase the artificial boundary between product and marketing. An AI-native approach in how you think, work, and lead — not just AI-curious. A bias for action and execution: you’d rather build the positioning doc yourself than wait for someone to draft it. Leading a team doesn’t mean you stop creating. The ability to build trust through clarity, accountability, and results. You care about outcomes, not organizational theater. A passion for transformation rather than maintenance. What Success Looks Like: Within 3–6 months, you will have: Established Product Marketing as a strategic growth function trusted by Product, GTM, and leadership. Driven measurable improvement in product adoption, continued usage, and customer expansion. Sharpened market and product positioning to the point where customers deeply understand the step-change innovation we’re delivering and how it transforms their business. Built a modern PMM operating model — a team of leaders fully leveraging AI in everything they do, oriented around measurable business outcomes. One more thing Please review the prompt below and come prepared to discuss it during the interview: Tell us about a time you drove product adoption through experimentation rather than a traditional launch playbook. What was the hypothesis? What did you learn? What would you do differently? We value this response highly — it tells us more about how you think than any resume line. Compensation Compensation details listed in this posting reflect the base rate only and do not include bonus, equity, sales incentives or other role specific compensation that the role may be eligible for. ActiveCampaign believes in and is committed to equitable compensation practices. The salary range provided above is a good faith estimate of the pay range determined by the location associated with the job posting. The actual salary depends on a candidate’s skills, experience, and work location. Additional Information About ActiveCampaign: ActiveCampaign is the autonomous marketing platform for people at the heart of the action. It empowers teams to automate their campaigns with AI agents that imagine, activate, and validate–freeing them from step-by-step workflows and unlocking limitless ways to orchestrate their marketing. With AI, goal-based automation, and 1,000+ app integrations, agencies, marketers, and owners can build cross-channel campaigns in minutes–fine-tuned with billions of data points to drive real results for their unique business. ActiveCampaign is the trusted choice to help businesses unlock a new world of boundless opportunities–where ideas become impact and potential turns into real results. As a global multicultural company, we are proud of our inclusive culture which embraces diverse voices, backgrounds, and perspectives. We don’t just celebrate our differences, we believe our diversity is what empowers our innovation and success. You can find out more about our DEI initiatives here . title: Compliance Manager (Australia)
description: Affirm is reinventing credit to make it more honest and friendly, giving consumers the flexibility to buy now and pay later without any hidden fees or compounding interest. Affirm’s International Compliance team designs and implements compliance programs that proactively address regulatory requirements while identifying and mitigating compliance risks. As a second line of defence function, Compliance partners closely with the business to support new products, markets, and strategic initiatives while strengthening controls and delivering strong consumer outcomes. As Regulatory Compliance Manager, Australia, you will lead the Australian regulatory compliance program. You will translate global compliance strategy into local execution, ensure applicable Australian regulatory and licensing obligations are met, and support responsible growth and strong consumer outcomes. What You’ll Do Australian Regulatory Program Ownership Own and oversee the Australian regulatory compliance framework for consumer credit and related financial services, including the National Consumer Credit Protection Act, National Credit Code, Privacy Act,, applicable licence conditions, and associated regulatory guidance. Maintain documented compliance arrangements that support Australian credit licence obligations and keep pace with regulatory change, including the rules applying to buy now pay later (low cost credit contracts) and consumer credit. Lead ASIC examinations, inquiries, information requests, licence interactions, and other supervisory engagement. Oversee timely and accurate regulatory notifications and reporting, including reportable situations, internal dispute resolution data, licence updates, and other applicable filings. Risk Management & Controls Maintain the Australian regulatory obligations register and compliance risk assessment process, with clear ownership, controls, monitoring, and evidence. Work closely with the Product Design team to ensure that messaging is integrated into product design and user experiences seamlessly. Hands-on experience writing for email, web, and in-product messaging, with a solid understanding of best practices for each medium. Proven ability to collaborate effectively with cross-functional partners, including designers, product managers, and engineers, to create user-centric solutions. Familiarity with UX writing principles and best practices, ensuring content enhances usability and user experience. A self-starter mentality, capable of managing multiple projects simultaneously, meeting deadlines, and adapting to shifting priorities in a fast-paced environment. Attention to detail with a strong commitment to clarity, scalability, and consistency across all written content. Experience with legal and compliance review processes, ensuring that all content meets necessary regulatory standards. title: Marketing Manager, Brazil
description: About Ahrefs Ahrefs is an all-in-one marketing intelligence platform used by marketers, businesses and agencies around the world. Our tools help people understand search demand, analyse competitors, improve website performance and research content opportunities, backed by 15 years of web crawling data and increasingly powered by AI. We’re bootstrapped and profitable, and we have been for 15 years. There are no investors and no board, which means no outside timeline on our decisions. We’re multinational, with offices in Palo Alto, Cambridge (MA), Singapore and Tokyo, and our culture is fast-moving, low-ego, and built on smart decisions and ownership. The role We’re looking for a Marketing Manager to drive Ahrefs’ growth in Brazil. This isn’t about translating global campaigns: it’s about building and executing a local marketing strategy that resonates with Brazilian marketers and businesses. You’ll bring a track record of helping SaaS companies expand in Brazil, a strong understanding of SEO and AEO, and the ability to turn market knowledge into measurable growth. You’ll start as a one-person local marketing team, working closely with our global marketing team. This role is remote and based in Brazil. What you’ll do Own Ahrefs’ marketing in Brazil, taking a hands-on approach across the marketing mix. Develop and execute marketing strategies that drive brand awareness, qualified leads and customer acquisition. Create and localise content for Brazilian audiences: blog posts, social media, email campaigns, landing pages and other digital assets. Manage local marketing activities, including content, events, partnerships, community engagement and public relations. Educate the Brazilian market on SEO, AEO and AI search, positioning Ahrefs as a trusted resource. Build relationships with Brazilian marketers, agencies, creators, industry experts and relevant communities. Organise and take part in conferences, networking events and customer meetups to build relationships and generate demand. Analyse market trends, competitor activity and customer insights to identify opportunities and improve performance. Report results, learnings and priorities to senior leadership, connecting marketing activity to business growth. What you’ll need Significant hands-on experience in SaaS marketing, with ownership of market growth and clear, measurable results. A track record of SaaS expansion in Brazil. You can show which companies you helped grow, what you personally owned, and the results in customer acquisition, revenue or other meaningful business metrics. Experience bringing a global SaaS brand into Brazil is particularly relevant. Strong practical knowledge of SEO and AEO, including how brands build visibility across search engines and AI-powered answer platforms. Good working knowledge of Ahrefs, and how its products serve marketers and businesses in Brazil. A deep understanding of the Brazilian marketing landscape, customer behaviour, and local channels and communities. Strong content creation and digital marketing skills, with experience adapting English-language content and creating original campaigns for Brazilian audiences. The ability to identify quick wins in your first few months, build on what works, and develop a longer-term strategy while operating as a one-person local team. Strong communication and relationship-building skills, working effectively across teams. Native-level Brazilian Portuguese and fluent English, written and spoken. Spanish is a plus. What success looks like In 6 months: you’ve launched a focused marketing strategy for Brazil, with measurable improvements in relevant traffic, engagement and qualified demand. You’re active in at least two relevant local communities, you’ve established relationships with potential partners and creators, and you can show which early initiatives are contributing to customer acquisition. In 1 year: Ahrefs has a recognised presence in the Brazilian marketing community. Your content, partnerships and community initiatives are contributing to measurable growth in customers and revenue. You’ve identified repeatable ways to acquire customers, built a plan for further expansion, and established whether growing a small local team is justified. Why Ahrefs We believe in empowering smart people to make big decisions. As our Marketing Manager for Brazil you won’t be managing a rigid process, you’ll be building a market. We don’t micromanage. We trust you to identify opportunities, move quickly and deliver results, working with a product that helps marketers do their jobs better. Ahrefs does not engage with agencies or third-party recruitment providers for the roles we hire for. If we need help, we’ll let you know. Location: Brazil. Remote. Ahrefs does not engage with agencies or third party recruitment solutions for the roles we hire for. If at any point we need help, we'll let you know!

title: Infrastructure Engineer
description: This role is open for LATAM based candidates About us: Airtm is a financial-infrastructure company building the future of the online-work economy. We are on a mission to empower the world's growing number of Digital Entrepreneurs in the Global South, giving them the financial freedom to thrive. The problem is clear: in emerging markets, accessing the dollar economy is difficult. Cross-border payments are slow, expensive, and often lose value to inflation. This limits the potential of millions of talented individuals. Airtm’s solution is a swift and comprehensive financial platform that facilitates low-value cross-border payments and local cash-outs. As pioneers in stablecoin-payment infrastructure, Airtm has built the most advanced cross-border payment system available on the market. As a company married to the world of online work, Airtm will go beyond payments to build the necessary infrastructure the online-work economy needs to thrive. We are fostering an entirely new economy, giving individuals, communities, and countries the tools to take control of their financial destinies. About the Role We're looking for an Infrastructure Engineer to design, build, and maintain our cloud infrastructure and platform systems. You'll work closely with development teams to create scalable, reliable, and secure infrastructure that powers our products. Essential Duties and Responsibilities Designs, implements, and manages AWS cloud infrastructure, including VPCs, EC2, RDS, S3, IAM, Lambda, and other foundational services. Develops and maintains Terraform modules to provision and manage infrastructure in a repeatable, version-controlled manner. Deploys, manages, and optimizes Kubernetes clusters (EKS), handling workload orchestration, autoscaling, and resource management. Builds and improves continuous integration and deployment (CI/CD) pipelines to enable fast, safe, and automated releases. Implements logging, monitoring, and alerting solutions to ensure system health and enable rapid incident response. Applies strict infrastructure security best practices, manages secrets, and ensures compliance with internal security policies. Writes scripts and tools to automate operational tasks, reducing manual toil and improving the overall developer experience. Creates and maintains runbooks, architecture diagrams, and technical documentation. Partners with development teams to improve platform reliability and streamline application deployments. Participates in an on-call rotation schedule to respond to production incidents and ensure continuous system reliability. Designs and provisions cloud infrastructure specifically tailored to support scalable AI/LLM workloads and agentic systems, ensuring optimized compute resource allocation and high availability. Evaluates and integrates AI-driven DevOps tools and LLM-assisted automations into the platform workflow to accelerate incident response, infrastructure provisioning, and operational troubleshooting. Qualifications Location: This role is fully remote and open exclusively to candidates based in LATAM. Experience: 4+ years of proven experience in infrastructure, DevOps, or platform engineering. Strong proficiency with AWS services and modern cloud architecture patterns. Hands-on experience utilizing Terraform for Infrastructure as Code (IaC). Solid understanding of Kubernetes concepts (deployments, services, ingress, RBAC, Helm charts) and containerization utilizing Docker. Proficiency in TypeScript and Bash scripting. Familiarity with standard CI/CD tools (e.g., GitHub Actions, GitLab CI, ArgoCD). Strong understanding of networking fundamentals (DNS, load balancing, firewalls, VPNs). Hands-on experience provisioning infrastructure for AI agent frameworks (e.g., LangChain, LlamaIndex, CrewAI) or deploying LLMs in a production or near-production context. Strong troubleshooting, problem-solving, and cross-functional communication skills. Nice to Have: Experience coding in Golang. Knowledge of GitOps practices and tools (ArgoCD, Flux). Familiarity with modern observability stacks (Prometheus, Grafana, Datadog, ELK). AWS certifications (Solutions Architect, DevOps Engineer) or Kubernetes certifications (CKA/CKAD). Experience with service mesh implementations (Istio, Linkerd) and FinOps practices for cost optimization. Compensation Additional Information

The engineer plays a critical role in maintaining high standards for product releases and improving the overall quality assurance process, while actively pioneering the integration of AI and LLM tools into the testing lifecycle. What you’ll be responsible for, the QA engineer: - Analyzes product specifications to derive comprehensive and testable acceptance criteria. Collaborates with product managers and developers to clarify requirements and identify potential edge cases. Designs, implements, and maintains a robust suite of automated tests, including end-to-end, integration, and regression tests. You’ll work within one of our autonomous product pods, taking ownership of projects end-to-end, from technical design through production, and mentoring the engineers around you. Our stack is TypeScript/Node.js microservices deployed on Kubernetes, paired with React front ends. You’ll work across the entire stack, backend and frontend, as needed to deliver on your pod’s goals, collaborating with engineers in other pods when initiatives cross boundaries. drive delivery from design through deployment Code Quality : Write well-tested, maintainable code; conduct thorough code reviews (including AI-generated code) and hold a high bar for the team Mentorship : Mentor junior and mid-level engineers, including on effective and responsible use of AI tooling; share knowledge and elevate the team’s technical practices Cross-Pod Collaboration : Coordinate with engineers in other pods when work crosses service boundaries; contribute code to shared services following established ownership guidelines On-Call : Participate in on-call rotation for services the pod owns; lead incident response and post-incident reviews Technical Debt : Proactively identify and address technical debt; balance short-term delivery with long-term health of the systems Required Qualifications 5+ years of professional software engineering experience, with demonstrated full stack range (backend services and frontend UIs) Proficiency in TypeScript and Node.js for building production services Proficiency in React for building production-facing UIs (state management, component design, performance) Experience designing and building REST or GraphQL APIs Solid understanding of relational databases (PostgreSQL or similar), modeling, query optimization, and migrations Familiarity with event-driven architecture and messaging patterns (Kafka, SQS, or similar) Experience working in a microservices environment Hands-on, day-to-day experience with AI-assisted development tools (e.g., GitHub Copilot, Cursor, Claude Code, Zed’s Agentic editing, or similar) for coding, debugging, and code review; comfort with prompt/context engineering and sound judgment about validating AI-generated output Strong grasp of software design principles : separation of concerns, error handling, testing strategies Experience writing unit, integration, and end-to-end tests Comfort operating in a cloud environment (AWS preferred), understanding of deployments, logs, and basic infrastructure concepts Strong communication skills; proactive about sharing progress, blockers, and technical risks Nice to Have Experience building or integrating AI/LLM-powered features into products (RAG, agents, tool calling, prompt pipelines) Familiarity with Kubernetes and container-based deployments Background in fintech, payments, or financial systems Experience working with GraphQL (schema design, federation, or tooling) Knowledge of CI/CD pipelines (Bitbucket Pipelines, GitHub Actions, ArgoCD) Familiarity with observability tooling (Datadog, Prometheus, Grafana) Experience mentoring engineers or leading technical design discussions What We Look For Beyond the technical skills, we’re looking for engineers who: Take ownership , they drive their work to completion and communicate early when something is at risk Write code for the next engineer , clean, tested, and documented, whether they or an AI tool wrote the first draft Improve the team around them, through reviews, mentorship, and knowledge sharing Collaborate across boundaries , they engage other pods constructively when work crosses service lines Have good technical judgment , they balance pragmatism with quality, know when to push back on scope, and know when (and when not) to lean on AI tooling Compensation Additional Information

title: Area Sales Manager Central Italy (Lazio and Abruzzo)
description: Ajax Systems is an international tech company and the largest manufacturer of security systems in Europe, with over 4.5 million end users and 330K PRO users in more than 180 countries worldwide. The company offers end-to-end solutions for protecting homes and businesses оf any scale. To date, Ajax product portfolio includes 280 devices for intrusion protection, video surveillance, fire and life safety, and comfort and automation. The company employs 5,000 specialists. We develop local teams because we understand local experts best comprehend market specifics. The company has sales representatives worldwide, including Norway, Sweden, Denmark, Finland, Italy, Spain, Germany, France, the United Kingdom, the USA, Australia, South Africa, and other regions. The Global Business Development team is like-minded people who share the ambitious goals of Ajax Systems. The best software combined with powerful hardware has forever changed the perception of security systems for users and industry professionals. Being recognized at the biggest specialized exhibitions such as IFSEC, Expoprotection, and Intersec, as well as winning prestigious awards from industry-leading media like PSI magazine and GIT SECURITY, today Ajax is one of the most awarded security systems in Europe. Ajax Systems production includes 4 factories, 2 of which are located in Ukraine, 1 in Turkey, and 1 in Vietnam. At the same time, the company's certification according to the ISO 14001 standard ensures a minimal impact of production on the environment. The selection of components for Ajax device manufacturing is determined by the presence of manufacturer declarations confirming compliance with RoHS requirements. The company emerged against the backdrop of revolution and war. That's why resilience is the cornerstone of the brand's DNA, and the fight against evil by creating the best security and automation devices is Ajax unwavering mission. Personality profile: 3+ years of experience in the electronic security industry or a similar industry. Proven sales experience in the Central Italy (Lazio and Abruzzo) region. Strong technical knowledge of electronic security systems, including access control, video surveillance, intrusion detection, or fire alarm systems. Proven track record of being involved in the entire sales process, from identifying new business opportunities, developing proposals and presentations, negotiating, and closing deals. Developing and implementing successful sales strategies. Excellent communication and interpersonal skills to build relationships with customers, partners, and industry experts at an executive level. Strong analytical skills to analyze market trends, identify customer needs, and develop effective solutions. Ability to manage and prioritize multiple projects and tasks simultaneously. Knowledge of the latest technologies and trends in electronic security, such as cloud-based solutions, IoT, and AI-based analytics. A strong combination of technical knowledge, sales expertise, and strong communication skills. Responsibilities: Develop and implement a strategic business development plan in Italy, aligned with company objectives and market trends. Identify, evaluate, and onboard new distributors and partners across the region, ensuring coverage in key markets and verticals. Identify and pursue new business opportunities that align with the company's growth strategy. Develop and maintain relationships with key clients, partners, and stakeholders. Conduct market research to identify new trends, opportunities, and potential risks. Analyze market data to develop and execute effective sales strategies. Collaborate with cross-functional teams to ensure the successful delivery of products and services. Prepare and deliver presentations to potential clients and partners. Negotiate contracts and agreements with clients and partners. Manage and prioritize multiple projects and initiatives simultaneously. We offer: Competitive compensation that includes a base salary and performance-related bonuses. A product that sells itself. Freedom to make decisions and implement ideas. A zero bullshit culture. A strong and well-coordinated team of professionals. Ambitious tasks and challenges. Opportunity to work with the most recognized security system and develop your career. Car allowance and all business expenses and work tools are covered by the company. Compensation Additional Information We are working to ensure that people's lives are calm and the world safe. Let's become a part of the team that creates in Ukraine a smart and useful global product.

title: Opticien (contrat freelance)
description: Qui est Alan ? En France, des millions de personnes renoncent aux soins faute de temps, d'accès ou de moyens. Alan est né pour changer ça — en combinant assurance santé et clinique virtuelle dans une seule application pour devenir un vrai partenaire santé . L'optique est au cœur de la promesse d’Alan "La santé ne peut pas attendre". Avec l 'Alan Shop , nos membres achètent lunettes et lentilles de contact depuis l'application ; avec notre réseau d'opticiens partenaires , ils sont mieux remboursés en magasin ; et nos équipes Fraude veillent à ce que chaque euro remboursé le soit à bon escient. Nous avons prouvé qu'une assurance santé pouvait vendre de l'optique en ligne. Nous voulons maintenant passer à l'échelle, avec un·e opticien·ne supplémentaire dans l'équipe. Ce que nous recherchons Ce opticien·ne diplômé·e, à l'aise avec le conseil à distance et motivé·e pour rejoindre l'équipe d'opticiens prenant en charge les différentes missions autours de l'optique d'Alan Shop. Les missions : Chat optique. Répondre à nos membres sur l'application (choix de monture, lecture d'ordonnance, verres, lentilles, questions d'optique au sens large), avec le ton Alan : clair, bienveillant, personnalisé. Validation des commandes de lentilles de contact. Contrôler les ordonnances que notre outil automatique ne peut pas valider, et signaler les suspicions de fraude (dates modifiées, documents falsifiés) à notre équipe dédiée. « Mon Opticien au Travail ». Animer des journées de conseil et de vente sur site chez nos entreprises clientes, sur la France entière et en priorité en Île-de-France : accueil des salariés, conseil visagiste, prise de mesures, aide au choix de la monture. Amélioration continue. Partager vos retours terrain pour faire évoluer le service, et potentiellement être investi de potentielles missions additionnelles comme : contribuer à la montée en puissance de Mo, notre compagnon santé IA, sur les questions d'optique simples étoffer le catalogue de montures de l’Alan Shop en collaboration avec le Marketing pour créer les collections accompagner la mise à l’échelle et les mises à jour du réseau Alan Optique notamment sur les mises à jour des grilles tarifaires améliorer les journées “Mon Opticien au Travail” avec l’équipe commerciale pour maximiser la satisfaction, l’expérience et la conversion de ces évènements. ⭐️ Le profil Est-ce que vous vous reconnaissez ? ✅ Diplôme d'opticien·ne lunetier·ère (BTS Opticien Lunetier ou équivalent) — indispensable, avec numéro d'inscription à jour. ✅ Au moins 3 ans d'expérience en magasin , idéalement avec une forte dimension conseil et style (visagisme, colorimétrie : un vrai plus). ✅ Maîtrise des lentilles de contact et de la lecture d'ordonnances, y compris les cas complexes (toriques, multifocales). ✅ Basé·e à Paris ou en Île-de-France , disponible pour des journées sur site. ✅ Disponible sur des horaires flexibles, y compris le soir ou le weekend pour le chat, avec de la souplesse pour absorber des pics. ✅ À l'aise avec les outils digitaux ; curieux·se d'une pratique de l'optique en ligne et enthousiaste à l'idée d'intégrer l'IA dans son quotidien. ✅ Excellente expression écrite en français ; l'anglais est un plus. ✅ Statut indépendant (micro-entreprise ou société), ou prêt·e à le créer. Pourquoi rejoindre Alan ? Des conditions claires. 25 € hors taxes de l'heure du lundi au samedi, 30 € hors taxes de l'heure le dimanche, facturés mensuellement sur la base des créneaux que vous déclarez. Les journées « Mon Opticien au Travail » sont rémunérées à la journée (de l'ordre de 500 à 750 € hors taxes selon le format), frais de déplacement et d'hébergement pris en charge. Une vraie flexibilité. Vous choisissez vos créneaux de chat en concertation avec l'équipe. Une petite équipe d'opticiens avec qui échanger sur les cas complexes, et une interlocutrice unique côté Alan. Un service en construction. Vous participez à la façon dont une assurance santé fait de l'optique en ligne et hors ligne : catalogue, parcours, nouveaux formats d'événements, place pour l'IA dans le parcours de soins. Chez Alan, les opticiens sont au cœur de ces réflexions et contribuent à faire évoluer les pratiques.

title: Clinical Operations Lead
description: Alimentiv is a global CRO with a singular focus: advancing therapies for patients with gastrointestinal diseases. GI is our WHY and for more than 30 years that purpose has driven our scientific rigour, operational excellence, and deep therapeutic expertise, including supporting more than 70% of IBD compounds in development. We operate as a private, profit-with-purpose company, channeling our commercial success back into scientific research, technology, and our people. With approximately 700 people across multiple countries and three service lines, we are growing deliberately, and the capability of our leaders and our organization is central to how we get there. If you want to do meaningful work, build something real, and invest back in research that changes lives — we want to meet you! Job Overview As a Clinical Operations Lead , you will provide clinical operations oversight for projects at a regional or global level, ensuring study deliverables, CRA activities and investigator sites are managed in accordance with the protocol, monitoring plan, ICH-GCP guidelines and applicable local regulations. You will act as a key liaison between CRAs and the clinical project team, providing operational guidance, training and oversight throughout the study. The role will also support site start-up and feasibility, recruitment and enrolment strategies, monitoring performance, issue escalation and corrective actions, while contributing to study planning, documentation and overall project delivery. Key Responsabilities Provide oversight of regional CRAs and investigator sites, ensuring compliance with study protocols, monitoring plans, ICH-GCP, local regulations and study timelines. Conduct co-monitoring and CRA assessment visits as required, supporting site and CRA performance and ensuring monitoring standards are maintained. Proactively monitor site and country performance, including recruitment, data collection, document collection and TMF activities, and communicate progress to the clinical project team. Oversee regional site start-up and feasibility activities and support vendor management activities where required. Review monitoring visit reports for quality, compliance and appropriate site management, ensuring project deliverables are completed accurately and on time. Serve as a key point of contact for regional CRAs, providing study-specific guidance, resolving issues and escalating matters to the Project Manager or relevant functions when appropriate. Provide training and mentoring to CRAs on study procedures, clinical plans, guidelines and timelines, and ensure study-specific training is completed and documented. Participate in Sponsor meetings and CRA calls, providing updates on country and site performance and operational progress. Develop and implement enrolment and recruitment strategies and create study tools, training materials, monitoring plans and other clinical operations documentation. Support the clinical project team with study deliverables, presentations, site management activities, protocol deviations, financial project activities and other operational objectives as required. Skills & Qualifications 4–6 years of relevant clinical research experience required, with 7–9 years preferred. Minimum 3 years of CRA experience, with strong hands-on understanding of clinical monitoring activities. Post-secondary certificate/diploma required; a Bachelor’s degree in Health Sciences, Life Sciences, Nursing or a related discipline is preferred. Strong understanding of ICH-GCP, local regulations, IRB/EC requirements and Investigator responsibilities as they relate to clinical monitoring. Experience working with EDC systems and clinical research documentation. Strong understanding of clinical trial processes, site management, monitoring activities and study performance metrics. Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to effectively communicate with CRAs, Sponsors, investigators and cross-functional teams. Strong organisational, interpersonal and project coordination skills, with the ability to manage multiple priorities and deadlines in a dynamic environment. Highly proactive, detail-oriented, task-driven and organised, with strong problem-solving and critical-thinking abilities. Proficiency in Microsoft Office and demonstrated ability to prepare high-quality reports, presentations and clinical research documentation. SoCRA and/or ACRP certification/designation is an advantage. What We Offer In addition, as an Alimentiv Employee, you’re also eligible for the following programs: Education Reimbursement program for full-time employees Monthly Cell Phone and Remote Work Allowance (dependent on role eligibility) One time office setup allowance (can be used to purchase a scanner/printer, extra monitor, office furniture, etc.) Working while visiting program – up to 4 weeks per year! Flexible Summer Hours Program from May – September Employee referral incentive – we know great people know other great people, and we think that warrants recognition! Full-time employees also become beneficiaries of the Alimentiv Trust after one year of employment, and permanent members after 5 years of employment Optional formal mentorship program (Alimentorship); country/region annual social events in person; leadership development programs for people leaders in accordance with your seniority; social committee and several other optional initiatives designed to support you in feeling like part of the Alimentiv team! Additional benefits may be available depending on the country of employment and are subject to local policies and eligibility. title: Payroll Specialist
description: The Payroll Specialist exists to ensure the accurate, complaint, and timely delivery of global payroll across all countries in which Alimentiv operates, maintaining a high standard of employee trust and satisfaction. The role provides subject matter expertise to manage complex payroll legislation, monthly reconciliations, government remittances, and external vendor relationships within a global, shared-services environment. Reporting to the Sr. Manager, People & Culture, the Payroll Specialist partners closely with HR and Finance to ensure payroll practices align with organizational and regulatory requirements. The role is distinguished from the Payroll Coordinator by its accountability for full-cycle, multi-country payroll processing, independent compliance interpretation, and active contribution to continuous improvement and payroll modernization. Payroll Processing (40%) Execute full-cycle, multi-country payroll processing for all Alimentiv employees, ensuring accuracy, timeliness, and compliance with applicable legislation across Canada, the United States, and global EOR jurisdictions. Validate and reconcile payroll inputs including new hires, terminations, salary changes, bonuses, and statutory deductions prior to each pay run. Prepare and submit government remittances, statutory filings, and year-end reporting obligations including T4s, W-2s, and other country-specific requirements. Manage off-cycle and adjustment payrolls as required, ensuring appropriate documentation and audit trails. Maintain payroll records in accordance with regulatory retention requirements and organizational data governance standards. Stakeholder Service and Communication (35%) Serve as the primary point of contact for employee payroll inquiries, resolving pay questions with accuracy and professionalism. Serve as the primary escalation point for Payroll Coordinators, investigating and resolving complex payroll issues, exceptions, and inquiries that require advanced knowledge or judgment beyond standard processing procedures. Collaborate with Finance on payroll reconciliations, journal entries, and budget reporting to ensure alignment across financial systems. Coordinate with HR Business Partners and People Operations on employee lifecycle events affecting payroll, including leaves, benefits elections, and terminations. Liaise with external payroll vendors and government agencies on remittance matters, regulatory inquiries, and service deliver. Compliance and Audit (10%) Monitor changes to payroll legislation, tax regulations, and employment standards across all jurisdictions in which Alimentiv operates and implement required updates. Prepare payroll-related documentation and data in support of internal and external audits, responding to auditor inquiries with accuracy and timeliness. Identify and escalate payroll compliance risks, recommending corrective actions where applicable. Ensure payroll processes align with SOX controls, SOC 2 requirements, and other applicable governance frameworks. Continuous Improvement and Systems (10%) Identify and lead opportunities to streamline payroll workflows, reduce manual effort, and improve data accuracy across the payroll cycle. Support the configuration, testing, and optimization of payroll and HRIS modules to ensure system integrity and alignment with business requirements. Contribute to payroll modernization initiatives including vendor transitions, system implementations, and process redesign projects. Maintain payroll system data governance practices, including access controls and validation processes. Team Capability and Mentorship (5%) Provide guidance and on-the-job mentoring to Payroll Coordinators and junior payroll staff to build team capability and ensure consistent payroll execution. Develop and maintain training materials, process guides, and documentation that reduce knowledge dependency and support team development. Qualifications Minimum of 4 - 6 years of related experience Post-secondary certificate / diploma (College, Training Institute, etc.) Fluent writing, reading, and oral communication in English Additional Knowledge and Skills In-depth knowledge of global payroll legislation (e.g. United Kingdom, Netherlands, Germany, Poland, Romania, Canada, United States, Brazil, Australia) payroll legislation, tax regulations, and employment standards across multiple jurisdictions. Hands-on experience with payroll systems and HRIS platforms, including system configuration, data validation, and reporting. Strong proficiency in payroll reconciliation, journal entries, and financial reporting processes. Familiarity with global EOR payroll models and multi-country payroll vendor management. Working knowledge of SOX controls, SOC 2 requirements, and payroll audit practices. Advanced proficiency in Microsoft Excel for data analysis, reconciliation, and reporting. Ability to manage competing deadlines with a high degree of accuracy and attention to detail. Discretion and professionalism in handling confidential employee and financial information. Professional payroll designation is strongly preferred Compensation Additional Information

title: Mobile Engineer - React Native (Paris or Remote France)
description: About Alma At Alma, we believe sustainable commerce depends on fair, well‑balanced trade. Because finance plays a pivotal role in business, our mission is to put it back in its rightful place - serving merchants and consumers. Our installment and deferred payment solutions help merchants boost sales by 20% or more, increase customer loyalty, and deliver a seamless shopping experience - without encouraging bad debt. As the buy now pay later leader in France and active in 10 European countries, we've empowered over +25,000 merchants and 10 million consumers. With 400+ Almakers and €100M+ ARR, Alma is scaling rapidly across Europe as a member of the Next40, and we're just getting started! About the team The Consumer Tribe builds the Alma app for consumers. To tackle more topics and accelerate the development of the consumer experience, the current Consumer squad is splitting into two dedicated squads: Alma Wallet and Consumer Engagement. Alma Wallet builds the payment experience of the app. With the Alma card, consumers can pay with Alma anywhere, not only at our partner merchants. In the app, they can manage their payments using Apple Pay, Google Pay or local payment methods. By taking Alma beyond our merchant network, the Alma card is one of the company's key strategic bets. Consumer Engagement drives consumer activation, engagement and long-term retention by helping people get more value from Alma. The team builds experiences that make it easier for consumers to discover partner merchants, benefit from loyalty and cashback rewards, and manage their account independently. In 2027, the focus is on turning Alma into a more engaging, everyday consumer experience by strengthening loyalty, increasing repeat usage and making Consumer Engagement a key driver of Alma's long-term growth. This is a new position created as the consumer app organization splits into two squads to tackle more topics. You will join one of these squads and work closely with its Engineering Manager, Product Manager, Designer and back-end engineers. You will report to Gautier Labarre , Engineering Manager . This position is a permanent contract (CDI), open to full remote from Metropolitan France. About the job Build and ship meaningful consumer experiences: Develop and release new features in the Alma app from design to production, working closely with Product, Design and back-end engineers. Make payments simple and secure: Integrate payment SDKs and native mobile capabilities such as Apple Pay, Google Pay, card management, biometrics and secure storage. Raise the quality bar of the app: Keep the application fast, reliable and maintainable through automated testing, monitoring, code reviews and continuous performance improvements. Help the team learn and move forward: Contribute to technical decisions, challenge product and back-end implementation when needed, and improve the team’s architecture, tooling and release processes. Tests: Jest, Testing Library, Maestro. Payments: Adyen, Stripe, Checkout.com SDKs. Observability: Datadog, Sentry, OpenTelemetry, OpenFeature. Back-end: Python, FastAPI. Tools: GitHub, Linear, Notion, Figma, Crowdin, Claude. You have a strong understanding of the React Native ecosystem, including Expo, navigation, state management and data fetching. You care deeply about software quality and have experience with testing, code reviews, monitoring and mobile performance. You are fluent in English and comfortable working in a cross-functional, international environment. And it will be nice if you also Have worked on payment products, fintech products or other security-sensitive applications. Have experience contributing to a consumer application used at scale. The Corporate Sales team is verticalized with a focus on the Fortune 1000 in the following sectors: Life Sciences, Technology, Media, and Telecom, Energy and Industrials, Consulting, and Consumer Packaged Goods. AlphaSense already earns meaningful inbound government revenue, entirely unsolicited, and our product consistently stacks up against legacy providers, who are winning multi-million dollar competitive contracts in this space. Tenacious and coachable: You are hard-working with a ‘never give up’ attitude, open to feedback, and resourceful in getting things done where no playbook exists. What You’ll Do: Be the first AlphaSense presence at priority agencies, including Commerce, Defense, Energy, Labor, Justice, Treasury, the Federal Reserve, and FDIC, and generate pipeline from scratch through your own outreach. Take responsibility for the end-to-end sales process: research opportunities, prospect, build relationships, conduct demos, manage product trials, and most importantly: close deals! Follow up on existing inbound government customers and interest, turning it into expansion and competitive wins against legacy providers. Partner with SDRs, Marketing, and sales leadership to create prospecting plans and drive pipeline. Forecast accurately and develop the necessary pipeline to meet/exceed quota. Work closely with our Product Specialist team during trials to ensure client engagement and ultimate purchase. Establish clear ownership and enable teams to handle routine matters within agreed guidelines. Manage disputes and outside counsel. Approximately 6+ years of relevant employment-law experience, including substantial experience counseling employers directly. Strong knowledge of U.S. employment law, including California and multistate issues, and experience applying that knowledge to practical workplace decisions. Experience advising on sensitive employee relations matters, investigations, performance management, accommodations, and separations. Experience supporting international employment matters and coordinating with local counsel. The ability to give a clear recommendation when facts are incomplete, distinguish material risks from manageable ones, and escalate appropriately. Strong drafting, communication, and relationship-building skills, with discretion, empathy, and sound judgment. A track record of managing competing priorities and carrying matters through to completion. An interest in improving how work gets done through practical tools, training, and repeatable processes. Experience that would be especially valuable In-house employment counseling at a technology company or another business with a distributed workforce. Experience with employment disputes, workforce changes, contractor classification, or employer-of-record arrangements. Experience developing employment playbooks, document workflows, or tools that enable People teams to operate more independently. Experience with employment counseling for teams in the UK, Mexico, Colombia, Poland, the Philippines, India or Canada. What success looks like People partners trust your advice and involve you early. Sensitive matters receive timely, well-supported recommendations and clear follow-through. Recurring questions become useful guidance and workflows. International advice is coordinated effectively, and the team has better visibility into open matters, priorities, and emerging risks.
